namespace DevExpress.Utils

	public enum FontIconsStyle
	{
		Latest,
		Win10
	}
	public static class FontIconsResolver
	{
		public const string fontIconsFamily = "dx-font-icons";

		private const string fluentIcons = "segoe fluent icons";

		private const string mdlAssets = "segoe mdl2 assets";

		private static readonly string latest;

		private static readonly string win10;

		private static readonly char[] trimChars;

		internal static FontIconsStyle IconsStyle { get; set; }

		static FontIconsResolver()
		{
			trimChars = new char[3] { '"', ' ', '\'' };
			IconsStyle = FontIconsStyle.Latest;
			latest = "segoe fluent icons, segoe mdl2 assets";
			win10 = "segoe mdl2 assets";
		}

		internal static string ResolveFontName(string input)
		{
			if (string.Equals(input.Trim(trimChars), "dx-font-icons", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
			{
				return IconsStyle switch
				{
					FontIconsStyle.Latest => latest, 
					FontIconsStyle.Win10 => win10, 
					_ => latest, 
				};
			}
			return input;
		}
	}
}

	public enum SvgImageRenderingMode
	{
		Default,
		HighSpeed,
		HighQuality
	}
	public class SvgBitmap : ISvgBitmap
	{
		private static string EmptySvgImagePath = "Utils.Svg.Resources.EmptySvgImage.svg";

		private static int DefaultLenght = 1536;

		private static int AdditionalLenght = 100;

		private PointF drawingOffset;

		private SvgImage svgImageCore;

		private ISvgElementWrapperFactory wrapperFactory;

		[ThreadStatic]
		internal static Image bufferedImage;

		[ThreadStatic]
		internal static DXBitmap bufferedDXImage;

		private readonly SvgRenderedImageCache renderedImageCache;

		private IEnumerable<SvgElementWrapper> rootElements;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static SvgImageRenderingMode? localSvgImageRenderingMode;

		private static SvgImageRenderingMode globalSvgImageRenderingMode;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static object DisabledTag = new object();

		private Type[] indirectElementTypes = new Type[2]
		{
			typeof(SvgDefinitionsWrapper),
			typeof(SvgClipPathWrapper)
		};

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static ImageAttributes transparentAttributes;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static SvgImageRenderingMode SvgImageRenderingMode
		{
			get
			{
				return localSvgImageRenderingMode.GetValueOrDefault(globalSvgImageRenderingMode);
			}
			set
			{
				globalSvgImageRenderingMode = value;
			}
		}

		protected SvgRenderedImageCache RenderedImageCache => renderedImageCache;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public List<SvgElementWrapper> Elements { get; set; }

		public double Scale { get; set; }

		public SvgImage SvgImage => svgImageCore;

		public PointF DrawingOffset

				rootElements = value;
			}

		public SvgBitmap(SvgImage svgImage)
		{
			Elements = new List<SvgElementWrapper>(svgImage.Elements.Count);
			svgImageCore = svgImage;
			if (svgImage.Width < 16.0 && svgImage.Height < 16.0)
			{
				Scale = (int)(768.0 / Math.Max(svgImage.Width, svgImage.Height)) + 1;
				Scale -= Scale % 16.0;
			}
			else if (svgImage.Width < 32.0 && svgImage.Height < 32.0)
			{
				Scale = 32.0;
			}
			else if (svgImage.Width > 96.0 || svgImage.Height > 96.0)
			{
				Scale = (int)((double)DefaultLenght / Math.Max(svgImage.Width, svgImage.Height));
				if (Scale > 2.0)
				{
					Scale -= Scale % 2.0;
				}
				if (Scale < 14.0)
				{
					Scale = 1.0;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Scale = 16.0;
			}
			DrawingOffset = new PointF((float)((0.0 - SvgImage.OffsetX) * Scale), (float)((0.0 - SvgImage.OffsetY) * Scale));
			wrapperFactory = CreateFactory();
			rootElements = WrapElements(SvgImage.Elements).ToArray();
			renderedImageCache = new SvgRenderedImageCache();
			svgImage.Owner = this;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void ForceHighSpeedRendering(Action render)
		{
			localSvgImageRenderingMode = SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed;
			try
			{
				render?.Invoke();
			}
			finally
			{
				localSvgImageRenderingMode = null;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static T ForceHighSpeedRendering<T>(Func<T> render)
		{
			localSvgImageRenderingMode = SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed;
			try
			{
				if (render != null)
				{
					return render();
				}
				return default(T);
			}
			finally
			{
				localSvgImageRenderingMode = null;
			}
		}

		public static SvgBitmap FromFile(string path)
		{
			return new SvgBitmap(SvgLoader.LoadFromFile(path));
		}

		public static SvgBitmap FromStream(Stream stream)
		{
			return new SvgBitmap(SvgLoader.LoadFromStream(stream));
		}

		public static SvgBitmap Create(SvgImage svgImage)
		{
			return (svgImage.Owner as SvgBitmap) ?? new SvgBitmap(svgImage);
		}

		protected virtual ISvgElementWrapperFactory CreateFactory()
		{
			return SvgElementWrapperFactory.Default;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetRenderedImage(bool disposeImage)
		{
			if (RenderedImageCache.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Image[] array = new Image[RenderedImageCache.Count];
			Dictionary<SvgImageKey, IDisposable>.ValueCollection values = RenderedImageCache.Values;
			IDisposable[] array2 = array;
			values.CopyTo(array2, 0);
			RenderedImageCache.Clear();
			if (disposeImage)
			{
				Image[] array3 = array;
				foreach (Image image in array3)
				{
					image.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public SvgElementWrapper WrapElement(SvgElement element)
		{
			SvgElementWrapper svgElementWrapper = wrapperFactory.Wrap(element);
			svgElementWrapper.Owner = this;
			return svgElementWrapper;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<SvgElementWrapper> WrapElements(IList<SvgElement> elements)
		{
			foreach (SvgElement element in elements)
			{
				SvgElementWrapper svgElementWrapper = wrapperFactory.Wrap(element);
				if (svgElementWrapper != null)
				{
					svgElementWrapper.Owner = this;
					Elements.Add(svgElementWrapper);
					svgElementWrapper.Childs.AddRange(WrapElements(element.Elements));
					yield return svgElementWrapper;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Save(string path)
		{
			SvgSerializer.SaveSvgImageToXML(path, SvgImage);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static SvgBitmap Create(Size size)
		{
			SvgBitmap svgBitmap = null;
			try
			{
				Assembly assembly = Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(SvgImage));
				Stream embeddedResourceStream = AssemblyHelper.GetEmbeddedResourceStream(assembly, EmptySvgImagePath, false);
				svgBitmap = FromStream(embeddedResourceStream);
				svgBitmap.SvgImage.Root.Background.Height = size.Height;
				svgBitmap.SvgImage.Root.Background.Width = size.Width;
				svgBitmap.SvgImage.Root.ViewBox.Height = size.Height;
				svgBitmap.SvgImage.Root.ViewBox.Width = size.Width;
				embeddedResourceStream.Close();
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return svgBitmap;
		}

		public void ClearCache(bool disposeImages)
		{
			IDisposable[] array = RenderedImageCache.Values.ToArray();
			RenderedImageCache.Clear();
			if (disposeImages)
			{
				IDisposable[] array2 = array;
				foreach (IDisposable disposable in array2)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void DisposeBufferedImage()
		{
			bufferedImage?.Dispose();
			bufferedDXImage?.Dispose();
		}

		public Image Render(Size imageSize, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider, DefaultBoolean useHighSpeedRendering = (DefaultBoolean)2, DefaultBoolean allowCache = (DefaultBoolean)2)
		{
			//IL_00bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c9: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Image image = null;
			SvgImageKey key = new SvgImageKey(string.Empty, imageSize, paletteProvider);
			if (renderedImageCache.TryGetValue(key, out image))
			{
				if (!ImageGuard.IsDisposedOrInvalid(image))
				{
					return image;
				}
				renderedImageCache.Remove(key);
			}
			if (bufferedImage == null || ImageGuard.IsDisposedOrInvalid(bufferedImage) || imageSize.Height > DefaultLenght || imageSize.Width > DefaultLenght)
			{
				bufferedImage?.Dispose();
				bufferedImage = new Bitmap(Math.Max(DefaultLenght, imageSize.Width), Math.Max(DefaultLenght, imageSize.Height), PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
			}
			image = RenderCore(imageSize, paletteProvider, bufferedImage, Scale, useHighSpeedRendering);
			if ((int)allowCache != 1)
			{
				if (renderedImageCache.Count > 5)
				{
					renderedImageCache.Remove(renderedImageCache.Keys.First());
				}
				renderedImageCache.Add(key, image);
			}
			return image;
		}

		protected internal Image RenderCore(Size imageSize, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider, Image bufferedImage, double scale, DefaultBoolean useHighSpeedRendering)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double width = SvgImage.Width;
			double height = SvgImage.Height;
			using (Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bufferedImage))
			{
				if (IsHighSpeedRender(scale, useHighSpeedRendering))
				{
					graphics.TextRenderingHint = TextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;
					graphics.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.Half;
					graphics.CompositingQuality = CompositingQuality.HighQuality;
					graphics.TextContrast = 1;
					localSvgImageRenderingMode = SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed;
					double num = Math.Max((double)imageSize.Width / width, (double)imageSize.Height / height);
					if (width > (double)DefaultLenght || height > (double)DefaultLenght || num > 0.0715)
					{
						scale = num;
					}
				}
				graphics.SetClip(new Rectangle(0, 0, (int)(width * scale) + AdditionalLenght, (int)(height * scale) + AdditionalLenght));
				graphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
				using SvgGraphics g = new SvgGraphics(graphics);
				foreach (SvgElementWrapper rootElement in rootElements)
				{
					rootElement.Render(g, paletteProvider, scale);
				}
			}
			Image image = ScaleImg(imageSize, new Size((int)Math.Ceiling(width * scale), (int)Math.Ceiling(height * scale)), bufferedImage, (paletteProvider != null) ? paletteProvider.Opacity : 1.0);
			if (paletteProvider is ISvgPaletteProviderExt)
			{
				image.Tag = (((ISvgPaletteProviderExt)((paletteProvider is ISvgPaletteProviderExt) ? paletteProvider : null)).Disabled ? DisabledTag : null);
			}
			localSvgImageRenderingMode = null;
			return image;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DXImage RenderDXImage(Size imageSize, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider = null)
		{
			SvgImageKey key = new SvgImageKey(string.Empty, imageSize, paletteProvider);
			if (renderedImageCache.TryGetValue(key, out DXImage image))
			{
				if (!image.IsDisposedOrInvalid)
				{
					return image;
				}
				renderedImageCache.Remove(key);
			}
			if (bufferedDXImage == null || bufferedDXImage.IsDisposedOrInvalid || imageSize.Height > DefaultLenght || imageSize.Width > DefaultLenght)
			{
				bufferedDXImage?.Dispose();
				bufferedDXImage = new DXBitmap(Math.Max(DefaultLenght, imageSize.Width), Math.Max(DefaultLenght, imageSize.Height));
			}
			image = RenderDXImageCore(imageSize, paletteProvider, bufferedDXImage, Scale);
			if (renderedImageCache.Count > 5)
			{
				renderedImageCache.Remove(renderedImageCache.Keys.First());
			}
			renderedImageCache.Add(key, image);
			return image;
		}

		protected internal DXImage RenderDXImageCore(Size imageSize, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider, DXBitmap bufferedImage, double scale)
		{
			double width = SvgImage.Width;
			double height = SvgImage.Height;
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = bufferedImage.CreateGraphics())
			{
				iDXGraphics.TextRenderingHint = DXTextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;
				iDXGraphics.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.Half;
				iDXGraphics.CompositingQuality = DXCompositingQuality.HighQuality;
				localSvgImageRenderingMode = SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed;
				double num = Math.Max((double)imageSize.Width / width, (double)imageSize.Height / height);
				if (width > (double)DefaultLenght || height > (double)DefaultLenght || num > 0.0715)
				{
					scale = num;
				}
				iDXGraphics.SetClip(new Rectangle(0, 0, (int)(width * scale) + AdditionalLenght, (int)(height * scale) + AdditionalLenght));
				iDXGraphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
				using SvgDXGraphics g = new SvgDXGraphics(iDXGraphics);
				foreach (SvgElementWrapper rootElement in RootElements)
				{
					rootElement.Render(g, paletteProvider, scale);
				}
			}
			DXImage result = ScaleDXImg(imageSize, new Size((int)Math.Ceiling(width * scale), (int)Math.Ceiling(height * scale)), bufferedImage, (paletteProvider != null) ? paletteProvider.Opacity : 1.0);
			localSvgImageRenderingMode = null;
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsHighSpeedRender(double scale, DefaultBoolean useHighSpeedRendering)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)useHighSpeedRendering == 2)
			{
				if (scale != 1.0 && SvgImageRenderingMode != SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed)
				{
					return Environment.OSVersion.Version.Major < 6;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (Environment.OSVersion.Version.Major >= 6)
			{
				return (int)useHighSpeedRendering == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public Image Render(ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider, double scaleFactor, DefaultBoolean useHighSpeedRendering = (DefaultBoolean)2, DefaultBoolean allowCache = (DefaultBoolean)2)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Size imageSize = new Size((int)(SvgImage.Width * scaleFactor), (int)(SvgImage.Height * scaleFactor));
			return Render(imageSize, paletteProvider, useHighSpeedRendering, allowCache);
		}

		public void RenderToGraphics(Graphics g, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider = null, double scaleFactor = 1.0, DefaultBoolean useHighSpeedRendering = (DefaultBoolean)2)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GraphicsState gstate = g.Save();
			try
			{
				if ((int)useHighSpeedRendering == 0)
				{
					localSvgImageRenderingMode = SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed;
					g.TextRenderingHint = TextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;
					g.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.Half;
					g.TextContrast = 1;
				}
				g.CompositingQuality = CompositingQuality.HighSpeed;
				using SvgGraphics g2 = new SvgGraphics(g);
				foreach (SvgElementWrapper rootElement in rootElements)
				{
					rootElement.Render(g2, paletteProvider, scaleFactor);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				localSvgImageRenderingMode = null;
				g.Restore(gstate);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void RenderToDXGraphics(IDXGraphics g, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider = null, double scaleFactor = 1.0, DefaultBoolean useHighSpeedRendering = (DefaultBoolean)2)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object state = g.Save();
			try
			{
				if ((int)useHighSpeedRendering == 0)
				{
					localSvgImageRenderingMode = SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed;
					g.TextRenderingHint = DXTextRenderingHint.AntiAlias;
					g.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.Half;
					if (g is GdiPlusGraphics)
					{
						((GdiPlusGraphics)g).Graphics.TextContrast = 1;
					}
				}
				g.CompositingQuality = DXCompositingQuality.HighSpeed;
				using ISvgGraphics g2 = new SvgDXGraphics(g);
				foreach (SvgElementWrapper rootElement in rootElements)
				{
					rootElement.Render(g2, paletteProvider, scaleFactor);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				localSvgImageRenderingMode = null;
				g.Restore(state);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void RenderToSvgGraphics(ISvgGraphics g, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider = null, double scaleFactor = 1.0)
		{
			object graphicsState = g.Save();
			localSvgImageRenderingMode = SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed;
			try
			{
				foreach (SvgElementWrapper rootElement in rootElements)
				{
					rootElement.Render(g, paletteProvider, scaleFactor);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				localSvgImageRenderingMode = null;
				g.Restore(graphicsState);
			}
		}

		public RectangleF GetBounds(bool withViewboxTransform = true)
		{
			Matrix matrix = (withViewboxTransform ? SvgImage.GetViewBoxTransform() : null);
			List<float> list = new List<float>();
			List<float> list2 = new List<float>();
			foreach (SvgElementWrapper element in rootElements)
			{
				if (!indirectElementTypes.Any((Type x) => x.IsAssignableFrom(element.GetType())))
				{
					RectangleF bounds = element.GetBounds(matrix);
					if (!bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						list.AddRange(new float[2] { bounds.X, bounds.Right });
						list2.AddRange(new float[2] { bounds.Y, bounds.Bottom });
					}
				}
			}
			matrix?.Dispose();
			if (list.Count == 0 || list2.Count == 0)
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			float num = list.Min();
			float num2 = list2.Min();
			return new RectangleF(num, num2, list.Max() - num, list2.Max() - num2);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool HitTest(PointF point, double outlineSize)
		{
			Matrix matrix = SvgImage.GetDxViewBoxTransform().Matrix;
			bool flag = false;
			SvgGraphics g = new SvgGraphics();
			foreach (SvgElementWrapper rootElement in rootElements)
			{
				flag |= HitTestCore(g, rootElement, point, matrix, outlineSize);
			}
			matrix.Dispose();
			return flag;
		}

		private bool HitTestCore(ISvgGraphics g, SvgElementWrapper item, PointF point, Matrix matrix, double outlineSize)
		{
			//IL_00b6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ca: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0098: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Pen hitTestPen = item.GetHitTestPen(1.0, outlineSize);
			Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(item.GetPen(g, 1.0));
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath = item.GetPath(null, 1.0).Path.Clone() as GraphicsPath;
			GraphicsPath graphicsPath2 = null;
			Region region = null;
			try
			{
				if (pen != null && item.CheckPathData(graphicsPath))
				{
					graphicsPath2 = (GraphicsPath)graphicsPath.Clone();
					try
					{
						graphicsPath2.Widen(pen, null, 0.01f);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				Matrix matrix2 = null;
				if (item is SvgTransformGroupWrapper)
				{
					Matrix matrix3 = item.GetTransform((IDxMatrix)new DirectXMatrix(), 1.0, clone: true).Matrix;
					matrix3.Multiply(matrix);
					matrix2 = matrix3;
				}
				else
				{
					matrix2 = item.GetTransform((IDxMatrix)new DirectXMatrix(matrix.Elements), 1.0, clone: true).Matrix;
				}
				graphicsPath.Transform(matrix2);
				region = new Region(graphicsPath);
				if (graphicsPath2 != null)
				{
					graphicsPath2.Transform(matrix2);
					region.Union(graphicsPath2);
					graphicsPath = graphicsPath2;
				}
				bool flag = (region.IsVisible(point) && (!string.Equals(item.Element.Fill, "none", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || (graphicsPath2 != null && graphicsPath2.IsVisible(point)))) || graphicsPath.IsOutlineVisible(point, hitTestPen);
				if (flag)
				{
					return flag;
				}
				foreach (SvgElementWrapper child in item.Childs)
				{
					flag |= HitTestCore(g, child, point, matrix2, outlineSize);
				}
				return flag;
			}
			finally
			{
				graphicsPath?.Dispose();
				graphicsPath2?.Dispose();
				region?.Dispose();
				hitTestPen?.Dispose();
				pen?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private Image ScaleImg(Size outputSize, Size srcSize, Image bufferedImage, double opacity)
		{
			outputSize.Width = ((outputSize.Width <= 0) ? 1 : outputSize.Width);
			outputSize.Height = ((outputSize.Height <= 0) ? 1 : outputSize.Height);
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(outputSize.Width, outputSize.Height, PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb);
			using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
			Rectangle destRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
			Rectangle srcRect = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, srcSize);
			if (opacity == 1.0)
			{
				graphics.DrawImage(bufferedImage, destRect, srcRect, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
				return bitmap;
			}
			ColorMatrix colorMatrix = new ColorMatrix();
			colorMatrix.Matrix33 = (float)opacity;
			if (transparentAttributes == null)
			{
				transparentAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
			}
			transparentAttributes.SetColorMatrix(colorMatrix, ColorMatrixFlag.Default, ColorAdjustType.Bitmap);
			graphics.DrawImage(bufferedImage, destRect, srcRect.X, srcRect.Y, srcRect.Width, srcRect.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, transparentAttributes);
			return bitmap;
		}

		private DXImage ScaleDXImg(Size outputSize, Size srcSize, DXBitmap bufferedImage, double opacity)
		{
			outputSize.Width = ((outputSize.Width <= 0) ? 1 : outputSize.Width);
			outputSize.Height = ((outputSize.Height <= 0) ? 1 : outputSize.Height);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(outputSize.Width, outputSize.Height);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics();
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(0, 0, dXBitmap.Width, dXBitmap.Height);
			Rectangle rectangle2 = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, srcSize);
			iDXGraphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
			if (opacity == 1.0)
			{
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(bufferedImage, rectangle, rectangle2);
				return dXBitmap;
			}
			int imageTransparency = (int)Math.Round(255f * (1f - (float)opacity));
			using DXBitmap image = DXBitmapCreator.CreateFromImage(bufferedImage, DXColorMatrix.CreateTransparencyColorMatrix(imageTransparency));
			iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, rectangle, rectangle2);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		protected internal SvgElementWrapper GetElementWrapperById(string id)
		{
			if (id.StartsWith("url("))
			{
				id = id.Substring(4).TrimEnd(')');
			}
			if (id.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				id = id.Substring(1);
			}
			foreach (SvgElementWrapper element in Elements)
			{
				if (string.Equals(element.Element.Id, id))
				{
					return element;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class SvgElementWrapper
	{
		private GraphicsPathCache pathCacheCore;

		private List<SvgElementWrapper> childsCore;

		private SvgBitmap ownerCore;

		private Type[] indirectElementTypes = new Type[2]
		{
			typeof(SvgDefinitionsWrapper),
			typeof(SvgClipPathWrapper)
		};

		protected ISvgGraphics graphics;

		protected GraphicsPathCache PathCache => pathCacheCore;

		protected internal SvgBitmap Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return ownerCore;
			}
			set
			{
				ownerCore = value;
			}
		}

		protected ISvgPaletteProvider PaletteProvider { get; set; }

		public double Scale { get; internal set; }

		public SvgElement Element { get; private set; }

		public List<SvgElementWrapper> Childs => childsCore;

		public bool IsDisplay
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Element.Display))
				{
					return !string.Equals(Element.Display.ToLower(), SvgUnit.None);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public SvgElementWrapper(SvgElement element)
		{
			Element = element;
			pathCacheCore = new GraphicsPathCache();
			childsCore = new List<SvgElementWrapper>();
		}

		protected void SetElement(SvgElement value)
		{
			Element = value;
		}

		public RectangleF GetBounds(Matrix transformMatrix = null)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			bool flag = transformMatrix == null;
			if (transformMatrix == null)
			{
				transformMatrix = new Matrix();
			}
			double scale = 1.0;
			transformMatrix = GetTransform((IDxMatrix)new DirectXMatrix(transformMatrix.Elements), scale, clone: true).Matrix;
			if (this is SvgUseWrapper)
			{
				SvgUseWrapper svgUseWrapper = this as SvgUseWrapper;
				RectangleF result = svgUseWrapper.ReferencedElement?.GetBounds(transformMatrix) ?? default(RectangleF);
				if (flag)
				{
					transformMatrix.Dispose();
				}
				return result;
			}
			List<float> list = new List<float>();
			List<float> list2 = new List<float>();
			RectangleF rect = RectangleF.Empty;
			SvgGraphics g = new SvgGraphics();
			using (Pen pen = SystemDrawingConverter.CreatePen(GetPen(g, scale)))
			{
				using GraphicsPath graphicsPath = (GraphicsPath)GetPath(null, scale).Path.Clone();
				using Matrix matrix = new Matrix();
				if (pen != null && CheckPathData(graphicsPath))
				{
					try
					{
						graphicsPath.Widen(pen);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				graphicsPath.Transform(transformMatrix);
				graphicsPath.Flatten(matrix, 0.01f);
				rect = graphicsPath.GetBounds();
			}
			PopulateCoordinates(rect, list, list2);
			foreach (SvgElementWrapper child in Childs)
			{
				if (!indirectElementTypes.Any((Type x) => x.IsAssignableFrom(child.GetType())))
				{
					RectangleF bounds = child.GetBounds(transformMatrix);
					PopulateCoordinates(bounds, list, list2);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				transformMatrix.Dispose();
			}
			if (list.Count == 0 || list2.Count == 0)
			{
				return RectangleF.Empty;
			}
			float num = list.Min();
			float num2 = list2.Min();
			return new RectangleF(num, num2, list.Max() - num, list2.Max() - num2);
		}

		private void PopulateCoordinates(RectangleF rect, List<float> xs, List<float> ys)
		{
			if (!rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				xs.AddRange(new float[2] { rect.X, rect.Right });
				ys.AddRange(new float[2] { rect.Y, rect.Bottom });
			}
		}

		internal bool CheckPathData(GraphicsPath path)
		{
			if (path.PathData.Points.Length == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			PointF pointF = path.PathData.Points.First();
			for (int i = 1; i < path.PathData.Points.Length; i++)
			{
				if (pointF != path.PathData.Points[i])
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void Render(ISvgGraphics g, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider, double scale)
		{
			if (IsDisplay)
			{
				PaletteProvider = paletteProvider;
				Scale = scale;
				object graphicsState = g.Save();
				IDxMatrix val = (g.DxTransform = GetTransform(g.DxTransform, scale));
				SetClip(g, scale);
				g.SmoothingMode = GetSmoothingMode(g.SmoothingMode, scale);
				RenderCore(g, scale);
				RenderChild(g, paletteProvider, scale, this);
				((IDisposable)val).Dispose();
				g.Restore(graphicsState);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetClip(ISvgGraphics g, double scale)
		{
			if (!(Element.ClipPath == null) && Owner.GetElementWrapperById(Element.ClipPath.ToString()) is SvgClipPathWrapper svgClipPathWrapper)
			{
				g.IntersectClip(svgClipPathWrapper.GetPath(g, scale));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RenderCore(ISvgGraphics g, double scale)
		{
			RenderElement(g, scale, Element);
			RenderStroke(g, scale, Element);
		}

		protected virtual void RenderChild(ISvgGraphics g, ISvgPaletteProvider paletteProvider, double scale, SvgElementWrapper elementWrapper)
		{
			foreach (SvgElementWrapper child in elementWrapper.Childs)
			{
				child.Render(g, paletteProvider, scale);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RenderElement(ISvgGraphics g, double scale, SvgElement element)
		{
			graphics = g;
			IDxGraphicsPath path = GetPath(g, scale);
			using (DXBrush brush = GetBrush(g, element, scale, element.Fill, element.FillOpacity, useStyleName: true, path))
			{
				g.FillPath(brush, path);
			}
			graphics = null;
		}

		private SvgElementWrapper FindBrush(string name)
		{
			return Owner.GetElementWrapperById(name);
		}

		public virtual DXBrush GetBrush(ISvgGraphics g, SvgElement element, double scale, string colorValue, double? opacity, bool useStyleName, IDxGraphicsPath path)
		{
			opacity = GetOpacity(element.Opacity, opacity);
			if (colorValue.StartsWith("url"))
			{
				SvgElementWrapper svgElementWrapper = FindBrush(colorValue);
				if (svgElementWrapper != null)
				{
					svgElementWrapper.PaletteProvider = PaletteProvider;
					return svgElementWrapper.GetBrush(g, element, scale, colorValue, opacity, useStyleName, path);
				}
			}
			SvgGradient svgGradient = null;
			Color color = GetColor(colorValue, opacity, element.Brightness, element.UsePaletteForFill, out svgGradient);
			if (svgGradient != (SvgGradient)null)
			{
				return new SvgLinearGradientWrapper((SvgElement)(object)svgGradient).GetBrush(g, element, scale, colorValue, opacity, useStyleName, path);
			}
			return new DXSolidBrush(color);
		}

		protected virtual void RenderStroke(ISvgGraphics g, double scale, SvgElement element)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(element.Stroke) || string.Equals(element.Stroke.ToLower(), SvgUnit.None))
			{
				return;
			}
			IDxGraphicsPath path = GetPath(g, scale);
			using DXBrush brush = GetStrokeBrush(g, element, scale, element.Stroke, GetOpacity(element.Opacity, element.StrokeOpacity), path);
			using DXPen pen = GetPenCore(g, brush, scale);
			g.DrawPath(pen, GetPath(g, scale));
		}

		public virtual DXBrush GetStrokeBrush(ISvgGraphics g, SvgElement element, double scale, string strokeValue, double? opacity, IDxGraphicsPath path)
		{
			bool useStyleName = false;
			if (strokeValue.StartsWith("url"))
			{
				SvgElementWrapper svgElementWrapper = FindBrush(strokeValue);
				if (svgElementWrapper != null)
				{
					svgElementWrapper.PaletteProvider = PaletteProvider;
					return svgElementWrapper.GetBrush(g, element, scale, strokeValue, opacity, useStyleName, path);
				}
			}
			SvgGradient svgGradient = null;
			Color color = GetColor(strokeValue, opacity, null, element.UsePaletteForStroke, out svgGradient, useStyleName);
			if (svgGradient != (SvgGradient)null)
			{
				return new SvgLinearGradientWrapper((SvgElement)(object)svgGradient).GetBrush(g, element, scale, strokeValue, opacity, useStyleName, path);
			}
			return new DXSolidBrush(color);
		}

		protected virtual SmoothingMode GetSmoothingMode(SmoothingMode defaultValue, double scale)
		{
			if (scale < 16.0 || SvgBitmap.SvgImageRenderingMode == SvgImageRenderingMode.HighSpeed)
			{
				return GetSmoothingModeCore(defaultValue);
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		protected virtual SmoothingMode GetSmoothingModeCore(SmoothingMode defaultValue)
		{
			return defaultValue;
		}

		protected double? GetOpacity(double? elementOpacity, double? additionOpacity)
		{
			if (!elementOpacity.HasValue && !additionOpacity.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			double val = (elementOpacity ?? 1.0) * (additionOpacity ?? 1.0);
			return Math.Min(Math.Max(val, 0.0), 1.0);
		}

		protected internal virtual IDxMatrix GetTransform(IDxMatrix m, double scale, bool clone = false)
		{
			IDxMatrix val = m;
			if (clone)
			{
				val = m.Clone();
			}
			if (Element.Transformations == null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			foreach (SvgTransform item in (DXCollectionBase<SvgTransform>)(object)Element.Transformations)
			{
				val.Multiply(item.GetDxMatrix(scale));
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected virtual Color GetColor(string colorValue, double? opacity, double? brightness, bool usePalette, bool useStyleName = true)
		{
			SvgGradient svgGradient = null;
			return GetColor(colorValue, opacity, brightness, usePalette, out svgGradient, useStyleName);
		}

		protected virtual Color GetColor(string colorValue, double? opacity, double? brightness, bool usePalette, out SvgGradient svgGradient, bool useStyleName = true)
		{
			svgGradient = null;
			Color black = Color.Black;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(colorValue))
			{
				colorValue = "#000000";
			}
			if (colorValue.StartsWith("rgb"))
			{
				colorValue = GetStandardColorValue(colorValue, ref opacity);
			}
			if (colorValue.Length == 4 && colorValue[0] == '#')
			{
				colorValue = string.Format("#{0}{0}{1}{1}{2}{2}", colorValue[1], colorValue[2], colorValue[3]);
			}
			if (colorValue == SvgUnit.None)
			{
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
			if (PaletteProvider != null && usePalette)
			{
				black = ((!(PaletteProvider is ISvgPaletteProviderExt)) ? PaletteProvider.GetColorByStyleName(useStyleName ? Element.StyleName : string.Empty, colorValue, Element.Tag) : ((ISvgPaletteProviderExt)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/).GetColorByStyleName(useStyleName ? Element.StyleName : string.Empty, colorValue, ref svgGradient, Element.Tag));
			}
			else
			{
				if (colorValue.StartsWith("url"))
				{
					return Color.Black;
				}
				if (string.Equals(colorValue, "currentColor", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return Color.Black;
				}
				try
				{
					black = ColorTranslator.FromHtml(colorValue);
				}
				catch
				{
					black = Color.Black;
				}
			}
			if (opacity.HasValue)
			{
				black = Color.FromArgb((int)(opacity.Value * (double)(int)black.A), black);
			}
			if (brightness.HasValue)
			{
				black = ChangeColorBrightness(black, brightness.Value);
			}
			return black;
		}

		public static Color ChangeColorBrightness(Color baseColor, double brightness)
		{
			brightness = Math.Min(1.0, Math.Max(-1.0, brightness));
			Func<byte, byte> func = ((!(brightness > 0.0)) ? ((Func<byte, byte>)((byte x) => (byte)((double)(int)x * (1.0 + brightness)))) : ((Func<byte, byte>)((byte x) => (byte)((double)(int)x + (double)(255 - x) * brightness))));
			return Color.FromArgb(baseColor.A, func(baseColor.R), func(baseColor.G), func(baseColor.B));
		}

		protected virtual string GetStandardColorValue(string colorValue, ref double? opacity)
		{
			int num = colorValue.IndexOf("(") + 1;
			string[] array = colorValue.Substring(num, colorValue.IndexOf(")") - num).Split(new char[2] { ',', ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (array.Length > 3)
			{
				string text = array[3];
				if (text.StartsWith("."))
				{
					text = "0" + text;
				}
				double num2 = double.Parse(text, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				if (num2 <= 1.0)
				{
					opacity = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					opacity = num2 / 255.0;
				}
			}
			Color color = ((!array[0].Trim().EndsWith("%")) ? Color.FromArgb(int.Parse(array[0]), int.Parse(array[1]), int.Parse(array[2])) : Color.FromArgb((int)(255.0 * double.Parse(array[0].Trim().TrimEnd('%'), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) / 100.0), (int)(255.0 * double.Parse(array[1].Trim().TrimEnd('%'), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) / 100.0), (int)(255.0 * double.Parse(array[2].Trim().TrimEnd('%'), CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) / 100.0)));
			return $"#{color.R:X2}{color.G:X2}{color.B:X2}";
		}

		protected internal Pen GetHitTestPen(double scale, double strokeWidth)
		{
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_012f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0134: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0135: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0137: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0139: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Pen pen = new Pen(Brushes.Transparent, (float)strokeWidth);
			pen.MiterLimit = (Element.StrokeMiterLimit.HasValue ? ((float)Element.StrokeMiterLimit.Value) : 4f);
			pen.LineJoin = (LineJoin)Element.StrokeLineJoin;
			if (MayBe.Get<SvgUnitCollection, bool>(Element.StrokeDashArray, (Func<SvgUnitCollection, bool>)((SvgUnitCollection x) => ((List<SvgUnit>)(object)x).Count > 0), false))
			{
				pen.DashStyle = DashStyle.Custom;
				pen.DashPattern = MayBe.Get<SvgUnitCollection, float[]>(Element.StrokeDashArray, (Func<SvgUnitCollection, float[]>)((SvgUnitCollection x) => ((IEnumerable<SvgUnit>)x).Select(delegate(SvgUnit c)
				{
					float num = (float)(c.Value * scale / strokeWidth);
					return (!(num <= 0f)) ? num : 1f;
				}).ToArray()), pen.DashPattern);
				if (pen.DashPattern.Count() == 1)
				{
					pen.DashPattern = new float[2]
					{
						pen.DashPattern[0],
						pen.DashPattern[0]
					};
				}
				pen.DashOffset = MayBe.Get<SvgUnit, float>(Element.StrokeDashOffset, (Func<SvgUnit, float>)((SvgUnit x) => (float)(x.Value * scale)), pen.DashOffset);
			}
			SvgStrokeLineCap strokeLineCap = Element.StrokeLineCap;
			if ((int)strokeLineCap != 1)
			{
				if ((int)strokeLineCap == 2)
				{
					pen.StartCap = LineCap.Square;
					pen.EndCap = LineCap.Square;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				pen.StartCap = LineCap.Round;
				pen.EndCap = LineCap.Round;
			}
			return pen;
		}

		public DXPen GetPen(ISvgGraphics g, double scale)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Element.Stroke) || string.Equals(Element.Stroke.ToLower(), SvgUnit.None))
			{
				return null;
			}
			using DXSolidBrush brush = new DXSolidBrush(GetColor(Element.Stroke, GetOpacity(Element.Opacity, Element.StrokeOpacity), null, Element.UsePaletteForStroke));
			return GetPenCore(g, brush, scale);
		}

		protected virtual DXPen GetPenCore(ISvgGraphics g, DXBrush brush, double scale)
		{
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0193: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0198: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_019f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a2: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			double num = MayBe.Get<SvgUnit, double>(Element.StrokeWidth, (Func<SvgUnit, double>)((SvgUnit x) => x.Value), 1.0) * scale;
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return new DXPen(Color.Transparent);
			}
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(brush, (float)num);
			dXPen.MiterLimit = (Element.StrokeMiterLimit.HasValue ? ((float)Element.StrokeMiterLimit.Value) : 4f);
			dXPen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)Element.StrokeLineJoin;
			if (MayBe.Get<SvgUnitCollection, bool>(Element.StrokeDashArray, (Func<SvgUnitCollection, bool>)((SvgUnitCollection x) => ((List<SvgUnit>)(object)x).Count > 0), false))
			{
				dXPen.DashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				dXPen.DashPattern = GetDashPattern(Element.StrokeDashArray, scale / num);
				if (dXPen.DashPattern.Length == 1)
				{
					dXPen.DashPattern = new float[2]
					{
						dXPen.DashPattern[0],
						dXPen.DashPattern[0]
					};
				}
				SvgUnit strokeDashOffset = Element.StrokeDashOffset;
				dXPen.DashOffset = ((float?)((strokeDashOffset != null) ? new double?(strokeDashOffset.Value * scale) : ((double?)null))) ?? dXPen.DashOffset;
			}
			SvgStrokeLineCap strokeLineCap = Element.StrokeLineCap;
			if ((int)strokeLineCap != 1)
			{
				if ((int)strokeLineCap == 2)
				{
					dXPen.StartCap = DXLineCap.Square;
					dXPen.EndCap = DXLineCap.Square;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dXPen.StartCap = DXLineCap.Round;
				dXPen.EndCap = DXLineCap.Round;
			}
			return dXPen;
		}

		private static float[] GetDashPattern(SvgUnitCollection strokeDashArray, double scale)
		{

			for (int i = 0; i < ((List<SvgUnit>)(object)strokeDashArray).Count; i++)
			{
				SvgUnit val = ((List<SvgUnit>)(object)strokeDashArray)[i];
				float num = (float)(val.Value * scale);
				array[i] = ((num <= 0f) ? 1f : num);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public IDxGraphicsPath GetPath(ISvgGraphics g, double scale, bool allowCache = true)
		{
			SvgGraphicsWrapper svgGraphicsWrapper = null;
			if (g == null)
			{
				svgGraphicsWrapper = new SvgGraphicsWrapper(g);
				g = svgGraphicsWrapper.SvgGraphics;
			}
			if (!PathCache.TryGetValue(scale, out var value))
			{
				value = GetPathCore(g, scale);
				AddPathToCache(scale, value, allowCache);
			}
			svgGraphicsWrapper?.Dispose();
			return value;
		}

		public GraphicsPath GetPath(double scale)
		{
			IDxGraphicsPath value;
			using (SvgGraphicsWrapper svgGraphicsWrapper = new SvgGraphicsWrapper(null))

				{
					value = GetPathCore(svgGraphicsWrapper.SvgGraphics, scale);
					AddPathToCache(scale, value);
				}
			}
			return value.Path;
		}

		protected virtual void AddPathToCache(double scale, IDxGraphicsPath path, bool allowCache = true)
		{
			if (!allowCache)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (((ICollection)PathCache).SyncRoot)
			{
				if (!PathCache.ContainsKey(scale))
				{
					PathCache.Add(scale, path);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual IDxGraphicsPath GetPathCore(ISvgGraphics g, double scale)
		{
			return g.CreatePath();
		}

		public float ScaleValue(double v, double scale)
		{
			if (scale == 1.0)
			{
				return (float)v;
			}
			return (float)(v * scale);
		}

		protected LinePart CalcPartToMove(RectangleF bounds, PointF start, PointF end)
		{

		private IList<PointF> CalcIntersections(RectangleF bounds, PointF start, PointF end)
		{
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>();
			if (Math.Round(Math.Abs(start.Y - end.Y), 3) == 0.0)
			{
				list.Add(new PointF(bounds.Left, start.Y));
				list.Add(new PointF(bounds.Right, start.Y));
			}
			else if (Math.Round(Math.Abs(start.X - end.X), 3) == 0.0)
			{
				list.Add(new PointF(start.X, bounds.Top));
				list.Add(new PointF(start.X, bounds.Bottom));
			}
			else
			{
				if ((start.X == bounds.Left || start.X == bounds.Right) && (start.Y == bounds.Top || start.Y == bounds.Bottom))
				{
					list.Add(start);
				}
				if ((end.X == bounds.Left || end.X == bounds.Right) && (end.Y == bounds.Top || end.Y == bounds.Bottom))
				{
					list.Add(end);
				}
				if (list.Count < 2)
				{
					PointF item = new PointF(bounds.Left, (end.Y - start.Y) / (end.X - start.X) * (bounds.Left - start.X) + start.Y);
					if (bounds.Top <= item.Y && item.Y <= bounds.Bottom && !list.Contains(item))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					item = new PointF(bounds.Right, (end.Y - start.Y) / (end.X - start.X) * (bounds.Right - start.X) + start.Y);
					if (bounds.Top <= item.Y && item.Y <= bounds.Bottom && !list.Contains(item))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					item = new PointF((bounds.Top - start.Y) / (end.Y - start.Y) * (end.X - start.X) + start.X, bounds.Top);
					if (bounds.Left <= item.X && item.X <= bounds.Right && !list.Contains(item))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					item = new PointF((bounds.Bottom - start.Y) / (end.Y - start.Y) * (end.X - start.X) + start.X, bounds.Bottom);
					if (bounds.Left <= item.X && item.X <= bounds.Right && !list.Contains(item))
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected DXColorBlend CalculateColorBlend(RectangleF bounds, double opacity, PointF specifiedStart, PointF realStart, PointF specifiedEnd, PointF realEnd)
		{

			//IL_00b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		protected static PointF MovePointAlongVector(PointF start, PointF unitVector, float distance)
		{
			return start + new SizeF(unitVector.X * distance, unitVector.Y * distance);
		}

		protected static double GetLength(PointF first, PointF second)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(first.X - second.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(first.Y - second.Y, 2.0));
		}

		private double CalcScale(RectangleF bounds, IDxGraphicsPath path)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(bounds.Left, bounds.Top),
				new PointF(bounds.Right, bounds.Top),
				new PointF(bounds.Right, bounds.Bottom),
				new PointF(bounds.Left, bounds.Bottom)
			};
			RectangleF bounds2 = path.GetBounds();
			PointF pointF = new PointF(bounds2.X + bounds2.Width / 2f, bounds2.Y + bounds2.Height / 2f);
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			dXMatrix.Translate(-1f * pointF.X, -1f * pointF.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			dXMatrix.Scale(0.95f, 0.95f, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			dXMatrix.Translate(pointF.X, pointF.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			while (!path.IsVisible(array[0]) || !path.IsVisible(array[1]) || !path.IsVisible(array[2]) || !path.IsVisible(array[3]))
			{
				PointF[] first = new PointF[4]
				{
					new PointF(array[0].X, array[0].Y),
					new PointF(array[1].X, array[1].Y),
					new PointF(array[2].X, array[2].Y),
					new PointF(array[3].X, array[3].Y)
				};
				dXMatrix.TransformPoints(array);
				if (first.SequenceEqual(array))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return bounds.Height / (array[2].Y - array[1].Y);
		}

	public sealed class SvgImageKey : IEquatable<SvgImageKey>
	{
		private readonly string name;

		private readonly int width;

		private readonly int height;

		private readonly ISvgPaletteProvider palette;

		private readonly Color customColor;

		public SvgImageKey(string name, Size size, ISvgPaletteProvider palette = null, Color customColor = default(Color))
		{
			this.name = name;
			width = size.Width;
			height = size.Height;
			this.palette = palette;
			this.customColor = customColor;
		}

		public bool Equals(SvgImageKey key)
		{
			if (key != null && key.name == name && key.customColor == customColor && key.width == width && key.height == height)
			{
				return ArePaletteProvidersEqual(key.palette, palette);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ArePaletteProvidersEqual(ISvgPaletteProvider x, ISvgPaletteProvider y)
		{
			if (x == y)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (x != null)
			{
				return x.Equals(y);
			}
			return y == null;
		}

		public sealed override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as SvgImageKey);
		}

		public sealed override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int hashCode = HashCodeHelper.GetHashCode<string>(name);
			int num = ((palette == null) ? HashCodeHelper.NullHash : palette.GetHashCode());
			int hashCode2 = HashCodeHelper.GetHashCode<Color>(customColor);
			return HashCodeHelper.Calculate(hashCode, width, height, hashCode2, num);
		}
	}

			return Math.PI * 2.0 - (num - num2);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public interface ISvgPathSegmentWrapperFactory
	{
		SvgPathSegmentWrapper Wrap(SvgPathSegment element);
	}
	internal sealed class SvgPathSegmentWrapperFactory : ISvgPathSegmentWrapperFactory
	{
		public static readonly ISvgPathSegmentWrapperFactory Default = new SvgPathSegmentWrapperFactory();

		private readonly IDictionary<Type, Func<SvgPathSegment, SvgPathSegmentWrapper>> providers;

		public SvgPathSegmentWrapperFactory()
		{
			providers = new Dictionary<Type, Func<SvgPathSegment, SvgPathSegmentWrapper>>();
			providers.Add(typeof(SvgPathMoveToSegment), (SvgPathSegment segment) => new SvgPathMoveToSegmentWrapper(segment));
			providers.Add(typeof(SvgPathCloseSegment), (SvgPathSegment segment) => new SvgPathCloseSegmentWrapper(segment));
			providers.Add(typeof(SvgPathLineToSegment), (SvgPathSegment segment) => new SvgPathLineToSegmentWrapper(segment));
			providers.Add(typeof(SvgPathCurveToCubicSegment), (SvgPathSegment segment) => new SvgPathCurveToCubicSegmentWrapper(segment));
			providers.Add(typeof(SvgPathCurveToQuadraticSegment), (SvgPathSegment segment) => new SvgPathCurveToQuadraticSegmentWrapper(segment));
			providers.Add(typeof(SvgPathArcSegment), (SvgPathSegment segment) => new SvgPathArcSegmentWrapper(segment));
		}

		public SvgPathSegmentWrapper Wrap(SvgPathSegment element)
		{
			Func<SvgPathSegment, SvgPathSegmentWrapper> func = providers[((object)element).GetType()];
			return func(element);
		}
	}
}

	public abstract class StringInfoBase
	{
		private List<StringBlock> blocks;

		private List<Rectangle> blockBounds;

		private Rectangle bounds;

		private object context;

		internal bool simpleString;

		private string sourceString;

		private Rectangle originalBounds;

		public HyperlinkSettings HyperlinkSettings { get; set; }

		public bool AllowBaselineAlignment { get; set; }

		public bool AllowPartiallyVisibleRows { get; set; }

		public bool DisableWrapNonFitText { get; set; }

		public Rectangle OriginalBounds
		{
			get
			{
				return originalBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				originalBounds = value;
			}
		}

		public bool SimpleString => simpleString;

		public object Context
		{
			get
			{
				return context;
			}
			set
			{
				context = value;
			}
		}

		public bool RoundTextHeight { get; set; }

		public abstract bool RightToLeft { get; }

		public abstract WordWrap WordWrap { get; }

		public abstract VertAlignment VAlignment { get; }

		public abstract HorzAlignment HAlignment { get; }

		public abstract Font Font { get; }

		public abstract DXFont DXFont { get; }

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Blocks != null)
				{
					return Blocks.Count == 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

		public string SourceString => sourceString;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public List<StringBlock> Blocks => blocks;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public List<Rectangle> BlocksBounds => blockBounds;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
