		public StringInfoBase()
			: this(null, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public StringInfoBase(List<StringBlock> blocks, List<Rectangle> blockBounds, string sourceString)
		{
			simpleString = false;
			originalBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
			this.sourceString = sourceString;
			this.blocks = blocks;
			this.blockBounds = blockBounds;
			bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
			AllowBaselineAlignment = true;
			HyperlinkSettings = new HyperlinkSettings();
			AllowPartiallyVisibleRows = true;
		}

		public void Assign(List<StringBlock> blocks, List<Rectangle> blockBounds, string sourceString)
		{
			this.sourceString = sourceString;
			this.blocks = blocks;
			this.blockBounds = blockBounds;
		}

		public virtual void Assign(StringInfoBase info)
		{
			if (Blocks == null)
			{
				blocks = new List<StringBlock>();
				blockBounds = new List<Rectangle>();
			}
			Blocks.Clear();
			BlocksBounds.Clear();
			sourceString = info.SourceString;
			bounds = info.Bounds;
			simpleString = info.simpleString;
			OriginalBounds = info.OriginalBounds;
			AllowBaselineAlignment = info.AllowBaselineAlignment;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((info.Blocks != null) ? info.Blocks.Count : 0); i++)
			{
				Blocks.Add(info.Blocks[i]);
				BlocksBounds.Add(info.BlocksBounds[i]);
			}
			LinesBounds = null;
			if (info.LinesBounds != null)
			{
				LinesBounds = new List<Rectangle>();
				for (int j = 0; j < info.LinesBounds.Count; j++)
				{
					LinesBounds.Add(info.LinesBounds[j]);
				}
			}
			AllowPartiallyVisibleRows = info.AllowPartiallyVisibleRows;
		}

		protected void SetSimpleStringInfo(string text, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			simpleString = true;
			sourceString = text;
			this.bounds = bounds;
			OriginalBounds = bounds;
		}

		public StringBlock GetLinkByPoint(Point pt)
		{
			if (Blocks == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Blocks.Count; i++)
			{
				if (Blocks[i].Type == StringBlockType.Link && BlocksBounds[i].Contains(pt))
				{
					return Blocks[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void SetLinkColor(Point pt, Color color)
		{
			GetLinkByPoint(pt)?.FontSettings.SetColor(color);
		}

		internal void UpdateXLocation(HorzAlignment align, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!StringPainterBase<StringInfoBase, StringCalculateArgsBase, TextProcessInfoBase>.IsValidSize(bounds) || (int)align == 1 || (int)align == 0 || Blocks == null || BlocksBounds == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int lineBlockCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < Blocks.Count; i += lineBlockCount)
			{
				lineBlockCount = GetLineBlockCount(i);
				int blocksWidth = GetBlocksWidth(i, lineBlockCount);
				int num = StringPainterBase<StringInfoBase, StringCalculateArgsBase, TextProcessInfoBase>.CalcXByAlignment(bounds, blocksWidth, align);
				for (int j = i; j < i + lineBlockCount; j++)
				{
					Rectangle value = BlocksBounds[j];
					value.X = num;
					BlocksBounds[j] = value;
					num += value.Width;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetLineBlockCount(int startIndex)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = startIndex;
			while (num3 < Blocks.Count)
			{
				if (num3 == startIndex)
				{
					num2 = Blocks[num3].LineNumber;
				}
				else if (Blocks[num3].LineNumber != num2)
				{
					break;
				}
				num3++;
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int GetBlocksWidth(int startIndex, int count)
		{
			if (count < 2)
			{
				return BlocksBounds[startIndex].Width;
			}
			return BlocksBounds[startIndex + count - 1].Right - BlocksBounds[startIndex].Left;
		}

		public void SetLocation(Point pt)
		{
			SetLocation(pt.X, pt.Y);
		}

		public void SetLocation(int x, int y)
		{
			int x2 = x - Bounds.X;
			int y2 = y - Bounds.Y;
			Offset(x2, y2);
			SetBounds(new Rectangle(x, y, Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height));
		}

		public void Offset(int x, int y)
		{
			if (originalBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			originalBounds.Offset(x, y);
			SetBounds(new Rectangle(Bounds.X + x, Bounds.Y + y, Bounds.Width, Bounds.Height));
			if (BlocksBounds == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < BlocksBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				Rectangle value = BlocksBounds[i];
				value.Offset(x, y);
				BlocksBounds[i] = value;
			}
			if (LinesBounds != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < LinesBounds.Count; j++)
				{
					Rectangle value2 = LinesBounds[j];
					value2.Offset(x, y);
					LinesBounds[j] = value2;
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
		}

		protected void SetBoundsLocation(Point location)
		{
			bounds.Location = location;
		}

		protected internal void UpdateLocation(Point pt)
		{
			if (BlocksBounds == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point point = new Point(pt.X - Bounds.X, pt.Y - Bounds.Y);
			for (int i = 0; i < BlocksBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				BlocksBounds[i] = new Rectangle(new Point(BlocksBounds[i].X + point.X, BlocksBounds[i].Y + point.Y), BlocksBounds[i].Size);
			}
			if (LinesBounds != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < LinesBounds.Count; j++)
				{
					LinesBounds[j] = new Rectangle(new Point(LinesBounds[j].X + point.X, LinesBounds[j].Y + point.Y), LinesBounds[j].Size);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class StringPainterBase<TStringInfo, TStringCalculateArgs, TTextProcessInfo> where TStringInfo : StringInfoBase where TStringCalculateArgs : StringCalculateArgsBase where TTextProcessInfo : TextProcessInfoBase
	{
		public static float AscentHeightMultiplier = 0.84f;

		internal static int CalcXByAlignment(Rectangle totalBounds, int textWidth, HorzAlignment align)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = totalBounds.Width - textWidth;
			int num2 = totalBounds.X;
			if (num < 1)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			if ((int)align == 2)
			{
				num2 += num / 2;
			}
			if ((int)align == 3)
			{
				num2 += num;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		public static bool IsValidSize(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (bounds.Width > 0)
			{
				return bounds.Height > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract TTextProcessInfo CreateTextProcessInfo(TStringCalculateArgs e);

		protected abstract void UpdateBlockFont(TStringCalculateArgs e, StringBlock block, Font initialFont, DXFont initialDXFont);

		protected abstract TStringInfo CreateAndInitializeStringInfo(TStringCalculateArgs e);

		protected abstract Size CalcTextSizeInt(TStringInfo info, TStringCalculateArgs e);

		protected abstract Size CalcStringBlockSize(TTextProcessInfo te, StringBlock block, string s, StringFormat format, DXStringFormat dxFormat);

		public List<StringBlock> Parse(StringInfoBase info, string text, bool allowNewlineSymbols = false)
		{
			float fontSize = info.DXFont?.Size ?? info.Font.Size;
			DXFontStyle style = ((info.DXFont != null) ? info.DXFont.Style : ((DXFontStyle)info.Font.Style));
			return ParseCore(fontSize, style, info.HyperlinkSettings, text, allowNewlineSymbols);
		}

		protected virtual List<StringBlock> ParseCore(float fontSize, DXFontStyle style, HyperlinkSettings hyperlinkSettings, string text, bool allowNewLineSymbols)
		{
			return StringParser.Parse(Color.Empty, Color.Empty, hyperlinkSettings, fontSize, style, text, allowNewLineSymbols);
		}

		public List<Rectangle> CalcBlocksInnerBounds(StringInfoBase stringInfo)
		{
			List<Rectangle> list = new List<Rectangle>();
			for (int i = 0; i < stringInfo.Blocks.Count; i++)
			{
				list.Add(CalcTextInnerBounds(stringInfo.Blocks[i], stringInfo.BlocksBounds[i]));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public virtual TStringInfo Calculate(TStringCalculateArgs e)
		{
			TStringInfo val = CreateAndInitializeStringInfo(e);
			if (e.AllowSimpleString && IsSimpleStringCore(e.Text))
			{
				SetupSimpleString(val, e);
				return val;
			}
			StringParser.DpiScaleFactor = GetDpiScaleFactor(e);
			List<StringBlock> strings = null;
			try
			{
				strings = Parse(val, e.Text, e.AllowNewLineSymbols);
			}
			finally
			{
				StringParser.DpiScaleFactor = 1f;
			}
			return CalculateCore(e, val, strings);
		}

		private void UpdateBoundsByAlignment(StringInfoBase info, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = 0;
			while (num < info.Blocks.Count)
			{
				StringBlock stringBlock = info.Blocks[num];
				if ((int)stringBlock.FontSettings.Alignment == 0)
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				int lineBlockCount = info.GetLineBlockCount(num);
				int num2 = num + lineBlockCount - 1;
				int num3 = info.BlocksBounds[num2].Right - info.BlocksBounds[num].Left;
				int num4 = 0;
				if ((int)stringBlock.FontSettings.Alignment == 2)
				{
					num4 = (bounds.Width - num3) / 2;
				}
				else if ((int)stringBlock.FontSettings.Alignment == 3)
				{
					num4 = bounds.Width - num3;
				}
				if (num4 != 0)
				{
					for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
					{
						Rectangle value = info.BlocksBounds[i];
						value.X += num4;
						info.BlocksBounds[i] = value;
					}
				}
				num += lineBlockCount;
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldInsertNewLine(TextProcessInfoBase te, StringCalculateArgsBase e, List<StringBlock> strings, int index)
		{
			StringBlock stringBlock = strings[index];
			if (stringBlock.NewLineBefore && index > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (index > 0 && strings[index - 1].NewLineAfter)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (e.AllowNewLineSymbols)
			{
				return stringBlock.LineNumber != te.LineNumber;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected TStringInfo CalculateCore(TStringCalculateArgs e, TStringInfo info, List<StringBlock> strings)
		{
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			Rectangle bounds = e.Bounds;
			UpdateFont(e, strings, info);
			List<StringBlock> blocks = new List<StringBlock>();
			List<Rectangle> blockBounds = new List<Rectangle>();
			info.Assign(blocks, blockBounds, e.Text);
			info.OriginalBounds = bounds;
			if (strings.Count == 0)
			{
				return info;
			}
			TTextProcessInfo val = CreateTextProcessInfo(e);
			val.RoundTextHeight = e.RoundTextHeight;
			val.AllowMultiLine = (int)info.WordWrap == 2;
			val.CurrentPosition = bounds.Location;
			val.Info = info;
			val.Bounds = bounds;
			val.Context = e.Context;
			for (int i = 0; i < strings.Count; i++)
			{
				StringBlock stringBlock = strings[i];
				if (ShouldInsertNewLine(val, e, strings, i))
				{
					int currentY = val.CurrentY + val.LineHeight;
					val.CurrentY = currentY;
					val.LineNumber++;
					val.LineHeight = 0;
					val.IsNewLine = true;
					val.CurrentX = val.Bounds.X;
				}
				if (stringBlock.FontSettings.HasModifiers)
				{
					info.HasScripts = true;
				}
				if (stringBlock.Type == StringBlockType.Image)
				{
					info.HasImages = true;
				}
				if (val.LineHeight == 0)
				{
					val.LineHeight = GetBlockHeight(info.Context, stringBlock, val.RoundTextHeight);
				}
				val.Block = stringBlock;
				ProcessBlock(e, val, strings, i);
			}
			info.IsCropped = val.IsCropped;
			UpdateBaseLine(bounds, info, val);
			if (info.HasScripts)
			{
				UpdateScripts(e, bounds, info, val);
			}
			UpdateMaximumBounds(info, bounds, val);
			info.SetBounds(Rectangle.FromLTRB(bounds.X, bounds.Y, val.End.X, val.End.Y));
			UpdateBoundsByAppearance(info, bounds);
			UpdateBoundsByAlignment(info, bounds);
			return info;
		}

		public void UpdateBoundsByAppearance(StringInfoBase info)
		{
			UpdateBoundsByAppearance(info, info.Bounds);
		}

		private void SetupSimpleString(TStringInfo info, TStringCalculateArgs e)
		{
			Size size = CalcTextSizeInt(info, e);
			if (e.RoundTextHeight && size.Height % 2 == 1)
			{
				size.Height++;
			}
			info.simpleString = true;
			info.SetBounds(new Rectangle(e.Bounds.Location, size));
			info.OriginalBounds = e.Bounds;
			info.Assign(null, null, e.Text);
		}

		private void UpdateFont(TStringCalculateArgs e, List<StringBlock> strings, StringInfoBase info)
		{
			if (info.DXFont != null)
			{
				UpdateFont(e, strings, null, info.DXFont);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateFont(e, strings, info.Font, null);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateFont(TStringCalculateArgs e, List<StringBlock> strings, Font initialFont, DXFont initialDXFont)
		{
			foreach (StringBlock @string in strings)
			{
				UpdateBlockFont(e, @string, initialFont, initialDXFont);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMaximumBounds(StringInfoBase info, Rectangle bounds, TTextProcessInfo te)
		{
			if (!IsValidSize(bounds))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = info.BlocksBounds.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				Rectangle value = info.BlocksBounds[num];
				if (value.Right > bounds.Right)
				{
					value.Width = bounds.Right - value.X;
					if (value.Width < 1)
					{
						value = Rectangle.Empty;
					}
				}
				if (!value.IsEmpty && value.Bottom > bounds.Bottom)
				{
					if (value.Top >= bounds.Bottom)
					{
						value = Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					else
					{
						int num2 = bounds.Bottom - value.Y;
						if (!info.AllowPartiallyVisibleRows || num2 < 1)
						{
							value = Rectangle.Empty;
						}
						else
						{
							StringBlock stringBlock = info.Blocks[num];
							if (stringBlock.Type == StringBlockType.Image)
							{
								stringBlock.ClipBounds = new Rectangle(value.X, value.Y, value.Width, num2);
							}
							else
							{
								value.Height = num2;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (value.IsEmpty)
				{
					info.BlocksBounds.RemoveAt(num);
					info.Blocks.RemoveAt(num);
					if (!info.AllowPartiallyVisibleRows)
					{
						te.End.Y = ((num > 0) ? info.BlocksBounds[num - 1].Bottom : te.Bounds.Y);
					}
					if (info.GetIsEllipsisTrimming() && HasPrecedingVisibleBlockTo(num, bounds, info))
					{
						AddEllipsisCharacter(info, bounds, te, num - 1);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					info.BlocksBounds[num] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool HasPrecedingVisibleBlockTo(int blockIndex, Rectangle bounds, StringInfoBase info)
		{
			if (blockIndex == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!info.AllowPartiallyVisibleRows)
			{
				return info.BlocksBounds[blockIndex - 1].Bottom <= bounds.Bottom;
			}
			return info.BlocksBounds[blockIndex - 1].Top < bounds.Bottom;
		}

		private void AddEllipsisCharacter(StringInfoBase info, Rectangle bounds, TTextProcessInfo te, int index)
		{
			info.Blocks[index].Text += "...";
			Rectangle value = info.BlocksBounds[index];
			value.Width = GetStringWidth(te, info, info.Blocks[index], info.Blocks[index].Text);
			if (value.Right > bounds.Right)
			{
				value.Width = bounds.Right - value.X;
			}
			info.BlocksBounds[index] = value;
		}

		protected void UpdateScriptBlocks(Rectangle originalBounds, StringInfoBase info)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < info.Blocks.Count; i++)
			{
				_ = info.Blocks[i].FontSettings.HasModifiers;
			}
		}

		protected bool HasScriptBlocks(StringInfoBase info)
		{
			foreach (StringBlock block in info.Blocks)
			{
				if (block.FontSettings.HasModifiers)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void UpdateScripts(TStringCalculateArgs e, Rectangle originalBounds, StringInfoBase info, TextProcessInfoBase te)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = -1;
			StringBlockTextModifierInfo stringBlockTextModifierInfo = null;
			Point location = e.Bounds.Location;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < info.Blocks.Count; i++)
			{
				if (info.Blocks[i].LineNumber != num3)
				{
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						OffsetBlocks(info, num3, num2);
						OffsetLines(info, num3 + 1, num2);
						UpdateLineHeight(info, num3, num2);
					}
					if (num > 0)
					{
						OffsetBlocks(info, num3 + 1, num);
						OffsetLines(info, num3 + 1, num);
						UpdateLineHeight(info, num3, num);
					}
					num = (num2 = 0);
					num4 = -1;
					num3 = info.Blocks[i].LineNumber;
				}
				if (!info.Blocks[i].FontSettings.HasModifiers)
				{
					if (stringBlockTextModifierInfo == null)
					{
						stringBlockTextModifierInfo = new StringBlockTextModifierInfo
						{
							Modifier = StringBlockTextModifier.Normal,
							Height = info.Blocks[i].FontHeight,
							AscentHeight = info.Blocks[i].FontAscentHeight,
							InternalLeading = info.Blocks[i].FontInternalLeading
						};
					}
					num4 = i;
					continue;
				}
				flag = true;
				if (num4 == -1)
				{
					num4 = FindNextAnchorIndex(info, num3, i);
				}
				Rectangle anchorBounds = new Rectangle(0, location.Y, 0, 0);
				if (num4 != -1)
				{
					anchorBounds = info.BlocksBounds[num4];
					anchorBounds.Y += info.Blocks[num4].FontInternalLeading;
					anchorBounds.Height = info.Blocks[num4].FontInnerHeight;
				}
				else
				{
					if (stringBlockTextModifierInfo == null)
					{
						float size = info.DXFont?.Size ?? info.Font.Size;
						stringBlockTextModifierInfo = new StringBlockTextModifierInfo
						{
							Modifier = StringBlockTextModifier.Normal,
							Size = size
						};
						SetModifierFontInfo(e, info, stringBlockTextModifierInfo);
					}
					anchorBounds.Y = info.LinesBounds[num3].Y + stringBlockTextModifierInfo.InternalLeading;
					anchorBounds.Height = stringBlockTextModifierInfo.InnerHeight;
				}
				Rectangle scriptBounds = info.BlocksBounds[i];
				Rectangle value = CalculateOffset(e, anchorBounds, scriptBounds, info.Blocks[i]);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, info.LinesBounds[num3].Top - value.Top);
				num = Math.Max(num, value.Bottom - info.LinesBounds[num3].Bottom);
				info.BlocksBounds[i] = value;
				te.End.Y = Math.Max(te.End.Y, value.Bottom);
			}
			if (num2 > 0)
			{
				OffsetBlocks(info, num3, num2);
				OffsetLines(info, num3 + 1, num2);
				UpdateLineHeight(info, num3, num2);
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				OffsetBlocks(info, num3 + 1, num);
				OffsetLines(info, num3 + 1, num);
				UpdateLineHeight(info, num3, num);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < info.BlocksBounds.Count; j++)
				{
					te.End.Y = Math.Max(te.End.Y, info.BlocksBounds[j].Bottom);
				}
			}
		}

		private int FindNextAnchorIndex(StringInfoBase info, int lineIndex, int startIndex)
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i < info.Blocks.Count && info.Blocks[i].LineNumber == lineIndex; i++)
			{
				if (!info.Blocks[i].FontSettings.HasModifiers)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void SetModifierFontInfo(TStringCalculateArgs e, StringInfoBase info, StringBlockTextModifierInfo modifier)
		{
			if (info.DXFont != null)
			{
				SetModifierFontInfo(e, null, info.DXFont, modifier);
			}
			else
			{
				SetModifierFontInfo(e, info.Font, null, modifier);
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetModifierFontInfo(TStringCalculateArgs e, Font font, DXFont dxFont, StringBlockTextModifierInfo modifier)
		{
		}

		public Rectangle CalcTextInnerBounds(StringBlock block, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Rectangle result = bounds;
			result.Height = block.FontAscentHeight - block.FontInternalLeading;
			result.Y += block.FontInternalLeading;
			return result;
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateOffset(TStringCalculateArgs e, Rectangle anchorBounds, Rectangle scriptBounds, StringBlock scriptBlock)
		{
			Rectangle result = new Rectangle(scriptBounds.X, anchorBounds.Y, scriptBounds.Width, anchorBounds.Height);
			List<StringBlockTextModifierInfo> modifiers = scriptBlock.FontSettings.Modifiers;
			StringBlockTextModifierInfo stringBlockTextModifierInfo = modifiers.Last();
			foreach (StringBlockTextModifierInfo item in modifiers)
			{
				if (item.Height == 0)
				{
					SetModifierFontInfo(e, scriptBlock.Font, scriptBlock.DXFont, item);
				}
				if (item.Modifier == StringBlockTextModifier.SubScript)
				{
					result.Y = result.Bottom - result.Height / 2;
				}
				else
				{
					result.Y = result.Y + result.Height / 2 - item.InnerHeight;
				}
				result.Height = item.InnerHeight;
			}
			result.Y -= stringBlockTextModifierInfo.InternalLeading;
			result.Height = stringBlockTextModifierInfo.Height;
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateLineHeight(StringInfoBase info, int lineIndex, int deltaHeight)
		{
			Rectangle value = info.LinesBounds[lineIndex];
			value.Height += deltaHeight;
			info.LinesBounds[lineIndex] = value;
		}

		private void OffsetLines(StringInfoBase info, int startLineNumber, int deltaY)
		{
			for (int i = startLineNumber; i < info.LinesBounds.Count; i++)
			{
				Rectangle value = info.LinesBounds[i];
				if (!value.IsEmpty)
				{
					value.Y += deltaY;
					info.LinesBounds[i] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OffsetBlocks(StringInfoBase info, int startLineNumber, int deltaY)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < info.Blocks.Count; i++)
			{
				if (info.Blocks[i].LineNumber >= startLineNumber)
				{
					Rectangle value = info.BlocksBounds[i];
					value.Y += deltaY;
					info.BlocksBounds[i] = value;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateBaseLine(Rectangle originalBounds, StringInfoBase info, TextProcessInfoBase te)
		{
			//IL_00de: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (info.Blocks.Count < 2)
			{
				if (info.Blocks.Count == 1)
				{
					info.LinesBounds = new List<Rectangle>();
					info.LinesBounds.Add(info.BlocksBounds[0]);
				}
				return;
			}
			info.LinesBounds = new List<Rectangle>();
			int count;
			for (int i = 0; i < info.Blocks.Count; i += count)
			{
				int ascentHeight;
				bool allAscentHeightsSame;
				int lineHeight = GetLineHeight(info, i, out count, out ascentHeight, info.RoundTextHeight, out allAscentHeightsSame);
				ascentHeight = Math.Min(ascentHeight, lineHeight);
				Rectangle item = Rectangle.Empty;
				for (int j = i; j < i + count; j++)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = info.BlocksBounds[j];
					StringBlock stringBlock = info.Blocks[j];
					if (stringBlock.Type != StringBlockType.Text && stringBlock.Type != StringBlockType.Link)
					{
						rectangle = UpdateBlockBoundsByAlign(stringBlock, rectangle, lineHeight);
					}
					else if (originalBounds.Height < 1 || originalBounds.Height > rectangle.Height)
					{
						VertAlignment vAlignment = info.VAlignment;
						if (!allAscentHeightsSame || !info.AllowBaselineAlignment)
						{
							rectangle.Y = UpdateTextBaseLine(info, ascentHeight, lineHeight, stringBlock, rectangle, vAlignment);
						}
						else
						{
							rectangle.Y = CalcYByAppearance(vAlignment, rectangle, lineHeight, reverseHeight: true);
						}
						if (!IsValidSize(info.Bounds))
						{
							te.End.Y = Math.Max(te.End.Y, rectangle.Bottom);
						}
					}
					if (item.IsEmpty)
					{
						item = rectangle;
					}
					else
					{
						item.X = Math.Min(item.X, rectangle.X);
						item.Y = Math.Min(item.Y, rectangle.Y);
						if (rectangle.Right > item.Right)
						{
							item.Width = rectangle.Right - item.X;
						}
						if (rectangle.Bottom > item.Bottom)
						{
							item.Height = rectangle.Bottom - item.Y;
						}
					}
					info.BlocksBounds[j] = rectangle;
				}
				while (info.LinesBounds.Count < info.Blocks[i].LineNumber)
				{
					info.LinesBounds.Add(Rectangle.Empty);
				}
				info.LinesBounds.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private int GetLineHeight(StringInfoBase info, int startIndex, out int count, out int ascentHeight, bool roundTextHeight, out bool allAscentHeightsSame)
		{
			count = 0;
			allAscentHeightsSame = true;
			ascentHeight = info.Blocks[startIndex].FontBaseLine;
			int val = 0;
			int lineNumber = info.Blocks[startIndex].LineNumber;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < info.Blocks.Count && info.Blocks[i].LineNumber == lineNumber; i++)
			{
				info.Blocks[i].Height = GetBlockHeight(info.Context, info.Blocks[i], roundTextHeight);
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int j = startIndex; j < info.Blocks.Count && info.Blocks[j].LineNumber == lineNumber; j++)
			{
				count++;
				num = Math.Max(num, info.Blocks[j].Height);
				if (info.Blocks[j].Type == StringBlockType.Image)
				{
					val = Math.Max(val, info.Blocks[j].FontBaseLine);
					continue;
				}
				if (ascentHeight != info.Blocks[j].FontBaseLine)
				{
					allAscentHeightsSame = false;
				}
				ascentHeight = Math.Max(ascentHeight, info.Blocks[j].FontBaseLine);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int UpdateTextBaseLine(StringInfoBase info, int ascentHeight, int lineHeight, StringBlock block, Rectangle bounds, VertAlignment valign)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			int y = bounds.Y;
			int num = bounds.Y + lineHeight;
			switch ((int)valign)
			{
			case 0:
			case 2:
				bounds.Y += (lineHeight - bounds.Height) / 2 + (ascentHeight - block.FontAscentHeight) / 2;
				break;
			case 1:
				bounds.Y += ascentHeight - block.FontBaseLine;
				break;
			case 3:
				bounds.Y += lineHeight - bounds.Height;
				break;
			}
			bounds.Y = Math.Max(bounds.Y, y);
			if (bounds.Y + block.FontAscentHeight > num)
			{
				bounds.Y -= bounds.Bottom - num;
			}
			return bounds.Y;
		}

		private Rectangle UpdateBlockBoundsByAlign(StringBlock sb, Rectangle bounds, int lineHeight)
		{
			if (bounds.Height < lineHeight)
			{
				switch (sb.Alignment)
				{
				case StringBlockAlignment.Bottom:
					bounds.Y += lineHeight - bounds.Height;
					break;
				case StringBlockAlignment.Center:
					bounds.Y += (lineHeight - bounds.Height) / 2;
					break;
				}
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		protected void UpdateBoundsByAppearance(StringInfoBase info, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int x = CalcXByAlignment(bounds, info.Bounds.Width, CheckRTLHAlignment(info));
			int y = CalcYByAppearance(info.VAlignment, bounds, info.Bounds.Height, reverseHeight: false);
			if (bounds.Width < 1)
			{
				x = bounds.X;
			}
			if (bounds.Height < 1)
			{
				y = bounds.Y;
			}
			info.UpdateLocation(new Point(x, y));
			if (bounds.Width > 0)
			{
				info.UpdateXLocation(CheckRTLHAlignment(info), bounds);
			}
			info.OriginalBounds = bounds;
		}

		private int CalcYByAppearance(VertAlignment align, Rectangle bounds, int height, bool reverseHeight)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = (reverseHeight ? (height - bounds.Height) : (bounds.Height - height));
			int num2 = bounds.Y;
			if (num < 1)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			if ((int)align == 2 || (int)align == 0)
			{
				num2 += num / 2 + ((!reverseHeight) ? (num % 2) : 0);
			}
			if ((int)align == 3)
			{
				num2 += num;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private HorzAlignment CheckRTLHAlignment(StringInfoBase info)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			HorzAlignment hAlignment = info.HAlignment;
			if (info.RightToLeft)
			{
				if ((int)hAlignment <= 1)
				{
					return (HorzAlignment)3;
				}
				if ((int)hAlignment == 3)
				{
					return (HorzAlignment)1;
				}
			}
			return hAlignment;
		}

		protected bool IsSimpleStringCore(string text)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (text.IndexOf('<') < 0)
			{
				return text.IndexOf('&') < 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public string RemoveFormat(string text, bool allowNewLine)
		{
			if (IsSimpleStringCore(text))
			{
				return text;
			}
			List<StringBlock> list = StringParser.Parse(12f, text, allowNewLine);
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1 && (list[0].Type == StringBlockType.Text || list[0].Type == StringBlockType.Link))
			{
				return list[0].Text;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				StringBlock stringBlock = list[i];
				if (stringBlock.Type == StringBlockType.Text || stringBlock.Type == StringBlockType.Link)
				{
					if (num != stringBlock.LineNumber && allowNewLine)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("\r\n");
						num = stringBlock.LineNumber;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(stringBlock.Text);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual float GetDpiScaleFactor(TStringCalculateArgs e)
		{
			return 1f;
		}

		protected virtual Image GetImage(object context, string id, Size size)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (id[0] == '#')
			{
				return ResourceImageProvider.Current.GetImage(context, id, 1f, size);
			}
			if (context is IStringImageProvider stringImageProvider)
			{
				return stringImageProvider.GetImage(id);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected Size GetBlockSize(object context, StringBlock block)
		{
			StringBlockType type = block.Type;
			if (type == StringBlockType.Image)
			{
				return GetImageBlockSize(context, block);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Unsupported block type", "block.Type");
		}

		protected virtual Size GetImageBlockSize(object context, StringBlock imageBlock)
		{
			Size size = imageBlock.Size;
			if (size.IsEmpty)
			{
				return GetImage(context, imageBlock.ImageName, imageBlock.Size)?.Size ?? Size.Empty;
			}
			return size;
		}

		protected int GetBlockHeight(object context, StringBlock block, bool roundTextHeight)
		{
			switch (block.Type)
			{
			case StringBlockType.Text:
			case StringBlockType.Link:
			{
				int num = Math.Max(block.TextHeight, block.FontHeight);
				if (roundTextHeight && num % 2 == 1)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}
			case StringBlockType.Image:
				return GetBlockSize(context, block).Height;
			default:
				return 0;
			}
		}

		protected void ProcessBlock(TStringCalculateArgs e, TTextProcessInfo te, List<StringBlock> strings, int index)
		{
			switch (te.Block.Type)
			{
			case StringBlockType.Text:
			case StringBlockType.Link:
				ProcessText(e, te, strings, index);
				break;
			case StringBlockType.Image:
				ProcessText(e, te, strings, index);
				break;
			default:
				throw new Exception($"Not implemented {te.Block.Type} block type");
			}
		}

		private int CalcSeparatorsWidth(TTextProcessInfo te, List<StringBlock> strings, int index)
		{
			if (strings == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (te.Block.Text[te.Block.Text.Length - 1] == '\r')
			{
				return 0;
			}
			for (int i = index + 1; i < strings.Count && IsSeparator(strings[i]); i++)
			{
				StringBlock block = te.Block;
				te.Block = strings[i];
				num += GetStringWidth(te, strings[i].Text);
				te.Block = block;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CalcConnectedWidth(TTextProcessInfo te, List<StringBlock> strings, int index)
		{
			int num = CalcSeparatorsWidth(te, strings, index);
			return num + CalcNbspTextWidth(te, strings, index);
		}

		private string[] GetWordList(TextProcessInfoBase te, string drawText)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			while (drawText != "")
			{
				string nextWord = GetNextWord(ref drawText);
				if (nextWord == "" || nextWord[0] < ' ')
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(nextWord);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private string GetWords(string[] array, int count)
		{
			return string.Join(string.Empty, array, 0, Math.Min(count, array.Length));
		}

		private int GetMaxCharacterCountCore(TTextProcessInfo te, string drawText, int maxWidth)
		{
			if (drawText.Length == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = te.Info.GetDXStringFormat();
			if (dXStringFormat != null)
			{
				DXStringFormatFlags formatFlags = dXStringFormat.FormatFlags;
				try
				{
					dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces | DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
					return GetMaxCharacterCount(te, drawText, null, dXStringFormat, maxWidth);
				}
				finally
				{
					dXStringFormat.FormatFlags = formatFlags;
				}
			}
			StringFormat stringFormat = te.Info.GetStringFormat();
			StringFormatFlags formatFlags2 = stringFormat.FormatFlags;
			try
			{
				stringFormat.FormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces | StringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
				return GetMaxCharacterCount(te, drawText, stringFormat, null, maxWidth);
			}
			finally
			{
				stringFormat.FormatFlags = formatFlags2;
			}
		}

		private string GetTextFitPart(TTextProcessInfo te, string drawText, int maxWidth)
		{
			int maxCharacterCountCore = GetMaxCharacterCountCore(te, drawText, maxWidth);
			if (maxCharacterCountCore == drawText.Length)
			{
				return drawText;
			}
			return drawText.Substring(0, maxCharacterCountCore);
		}

		protected virtual int GetMaxCharacterCount(TTextProcessInfo te, string drawText, StringFormat format, DXStringFormat dxFormat, int maxWidth)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = drawText.Length;
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
			{
				if (num2 - num <= 1)
				{
					break;
				}
				num3 = (num2 + num) / 2;
				string text = drawText.Substring(0, num3);
				num4 = GetStringWidth(te, te.Info, te.Block, text);
				if (num4 == maxWidth)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (num4 > maxWidth)
				{
					num2 = num3;
				}
				else
				{
					num = num3;
				}
			}
			if (num4 > maxWidth)
			{
				num3 = num;
			}
			return num3;
		}

		private int RemoveControlChars(string drawText, int textPos)
		{
			while (RemainLength(drawText, textPos) > 0 && drawText[textPos] != '\r' && drawText[textPos] < ' ')
			{
				textPos++;
			}
			return textPos;
		}

		private int TrimStart(string text, int textPos)
		{
			while (textPos < text.Length && (text[textPos] == ' ' || text[textPos] == '\u00a0'))
			{
				textPos++;
			}
			return textPos;
		}

		private int ProcessEmptyWord(TextProcessInfoBase te, string text, int textPos, StringCalculateArgsBase e, List<StringBlock> strings, int index)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (RemainLength(text, textPos) > 0 && text[textPos] == '\r')
			{
				while (RemainLength(text, textPos) > 0 && text[textPos] == '\r')
				{
					textPos++;
					textPos = RemoveControlChars(text, textPos);
					te.CurrentY += te.LineHeight;
				}
				flag = false;
			}
			else
			{
				te.CurrentY += te.LineHeight;
			}
			textPos = RemoveControlChars(text, textPos);
			te.LineNumber++;
			if (e.AllowNewLineSymbols)
			{
				for (int i = index + 1; i < strings.Count; i++)
				{
					strings[i].LineNumber++;
				}
			}
			te.LineHeight = 0;
			te.CurrentX = te.Bounds.X;
			te.IsNewLine = true;
			if (flag)
			{
				textPos = TrimStart(text, textPos);
			}
			if (te.Info.DisableWrapNonFitText)
			{
				return text.Length;
			}
			return textPos;
		}

		private bool StartsWithNbsp(string text, int textPos)
		{
			if (textPos >= 0 && textPos < text.Length)
			{
				return text[textPos] == '\u00a0';
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetNextWordsAlt(TTextProcessInfo te, string drawText, int textPos, int wordsWidth, out int width)
		{
			width = 0;
			if (!te.AllowMultiLine)
			{
				width = GetStringWidth(te, drawText);
				return drawText;
			}
			string[] wordList = GetWordList(te, drawText);
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (wordList.Length > 6)
			{
				string text = "";
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = wordList.Length - 1;
				int num3 = -1;
				while (num <= num2)
				{
					int num4 = num + (num2 - num >> 1);
					string words = GetWords(wordList, num4);
					int stringWidth = GetStringWidth(te, words);
					if (stringWidth < wordsWidth)
					{
						num = num4 + 1;
						num3 = num4;
						text = words;
						width = stringWidth;
						continue;
					}
					if (stringWidth == wordsWidth)
					{
						width = stringWidth;
						text = words;
						break;
					}
					num2 = num4 - 1;
				}
				if (text != "")
				{
					return text;
				}
				if (te.IsNewLine)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(wordList[0]);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < wordList.Length; i++)
				{
					string text2 = wordList[i];
					int stringWidth2 = GetStringWidth(te, stringBuilder?.ToString() + text2);
					if (stringWidth2 > wordsWidth && (i > 0 || !te.IsNewLine))
					{
						break;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(text2);
				}
			}
			if (width == 0 && stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				width = GetStringWidth(te, stringBuilder.ToString());
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected int GetNextWordLengthCore(string text, int start)
		{
			if (start >= text.Length)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int i;
			for (i = start + 1; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c == '\u0085' || (c != '\u00a0' && c != '\t' && c <= ' '))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return i - start;
		}

		protected string GetNextWord(ref string drawText)
		{
			if (GetUseAltAlgorithm())
			{
				return GetNextWordAlt(ref drawText);
			}
			if (drawText.Length == 0)
			{
				return "";
			}
			int i;
			for (i = 1; i < drawText.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = drawText[i];
				if (c == '\u0085' || (c != '\u00a0' && c != '\t' && c <= ' '))
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			string result = drawText.Substring(0, i);
			drawText = drawText.Substring(i, drawText.Length - i);
			return result;
		}

		private string GetNextWordAlt(ref string drawText)
		{
			if (drawText.Length == 0)
			{
				return "";
			}
			int i;
			for (i = 1; i < drawText.Length && !char.IsWhiteSpace(drawText[i]) && drawText[i] >= ' '; i++)
			{
				if (char.GetUnicodeCategory(drawText[i]) == UnicodeCategory.OtherLetter && i < drawText.Length - 1)
				{
					char c = drawText[i + 1];
					if (char.GetUnicodeCategory(c) == UnicodeCategory.OtherLetter)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			string result = drawText.Substring(0, i);
			drawText = drawText.Substring(i, drawText.Length - i);
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual bool GetUseAltAlgorithm()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private string GetNextWords(TTextProcessInfo te, string text, int textPos, int availableWidth, out int width, int separatorWidth)
		{
			if (GetUseAltAlgorithm())
			{
				availableWidth -= separatorWidth;
				return GetNextWordsAlt(te, text, textPos, availableWidth, out width);
			}
			if (!te.AllowMultiLine)
			{
				width = GetStringWidth(te, text);
				return text;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
			if (te.IsNewLine)
			{
				int nextWordLengthCore = GetNextWordLengthCore(text, textPos);
				stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(nextWordLengthCore);
				stringBuilder.Append(text, textPos, nextWordLengthCore);
				textPos += nextWordLengthCore;
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			}
			width = 0;
			int num = 0;
			while (textPos < text.Length)
			{
				num = GetNextWordLengthCore(text, textPos);
				if (num == 0 || text[textPos] < ' ')
				{
					break;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(text, textPos, num);
				int stringWidth = GetStringWidth(te, stringBuilder.ToString());
				if (textPos + num >= text.Length)
				{
					availableWidth -= separatorWidth;
				}
				if (stringWidth > availableWidth)
				{
					stringBuilder.Remove(stringBuilder.Length - num, num);
					break;
				}
				width = stringWidth;
				textPos += num;
			}
			string text2 = stringBuilder.ToString();
			if (width == 0 && stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				width = GetStringWidth(te, text2);
				if (!te.IsNewLine)
				{
					textPos += text2.Length;
				}
			}
			return text2;
		}

		private bool TextFit(TextProcessInfoBase te, int textWidth, int maxWidth, int separatorWidth)
		{
			return te.CurrentX - te.Bounds.X + textWidth + separatorWidth <= maxWidth;
		}

		private bool IsSeparator(StringBlock block)
		{
			if (block.Text != null && block.Text.Length == 1)
			{
				return char.GetUnicodeCategory(block.Text, 0) == UnicodeCategory.OtherPunctuation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int RemainLength(string text, int startPos)
		{
			return text.Length - startPos;
		}

		protected void ProcessText(TStringCalculateArgs e, TTextProcessInfo te, List<StringBlock> strings, int index)
		{
			int num = te.Bounds.Width;
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				num = int.MaxValue;
			}
			string text = te.Block.Text;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			while (RemainLength(text, num2) > 0 && text[num2] != 0)
			{
				te.IsNewLine = te.Bounds.X == te.CurrentX || !te.AllowMultiLine;
				int width = 0;
				string empty = string.Empty;
				int num3 = CalcConnectedWidth(te, strings, index);
				flag2 = te.Block.Type == StringBlockType.Image && num3 > 0;
				int num4 = num - (te.CurrentX - te.Bounds.X);
				if (te.Block.Type == StringBlockType.Text || te.Block.Type == StringBlockType.Link || flag2)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						empty = GetNextWords(te, text, num2, num4, out width, num3);
					}
					else
					{
						width = GetBlockSize(te.Context, te.Block).Width;
						empty = text;
					}
					if (te.AllowMultiLine)
					{
						bool flag3 = e.AllowNewLineSymbols && empty.Length > 0 && empty[0] == '\r';
						if (flag || ((empty == "" || empty[0] < ' ') && !StartsWithNbsp(text, num2) && !flag3))
						{
							flag = false;
							num2 = ProcessEmptyWord(te, text, num2, e, strings, index);
							continue;
						}
						if (empty == "" && StartsWithNbsp(text, num2))
						{
							string text2 = text.Substring(num2);
							width = GetStringWidth(te, text2);
							empty = text2;
						}
						if (te.AllowMultiLine && !TextFit(te, width, num, num3))
						{
							if (flag2)
							{
								if (te.CurrentX != te.Bounds.X)
								{
									flag = false;
									num2 = ProcessEmptyWord(te, text, num2, e, strings, index);
									continue;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								string textFitPart = GetTextFitPart(te, empty, num4);
								if (textFitPart != string.Empty)
								{
									empty = textFitPart;
									width = GetStringWidth(te, empty);
									if (te.Info.DisableWrapNonFitText)
									{
										empty = text;
									}
									flag = true;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (te.Block.Type == StringBlockType.Image)
					{
						width = GetBlockSize(te.Context, te.Block).Width;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					empty = te.Block.Text;
					width = GetBlockSize(te.Context, te.Block).Width;
					if (te.Block.Type == StringBlockType.Image && te.AllowMultiLine && width > num4 && width <= num)
					{
						ProcessEmptyWord(te, text, num2, e, strings, index);
						continue;
					}
				}
				int blockHeight = GetBlockHeight(te.Context, te.Block, te.RoundTextHeight);
				if (te.IsNewLine)
				{
					te.LineHeight = blockHeight;
				}
				else
				{
					te.LineHeight = Math.Max(blockHeight, te.LineHeight);
				}
				Rectangle value = CreateNewBlock(e, te, width, empty);
				if (!te.AllowMultiLine && num != int.MaxValue && te.CurrentX >= te.Bounds.X + num)
				{
					value.Width = Math.Max(0, te.Bounds.X + num - value.X);
					te.End.X = value.Right;
					te.CurrentX = value.Right;
					te.Info.BlocksBounds[te.Info.BlocksBounds.Count - 1] = value;
					te.IsCropped = true;
					break;
				}
				te.End.X = Math.Min(te.End.X, te.Bounds.X + num);
				if ((te.Block.Type == StringBlockType.Text || te.Block.Type == StringBlockType.Link) && empty.Length != text.Length)
				{
					num2 += empty.Length;
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private Rectangle CreateNewBlock(TStringCalculateArgs e, TextProcessInfoBase te, int textWidth, string words)
		{
			StringBlock stringBlock = new StringBlock
			{
				DpiScaleFactor = GetDpiScaleFactor(e)
			};
			stringBlock.Text = words;
			stringBlock.SetBlock(te.Block);
			stringBlock.LineNumber = te.LineNumber;
			stringBlock.Link = te.Block.Link;
			te.Info.Blocks.Add(stringBlock);
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(te.CurrentPosition, new Size(textWidth, GetBlockHeight(te.Context, te.Block, te.RoundTextHeight)));
			te.Info.BlocksBounds.Add(rectangle);
			UpdateBlockAscentHeight(te, stringBlock, rectangle);
			te.CurrentX += textWidth;
			te.End.Y = Math.Max(te.End.Y, te.CurrentY + te.LineHeight);
			te.End.X = Math.Max(te.End.X, te.CurrentX);
			te.LastBlock = stringBlock;
			return rectangle;
		}

		private void UpdateBlockAscentHeight(TextProcessInfoBase te, StringBlock newBlock, Rectangle lastBlock)
		{
			if (newBlock.Type == StringBlockType.Image && lastBlock.Height > 0)
			{
				newBlock.SetAscentHeight((int)((float)lastBlock.Height * AscentHeightMultiplier));
			}
		}

		private int GetStringWidth(TTextProcessInfo te, string text)
		{
			return GetStringWidth(te, te.Info, te.Block, text);
		}

		protected virtual int GetStringWidth(TTextProcessInfo te, StringInfoBase info, StringBlock block, string text)
		{
			if (text.Length == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = info.GetDXStringFormat();
			if (dXStringFormat != null)
			{
				DXStringAlignment alignment = dXStringFormat.Alignment;
				DXStringFormatFlags formatFlags = dXStringFormat.FormatFlags;
				try
				{
					dXStringFormat.Alignment = DXStringAlignment.Near;
					dXStringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces | DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
					Size size = CalcStringBlockSize(te, block, text, null, dXStringFormat);
					block.TextHeight = Math.Max(block.TextHeight, size.Height);
					return size.Width;
				}
				finally
				{
					dXStringFormat.FormatFlags = formatFlags;
					dXStringFormat.Alignment = alignment;
				}
			}
			StringFormat stringFormat = info.GetStringFormat();
			StringAlignment alignment2 = stringFormat.Alignment;
			StringFormatFlags formatFlags2 = stringFormat.FormatFlags;
			try
			{
				stringFormat.Alignment = StringAlignment.Near;
				stringFormat.FormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces | StringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
				Size size2 = CalcStringBlockSize(te, block, text, stringFormat, null);
				block.TextHeight = Math.Max(block.TextHeight, size2.Height);
				return size2.Width;
			}
			finally
			{
				stringFormat.FormatFlags = formatFlags2;
				stringFormat.Alignment = alignment2;
			}
		}

		private int CalcNbspTextWidth(TTextProcessInfo te, List<StringBlock> strings, int index)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (strings == null || index == strings.Count - 1)
			{
				return num;
			}
			StringBlock stringBlock = strings[index + 1];
			if (strings[index].LineNumber != stringBlock.LineNumber)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (stringBlock.Text.Length > 0 && stringBlock.Text[0] == '\u00a0')
			{
				num = CalcStringWidthCore(te, stringBlock);
				index++;
				if (stringBlock.Text.Length == 1 && strings.Count > index + 1)
				{
					num += CalcStringWidthCore(te, strings[index + 1]);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CalcStringWidthCore(TTextProcessInfo te, StringBlock block)
		{
			int num = 0;
			StringBlock block2 = te.Block;
			te.Block = block;
			num = GetStringWidth(te, block.Text);
			te.Block = block2;
			return num;
		}
	}

	public class StringParser
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		internal static bool ApplyScaleFactorOnInlineFontSize = false;

		private static TypeConverter converter;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static float dpiScaleFactor;

		public static bool KeepFontStyle { get; set; } = true;

		private static TypeConverter Converter
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (converter == null)
				{
					converter = (TypeConverter)new ColorConverter();
				}
				return converter;
			}
		}

		public static float DpiScaleFactor
		{
			get
			{
				if (dpiScaleFactor == 0f)
				{
					dpiScaleFactor = 1f;
				}
				return dpiScaleFactor;
			}
			internal set
			{
				dpiScaleFactor = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void RegisterColorConverter(TypeConverter colorConverter)
		{
			converter = colorConverter;
		}

		public static StringCommand ParseCommand(ref int n, string text)
		{
			StringCommand stringCommand = new StringCommand();
			int num = n + 1;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || (text[n] != '<' && text[n] != '&'))
			{
				if (IsSeparator(text[n]))
				{
					stringCommand.Command = text[n].ToString();
				}
				return stringCommand;
			}
			int length = text.Length;
			if (length < 3)
			{
				return stringCommand;
			}
			char c = '<';
			char chCommandEnd = '>';
			if (text[n] == '&')
			{
				c = '\0';
				chCommandEnd = ';';
			}
			if (text[num] == c)
			{
				n++;
				return stringCommand;
			}
			if (text[num] == '/')
			{
				num++;
				stringCommand.SetEnd();
			}
			else
			{
				stringCommand.SetStart();
			}
			int num2 = FindCommandEnd(text, num, length, chCommandEnd);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				return stringCommand;
			}
			num2--;
			int num3 = num2 + 1;
			if (num2 > 0 && text[num2 - 1] == '/')
			{
				num2 = SkipWhitespaceFromRight(text, num2 - 2);
				stringCommand.Single = true;
			}
			string cmdUpdated = text.Substring(num, num2 - num);
			if (cmdUpdated.Length < 1)
			{
				return stringCommand;
			}
			int attrStartIndex = 0;
			HtmlStringCommand decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Unknown;
			if (!CheckValidCommand(cmdUpdated, out cmdUpdated, out decodedCommand, out attrStartIndex))
			{
				stringCommand.Code = decodedCommand;
				stringCommand.AttributesStartIndex = attrStartIndex;
				return stringCommand;
			}
			stringCommand.AttributesStartIndex = attrStartIndex;
			stringCommand.Code = decodedCommand;
			stringCommand.Command = cmdUpdated;
			n = num3;
			return stringCommand;
		}

		private static bool CheckValidCommand(string cmd, out string cmdUpdated, out HtmlStringCommand decodedCommand, out int attrStartIndex)
		{
			cmdUpdated = cmd.ToLowerInvariant();
			decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Unknown;
			switch (cmdUpdated)
			{
			case "br":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Br;
				attrStartIndex = 2;
				return true;
			case "b":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.B;
				attrStartIndex = 1;
				return true;
			case "i":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.I;
				attrStartIndex = 1;
				return true;
			case "u":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.U;
				attrStartIndex = 1;
				return true;
			case "nbsp":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Nbsp;
				attrStartIndex = 4;
				return true;
			case "gt":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Greater;
				attrStartIndex = 2;
				return true;
			case "lt":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Less;
				attrStartIndex = 2;
				return true;
			case "s":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.S;
				attrStartIndex = 1;
				return true;
			case "r":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.R;
				attrStartIndex = 1;
				return true;
			case "sub":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Sub;
				attrStartIndex = 3;
				return true;
			case "sup":
				decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Sup;
				attrStartIndex = 3;
				return true;
			default:
				if (cmdUpdated.StartsWith("font"))
				{
					decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Font;
					cmdUpdated = cmd;
					attrStartIndex = 4;
					return true;
				}
				if (cmdUpdated.StartsWith("href"))
				{
					int num = cmd.IndexOf('=');
					if (num != -1)
					{
						cmdUpdated = cmd.Substring(0, num).ToLowerInvariant() + cmd.Substring(num, cmd.Length - num);
					}
					decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Href;
					attrStartIndex = 4;
					return true;
				}
				if (cmdUpdated.StartsWith("color"))
				{
					decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.ForeColor;
					attrStartIndex = 5;
					return true;
				}
				if (cmdUpdated.StartsWith("backcolor"))
				{
					decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.BackColor;
					attrStartIndex = 9;
					return true;
				}
				if (cmdUpdated.StartsWith("size"))
				{
					decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Size;
					attrStartIndex = 4;
					return true;
				}
				if (cmdUpdated.StartsWith("image"))
				{
					cmdUpdated = "image" + cmd.Substring(5);
					decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.Image;
					attrStartIndex = 5;
					return true;
				}
				if (IsKnownTag(cmdUpdated, "p"))
				{
					cmdUpdated = "p" + cmd.Substring(1).ToLowerInvariant();
					decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.P;
					attrStartIndex = 1;
					return true;
				}
				if (IsKnownTag(cmdUpdated, "a"))
				{
					cmdUpdated = "a" + cmd.Substring(1);
					decodedCommand = HtmlStringCommand.A;
					attrStartIndex = 1;
					return true;
				}
				attrStartIndex = 0;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsKnownTag(string command, string tag)
		{
			if (command.Length < tag.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (command.Length == tag.Length)
			{
				return command == tag;
			}
			char c = command[tag.Length];
			if (command.StartsWith(tag))
			{
				if (command.Length != tag.Length && !char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
				{
					return c == '>';
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static List<StringBlock> Parse(float fontSize, string text, bool allowNewLineSymbols)
		{
			return Parse(Color.Empty, fontSize, text, allowNewLineSymbols);
		}

		public static List<StringBlock> Parse(Color foreColor, float fontSize, string text, bool allowNewLineSymbols)
		{
			return Parse(foreColor, Color.Empty, fontSize, text, allowNewLineSymbols);
		}

		public static List<StringBlock> Parse(Color foreColor, Color backColor, float fontSize, string text, bool allowNewLineSymbols)
		{
			return Parse(foreColor, backColor, new HyperlinkSettings
			{
				Color = Color.Blue,
				Underline = true
			}, fontSize, DXFontStyle.Regular, text, allowNewLineSymbols);
		}

		public static StringBlock CreateBlock()
		{
			return new StringBlock
			{
				DpiScaleFactor = DpiScaleFactor
			};
		}

		public static List<StringBlock> Parse(Color foreColor, Color backColor, HyperlinkSettings hyperlinkSettings, float fontSize, string text, bool allowNewLineSymbols)
		{
			return Parse(foreColor, backColor, hyperlinkSettings, fontSize, DXFontStyle.Regular, text, allowNewLineSymbols);
		}

		public static List<StringBlock> Parse(Color foreColor, Color backColor, HyperlinkSettings hyperlinkSettings, float fontSize, DXFontStyle style, string text, bool allowNewLineSymbols)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			List<StringBlock> list = new List<StringBlock>();
			StringBlock stringBlock = CreateBlock();
			stringBlock.FontSettings.SetColor(foreColor);
			stringBlock.FontSettings.SetBackColor(backColor);
			stringBlock.FontSettings.SetSize(fontSize);
			if (KeepFontStyle)
			{
				stringBlock.FontSettings.SetStyle(style);
			}
			StringFontSettings defaultSettings = stringBlock.FontSettings.Clone();
			Stack<StringCommand> commands = new Stack<StringCommand>();
			stringBlock = ParseCore(text, list, stringBlock, defaultSettings, hyperlinkSettings, commands);
			if (!stringBlock.IsEmpty)
			{
				list.Add(stringBlock);
			}
			if (allowNewLineSymbols)
			{
				UpdateLineNumbers(list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static StringBlock ParseCore(string text, List<StringBlock> res, StringBlock block, StringFontSettings defaultSettings, HyperlinkSettings hyperlinkSettings, Stack<StringCommand> commands)
		{
			int length = text.Length;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			StringCommand stringCommand = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c == '\n')
				{
					if ((i > 0 && text[i - 1] == '\r') || (i < length - 1 && text[i + 1] == '\r'))
					{
						continue;
					}
					c = '\r';
				}
				bool flag = stringCommand != null && stringCommand.IsStart && IsHrefCommand(stringCommand);
				if ((c == '<' || c == '&' || (IsSeparator(c) && !flag)) && i < length - 1)
				{
					StringCommand stringCommand2 = ParseCommand(ref i, text);
					if (stringCommand2.IsValid)
					{
						if (stringCommand2.IsSeparator && stringBuilder.Length > 0)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(c);
							continue;
						}
						i--;
						if (stringCommand2.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Br)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append("\r");
						}
						if (stringCommand2.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Nbsp)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append("\u00a0");
							continue;
						}
						if (stringCommand2.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Greater)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append('>');
							continue;
						}
						if (stringCommand2.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Less)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append('<');
							continue;
						}
						if (stringCommand2.IsSeparator && stringBuilder.Length == 0)
						{
							i++;
						}
						StringFontSettings stringFontSettings = block.FontSettings.Clone();
						ApplyCommandSettings(stringFontSettings, defaultSettings, hyperlinkSettings, stringCommand2, commands);
						if (!MustBreak(stringCommand2))
						{
							if (!stringCommand2.IsSeparator && block.FontSettings.IsEquals(stringFontSettings))
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (stringBuilder.Length == 0)
							{
								if ((IsHrefCommand(stringCommand2) || IsScriptCommand(stringCommand2)) && stringCommand2.IsStart)
								{
									ApplyCommand(block, stringCommand2);
								}
								block.FontSettings.Assign(stringFontSettings);
								if (!stringCommand2.IsSeparator)
								{
									stringCommand = stringCommand2;
									continue;
								}
							}
						}
						block.Text = ((stringCommand2.IsSeparator && stringBuilder.Length == 0) ? stringCommand2.Command : stringBuilder.ToString());
						bool flag2 = false;
						if ((block.Type != StringBlockType.Text && block.Type != StringBlockType.Link) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(block.Text))
						{
							res.Add(block);
							flag2 = true;
						}
						StringBlock stringBlock = block;
						block = CreateBlock();
						if (!flag2)
						{
							block.NewLineBefore = stringBlock.NewLineBefore;
						}
						block.FontSettings.Assign(stringFontSettings);
						if (ApplyCommand(block, stringCommand2))
						{
							res.Add(block);
							block = CreateBlock();
							block.FontSettings.Assign(stringFontSettings);
						}
						stringCommand = stringCommand2;
						stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
						continue;
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
			}
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				block.Text = stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return block;
		}

		private static bool IsSeparator(char ch)
		{
			if (ch == '\\' || ch == '/')
			{
				return false;
			}
			return StringExtensions.GetUnicodeCategory(ch) == UnicodeCategory.OtherPunctuation;
		}

		private static bool ApplyCommand(StringBlock block, StringCommand command)
		{
			if (IsImageCommand(command))
			{
				block.Type = StringBlockType.Image;
				block.Text = GetParameterOption(command);
				return true;
			}
			if (command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Href)
			{
				if (command.IsStart)
				{
					block.Type = StringBlockType.Link;
					block.Link = GetParameterOption(command);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.A)
			{
				if (command.IsStart)
				{
					block.Type = StringBlockType.Link;
					block.Link = command.GetAttribute("href");
				}
			}
			else if (command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.P)
			{
				if (command.IsStart)
				{
					block.NewLineBefore = true;
				}
				else
				{
					block.NewLineAfter = true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool MustBreak(StringCommand command)
		{
			if (command.Code != HtmlStringCommand.Br && command.Code != HtmlStringCommand.Image)
			{
				return command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.P;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void ApplyCommandSettings(StringFontSettings current, StringFontSettings defaultSettings, HyperlinkSettings hyperlinkSettings, StringCommand command, Stack<StringCommand> commands)
		{
			if (command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.P || command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Div || command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.A)
			{
				if (command.IsStart)
				{
					commands.Push(command);
					command.Attributes = ExtractAttributes(command);
					ApplyAttributes(current, command);
				}
				else
				{
					if (commands.Count == 0)
					{
						return;
					}
					StringCommand stringCommand = commands.Peek();
					if (stringCommand.Code != command.Code)
					{
						return;
					}
					commands.Pop();
					RevertAttributes(current, command, stringCommand);
				}
			}
			if (IsFontStyleCommand(command))
			{
				DXFontStyle fontStyleCommandOptions = GetFontStyleCommandOptions(command);
				if (command.IsStart)
				{
					if (command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.R)
					{
						current.PushStyle(fontStyleCommandOptions);
					}
					else
					{
						current.AddStyle(fontStyleCommandOptions);
					}
				}
				else if (command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.R)
				{
					current.PopStyle();
				}
				else
				{
					current.RemoveStyle(fontStyleCommandOptions);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (IsHrefCommand(command))
			{
				if (command.IsStart)
				{
					current.SetColor(hyperlinkSettings.Color);
					if (hyperlinkSettings.Underline)
					{
						current.ModifyStyle(DXFontStyle.Underline);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					current.SetColor(Color.Empty);
					current.SetStyle(current.Style & ~DXFontStyle.Underline);
				}
			}
			if (IsColorCommand(command))
			{
				if (command.IsEnd)
				{
					current.RestoreColor(defaultSettings);
					return;
				}
				current.SaveColor(defaultSettings);
				current.SetColor(GetFontColorCommandOptions(command, current));
			}
			else if (IsBackColorCommand(command))
			{
				current.SetBackColor(command.IsEnd ? Color.Empty : GetFontColorCommandOptions(command, current));
			}
			else if (IsFontCommand(command))
			{
				if (command.IsStart)
				{
					string size = string.Empty;
					string color = string.Empty;
					string font = string.Empty;
					if (ExtractFontParams(command.Command, out font, out size, out color))
					{
						float size2 = current.Size;
						Color color2 = current.Color;
						current.SaveSize(defaultSettings);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(size))
						{
							size2 = GetFontSizeCoreWithoutParamName(size, current.Size);
							current.SetSize(size2);
						}
						current.SaveColor(defaultSettings);
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(color))
						{
							color2 = GetColorFromString(color);
							current.SetColor(color2);
						}
						current.FontFamily = font;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					current.RestoreSize(defaultSettings);
					current.RestoreColor(defaultSettings);
					current.FontFamily = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!IsFontSizeCommand(command))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (IsScriptCommand(command))
				{
					float fontSizeCommandOptions = GetFontSizeCommandOptions(command, current.Size);
					if (command.IsStart)
					{
						current.AddModifier((command.Code != HtmlStringCommand.Sub) ? StringBlockTextModifier.SuperScript : StringBlockTextModifier.SubScript, fontSizeCommandOptions);
					}
					else
					{
						current.RemoveLastModifier((command.Code != HtmlStringCommand.Sub) ? StringBlockTextModifier.SuperScript : StringBlockTextModifier.SubScript);
					}
					current.SetSize(fontSizeCommandOptions);
				}
				else if (command.IsEnd)
				{
					current.RestoreSize(defaultSettings);
				}
				else
				{
					current.SaveSize(defaultSettings);
					current.SetSize(GetFontSizeCommandOptions(command, current.Size));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void RevertAttributes(StringFontSettings current, StringCommand command, StringCommand openCommand)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			HorzAlignment alignAttribute = command.GetAlignAttribute();
			if ((int)alignAttribute != 0)
			{
				current.PopAlign();
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyAttributes(StringFontSettings current, StringCommand command)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			HorzAlignment alignAttribute = command.GetAlignAttribute();
			if ((int)alignAttribute != 0)
			{
				current.PushAlign(alignAttribute);
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<string, string> ExtractAttributes(StringCommand command)
		{
			string param = null;
			int startIndex = command.AttributesStartIndex;
			string text = FindParamValue(command.Command, ref startIndex, out param);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>();
			while (text != null)
			{
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(param))
				{
					dictionary[param] = "value";
				}
				else
				{
					dictionary.Add(param, text);
				}
				text = FindParamValue(command.Command, ref startIndex, out param);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static bool ExtractFontParams(string command, out string font, out string size, out string color)
		{
			size = string.Empty;
			color = string.Empty;
			font = string.Empty;
			int startIndex = 0;
			string param = null;
			string text = FindParamValue(command, ref startIndex, out param);
			if (text == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (text != null)
			{
				switch (param)
				{
				case "font":
					font = text;
					break;
				case "color":
					color = text;
					break;
				case "size":
					size = text;
					break;
				}
				text = FindParamValue(command, ref startIndex, out param);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static string FindParamValue(string text, ref int startIndex, out string param)
		{
			param = null;
			int num = FindNextNonSpaceSymbol(text, startIndex);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string paramName = null;
			int num2 = ReadParamName(text, num, out paramName);
			if (num2 == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num3 = FindNextNonSpaceSymbol(text, num2 + 1);
			if (num3 == -1 || text[num3] != '=')
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num4 = FindNextNonSpaceSymbol(text, num3 + 1);
			if (num4 == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num5 = FindNextSpaceSymbol(text, num4);
			if (num5 < num4)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			startIndex = num5 + 1;
			if (text[num4] == '\'' || text[num4] == '"')
			{
				num4++;
				num5--;
			}
			param = paramName;
			if (num5 < num4)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return text.Substring(num4, num5 - num4 + 1);
		}

		private static int ReadParamName(string text, int startIndex, out string paramName)
		{
			paramName = null;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!char.IsLetter(text[i]))
				{
					paramName = text.Substring(startIndex, i - startIndex);
					return i - 1;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private static int FindNextSpaceSymbol(string text, int startIndex)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			char c = '"';
			for (int i = startIndex; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				if (text[i] == '\'' || text[i] == '"')
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						c = text[i];
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (text[i] == c)
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
				else if (char.IsWhiteSpace(text[i]) && !flag)
				{
					return i - 1;
				}
			}
			return text.Length - 1;
		}

		private static int FindNextNonSpaceSymbol(string text, int startIndex)
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!char.IsWhiteSpace(text[i]))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private static void UpdateLineNumbers(List<StringBlock> stringBlocks)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < stringBlocks.Count; i++)
			{
				stringBlocks[i].LineNumber = num;
				stringBlocks[i].Text = stringBlocks[i].Text.Replace("\r\n", "\r");
				stringBlocks[i].Text = stringBlocks[i].Text.Replace('\n', '\r');
				string[] array = stringBlocks[i].Text.Split('\r');
				if (array.Length > 1)
				{
					stringBlocks[i].Text = array[0];
					for (int j = 1; j < array.Length; j++)
					{
						num++;
						StringBlock stringBlock = CreateBlock();
						stringBlock.SetBlock(stringBlocks[i]);
						stringBlock.Text = array[j];
						stringBlock.LineNumber = num;
						i++;
						stringBlocks.Insert(i, stringBlock);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 1; k < stringBlocks.Count; k++)
			{
				if (stringBlocks[k].Text == string.Empty && stringBlocks[k].LineNumber == stringBlocks[k - 1].LineNumber)
				{
					stringBlocks.RemoveAt(k--);
				}
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < stringBlocks.Count - 1; l++)
			{
				if (stringBlocks[l].Text == string.Empty && stringBlocks[l].LineNumber == stringBlocks[l + 1].LineNumber)
				{
					stringBlocks.RemoveAt(l--);
				}
			}
			for (int m = 0; m < stringBlocks.Count; m++)
			{
				if (stringBlocks[m].Text == string.Empty)
				{
					stringBlocks[m].Text = "\r";
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsColorCommand(StringCommand command)
		{
			return command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.ForeColor;
		}

		private static bool IsHrefCommand(StringCommand command)
		{
			if (command.Code != HtmlStringCommand.Href)
			{
				return command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.A;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsFontCommand(StringCommand command)
		{
			return command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Font;
		}

		private static bool IsScriptCommand(StringCommand command)
		{
			if (command.Code != HtmlStringCommand.Sub)
			{
				return command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Sup;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsBackColorCommand(StringCommand command)
		{
			return command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.BackColor;
		}

		private static bool IsImageCommand(StringCommand command)
		{
			return command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Image;
		}

		private static bool IsFontSizeCommand(StringCommand command)
		{
			if (command.Code != HtmlStringCommand.Size && command.Code != HtmlStringCommand.Sub)
			{
				return command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Sup;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsFontStyleCommand(StringCommand command)
		{
			if (command.Code >= HtmlStringCommand.B)
			{
				return command.Code <= HtmlStringCommand.R;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Color GetColorFromString(string str)
		{
			Color empty = Color.Empty;
			try
			{
				return (Color)Converter.ConvertFromInvariantString(str);
			}
			catch
			{
				return empty;
			}
		}

		private static Color GetFontColorCommandOptions(StringCommand command, StringFontSettings current)
		{
			Color color = current.Color;
			if (command.Command.StartsWith("color="))
			{
				Color colorFromString = GetColorFromString(command.Command.Substring(6));
				if (colorFromString == Color.Empty)
				{
					return current.Color;
				}
				return colorFromString;
			}
			if (command.Command.StartsWith("backcolor="))
			{
				Color colorFromString2 = GetColorFromString(command.Command.Substring(10));
				if (colorFromString2 == Color.Empty)
				{
					return current.BackColor;
				}
				return colorFromString2;
			}
			return color;
		}

		private static string GetParameterOption(StringCommand command)
		{
			int num = command.Command.IndexOf('=');
			if (num > -1)
			{
				return command.Command.Substring(num + 1);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static DXFontStyle GetFontStyleCommandOptions(StringCommand command)
		{
			DXFontStyle dXFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			switch (command.Code)
			{
			case HtmlStringCommand.B:
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Bold;
				break;
			case HtmlStringCommand.I:
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Italic;
				break;
			case HtmlStringCommand.U:
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Underline;
				break;
			case HtmlStringCommand.S:
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Strikeout;
				break;
			case HtmlStringCommand.R:
				return dXFontStyle;
			}
			return dXFontStyle;
		}

		private static float GetFontSizeCommandOptions(StringCommand command, float current)
		{
			string text = command.Command;
			if (command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Sub || command.Code == HtmlStringCommand.Sup)
			{
				text = ((!command.IsStart) ? "size=+2" : "size=-2");
			}
			if (text.StartsWith("size=") && text.Length > 5)
			{
				return GetFontSizeCore(text, current);
			}
			return current;
		}

		private static float GetFontSizeCore(string commandText, float current)
		{
			int num = 5;
			if (commandText[5] == '+' || commandText[5] == '-')
			{
				num = 6;
			}
			if (float.TryParse(commandText.Substring(num), NumberStyles.Any, NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo, out var result) && result > 0f)
			{
				float num2 = ((num == 6) ? (current + ((commandText[5] == '-') ? (0f - result) : result)) : result);
				if (ApplyScaleFactorOnInlineFontSize)
				{
					num2 *= DpiScaleFactor;
				}
				return num2;
			}
			return current;
		}

		private static float GetFontSizeCoreWithoutParamName(string commandText, float current)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (commandText[0] == '+' || commandText[0] == '-')
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			if (float.TryParse(commandText.Substring(num), NumberStyles.Any, NumberFormatInfo.InvariantInfo, out var result) && result > 0f)
			{
				if (num != 1)
				{
					return result;
				}
				return current + ((commandText[0] == '-') ? (0f - result) : result);
			}
			return current;
		}

		private static int SkipWhitespaceFromRight(string text, int pos)
		{
			int result = pos;
			while (pos >= 0)
			{
				if (!char.IsWhiteSpace(text[pos]))
				{
					return pos + 1;
				}
				pos--;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static int FindCommandEnd(string text, int pos, int len, char chCommandEnd)
		{
			int num = pos + 1;
			bool flag = false;
			while (num < len)
			{
				if (text[num++] == chCommandEnd)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public static bool Match(List<StringBlock> blocks, string text, bool multiMatch = false, bool caseInsensitive = true)
		{
			if (blocks.Count == 0 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!multiMatch)
			{
				foreach (StringBlock block in blocks)
				{
					block.ResetMatchInfo();
				}
			}
			bool matchFound = false;
			int matchBlockStart = -1;
			int matchStartPosition = -1;
			int matchCount = 0;
			int num = 0;
			num = MatchCore(blocks, text, ref matchFound, ref matchBlockStart, ref matchStartPosition, ref matchCount, caseInsensitive);
			if (!matchFound || matchCount != text.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ApplyMatchCore(blocks, matchBlockStart, matchStartPosition, matchCount);
		}

		private static bool IsAllowMatch(StringBlock block, out int minStartPosition)
		{
			minStartPosition = 0;
			if (block.MatchIndexes != null)
			{
				minStartPosition = block.MatchIndexes.Last() + block.MatchLength.Last();
			}
			if (block.Type != StringBlockType.Link)
			{
				return block.Type == StringBlockType.Text;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ApplyMatchCore(List<StringBlock> blocks, int matchBlockStart, int matchStartPosition, int matchCount)
		{
			for (int i = matchBlockStart; i < blocks.Count; i++)
			{
				StringBlock stringBlock = blocks[i];
				if (IsAllowMatch(stringBlock, out var _) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(stringBlock.Text))
				{
					int num = Math.Min(stringBlock.Text.Length - matchStartPosition, matchCount);
					stringBlock.SetMatchInfo(matchStartPosition, num);
					matchCount -= num;
					matchStartPosition = 0;
					if (matchCount < 1)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static int MatchCore(List<StringBlock> blocks, string text, ref bool matchFound, ref int matchBlockStart, ref int matchStartPosition, ref int matchCount, bool caseInsensitive)
		{
			string text2 = text;
			StringComparison comparisonType = (caseInsensitive ? StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase : StringComparison.CurrentCulture);
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < blocks.Count; i++)
			{
				StringBlock stringBlock = blocks[i];
				if (!IsAllowMatch(stringBlock, out var minStartPosition))
				{
					if (matchFound)
					{
						i = matchBlockStart;
						matchFound = false;
						matchStartPosition = -1;
						text2 = text;
					}
					continue;
				}
				string text3 = stringBlock.Text;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = -1;
				if (matchFound && minStartPosition > 0)
				{
					matchFound = false;
				}
				if (!matchFound)
				{
					num = Math.Max(matchStartPosition, minStartPosition - 1);
					matchStartPosition = minStartPosition - 1;
				}
				while (true)
				{
					int num2 = ((num + 1 >= text3.Length) ? (-1) : text3.IndexOf(text2.Substring(0, 1), num + 1, comparisonType));
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						if (matchFound)
						{
							i = matchBlockStart + 1;
							matchStartPosition = -1;
							matchFound = false;
							text2 = text;
						}
						break;
					}
					int val = text3.Length - num2;
					if (string.Compare(text3, num2, text2, 0, Math.Min(val, text2.Length), comparisonType) != 0)
					{
						num = num2;
						continue;
					}
					if (!matchFound)
					{
						matchFound = true;
						matchStartPosition = num2;
						matchCount = Math.Min(val, text2.Length);
						matchBlockStart = i;
					}
					else
					{
						matchCount += Math.Min(val, text2.Length);
					}
					text2 = text2.Substring(Math.Min(val, text2.Length));
					break;
				}
				if (matchFound && matchCount == text.Length)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}
	}
