	public class ResourceImageProvider
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static ResourceImageProvider current;

		private Dictionary<string, Image> images;

		private ResourceManager resourceManager;

		public static ResourceImageProvider Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (current == null)
				{
					current = new ResourceImageProvider();
				}
				return current;
			}
		}

		protected Dictionary<string, Image> Images
		{
			get
			{
				if (images == null)
				{
					images = new Dictionary<string, Image>();
				}
				return images;
			}
		}

		public ResourceManager ResourceManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (resourceManager == null)
				{
					resourceManager = GetDefaultResourceManager();
				}
				return resourceManager;
			}
			set
			{
				resourceManager = value;
			}
		}

		protected ResourceManager GetDefaultResourceManager()
		{
			Assembly entryAssembly = Assembly.GetEntryAssembly();
			if (entryAssembly == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string[] manifestResourceNames = entryAssembly.GetManifestResourceNames();
			string[] array = manifestResourceNames;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				string text2 = text.ToLowerInvariant();
				if (text2.EndsWith(".resources.resources") || text2.Equals("resources.resources"))
				{
					string baseName = text.Substring(0, text.Length - ".resources".Length);
					return new ResourceManager(baseName, entryAssembly);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected Image GetResourceImage(object context, string id, float dpiScaleFactor, Size imageSize)
		{
			ResourceManager resourceManager = ResourceManager;
			if (resourceManager != null)
			{
				object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(id);
				if (obj is Image)
				{
					return (Image)obj;
				}
				SvgImage val = (SvgImage)((obj is SvgImage) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (imageSize.IsEmpty)
					{
						return SvgBitmap.Create(val).Render(null, dpiScaleFactor, (DefaultBoolean)2, (DefaultBoolean)2);
					}
					imageSize = new Size((int)((float)imageSize.Width * dpiScaleFactor), (int)((float)imageSize.Height * dpiScaleFactor));
					return SvgBitmap.Create(val).Render(imageSize, null, (DefaultBoolean)2, (DefaultBoolean)2);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Image GetImage(object context, string id)
		{
			return GetImage(context, id, 1f, Size.Empty);
		}

		public Image GetImage(object context, string id, float dpiScaleFactor, Size imageSize)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (id[0] == '#')
			{
				id = id.Substring(1);
			}
			if (Images.TryGetValue(id, out var value) && value != null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			try
			{
				value = GetResourceImage(context, id, dpiScaleFactor, imageSize);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Images[id] = value;
			return value;
		}
	}

	public enum HtmlStringCommand
	{
		Unknown,
		Br,
		B,
		I,
		U,
		S,
		R,
		Nbsp,
		Sub,
		Sup,

	public class StringCommand
	{
		private bool isStart = true;

		private string command = string.Empty;

		public bool IsValid => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(command);

		public string Command
		{
			get
			{
				return command;
			}
			set
			{
				command = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsStart => isStart;

		public bool IsEnd
		{
			get
			{
				if (isStart)
				{
					return Single;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool Single { get; internal set; }

		internal int AttributesStartIndex { get; set; }

		internal HtmlStringCommand Code { get; set; }

		public bool IsSeparator
		{
			get
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Command))
				{
					return StringExtensions.GetUnicodeCategory(Command[0]) == UnicodeCategory.OtherPunctuation;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public Dictionary<string, string> Attributes { get; set; }

		internal void SetStart()
		{
			isStart = true;
		}

		internal void SetEnd()
		{
			isStart = false;
		}

		public string GetAttribute(string name)
		{
			string value = string.Empty;
			if (Attributes == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (Attributes.TryGetValue(name, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public HorzAlignment GetAlignAttribute()
		{
			if (Attributes != null)
			{
				string value = string.Empty;
				if (Attributes.TryGetValue("align", out value))
				{
					switch (value)
					{
					case "center":
						return (HorzAlignment)2;
					case "near":
					case "left":
						return (HorzAlignment)1;
					case "far":
					case "right":
						return (HorzAlignment)3;
					}
				}
				return (HorzAlignment)0;
			}
			return (HorzAlignment)0;
		}
	}
	public class StringFontSettings
	{
		private bool styleSet;

		private bool styleModified;

		private DXFontStyle style;

		private HorzAlignment alignment;

		private Color color;

		private Color backColor;

		private float size;

		private Color[] colorStack = new Color[5];

		private int colorStackTop = -1;

		private float[] sizeStack = new float[5];

		private int sizeStackTop = -1;

		private List<StringBlockTextModifierInfo> modifiers;

		public HorzAlignment Alignment => alignment;

		public DXFontStyle Style => style;

		public Color Color => color;

		public Color BackColor => backColor;

		public float Size => size;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsStyleSet
		{
			get
			{
				return styleSet;
			}
			internal set
			{
				styleSet = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsStyleModified
		{
			get
			{
				return styleModified;
			}
			internal set
			{
				styleModified = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int StyleLevel { get; set; }

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int AlignLevel { get; set; }

		public List<StringBlockTextModifierInfo> Modifiers => modifiers;

		public bool HasModifiers
		{
			get
			{
				if (modifiers != null)
				{
					return modifiers.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected DXFontStyle PrevStyle { get; set; }

		protected HorzAlignment PrevAlign { get; set; }

		public string FontFamily { get; internal set; }

		public StringFontSettings()
		{
			style = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			backColor = (color = Color.Empty);
			size = 0f;
		}

		public bool IsEquals(StringFontSettings settings)
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (settings.Style == Style && settings.Color == Color && settings.Size == Size && settings.BackColor == BackColor && settings.FontFamily == FontFamily && settings.StyleLevel == StyleLevel)
			{
				return settings.Alignment == Alignment;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddStyle(DXFontStyle style)
		{
			SetStyle(Style | style);
			StyleLevel++;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void RemoveStyle(DXFontStyle style)
		{
			SetStyle(Style & ~style);
			StyleLevel--;
			if (StyleLevel == 0)
			{
				styleModified = false;
				styleSet = false;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetStyle(DXFontStyle style)
		{
			this.style = style;
			styleSet = true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetAlign(HorzAlignment align)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			alignment = align;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public void ModifyStyle(DXFontStyle style)
		{
			this.style |= style;
			styleModified = true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public void ModifyAlign(HorzAlignment align)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			alignment |= align;
		}

		internal void SetColor(Color color)
		{
			this.color = color;
		}

		internal void SaveColor(StringFontSettings s)
		{
			if (s.colorStackTop < s.colorStack.Length - 1)
			{
				s.colorStackTop++;
				s.colorStack[s.colorStackTop] = color;
			}
		}

		internal void RestoreColor(StringFontSettings s)
		{
			if (s.colorStackTop < 0)
			{
				color = s.Color;
				return;
			}
			color = s.colorStack[s.colorStackTop];
			s.colorStackTop--;
		}

		internal void RestoreSize(StringFontSettings s)
		{
			if (s.sizeStackTop < 0)
			{
				size = s.size;
				return;
			}
			size = s.sizeStack[s.sizeStackTop];
			s.sizeStackTop--;
		}

		internal void SaveSize(StringFontSettings s)
		{
			if (s.sizeStackTop < s.sizeStack.Length - 1)
			{
				s.sizeStackTop++;
				s.sizeStack[s.sizeStackTop] = size;
			}
		}

		internal void SetSize(float size)
		{
			this.size = size;
		}

		internal void SetBackColor(Color backColor)
		{
			this.backColor = backColor;
		}

		public void AddModifier(StringBlockTextModifier modifier, float height)
		{
			if (modifiers == null)
			{
				modifiers = new List<StringBlockTextModifierInfo>();
			}
			Modifiers.Add(new StringBlockTextModifierInfo
			{
				Modifier = modifier,
				Size = height
			});
		}

		public void RemoveLastModifier(StringBlockTextModifier modifierToRemove)
		{
			if (modifiers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = Modifiers.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (Modifiers[num].Modifier == modifierToRemove)
				{
					Modifiers.RemoveAt(num);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Assign(StringFontSettings source)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			styleSet = source.styleSet;
			styleModified = source.styleModified;
			style = source.style;
			alignment = source.alignment;
			color = source.color;
			size = source.size;
			backColor = source.backColor;
			StyleLevel = source.StyleLevel;
			AlignLevel = source.AlignLevel;
			PrevAlign = source.PrevAlign;
			PrevStyle = source.PrevStyle;
			FontFamily = source.FontFamily;
			if (source.modifiers != null)
			{
				modifiers = new List<StringBlockTextModifierInfo>(source.Modifiers.Count);
				modifiers.AddRange(source.Modifiers);
			}
		}

		internal StringFontSettings Clone()
		{
			StringFontSettings stringFontSettings = new StringFontSettings();
			stringFontSettings.Assign(this);
			return stringFontSettings;
		}

		internal void ResetAlign()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			alignment = (HorzAlignment)0;
		}

		internal void ResetStyle(DXFontStyle style)
		{
			this.style = style;
			styleModified = false;
			styleSet = false;
		}

		public void PushStyle(DXFontStyle fontStyle)
		{
			PrevStyle = Style;
			SetStyle(fontStyle);
			StyleLevel++;
		}

		public void PopStyle()
		{
			style = PrevStyle;
			StyleLevel--;
			if (StyleLevel == 0)
			{
				styleModified = false;
				styleSet = false;
			}
		}

		public void PushAlign(HorzAlignment align)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PrevAlign = Alignment;
			SetAlign(align);
			AlignLevel++;
		}

		public void PopAlign()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			alignment = PrevAlign;
			if (AlignLevel != 0)
			{
				AlignLevel--;
			}
		}
	}
	public enum StringBlockType
	{
		Text,
		Image,
		Object,
		Link
	}
	public enum StringBlockAlignment
	{
		Top,
		Center,
		Bottom
	}
	public class StringBlockTextModifierInfo
	{
		public StringBlockTextModifier Modifier { get; set; }

		public int Height { get; set; }

		public int AscentHeight { get; set; }

		public int InternalLeading { get; set; }

		public int InnerHeight => AscentHeight - InternalLeading;

		public float Size { get; set; }
	}
	public enum StringBlockTextModifier
	{
		SubScript,
		SuperScript,
		Normal
	}
	public class StringBlock
	{
		private string text;

		private string imageName;

		private string alt;

		private Font font;

		private DXFont dxFont;

		private int fontHeight = -1;

		private int fontAscentHeight = -1;

		private int internalLeading = -1;

		private int lineNumber = -1;

		private Size? size;

		private StringBlockType type;

		private StringFontSettings fontSettings;

		private StringBlockAlignment? alignment;

		private int[] matchIndex;

		private int[] matchLength;

		internal float DpiScaleFactor { get; set; }

		public StringBlockAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				if (!alignment.HasValue)
				{
					ParseSettings();
				}
				if (!alignment.HasValue)
				{
					return StringBlockAlignment.Center;
				}
				return alignment.Value;
			}
		}

		public int Height { get; set; }

		internal int TextHeight { get; set; }

		public string ImageName
		{
			get
			{
				if (imageName == null)
				{
					ParseSettings();
				}
				if (imageName != null)
				{
					return imageName;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

		public Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				if (!size.HasValue)
				{
					ParseSettings();
				}
				if (!size.HasValue)
				{
					return Size.Empty;
				}
				return size.Value;
			}
		}

		public string Alt
		{
			get
			{
				if (alt == null)
				{
					ParseSettings();
				}
				return alt;
			}
		}

		public string Link { get; set; }

		public StringBlockType Type
		{
			get
			{
				return type;
			}
			set
			{
				type = value;
			}
		}

		public Font Font => font;

		public DXFont DXFont => dxFont;

		public bool IsEmpty => string.IsNullOrEmpty(text);

		public object Data { get; set; }

		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				return text;
			}
			set
			{
				text = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool NewLineBefore { get; set; }

		internal bool NewLineAfter { get; set; }

		public int LineNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return lineNumber;
			}
			set
			{
				lineNumber = value;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int FontHeight => fontHeight;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int FontAscentHeight => fontAscentHeight;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int FontInnerHeight => FontAscentHeight - FontInternalLeading;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int FontBaseLine => FontAscentHeight;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int FontInternalLeading => internalLeading;

		public StringFontSettings FontSettings => fontSettings;

		public int[] MatchIndexes => matchIndex;

		public int[] MatchLength => matchLength;

		public Rectangle ClipBounds { get; internal set; }

		public StringBlock()
		{
			imageName = null;
			size = null;
			alt = null;
			alignment = null;
			fontSettings = new StringFontSettings();
			text = null;
			type = StringBlockType.Text;
			DpiScaleFactor = 1f;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (Type == StringBlockType.Image || Type == StringBlockType.Object)
			{
				return Type.ToString();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Text))
			{
				return Text;
			}
			return "";
		}

		private void ParseSettings()
		{
			if (Type == StringBlockType.Text || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Text))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = text.IndexOf(';');
			if (num < 0)
			{
				imageName = Text;
				alignment = StringBlockAlignment.Center;
				size = Size.Empty;
				return;
			}
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			imageName = array[0];
			for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				ParseParameter(array[i], out var name, out var value);
				ParseSettingsParameter(name, value);
			}
		}

		public static void ParseParameter(string parameter, out string name, out string value)
		{
			name = parameter;
			value = null;
			int num = parameter.IndexOf('=');
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				name = parameter.Substring(0, num).ToLowerInvariant();
				value = parameter.Substring(num + 1);
			}
		}

		private void ParseSettingsParameter(string parName, string parValue)
		{
			switch (parName)
			{
			case "align":
			case "alignment":
				alignment = ParseSettingsAlignment(parValue.ToLowerInvariant());
				break;
			case "size":
				size = ParseSettingsSize(parValue.ToLowerInvariant());
				break;
			case "alt":
				alt = parValue;
				break;
			}
		}

		public string GetMatchText(int index)
		{
			if (matchIndex == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(Text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (index >= matchIndex.Length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = MatchIndexes[index];
			int val = MatchLength[index];
			if (num >= Text.Length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Text.Substring(num, Math.Min(Text.Length - num, val));
		}

		private Size ParseSettingsSize(string parValue)
		{
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			try
			{
				int num = parValue.IndexOf(',');
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return empty;
				}
				empty.Width = (int)(DpiScaleFactor * (float)int.Parse(parValue.Substring(0, num)));
				empty.Height = (int)(DpiScaleFactor * (float)int.Parse(parValue.Substring(num + 1)));
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return empty;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetFontInfo(Font font, DXFont dxFont, int fontHeight, int fontAscentHeight, int internalLeading)
		{
			this.font = font;
			this.dxFont = dxFont;
			this.fontHeight = fontHeight;
			this.fontAscentHeight = fontAscentHeight;
			this.internalLeading = internalLeading;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetFontInfo(Font font, DXFont dxFont, int fontHeight, int fontAscentHeight)
		{
			SetFontInfo(font, dxFont, fontHeight, fontAscentHeight, 0);
		}

		private StringBlockAlignment ParseSettingsAlignment(string parValue)
		{
			if (parValue == "top")
			{
				return StringBlockAlignment.Top;
			}
			if (parValue == "bottom")
			{
				return StringBlockAlignment.Bottom;
			}
			return StringBlockAlignment.Center;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetBlock(StringBlock source)
		{
			alt = source.alt;
			size = source.size;
			alignment = source.alignment;
			font = source.font;
			dxFont = source.dxFont;
			fontHeight = source.fontHeight;
			fontAscentHeight = source.fontAscentHeight;
			internalLeading = source.internalLeading;
			FontSettings.Assign(source.FontSettings);
			type = source.Type;
			LineNumber = source.lineNumber;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetAscentHeight(int fontAscentHeight)
		{
			this.fontAscentHeight = fontAscentHeight;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetMatchInfo(int matchIndex, int matchLength)
		{
			if (this.matchIndex == null)
			{
				this.matchIndex = new int[1] { matchIndex };
				this.matchLength = new int[1] { matchLength };
			}
			else
			{
				Array.Resize(ref this.matchIndex, this.matchIndex.Length + 1);
				Array.Resize(ref this.matchLength, this.matchLength.Length + 1);
				this.matchIndex[this.matchIndex.Length - 1] = matchIndex;
				this.matchLength[this.matchLength.Length - 1] = matchLength;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetMatchInfo(int[] matchIndex, int[] matchLength)
		{
			this.matchIndex = matchIndex;
			this.matchLength = matchLength;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetMatchInfo()
		{
			SetMatchInfo(null, null);
		}
	}
}

	public class DXImageFormatConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		private StandardValuesCollection values;

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string b = text.Trim();
				PropertyInfo[] properties = GetProperties();
				foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
				{
					if (string.Equals(propertyInfo.Name, b, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						object[] index = null;
						return propertyInfo.GetValue(null, index);
					}
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			if (value is DXImageFormat)
			{
				PropertyInfo propertyInfo = null;
				PropertyInfo[] properties = GetProperties();
				PropertyInfo[] array = properties;
				foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo2 in array)
				{
					if (propertyInfo2.GetValue(null, null).Equals(value))
					{
						propertyInfo = propertyInfo2;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (propertyInfo != null)
				{
					if (destinationType == typeof(string))
					{
						return propertyInfo.Name;
					}
					if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(propertyInfo, null);
					}
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		private PropertyInfo[] GetProperties()
		{
			return typeof(DXImageFormat).GetProperties(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			if (values == null)
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
				PropertyInfo[] properties = GetProperties();
				foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in properties)
				{
					object[] index = null;
					arrayList.Add(propertyInfo.GetValue(null, index));
				}
				values = new StandardValuesCollection(arrayList.ToArray());
			}
			return values;
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

	public class DXMarginsConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((TypeConverter)this).CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string text2 = text.Trim();
				if (text2.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (culture == null)
				{
					culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				}
				char c = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator[0];
				string[] array = text2.Split(c);
				float[] array2 = new float[array.Length];
				TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(float));
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					array2[i] = (float)converter.ConvertFromString(context, culture, array[i]);
				}
				if (array2.Length == 1)
				{
					array2 = Enumerable.Repeat(array2.Single(), 4).ToArray();
				}
				else if (array2.Length == 2)
				{
					float num = array2[0];
					float num2 = array2[1];
					array2 = new float[4] { num, num, num2, num2 };
				}
				if (array2.Length != 4)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("TextParseFailedFormat");
				}
				return new DXMargins(array2[0], array2[1], array2[2], array2[3]);
			}
			return ((TypeConverter)this).ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			if (value is DXMargins)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					DXMargins dXMargins = (DXMargins)value;
					if (culture == null)
					{
						culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
					}
					string separator = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator + " ";
					TypeConverter converter = TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(float));
					string[] array = new string[4];
					int num = 0;
					array[num++] = converter.ConvertToString(context, culture, dXMargins.Left);
					array[num++] = converter.ConvertToString(context, culture, dXMargins.Right);
					array[num++] = converter.ConvertToString(context, culture, dXMargins.Top);
					array[num++] = converter.ConvertToString(context, culture, dXMargins.Bottom);
					return string.Join(separator, array);
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					DXMargins dXMargins2 = (DXMargins)value;
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(DXMargins).GetConstructor(new Type[4]
					{
						typeof(float),
						typeof(float),
						typeof(float),
						typeof(float)
					});
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[4] { dXMargins2.Left, dXMargins2.Right, dXMargins2.Top, dXMargins2.Bottom });
					}
				}
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		public override object CreateInstance(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IDictionary propertyValues)
		{
			if (propertyValues == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("propertyValues");
			}
			object obj = propertyValues["Left"];
			object obj2 = propertyValues["Right"];
			object obj3 = propertyValues["Top"];
			object obj4 = propertyValues["Bottom"];
			if (obj == null || obj2 == null || obj4 == null || obj3 == null || !(obj is float) || !(obj2 is float) || !(obj4 is float) || !(obj3 is float))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("PropertyValueInvalidEntry");
			}
			return new DXMargins((float)obj, (float)obj2, (float)obj3, (float)obj4);
		}

		public override bool GetCreateInstanceSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

				if (culture == null)

					culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				}
				string[] value2 = new string[4]
				{

		private static PropertyDescriptorCollection PathProperties(Type type, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(type, attributes);
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				string text = $"{item.ComponentType}.{item.Name}";
				list.Add(TypeDescriptorHelper.CreateProperty(type, item, new Attribute[2]
				{
					new TypeConverterAttribute(typeof(SingleTypeConverter)),
					(Attribute)new DXDisplayNameAttribute(typeof(ResFinder), text)
				}));
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray()).Sort(new string[4] { "Left", "Right", "Top", "Bottom" });
		}

	public class DXFontTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public sealed class DXFontNameConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			private StandardValuesCollection values;

			[ThreadStatic]
			private static string[] fontFamilyNames;

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				if (value is string)
				{
					return value;
				}
				return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				if (values == null)
				{
					string[] array = GetFontFamilyNames();
					Array.Sort(array, Comparer.Default);
					values = new StandardValuesCollection(array);
				}
				return values;
			}

			private static string[] GetFontFamilyNames()
			{
				if (fontFamilyNames == null)
				{
					FontFamily[] families = FontFamily.Families;
					HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
					for (int i = 0; i < families.Length; i++)
					{
						hashSet.Add(families[i].Name);
					}
					string[] array = new string[hashSet.Count];
					hashSet.CopyTo(array, 0);
					fontFamilyNames = array;
				}
				return fontFamilyNames;
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesExclusive(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return true;
			}

			private string MatchFontName(string name, ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				CompareInfo compareInfo = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture.CompareInfo;
				string text = null;
				string[] array = GetFontFamilyNames();
				foreach (string text2 in array)
				{
					if (compareInfo.Compare(text2, name) == 0)
					{
						return text2;
					}
					if (compareInfo.IsPrefix(text2, name) && (text == null || text2.Length <= text.Length))
					{
						text = text2;
					}
				}
				return text ?? name;
			}
		}

		public class DXFontDXUnitConverter : EnumTypeConverter
		{
			public DXFontDXUnitConverter()
				: base(typeof(DXGraphicsUnit))
			{
			}

			public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				if (((EnumConverter)this).Values == null)
				{
					((EnumConverter)this).GetStandardValues(context);
					ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(((EnumConverter)this).Values);
					arrayList.Remove(DXGraphicsUnit.Display);
					((EnumConverter)this).Values = new StandardValuesCollection(arrayList);
				}
				return ((EnumConverter)this).Values;
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static DXFontTypeConverter _default;

		private DXFontNameConverter fontFamilyNameConverter;

		private const string styleHdr = "style=";

		internal static DXFontTypeConverter Default => _default ?? (_default = new DXFontTypeConverter());

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string text)
			{
				string text2 = text.Trim();
				if (text2.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (culture == null)
				{
					culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				}
				char c = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator[0];
				string value2 = text2;
				string text3 = null;
				string text4 = null;
				float size = 8.25f;
				DXFontStyle dXFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
				DXGraphicsUnit unit = DXGraphicsUnit.Point;
				int num = text2.IndexOf(c);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					value2 = text2.Substring(0, num);
					if (num < text2.Length - 1)
					{
						int num2 = text2.IndexOf("style=");
						if (num2 != -1)
						{
							text3 = text2.Substring(num2, text2.Length - num2);
							if (!text3.StartsWith("style="))
							{
								throw GetFormatException(text2, c);
							}
							text4 = text2.Substring(num + 1, num2 - num - 1);
						}
						else
						{
							text4 = text2.Substring(num + 1, text2.Length - num - 1);
						}
						string[] array = ParseSizeTokens(text4, c);
						if (array[0] != null)
						{
							try
							{
								size = (float)TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(typeof(float)).ConvertFromString(context, culture, array[0]);
							}
							catch
							{
								throw GetFormatException(text2, c);
							}
						}
						if (array[1] != null)
						{
							unit = ParseGraphicsUnits(array[1]);
						}
						if (text3 != null)
						{
							int num3 = text3.IndexOf("=");
							text3 = text3.Substring(num3 + 1, text3.Length - "style=".Length);
							string[] array2 = text3.Split(c);
							for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
							{
								string text5 = array2[i];
								text5 = text5.Trim();
								try
								{
									dXFontStyle |= (DXFontStyle)Enum.Parse(typeof(DXFontStyle), text5, ignoreCase: true);
								}
								catch (Exception ex)
								{
									if (ex is InvalidEnumArgumentException)
									{
										throw;
									}
									throw GetFormatException(text2, c);
								}
								DXFontStyle dXFontStyle2 = DXFontStyle.Bold | DXFontStyle.Italic | DXFontStyle.Underline | DXFontStyle.Strikeout;
								if ((dXFontStyle | dXFontStyle2) != dXFontStyle2)
								{
									throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("style", (int)dXFontStyle, typeof(DXFontStyle));
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (fontFamilyNameConverter == null)
				{
					fontFamilyNameConverter = new DXFontNameConverter();
				}
				value2 = (string)fontFamilyNameConverter.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value2);
				return new DXFont(value2, size, dXFontStyle, unit);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (!(value is DXFont font))
				{
					return DesignSR.NoneString;
				}
				if (culture == null)
				{
					culture = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
				}
				return ConvertToStringPresentation(context, culture, font);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is DXFont && TryConvertToInstanceDescriptor((DXFont)value, out var instanceDescriptor))
			{
				return instanceDescriptor;
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		private string ConvertToStringPresentation(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, DXFont font)
		{
			string separator = culture.TextInfo.ListSeparator + " ";
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.InsertRange(0, new string[2]
			{
				font.Name,
				TypeDescriptor.GetConverter(font.Size).ConvertToString(context, culture, font.Size) + GetGraphicsUnitText(font.Unit)
			});
			if (font.Style != DXFontStyle.Regular)
			{
				list.Add("style=" + font.Style.ToString("G"));
			}
			return string.Join(separator, list);
		}

		private bool TryConvertToInstanceDescriptor(DXFont font, out InstanceDescriptor instanceDescriptor)
		{
			int num = 2;
			if (font.AdditionalProperties.Any())
			{
				num = 5;
			}
			else if (font.Unit != DXGraphicsUnit.Point)
			{
				num = 4;
			}
			else if (font.Style != DXFontStyle.Regular)
			{
				num = 3;
			}
			object[] array = new object[num];
			Type[] array2 = new Type[num];
			array[0] = font.Name;
			array2[0] = typeof(string);
			array[1] = font.Size;
			array2[1] = typeof(float);
			if (num > 2)
			{
				array[2] = font.Style;
				array2[2] = typeof(DXFontStyle);
			}
			if (num > 3)
			{
				array[3] = font.Unit;
				array2[3] = typeof(DXGraphicsUnit);
			}
			if (num > 4)
			{
				array[4] = font.AdditionalProperties.ToArray();
				array2[4] = typeof(DXFontAdditionalProperty[]);
			}
			MemberInfo constructor = typeof(DXFont).GetConstructor(array2);
			if (constructor != null)
			{
				instanceDescriptor = new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, array);
				return true;
			}
			instanceDescriptor = null;
			return false;
		}

		public override object CreateInstance(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IDictionary propertyValues)
		{
			if (propertyValues == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("propertyValues");
			}
			object obj = propertyValues["Name"];
			object obj2 = propertyValues["Size"];
			object obj3 = propertyValues["Unit"];
			object obj4 = propertyValues["Bold"];
			object obj5 = propertyValues["Italic"];
			object obj6 = propertyValues["Strikeout"];
			object obj7 = propertyValues["Underline"];
			if (obj == null)
			{
				obj = "Tahoma";
			}
			if (obj2 == null)
			{
				obj2 = 8.25f;
			}
			if (obj3 == null)
			{
				obj3 = DXGraphicsUnit.Point;
			}
			if (obj4 == null)
			{
				obj4 = false;
			}
			if (obj5 == null)
			{
				obj5 = false;
			}
			if (obj6 == null)
			{
				obj6 = false;
			}
			if (obj7 == null)
			{
				obj7 = false;
			}
			if (!(obj is string) || !(obj2 is float) || !(obj3 is DXGraphicsUnit) || !(obj4 is bool) || !(obj5 is bool) || !(obj6 is bool) || !(obj7 is bool))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Argument is invalid.", "propertyValues");
			}
			DXFontStyle dXFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			if (obj4 != null && (bool)obj4)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (obj5 != null && (bool)obj5)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if (obj6 != null && (bool)obj6)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Strikeout;
			}
			if (obj7 != null && (bool)obj7)
			{
				dXFontStyle |= DXFontStyle.Underline;
			}
			return new DXFont((string)obj, (float)obj2, dXFontStyle, (DXGraphicsUnit)obj3);
		}

		public override bool GetCreateInstanceSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private ArgumentException GetFormatException(string text, char separator)
		{
			string arg = string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "name{0} size[units[{0} style1[{0} style2{0} ...]]]", new object[1] { separator });
			return new ArgumentException($"The font {text} is not valid for format {arg}.");
		}

		private string GetGraphicsUnitText(DXGraphicsUnit units)
		{
			string result = "";
			for (int i = 0; i < UnitName.names.Length; i++)
			{
				if (UnitName.names[i].unit == (GraphicsUnit)units)
				{
					result = UnitName.names[i].name;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(DXFont), attributes);
			return properties.Sort(new string[7] { "Name", "Size", "Unit", "Bold", "Italic", "Underline", "Strikeout" });
		}

		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private string[] ParseSizeTokens(string text, char separator)
		{
			string text2 = null;
			string text3 = null;
			text = text.Trim();
			int length = text.Length;
			if (length > 0)
			{
				int i;
				for (i = 0; i < length && !char.IsLetter(text[i]); i++)
				{
				}
				char[] trimChars = new char[2] { separator, ' ' };
				if (i > 0)
				{
					text2 = text.Substring(0, i);
					text2 = text2.Trim(trimChars);
				}
				if (i < length)
				{
					text3 = text.Substring(i);
					text3 = text3.TrimEnd(trimChars);
				}
			}
			return new string[2] { text2, text3 };
		}

		private DXGraphicsUnit ParseGraphicsUnits(string units)
		{
			UnitName val = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < UnitName.names.Length; i++)
			{
				if (string.Equals(UnitName.names[i].name, units, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					val = UnitName.names[i];
					break;
				}
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"{units} is not valid value", "units");
			}
			return (DXGraphicsUnit)val.unit;
		}
	}
	public class DXFontAdditionalPropertyTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is DXFontAdditionalProperty && TryConvertToInstanceDescriptor((DXFontAdditionalProperty)value, out var instanceDescriptor))
			{
				return instanceDescriptor;
			}
			return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}

		private bool TryConvertToInstanceDescriptor(DXFontAdditionalProperty additionalProperty, out InstanceDescriptor instanceDescriptor)
		{
			object[] array = new object[2];
			Type[] array2 = new Type[2];
			array[0] = additionalProperty.Name;
			array2[0] = typeof(string);
			array[1] = additionalProperty.Value;
			string name = additionalProperty.Name;
			if (!(name == "GdiCharSet"))
			{
				if (name == "GdiVerticalFont")
				{
					array2[1] = typeof(bool);
				}
				else
				{
					array2[1] = typeof(object);
					array[0] = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				array2[1] = typeof(byte);
			}
			MemberInfo constructor = typeof(DXFontAdditionalProperty).GetConstructor(array2);
			if (constructor != null)
			{
				instanceDescriptor = new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, array);
				return true;
			}
			instanceDescriptor = null;
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class EmfPlusBeginContainerRecord : EmfPlusRecord
	{
		protected override EmfPlusRecordType Type => EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusBeginContainer;

		public int StackIndex { get; }

		protected override int DataSize => 36;

		public RectangleF SrcRect { get; }

		public RectangleF DstRect { get; }

		public EmfPlusBeginContainerRecord(short flags, EmfPlusReader reader)
			: base(flags)
		{
			DstRect = reader.ReadRectangleF(compressed: false);
			SrcRect = reader.ReadRectangleF(compressed: false);
			StackIndex = reader.ReadInt32();
		}

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		protected override void WriteEmfPlusRecord(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteHeader(writer);
			writer.Write(DstRect);
			writer.Write(SrcRect);
			writer.Write(StackIndex);
		}
	}

	internal class EmfMetafileGraphicsPlayer : IEmfMetafileVisitor
	{
		private readonly IDXGraphics graphics;

		private readonly object fontCache;

		private EmfMetafileState state;

		private EmfPlusExporter emfPlusContext;

		public EmfMetafileGraphicsPlayer(IDXGraphics graphics, object fontCache)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
			this.fontCache = fontCache;
		}

		public void Play(EmfMetafileModel metafile, RectangleF srcRect, RectangleF dstRect)
		{
			using (state = new EmfMetafileState(graphics))
			{
				emfPlusContext = new EmfPlusExporter(fontCache, state);
				state.StartMetafileDrawing(srcRect, dstRect);
				foreach (EmfRecord record in metafile.Records)
				{
					record.Accept(this);
				}
				state.EndMetafileDrawing();
			}
		}

		public void Visit(EmfPlusSetAntiAliasModeRecord record)
		{
			emfPlusContext.SetSmoothingMode(record.SmoothingMode);

	internal static class MetafileHelper
	{
		public static bool IsEmfMetafile(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream.Length - stream.Position < 88)
			{
				return false;
			}
			uint num = BinaryHelper.ReadUInt32Le(stream);
			uint num2 = BinaryHelper.ReadUInt32Le(stream);
			if (num != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (num2 < 88)
			{
				return false;
			}
			byte[] content = BinaryHelper.ReadBytes(stream, (int)num2);
			EmfMetafileHeaderRecord header;
			return EmfMetafileHeaderRecord.TryRead(content, out header);
		}
	}
	public class EmfTextureBrushWriter : EmfPlusBrushWriter<DXTextureBrush>
	{
		public override int BrushDataSize => 0;

		public EmfTextureBrushWriter(DXTextureBrush brush)
			: base(brush)
		{
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(2);
			bool flag = base.Brush.Transform != null && !base.Brush.Transform.IsIdentity;
			EmfPlusBrushData value = (flag ? EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataTransform : EmfPlusBrushData.None);
			writer.Write((int)value);
			writer.Write((int)base.Brush.WrapMode);
			if (flag)
			{
				writer.Write(base.Brush.Transform);
			}
			EmfPlusImage emfPlusImage = new EmfPlusImage(base.Brush.Image);
			emfPlusImage.Write(writer);
		}
	}

	internal static class FlagsHelper
	{
		private const int propertyMask = 255;

		private const ushort smoothingModeMask = 254;

		private const int smoothingModeShift = 1;

		private const ushort antiAliasMask = 1;

		private const int continuedObjectMask = 32768;

		private const short objectTypeMask = 32512;

		private const int objectTypeShift = 8;

		public static EmfPlusObjectType FlagsToObjectType(short flags)
		{
			return (EmfPlusObjectType)((flags & 0x7F00) >> 8);
		}

		public static bool FlagsToContinuedObject(short flags)
		{
			return (flags & 0x8000) != 0;
		}

		public static short GetObjectFlags(int id, EmfPlusObjectType type)
		{
			return (short)(id | ((int)type << 8));
		}

		public static int FlagsToProperty(short flags)
		{
			return flags & 0xFF;
		}

		public static short PropertyToFlags(int property)
		{
			return (short)(property & 0xFF);
		}

		public static EmfPlusSmoothingMode FlagsToSmoothingMode(short flags)
		{
			return (EmfPlusSmoothingMode)((flags & 0xFE) >> 1);
		}

		public static bool FlagsToAntiAlias(short flags)
		{
			return (flags & 1) != 0;
		}

		public static short GetAntiAliasModeFlags(EmfPlusSmoothingMode smoothingMode, bool antiAlias)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num |= ((int)smoothingMode << 1) & 0xFE;
			if (antiAlias)
			{
				num |= 1;
			}
			return (short)num;
		}
	}

	public class EmfHatchBrushWriter : EmfPlusBrushWriter<DXHatchBrush>
	{
		public override int BrushDataSize => 16;

		public EmfHatchBrushWriter(DXHatchBrush brush)
			: base(brush)
		{
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(1);
			writer.Write((int)base.Brush.HatchStyle);
			writer.Write(base.Brush.ForegroundColor);
			writer.Write(base.Brush.BackgroundColor);
		}
	}
	public class EmfLinearGradientBrushWriter : EmfPlusBrushWriter<DXLinearGradientBrush>
	{
		public override int BrushDataSize
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 44;
				if (ShouldWriteTransform)
				{
					num += 24;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteBlend)
				{
					num += EmfPlusBrushWriter<DXLinearGradientBrush>.GetBlendSize(base.Brush.Blend);
				}
				if (ShouldWriteColorBlend)
				{
					num += 4 + 8 * base.Brush.InterpolationColors.Colors.Length;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldWriteBlend
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Brush.Blend != null)
				{
					return !EmfPlusBrushWriter<DXLinearGradientBrush>.IsDefaultBlend(base.Brush.Blend, DXLinearGradientBrush.DefaultBlend);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldWriteTransform => !base.Brush.Transform.IsIdentity;

		private bool ShouldWriteColorBlend => base.Brush.InterpolationColors != null;

		public EmfLinearGradientBrushWriter(DXLinearGradientBrush brush)
			: base(brush)
		{
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(4);
			bool shouldWriteTransform = ShouldWriteTransform;
			bool shouldWriteBlend = ShouldWriteBlend;
			bool shouldWriteColorBlend = ShouldWriteColorBlend;
			EmfPlusBrushData emfPlusBrushData = EmfPlusBrushData.None;
			if (shouldWriteTransform)
			{
				emfPlusBrushData |= EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataTransform;
			}
			if (shouldWriteBlend)
			{
				emfPlusBrushData |= EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataBlendFactors;
			}
			if (shouldWriteColorBlend)
			{
				emfPlusBrushData |= EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataPresetColors;
			}
			writer.Write((int)emfPlusBrushData);
			writer.Write((int)base.Brush.WrapMode);
			writer.Write(base.Brush.Rectangle);
			for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			{
				writer.Write(base.Brush.LinearColors[0]);
				writer.Write(base.Brush.LinearColors[1]);
			}
			if (shouldWriteTransform)
			{
				writer.Write(base.Brush.Transform);
			}
			if (shouldWriteBlend)
			{
				writer.Write(base.Brush.Blend);
			}
			if (shouldWriteColorBlend)
			{
				writer.Write(base.Brush.InterpolationColors);
			}
		}
	}
	public class EmfPathGradientBrushWriter : EmfPlusBrushWriter<DXPathGradientBrush>
	{
		public override int BrushDataSize => 32 + 4 * base.Brush.SurroundColors.Length + EmfPlusPath.GetPathObjectSize(base.Brush.PathData) + (ShouldWriteBlend ? EmfPlusBrushWriter<DXPathGradientBrush>.GetBlendSize(base.Brush.Blend) : 0);

		private bool ShouldWriteBlend
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Brush.Blend != null)
				{
					return !EmfPlusBrushWriter<DXPathGradientBrush>.IsDefaultBlend(base.Brush.Blend, DXPathGradientBrush.DefaultBlend);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldWriteInterpolationColors => base.Brush.InterpolationColors != null;

		private bool ShouldWriteFocusScales => !base.Brush.FocusScales.IsEmpty;

		public EmfPathGradientBrushWriter(DXPathGradientBrush brush)
			: base(brush)
		{
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(3);
			EmfPlusBrushData emfPlusBrushData = EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataPath;
			if (ShouldWriteBlend)
			{
				emfPlusBrushData |= EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataBlendFactors;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteInterpolationColors)
			{
				emfPlusBrushData |= EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataPresetColors;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteFocusScales)
			{
				emfPlusBrushData |= EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataFocusScales;
			}
			writer.Write((int)emfPlusBrushData);
			writer.Write((int)base.Brush.WrapMode);
			writer.Write(base.Brush.CenterColor);
			writer.Write(base.Brush.GetActualCenterPoint());
			writer.Write(base.Brush.SurroundColors.Length);
			Color[] surroundColors = base.Brush.SurroundColors;
			foreach (Color color in surroundColors)
			{
				writer.Write(color);
			}
			writer.Write(EmfPlusPath.GetPathObjectSize(base.Brush.PathData));
			writer.Write(base.Brush.PathData);
			if (ShouldWriteBlend)
			{
				writer.Write(base.Brush.Blend);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteInterpolationColors)
			{
				writer.Write(base.Brush.InterpolationColors);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteFocusScales)
			{
				writer.Write(2);
				writer.Write(base.Brush.FocusScales);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class EmfPlusBrushWriter
	{
		public abstract int BrushDataSize { get; }

		public abstract void Write(EmfContentWriter writer);
	}
	public abstract class EmfPlusBrushWriter<T> : EmfPlusBrushWriter where T : DXBrush
	{
		protected T Brush { get; }

		protected static int GetBlendSize(DXBlend blend)
		{
			return 4 + 8 * blend.Factors.Length;
		}

		protected static bool IsDefaultBlend(DXBlend blend, DXBlend defaultBlend)
		{
			if (blend.Factors.SequenceEqual(defaultBlend.Factors))
			{
				return blend.Positions.SequenceEqual(defaultBlend.Positions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected EmfPlusBrushWriter(T brush)
		{
			Brush = brush;
		}
	}

		}
	}

	public enum EmfPlusFontStyle

		Regular = 0,

	}
	public class EmfContentWriter : BinaryWriter
	{
		public EmfContentWriter(Stream stream)
			: base(stream)
		{
		}

		public void Write(DXGraphicsPathData path)
		{
			Write(-608169982);
			IReadOnlyList<PointF> pathPoints = path.PathPoints;
			int count = pathPoints.Count;
			Write(count);
			Write((path.FillMode == DXFillMode.Winding) ? 8192 : 0);
			Write(pathPoints);
			foreach (DXPathPointType pathType in path.PathTypes)
			{
				Write((byte)pathType);
			}
			int num = 4 - count % 4;
			if (num != 4)
			{
				Write(new byte[num]);
			}
		}

		public void Write(EmfRectL rect)
		{
			Write(rect.Left);
			Write(rect.Top);
			Write(rect.Right);
			Write(rect.Bottom);
		}

		public void Write(EmfSizeL size)
		{
			Write((uint)size.Width);
			Write((uint)size.Height);
		}

		public void Write(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			Write(rectangle.X);
			Write(rectangle.Y);
			Write(rectangle.Width);
			Write(rectangle.Height);
		}

		public void Write(RectangleF rectangle, bool isCompressed)
		{
			if (isCompressed)
			{
				Write(new EmfPlusRect(rectangle));
			}
			else
			{
				Write(rectangle);
			}
		}

		public void Write(EmfPlusRect rectangle)
		{
			Write(rectangle.X);
			Write(rectangle.Y);
			Write(rectangle.Width);
			Write(rectangle.Height);
		}

		public void Write(Color color)
		{
			Write(color.ToArgb());
		}

		public void Write(DXMatrix transformationMatrix)
		{
			Write(transformationMatrix.A);
			Write(transformationMatrix.B);
			Write(transformationMatrix.C);
			Write(transformationMatrix.D);
			Write(transformationMatrix.E);
			Write(transformationMatrix.F);
		}

		public void Write(DXBlend blend)
		{
			float[] positions = blend.Positions;
			Write(positions.Length);
			Write(positions);
			Write(blend.Factors);
		}

		public void Write(DXColorBlend colorBlend)
		{
			float[] positions = colorBlend.Positions;
			Write(positions.Length);
			Write(positions);
			Color[] colors = colorBlend.Colors;
			foreach (Color color in colors)
			{
				Write(color);
			}
		}

		public void Write(IEnumerable<PointF> points)
		{
			foreach (PointF point in points)
			{
				Write(point);
			}
		}

		public void Write(PointF point)
		{
			Write(point.X);
			Write(point.Y);
		}

		private void Write(float[] array)
		{
			foreach (float value in array)
			{
				Write(value);
			}
		}
	}
	public class EmfMetafileModel : IDisposable
	{
		public IList<EmfRecord> Records { get; }

		public bool IsVideoDisplay { get; }

		public EmfRectL Bounds { get; }

		public DXMetafileHeader Header { get; }

		internal bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

		public static EmfMetafileModel Create(byte[] data)
		{
			return Create(new MemoryStream(data));
		}

		public static EmfMetafileModel Create(Stream stream)
		{
			using (IEnumerator<EmfRecord> enumerator = new EmfMetafileParser(stream).GetEnumerator())
			{
				if (enumerator.MoveNext() && enumerator.Current is EmfMetafileHeaderRecord emfMetafileHeaderRecord && enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					IList<EmfRecord> list = new List<EmfRecord>(emfMetafileHeaderRecord.RecordsCount);
					list.Add(emfMetafileHeaderRecord);
					bool isVideoDisplay = true;
					if (((enumerator.Current is EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord emfCommentEmfPlusRecord) ? emfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Records.FirstOrDefault() : null) is EmfPlusHeaderRecord emfPlusHeaderRecord)
					{
						isVideoDisplay = emfPlusHeaderRecord.IsVideoDisplay;
					}
					do
					{
						EmfRecord current = enumerator.Current;
						if (current == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						list.Add(current);
					}
					while (enumerator.MoveNext());
					return new EmfMetafileModel(list, isVideoDisplay, emfMetafileHeaderRecord.Bounds, DXMetafileHeader.FromEmfHeaderRecord(emfMetafileHeaderRecord));
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private EmfMetafileModel(IList<EmfRecord> records, bool isVideoDisplay, EmfRectL bounds, DXMetafileHeader header)
		{
			Records = records;
			IsVideoDisplay = isVideoDisplay;
			Bounds = bounds;
			Header = header;
		}

		public EmfMetafileModel(IList<EmfRecord> records, EmfRectL bounds)
			: this(records, isVideoDisplay: true, bounds, DXMetafileHeader.FromEmfHeaderRecord((EmfMetafileHeaderRecord)records[0]))
		{
		}

		public EmfMetafileModel(IList<EmfRecord> records)
		{
			EmfMetafileHeaderRecord emfMetafileHeaderRecord = (EmfMetafileHeaderRecord)records[0];
			Header = DXMetafileHeader.FromEmfHeaderRecord(emfMetafileHeaderRecord);
			Records = records;
			IsVideoDisplay = true;
			Bounds = emfMetafileHeaderRecord.Bounds;
		}

		public EmfMetafileModel(Size size, DXMetafileFrameUnit frameUnit)
			: this(CreateRecords(size, frameUnit))
		{
		}

		private static IList<EmfRecord> CreateRecords(Size size, DXMetafileFrameUnit frameUnit)
		{
			return new List<EmfRecord>
			{
				EmfMetafileHeaderRecord.CreateFromSize(UnitsToPixels(size, frameUnit, 96f, 96f), 96f, 96f),
				new EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord(new List<EmfPlusRecord>
				{
					new EmfPlusHeaderRecord(96, 96)
				}),
				new EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord(new List<EmfPlusRecord>
				{
					new EmfPlusEofRecord()
				}),
				new EmfEofRecord()
			};
		}

		private static SizeF UnitsToPixels(Size size, DXMetafileFrameUnit unit, float hRes, float vRes)
		{
			return unit switch
			{
				DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel => size, 
				DXMetafileFrameUnit.Point => new SizeF(UnitConverterHelper.PointToPixel(size.Width, hRes), UnitConverterHelper.PointToPixel(size.Height, vRes)), 
				DXMetafileFrameUnit.Inch => new SizeF(UnitConverterHelper.InchToPixel(size.Width, hRes), UnitConverterHelper.InchToPixel(size.Height, vRes)), 
				DXMetafileFrameUnit.Document => new SizeF(UnitConverterHelper.DocumentToPixel(size.Width, hRes), UnitConverterHelper.DocumentToPixel(size.Height, vRes)), 
				DXMetafileFrameUnit.Millimeter => new SizeF(UnitConverterHelper.MmToPixel(size.Width, hRes), UnitConverterHelper.MmToPixel(size.Height, vRes)), 
				_ => size, 
			};
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (EmfRecord record in Records)
			{
				record.Dispose();
			}
			IsDisposed = true;
		}

		public EmfMetafileModel Clone()
		{
			if (IsDisposed)
			{
				throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().FullName);
			}
			List<EmfRecord> list = new List<EmfRecord>(Records.Count);
			foreach (EmfRecord record in Records)
			{
				list.Add(record.Clone());
			}
			return new EmfMetafileModel(list, IsVideoDisplay, Bounds, Header);
		}
	}
	public class EmfMetafileParser : IEnumerable<EmfRecord>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly Stream metafileStream;

		public EmfMetafileParser(byte[] metafileBytes)
		{
			metafileStream = new MemoryStream(metafileBytes);
		}

		public EmfMetafileParser(Stream stream)
		{
			metafileStream = stream;
		}

		public IEnumerator<EmfRecord> GetEnumerator()
		{
			using BinaryReader reader = new BinaryReader(metafileStream, Encoding.UTF8, leaveOpen: true);
			bool isShouldProcessEmf = true;
			while (reader.BaseStream.Position < reader.BaseStream.Length)
			{
				EmfRecordType emfRecordType = (EmfRecordType)reader.ReadInt32();
				int num = reader.ReadInt32();
				switch (emfRecordType)
				{
				case EmfRecordType.EMR_COMMENT:
				{
					int dataSize = reader.ReadInt32();
					if (reader.ReadInt32() == 726027589)
					{
						isShouldProcessEmf = false;
						EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord emfCommentEmfPlusRecord = EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Parse(reader, dataSize);
						if (emfCommentEmfPlusRecord != null)
						{
							IList<EmfPlusRecord> records = emfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Records;
							int count = records.Count;
							if (count > 0)
							{
								isShouldProcessEmf = records[count - 1] is EmfPlusGetDCRecord;
							}
						}
						yield return emfCommentEmfPlusRecord;
					}
					else
					{
						reader.ReadBytes(num - 16);
					}
					break;
				}
				case EmfRecordType.EMR_HEADER:
					yield return EmfMetafileHeaderRecord.Read(reader.ReadBytes(num - 8));
					break;
				case EmfRecordType.EMR_EOF:
					yield return new EmfEofRecord();
					yield break;
				default:
				{
					byte[] content = reader.ReadBytes(num - 8);
					if (isShouldProcessEmf)
					{
						yield return EmfRecord.Create(emfRecordType, content);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class EmfPlusReader : BinaryReader
	{
		private const short relativeLocationFlagMask = 2048;

		private const short compressedFlagMask = 16384;

		public EmfPlusReader(Stream stream)
			: base(stream)
		{
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathData ReadPathData()
		{
			ReadInt32();
			int num = ReadInt32();
			DXPathPointType[] array = new DXPathPointType[num];
			short num2 = ReadInt16();
			ReadInt16();
			PointF[] points = ReadPoints(num, num2);
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num3 < num)
			{
				array[num3++] = (DXPathPointType)ReadByte();
			}
			Stream baseStream = BaseStream;
			long position = baseStream.Position;
			baseStream.Position = position + 3 >> 2 << 2;
			return new DXGraphicsPathData(points, array, ((num2 & 0x2000) != 0) ? DXFillMode.Winding : DXFillMode.Alternate);
		}

		public PointF ReadPointF()
		{
			return ReadPointF(compressed: false);
		}

		public PointF ReadPointF(bool compressed)
		{
			if (compressed)
			{
				return new PointF(ReadInt16(), ReadInt16());
			}
			return new PointF(ReadSingle(), ReadSingle());
		}

		public PointF[] ReadPoints(int count, short flags)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[count];
			if ((flags & 0x800) != 0)
			{
				PointF pointF = (array[0] = new PointF(ReadEmfPlusInt(), ReadEmfPlusInt()));
				for (int i = 1; i < count; i++)
				{
					pointF = (array[i] = new PointF(pointF.X + (float)ReadEmfPlusInt(), pointF.Y + (float)ReadEmfPlusInt()));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bool compressed = (flags & 0x4000) != 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					array[j] = ReadPointF(compressed);
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public RectangleF ReadRectangleF(bool compressed)
		{
			if (compressed)
			{
				return new RectangleF(ReadInt16(), ReadInt16(), ReadInt16(), ReadInt16());
			}
			return new RectangleF(ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle());
		}

		public Color ReadColor()
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(ReadInt32());
		}

		public DXMatrix ReadTransformMatrix()
		{
			return new DXMatrix(ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle());
		}

		public DXBlend ReadBlend()
		{
			int num = ReadInt32();
			DXBlend dXBlend = new DXBlend(num);
			float[] positions = dXBlend.Positions;
			float[] factors = dXBlend.Factors;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				positions[i] = ReadSingle();
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				factors[j] = ReadSingle();
			}
			return dXBlend;
		}

		public DXColorBlend ReadColorBlend()
		{
			int num = ReadInt32();
			DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = new DXColorBlend(num);
			float[] positions = dXColorBlend.Positions;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				positions[i] = ReadSingle();
			}
			Color[] colors = dXColorBlend.Colors;
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				colors[j] = ReadColor();
			}
			return dXColorBlend;
		}

		private int ReadEmfPlusInt()
		{
			byte b = ReadByte();
			byte b2 = (byte)(b >> 1);
			if ((b & 1) == 0)
			{
				if ((b & 0x80) != 0)
				{
					return b2 | -128;
				}
				return b2;
			}
			int num = b2 | (ReadByte() << 7);
			if ((num & 0x4000) != 0)
			{
				return num | -16384;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

	public class EmfWriter
	{
		private readonly IList<EmfRecord> metafileRecords;

		public EmfWriter(EmfMetafileModel metafile)
		{
			metafileRecords = metafile.Records;
		}

		public void Write(Stream stream)
		{
			EmfContentWriter emfContentWriter = new EmfContentWriter(stream);
			int count = metafileRecords.Count;
			foreach (EmfRecord metafileRecord in metafileRecords)
			{
				metafileRecord.Write(emfContentWriter);
			}
			EmfMetafileHeaderRecord.UpdateMetafileSize(emfContentWriter, emfContentWriter.BaseStream.Position);
		}
	}
	public class EmfReader : BinaryReader
	{
		public EmfReader(Stream stream)
			: base(stream)
		{
		}

		public EmfSizeL ReadSignedSizeL()
		{
			return new EmfSizeL(ReadInt32(), ReadInt32());
		}

		public EmfSizeL ReadSizeL()
		{
			return new EmfSizeL(ReadUInt32(), ReadUInt32());
		}

		public Point ReadPoint()
		{
			return new Point(ReadInt32(), ReadInt32());
		}

		public Point ReadPointS()
		{
			return new Point(ReadInt16(), ReadInt16());
		}

		public Color ReadColor()
		{
			Color result = Color.FromArgb(ReadByte(), ReadByte(), ReadByte());
			ReadByte();
			return result;
		}

		public EmfRectL ReadRect()
		{
			return new EmfRectL(ReadInt32(), ReadInt32(), ReadInt32(), ReadInt32());
		}

		public DXMatrix ReadMatrix()
		{
			return new DXMatrix(ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle(), ReadSingle());
		}

		public EmfRectL[] ReadRegion()
		{
			ReadInt32();
			ReadInt32();
			int num = ReadInt32();
			ReadInt32();
			EmfRectL emfRectL = ReadRect();
			EmfRectL[] array = new EmfRectL[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = ReadRect();
			}
			return array;
		}

		public string ReadUnicodeNullTerminatedString(int maxLength)
		{
			long position = BaseStream.Position + maxLength * 2;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(maxLength);
			for (int i = 0; i < maxLength; i++)
			{
				char c = (char)ReadByte();
				c = (char)((ReadByte() << 8) | c);
				if (c == '\0')
				{
					break;
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(c);
			}
			BaseStream.Position = position;
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}

	public class EmfPlusBrush : EmfPlusObject
	{
		private readonly DXBrush brush;

		public DXBrush Brush => brush;

		public override EmfPlusObjectType Type => EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeBrush;

		public override int Size => 4 + CreateBrushWriter().BrushDataSize;

		private static EmfPlusBrush CreateTextureBrush(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			EmfPlusBrushData emfPlusBrushData = (EmfPlusBrushData)reader.ReadInt32();
			DXWrapMode wrapMode = (DXWrapMode)reader.ReadInt32();
			DXMatrix transform = ((!emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataTransform)) ? new DXMatrix() : reader.ReadTransformMatrix());
			DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush = new DXTextureBrush(new EmfPlusImage(reader).Image, wrapMode);
			dXTextureBrush.Transform = transform;
			return new EmfPlusBrush(dXTextureBrush);
		}

		private static EmfPlusBrush CreateLinearGradientBrush(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			EmfPlusBrushData emfPlusBrushData = (EmfPlusBrushData)reader.ReadInt32();
			DXWrapMode wrapMode = (DXWrapMode)reader.ReadInt32();
			DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush = new DXLinearGradientBrush(reader.ReadRectangleF(compressed: false), reader.ReadColor(), reader.ReadColor());
			dXLinearGradientBrush.WrapMode = wrapMode;
			reader.ReadBytes(8);
			if (emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataTransform))
			{
				dXLinearGradientBrush.Transform = reader.ReadTransformMatrix();
			}
			if (emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataBlendFactors))
			{
				dXLinearGradientBrush.Blend = reader.ReadBlend();
			}
			if (emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataPresetColors))
			{
				dXLinearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = reader.ReadColorBlend();
			}
			return new EmfPlusBrush(dXLinearGradientBrush);
		}

		private static EmfPlusBrush CreatePathGradienBrush(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			EmfPlusBrushData emfPlusBrushData = (EmfPlusBrushData)reader.ReadInt32();
			DXWrapMode wrapMode = (DXWrapMode)reader.ReadInt32();
			Color centerColor = reader.ReadColor();
			PointF value = reader.ReadPointF();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			Color[] array = new Color[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = reader.ReadColor();
			}
			DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush;
			if (emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataPath))
			{
				reader.ReadUInt32();
				EmfPlusPath emfPlusPath = new EmfPlusPath(reader);
				dXPathGradientBrush = new DXPathGradientBrush(emfPlusPath.PathData);
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
				PointF[] array2 = new PointF[num2];
				for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
				{
					array2[j] = reader.ReadPointF();
				}
				DXPathPointType[] array3 = new DXPathPointType[num2];
				array3[0] = DXPathPointType.Start;
				for (int k = 1; k < num2; k++)
				{
					array3[k] = DXPathPointType.Line;
				}
				dXPathGradientBrush = new DXPathGradientBrush(new DXGraphicsPathData(array2, array3, DXFillMode.Alternate));
			}
			if (emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataTransform))
			{
				dXPathGradientBrush.Transform = reader.ReadTransformMatrix();
			}
			if (emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataBlendFactors))
			{
				dXPathGradientBrush.Blend = reader.ReadBlend();
			}
			if (emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataPresetColors))
			{
				dXPathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = reader.ReadColorBlend();
			}
			if (emfPlusBrushData.HasFlag(EmfPlusBrushData.BrushDataFocusScales))
			{
				reader.ReadInt32();
				dXPathGradientBrush.FocusScales = reader.ReadPointF();
			}
			dXPathGradientBrush.WrapMode = wrapMode;
			dXPathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = array;
			dXPathGradientBrush.CenterColor = centerColor;
			dXPathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = value;
			return new EmfPlusBrush(dXPathGradientBrush);
		}

		public static EmfPlusBrush Create(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadInt32();
			return (EmfPlusBrushType)reader.ReadInt32() switch
			{
				EmfPlusBrushType.BrushTypeSolidColor => new EmfPlusBrush(new DXSolidBrush(reader.ReadColor())), 
				EmfPlusBrushType.BrushTypeLinearGradient => CreateLinearGradientBrush(reader), 
				EmfPlusBrushType.BrushTypeHatchFill => new EmfPlusBrush(new DXHatchBrush((DXHatchStyle)reader.ReadInt32(), reader.ReadColor(), reader.ReadColor())), 
				EmfPlusBrushType.BrushTypePathGradient => CreatePathGradienBrush(reader), 
				EmfPlusBrushType.BrushTypeTextureFill => CreateTextureBrush(reader), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public EmfPlusBrush(DXBrush brush)
		{
			this.brush = brush;
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			if (brush != null)
			{
				brush.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(-608169982);
			CreateBrushWriter().Write(writer);
		}

		private EmfPlusBrushWriter CreateBrushWriter()
		{
			return EmfBrushWriterFactory.Create(Brush);
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum EmfPlusBrushData
	{
		None = 0,
		BrushDataPath = 1,
		BrushDataTransform = 2,
		BrushDataPresetColors = 4,
		BrushDataBlendFactors = 8,
		BrushDataFocusScales = 0x40,
		BrushDataIsGammaCorrected = 0x80,
		BrushDataDoNotTransform = 0x100
	}
	public enum EmfPlusBrushType
	{
		BrushTypeSolidColor,
		BrushTypeHatchFill,
		BrushTypeTextureFill,
		BrushTypePathGradient,
		BrushTypeLinearGradient
	}

	{
		CombineModeReplace,
		CombineModeIntersect,
		CombineModeUnion,
		CombineModeXOR,
		CombineModeExclude,
		CombineModeComplement
	}
	public class EmfPlusContinuedObject
	{
		private readonly MemoryStream contentStream = new MemoryStream();

		private int totalSize;

		private readonly EmfPlusObjectType objectType;

		public bool IsObjectFinished { get; private set; }

		public EmfPlusContinuedObject(EmfPlusObjectType objectType)
		{
			this.objectType = objectType;
		}

		public void Append(byte[] recordData)
		{
			if (totalSize == 0)
			{
				using EmfPlusReader emfPlusReader = new EmfPlusReader(new MemoryStream(recordData));
				totalSize = emfPlusReader.ReadInt32();
			}
			contentStream.Write(recordData, 4, recordData.Length - 4);
			if (contentStream.Length >= totalSize)
			{
				IsObjectFinished = true;
			}
		}

		public EmfPlusObject ParseObject()
		{
			contentStream.Position = 0L;
			using EmfPlusReader reader = new EmfPlusReader(contentStream);
			return EmfPlusObject.CreateObject(objectType, reader);
		}
	}
	public enum EmfPlusCustomLineCapData
	{
		None,
		FillPath,
		LinePath
	}
	public enum EmfPlusCustomLineCapDataType
	{
		Default,
		AdjustableArrow
	}
	public static class EmfPlusCustomLineCapParser
	{
		private static DXGraphicsPathData ReadPathData(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(reader.ReadBytes(reader.ReadInt32()));
			using EmfPlusReader emfPlusReader = new EmfPlusReader(stream);
			return emfPlusReader.ReadPathData();
		}

		private static DXCustomLineCapBase Read(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadInt32();
			return (EmfPlusCustomLineCapDataType)reader.ReadInt32() switch
			{
				EmfPlusCustomLineCapDataType.Default => ReadCustomLineCap(reader), 
				EmfPlusCustomLineCapDataType.AdjustableArrow => ReadAdjustableArrowCap(reader), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static DXCustomLineCapBase ReadCustomLineCap(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap = new DXCustomLineCap();
			EmfPlusCustomLineCapData emfPlusCustomLineCapData = (EmfPlusCustomLineCapData)reader.ReadInt32();
			dXCustomLineCap.BaseCap = (DXLineCap)reader.ReadInt32();
			dXCustomLineCap.BaseInset = reader.ReadSingle();
			dXCustomLineCap.StrokeStartCap = (DXLineCap)reader.ReadInt32();
			dXCustomLineCap.StrokeEndCap = (DXLineCap)reader.ReadInt32();
			dXCustomLineCap.StrokeJoin = (DXLineJoin)reader.ReadInt32();
			dXCustomLineCap.StrokeMiterLimit = reader.ReadSingle();
			dXCustomLineCap.WidthScale = reader.ReadSingle();
			reader.BaseStream.Position += 16L;
			if (emfPlusCustomLineCapData.HasFlag(EmfPlusCustomLineCapData.FillPath))
			{
				dXCustomLineCap.FillPath = ReadPathData(reader);
			}
			if (emfPlusCustomLineCapData.HasFlag(EmfPlusCustomLineCapData.LinePath))
			{
				dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath = ReadPathData(reader);
			}
			return dXCustomLineCap;
		}

		private static DXAdjustableArrowCap ReadAdjustableArrowCap(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			DXAdjustableArrowCap dXAdjustableArrowCap = new DXAdjustableArrowCap();
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.Width = reader.ReadSingle();
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.Height = reader.ReadSingle();
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.MiddleInset = reader.ReadSingle();
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.Filled = reader.ReadInt32() != 0;
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.StrokeStartCap = (DXLineCap)reader.ReadInt32();
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.StrokeEndCap = (DXLineCap)reader.ReadInt32();
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.StrokeJoin = (DXLineJoin)reader.ReadInt32();
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.StrokeMiterLimit = reader.ReadSingle();
			dXAdjustableArrowCap.WidthScale = reader.ReadSingle();
			reader.BaseStream.Position += 16L;
			return dXAdjustableArrowCap;
		}

		public static DXCustomLineCapBase Read(byte[] data)
		{
			using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(data);
			return Read(new EmfPlusReader(stream));
		}
	}
	public static class EmfPlusCustomLineCapWriter
	{
		private static void WritePath(EmfContentWriter writer, DXGraphicsPathData path)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using EmfContentWriter emfContentWriter = new EmfContentWriter(memoryStream);
			emfContentWriter.Write(path);
			writer.Write((int)memoryStream.Length);
			writer.Write(memoryStream.ToArray());
		}

		private static int GetPathSize(DXGraphicsPathData path)
		{
			return EmfPlusPath.GetPathObjectSize(path) + 4;
		}

		private static void WriteCustomLineCap(DXCustomLineCap cap, EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(0);
			EmfPlusCustomLineCapData emfPlusCustomLineCapData = EmfPlusCustomLineCapData.None;
			if (cap.FillPath != null)
			{
				emfPlusCustomLineCapData |= EmfPlusCustomLineCapData.FillPath;
			}
			if (cap.StrokePath != null)
			{
				emfPlusCustomLineCapData |= EmfPlusCustomLineCapData.LinePath;
			}
			writer.Write((int)emfPlusCustomLineCapData);
			writer.Write((int)cap.BaseCap);
			writer.Write(cap.BaseInset);
			WriteBaseCapData(cap, writer);
			if (cap.FillPath != null)
			{
				WritePath(writer, cap.FillPath);
			}
			if (cap.StrokePath != null)
			{
				WritePath(writer, cap.StrokePath);
			}
		}

		private static void WriteBaseCapData(DXCustomLineCapBase cap, EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write((int)cap.StrokeStartCap);
			writer.Write((int)cap.StrokeEndCap);
			writer.Write((int)cap.StrokeJoin);
			writer.Write(cap.StrokeMiterLimit);
			writer.Write(cap.WidthScale);
			writer.Write(default(PointF));
			writer.Write(default(PointF));
		}

		private static void WriteAdjustableArrowCap(DXAdjustableArrowCap cap, EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(1);
			writer.Write(cap.Width);
			writer.Write(cap.Height);
			writer.Write(cap.MiddleInset);
			writer.Write(cap.Filled ? 1 : 0);
			WriteBaseCapData(cap, writer);
		}

		public static byte[] Write(DXCustomLineCapBase cap)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using EmfContentWriter emfContentWriter = new EmfContentWriter(memoryStream);
			emfContentWriter.Write(-608169982);
			if (cap is DXCustomLineCap cap2)
			{
				WriteCustomLineCap(cap2, emfContentWriter);
			}
			else
			{
				WriteAdjustableArrowCap((DXAdjustableArrowCap)cap, emfContentWriter);
			}
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		public static int GetSize(DXCustomLineCapBase cap)
		{
			if (cap is DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap)
			{
				int num = 56;
				if (dXCustomLineCap.FillPath != null)
				{
					num += GetPathSize(dXCustomLineCap.FillPath);
				}
				if (dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath != null)
				{
					num += GetPathSize(dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath);
				}
				return num;
			}
			return 60;
		}
	}

	public enum EmfPlusDriverStringOptions
