		DriverStringOptionsVertical = 2,
		DriverStringOptionsRealizedAdvance = 4,
		DriverStringOptionsLimitSubPixel = 8
	}
	public class EmfPlusFont : EmfPlusObject
	{
		private readonly float emSize;

		private readonly DXGraphicsUnit unitType;

		private readonly EmfPlusFontStyle fontStyle;

		private readonly string fontFamily;

		public float EmSize => emSize;

		public DXGraphicsUnit UnitType => unitType;

		public EmfPlusFontStyle FontStyle => fontStyle;

		public string FontFamily => fontFamily;

		public override EmfPlusObjectType Type => EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeFont;

		public override int Size => 24 + fontFamily.Length * 2;

		public EmfPlusFont(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadInt32();
			emSize = reader.ReadSingle();
			unitType = (DXGraphicsUnit)reader.ReadInt32();
			fontStyle = (EmfPlusFontStyle)reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			fontFamily = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(reader.ReadBytes(num * 2));
		}

		public EmfPlusFont(string fontFamily, float emSize, EmfPlusFontStyle fontStyle, DXGraphicsUnit unitType)
		{
			this.fontFamily = fontFamily;
			this.emSize = emSize;
			this.fontStyle = fontStyle;
			this.unitType = unitType;
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(-608169982);
			writer.Write(emSize);
			writer.Write((int)unitType);
			writer.Write((int)fontStyle);
			writer.Write(0);
			writer.Write(fontFamily.Length);
			writer.Write(Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(fontFamily));
		}
	}
	public class EmfPlusImage : EmfPlusObject
	{
		private readonly object syncRoot = new object();

		private DXImage image;

		private byte[] imageData;

		public DXImage Image
		{
			get
			{
				if (image == null)
				{
					image = DXImage.FromStream(new MemoryStream(imageData));
					imageData = null;
				}
				return image;
			}
		}

		public override EmfPlusObjectType Type => EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeImage;

		public override int Size
		{
			get
			{
				int num;
				if (imageData != null)
				{
					num = imageData.Length;
				}
				else
				{
					using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
					SaveImageToStream(memoryStream);
					num = (int)memoryStream.Length;
				}
				return 28 + num;
			}
		}

		public EmfPlusImage(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadInt32();
			switch ((EmfPlusImageDataType)reader.ReadInt32())
			{
			case EmfPlusImageDataType.ImageDataTypeBitmap:
			{
				int width = reader.ReadInt32();
				int height = reader.ReadInt32();
				int stride = reader.ReadInt32();
				int num = reader.ReadInt32();
				PixelFormat pixelFormat = ((num != 1720334) ? ((PixelFormat)num) : PixelFormat.Format64bppPArgb);
				bool flag = reader.ReadInt32() != 0;
				byte[] bitmapData = reader.ReadBytes((int)(reader.BaseStream.Length - reader.BaseStream.Position));
				if (flag)
				{
					imageData = bitmapData;
				}
				else
				{
					image = CreateBitmap(width, height, stride, pixelFormat, bitmapData);
				}
				break;
			}
			case EmfPlusImageDataType.ImageDataTypeMetafile:
			{
				if (reader.ReadInt32() == 2)
				{
					reader.ReadBytes(24);
				}
				byte[] buffer = reader.ReadBytes(reader.ReadInt32());
				image = DXImage.FromStream(new MemoryStream(buffer));
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		public EmfPlusImage(DXImage image)
		{
			this.image = image;
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				image.Dispose();
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private DXBitmap CreateBitmap(int width, int height, int stride, PixelFormat pixelFormat, byte[] bitmapData)
		{
			bool flag = (pixelFormat & PixelFormat.Indexed) != 0;
			int num = 0;
			Color[] array;
			if (flag)
			{
				using BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(new MemoryStream(bitmapData));
				int num2 = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				int num3 = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
				array = new Color[num3];
				for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
				{
					array[i] = Color.FromArgb(binaryReader.ReadInt32());
				}
				num += 4 * (2 + num3);
			}
			else
			{
				array = null;
			}
			return new DXBitmap(width, height, stride, pixelFormat, array, bitmapData, num);
		}

		private void SaveImageToStream(Stream stream)
		{
			lock (syncRoot)
			{
				DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions = Image.ImageFormatOptions;
				DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions2 = ((imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat != DXImageFormat.Jpeg && imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat != DXImageFormat.Tiff) ? DXImageFormatOptions.Png : imageFormatOptions);
				Image.Save(stream, imageFormatOptions2);
			}
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			if (image != null && image.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Emf)
			{
				WriteEmfImage(writer);
			}
			else
			{
				WriteBitmapImage(writer);
			}
		}

		private void WriteEmfImage(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(-608169982);
			writer.Write(2);
			writer.Write(4);
			if (imageData == null)
			{
				using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
				{
					Image.Save(memoryStream, DXImageFormat.Emf);
					writer.Write((int)memoryStream.Length);
					writer.Write(memoryStream.GetBuffer(), 0, (int)memoryStream.Length);
					return;
				}
			}
			writer.Write(imageData.Length);
			writer.Write(imageData);
		}

		private void WriteBitmapImage(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(-608169982);
			writer.Write(1);
			writer.Write(new byte[16]);
			writer.Write(1);
			if (imageData == null)
			{
				using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
				{
					SaveImageToStream(memoryStream);
					writer.Write(memoryStream.GetBuffer(), 0, (int)memoryStream.Length);
					return;
				}
			}
			writer.Write(imageData);
		}
	}
	public enum EmfPlusImageDataType
	{
		ImageDataTypeUnknown,
		ImageDataTypeBitmap,
		ImageDataTypeMetafile
	}
	public enum EmfPlusMetafileDataType

		MetafileDataTypeEmfPlusDual
	}
	public abstract class EmfPlusObject : IDisposable
	{
		public abstract EmfPlusObjectType Type { get; }

		public abstract int Size { get; }

		public static EmfPlusObject CreateObject(EmfPlusObjectRecord record)
		{
			return CreateObject(record.ObjectType, record.ObjectData);
		}

		public static EmfPlusObject CreateObject(EmfPlusObjectType type, byte[] data)
		{
			using EmfPlusReader reader = new EmfPlusReader(new MemoryStream(data));
			return CreateObject(type, reader);
		}

		public static EmfPlusObject CreateObject(EmfPlusObjectType type, EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeBrush => EmfPlusBrush.Create(reader), 
				EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypePen => new EmfPlusPen(reader), 
				EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypePath => new EmfPlusPath(reader), 
				EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeRegion => new EmfPlusRegion(reader), 
				EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeImage => new EmfPlusImage(reader), 
				EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeFont => new EmfPlusFont(reader), 
				EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeStringFormat => new EmfPlusStringFormat(reader), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public abstract void Write(EmfContentWriter writer);

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}
	public enum EmfPlusObjectType
	{
		ObjectTypeInvalid,
		ObjectTypeBrush,
		ObjectTypePen,
		ObjectTypePath,
		ObjectTypeRegion,
		ObjectTypeImage,
		ObjectTypeFont,
		ObjectTypeStringFormat,
		ObjectTypeImageAttributes,
		ObjectTypeCustomLineCap
	}
	public class EmfPlusPath : EmfPlusObject
	{
		private readonly DXGraphicsPathData pathData;

		public DXGraphicsPathData PathData => pathData;

		public override int Size => GetPathObjectSize(pathData);

		public override EmfPlusObjectType Type => EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypePath;

		public static int GetPathObjectSize(DXGraphicsPathData path)
		{
			int count = path.PathPoints.Count;
			return (count * 2 + 3 + (int)Math.Ceiling((double)count / 4.0)) * 4;
		}

		public EmfPlusPath(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			pathData = reader.ReadPathData();
		}

		public EmfPlusPath(DXGraphicsPathData path)
		{
			pathData = path;
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(pathData);
		}
	}
	public class EmfPlusPen : EmfPlusObject
	{
		private readonly DXPen pen;

		public DXPen Pen => pen;

		public override EmfPlusObjectType Type => EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypePen;

		public override int Size
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 20 + EmfBrushWriterFactory.Create(pen.Brush).BrushDataSize + 4;
				if (ShouldWriteStartCap)
				{
					num += 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteEndCap)
				{
					num += 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteLineJoing)
				{
					num += 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteDashStyle)
				{
					num += 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteDashCap)
				{
					num += 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteDashOffset)
				{
					num += 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteCustomDashPattern)
				{
					num += 4 + pen.DashPattern.Length * 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteAlignment)
				{
					num += 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteCompoundArray)
				{
					num += 4 + pen.CompoundArray.Length * 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteCustomStartCap)
				{
					num += EmfPlusCustomLineCapWriter.GetSize(pen.CustomStartCap) + 4;
				}
				if (ShouldWriteCustomEndCap)
				{
					num += EmfPlusCustomLineCapWriter.GetSize(pen.CustomEndCap) + 4;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldWriteStartCap => pen.StartCap != DXLineCap.Flat;

		private bool ShouldWriteEndCap => pen.EndCap != DXLineCap.Flat;

		private bool ShouldWriteLineJoing => pen.LineJoin != DXLineJoin.Miter;

		private bool ShouldWriteMiterLimit => !DXMathUtils.NearlyEquals(pen.MiterLimit, 10f);

		private bool ShouldWriteDashStyle => pen.DashStyle != DXDashStyle.Solid;

		private bool ShouldWriteDashCap => pen.DashCap != DXDashCap.Flat;

		private bool ShouldWriteDashOffset => pen.DashOffset != 0f;

		private bool ShouldWriteCustomDashPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (pen.DashStyle == DXDashStyle.Custom)
				{
					return pen.DashPattern != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldWriteAlignment => pen.Alignment != DXPenAlignment.Center;

		private bool ShouldWriteCompoundArray => pen.CompoundArray != null;

		private bool ShouldWriteCustomStartCap
		{
			get
			{
				if (pen.StartCap == DXLineCap.Custom)
				{
					return pen.CustomStartCap != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldWriteCustomEndCap
		{
			get
			{
				if (pen.EndCap == DXLineCap.Custom)
				{
					return pen.CustomEndCap != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static void WriteArrayData(EmfContentWriter writer, float[] arrayData)
		{
			writer.Write(arrayData.Length);
			foreach (float value in arrayData)
			{
				writer.Write(value);
			}
		}

		private static float[] ReadArrayData(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			float[] array = new float[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = reader.ReadSingle();
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static void WriteCustomLineCap(EmfContentWriter writer, DXCustomLineCapBase cap)
		{
			byte[] array = EmfPlusCustomLineCapWriter.Write(cap);
			writer.Write(array.Length);
			writer.Write(array);
		}

		public EmfPlusPen(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			reader.BaseStream.Position += 8L;
			EmfPlusPenDataFlags emfPlusPenDataFlags = (EmfPlusPenDataFlags)reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			pen = new DXPen(Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 0), reader.ReadSingle());
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataTransform))
			{
				reader.ReadBytes(24);
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataStartCap))
			{
				pen.StartCap = (DXLineCap)reader.ReadInt32();
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataEndCap))
			{
				pen.EndCap = (DXLineCap)reader.ReadInt32();
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataJoin))
			{
				pen.LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)reader.ReadInt32();
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataMiterLimit))
			{
				pen.MiterLimit = reader.ReadSingle();
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataLineStyle))
			{
				pen.DashStyle = (DXDashStyle)reader.ReadInt32();
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataDashedLineCap))
			{
				pen.DashCap = (DXDashCap)reader.ReadInt32();
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataDashedLineOffset))
			{
				pen.DashOffset = reader.ReadSingle();
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataDashedLine))
			{
				pen.DashPattern = ReadArrayData(reader);
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataNonCenter))
			{
				int num = reader.ReadInt32();
				switch (num)
				{
				case 2:
					pen.Alignment = DXPenAlignment.Left;
					break;
				case 3:
					pen.Alignment = DXPenAlignment.Outset;
					break;
				default:
					pen.Alignment = (DXPenAlignment)num;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataCompoundLine))
			{
				pen.CompoundArray = ReadArrayData(reader);
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataCustomStartCap))
			{
				pen.CustomStartCap = EmfPlusCustomLineCapParser.Read(reader.ReadBytes(reader.ReadInt32()));
			}
			if (emfPlusPenDataFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataCustomEndCap))
			{
				pen.CustomEndCap = EmfPlusCustomLineCapParser.Read(reader.ReadBytes(reader.ReadInt32()));
			}
			pen.Brush = EmfPlusBrush.Create(reader).Brush;
		}

		public EmfPlusPen(DXPen pen)
		{
			this.pen = pen;
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(-608169982);
			EmfPlusPenDataFlags emfPlusPenDataFlags = (EmfPlusPenDataFlags)0;
			if (ShouldWriteStartCap)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataStartCap;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteEndCap)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataEndCap;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteLineJoing)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataJoin;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteMiterLimit)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataMiterLimit;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteDashStyle)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataLineStyle;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteDashCap)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataDashedLineCap;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteDashOffset)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataDashedLineOffset;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteCustomDashPattern)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataDashedLine;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteAlignment)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataNonCenter;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteCompoundArray)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataCompoundLine;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteCustomStartCap)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataCustomStartCap;
			}
			if (ShouldWriteCustomEndCap)
			{
				emfPlusPenDataFlags |= EmfPlusPenDataFlags.PenDataCustomEndCap;
			}
			writer.Write(0);
			writer.Write((int)emfPlusPenDataFlags);
			writer.Write(0);
			writer.Write(pen.Width);
			if (ShouldWriteStartCap)
			{
				writer.Write((int)pen.StartCap);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteEndCap)
			{
				writer.Write((int)pen.EndCap);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteLineJoing)
			{
				writer.Write((int)pen.LineJoin);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteMiterLimit)
			{
				writer.Write(pen.MiterLimit);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteDashStyle)
			{
				writer.Write((int)pen.DashStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteDashCap)
			{
				writer.Write((int)pen.DashCap);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteDashOffset)
			{
				writer.Write(pen.DashOffset);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteCustomDashPattern)
			{
				WriteArrayData(writer, pen.DashPattern);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteAlignment)
			{
				switch (pen.Alignment)
				{
				case DXPenAlignment.Outset:
					writer.Write(3);
					break;
				case DXPenAlignment.Left:
					writer.Write(2);
					break;
				default:
					writer.Write((int)pen.Alignment);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (ShouldWriteCompoundArray)
			{
				WriteArrayData(writer, pen.CompoundArray);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteCustomStartCap)
			{
				WriteCustomLineCap(writer, pen.CustomStartCap);
			}
			if (ShouldWriteCustomEndCap)
			{
				WriteCustomLineCap(writer, pen.CustomEndCap);
			}
			new EmfPlusBrush(pen.Brush).Write(writer);
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			pen.Dispose();
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum EmfPlusPenDataFlags
	{
		PenDataTransform = 1,
		PenDataStartCap = 2,
		PenDataEndCap = 4,
		PenDataJoin = 8,
		PenDataMiterLimit = 0x10,
		PenDataLineStyle = 0x20,
		PenDataDashedLineCap = 0x40,
		PenDataDashedLineOffset = 0x80,
		PenDataDashedLine = 0x100,
		PenDataNonCenter = 0x200,
		PenDataCompoundLine = 0x400,
		PenDataCustomStartCap = 0x800,
		PenDataCustomEndCap = 0x1000
	}
	public enum EmfPlusPixelFormat
	{
		PixelFormatUndefined = 0,
		PixelFormat1bppIndexed = 196865,
		PixelFormat4bppIndexed = 197634,
		PixelFormat8bppIndexed = 198659,
		PixelFormat16bppGrayScale = 1052676,
		PixelFormat16bppRGB555 = 135173,
		PixelFormat16bppRGB565 = 135174,
		PixelFormat16bppARGB1555 = 397319,
		PixelFormat24bppRGB = 137224,
		PixelFormat32bppRGB = 139273,
		PixelFormat32bppARGB = 2498570,
		PixelFormat32bppPARGB = 925707,

	}
	public class EmfPlusRegion : EmfPlusObject
	{
		private class NodeWriter : IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor
		{
			private EmfContentWriter writer;

			public static void Write(EmfContentWriter writer, DXRegionDataNode node)
			{
				NodeWriter nodeWriter = new NodeWriter();
				nodeWriter.writer = writer;
				node.Accept(nodeWriter);
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodeRectangle node)
			{
				writer.Write(268435456);
				writer.Write(node.Rectangle);
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodePath node)
			{
				writer.Write(268435457);
				EmfPlusPath emfPlusPath = new EmfPlusPath(node.PathData);
				writer.Write(emfPlusPath.Size);
				emfPlusPath.Write(writer);
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodeEmpty node)
			{
				writer.Write(268435458);
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodeInfinite node)
			{
				writer.Write(268435459);
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodeComplex node)
			{
				writer.Write((int)CombineModeToType(node.CombineMode));
				node.Left.Accept(this);
				node.Right.Accept(this);
			}
		}

		private class NodeCounter : IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor
		{
			private int count;

			public static int Count(DXRegionDataNode node)
			{
				NodeCounter nodeCounter = new NodeCounter();
				node.Accept(nodeCounter);
				return nodeCounter.count;
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodeRectangle node)
			{
				count++;
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodePath node)
			{
				count++;
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodeEmpty node)
			{
				count++;
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodeInfinite node)
			{
				count++;
			}

			void IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor.Visit(DXRegionDataNodeComplex node)
			{
				count++;
				node.Left.Accept(this);
				node.Right.Accept(this);
			}
		}

		public DXRegionDataNode RegionData { get; }

		public override EmfPlusObjectType Type => EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeRegion;

		public override int Size => 0;

		private static EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType CombineModeToType(DXRegionDataCombineMode mode)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				DXRegionDataCombineMode.Intersect => EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeAnd, 
				DXRegionDataCombineMode.Union => EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeOr, 
				DXRegionDataCombineMode.XOR => EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeXor, 
				DXRegionDataCombineMode.Exclude => EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeExclude, 
				DXRegionDataCombineMode.Complement => EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeComplement, 
				_ => EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeAnd, 
			};
		}

		private static DXRegionDataCombineMode CombineModeToDx(EmfPlusCombineMode mode)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeIntersect => DXRegionDataCombineMode.Intersect, 
				EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeUnion => DXRegionDataCombineMode.Union, 
				EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeXOR => DXRegionDataCombineMode.XOR, 
				EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeExclude => DXRegionDataCombineMode.Exclude, 
				EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeComplement => DXRegionDataCombineMode.Complement, 
				_ => DXRegionDataCombineMode.Intersect, 
			};
		}

		private static DXRegionDataNode Create(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType emfPlusRegionNodeDataType = (EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType)reader.ReadInt32();
			switch (emfPlusRegionNodeDataType)
			{
			case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeRect:
				return new DXRegionDataNodeRectangle(new RectangleF(reader.ReadSingle(), reader.ReadSingle(), reader.ReadSingle(), reader.ReadSingle()));
			case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypePath:
			{
				int num = reader.ReadInt32() + (int)reader.BaseStream.Position;
				EmfPlusPath emfPlusPath = new EmfPlusPath(reader);
				reader.BaseStream.Position = num;
				DXGraphicsPathData pathData = emfPlusPath.PathData;
				return new DXRegionDataNodePath(pathData);
			}
			case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeInfinite:
				return DXRegionDataNodeInfinite.Instance;
			case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeEmpty:
				return DXRegionDataNodeEmpty.Instance;
			default:
			{
				DXRegionDataNode dXRegionDataNode = Create(reader);
				DXRegionDataNode right = Create(reader);
				DXRegionDataCombineMode combineMode;
				switch (emfPlusRegionNodeDataType)
				{
				case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeAnd:
					combineMode = DXRegionDataCombineMode.Intersect;
					break;
				case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeOr:
					combineMode = DXRegionDataCombineMode.Union;
					break;
				case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeXor:
					combineMode = DXRegionDataCombineMode.XOR;
					break;
				case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeExclude:
					combineMode = DXRegionDataCombineMode.Exclude;
					break;
				case EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType.RegionNodeDataTypeComplement:
					combineMode = DXRegionDataCombineMode.Complement;
					break;
				default:
					return null;
				}
				return dXRegionDataNode.Combine(right, combineMode);
			}
			}
		}

		public EmfPlusRegion(DXRegionDataNode head)
		{
			RegionData = head;
		}

		public EmfPlusRegion(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadInt32();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			RegionData = Create(reader);
		}

		public EmfPlusRegion GetTransformedRegion(DXMatrix transformMatrix)
		{
			return new EmfPlusRegion(RegionData.Transform(transformMatrix));
		}

		public EmfPlusRegion Combine(EmfPlusCombineMode mode, EmfPlusRegion newRegion)
		{
			if (mode == EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeReplace)
			{
				return newRegion;
			}
			return new EmfPlusRegion(RegionData.Combine(newRegion.RegionData, CombineModeToDx(mode)));
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(-608169982);
			writer.Write(NodeCounter.Count(RegionData) - 1);
			NodeWriter.Write(writer, RegionData);
		}
	}
	public enum EmfPlusRegionNodeDataType
	{
		RegionNodeDataTypeAnd = 1,
		RegionNodeDataTypeOr = 2,
		RegionNodeDataTypeXor = 3,
		RegionNodeDataTypeExclude = 4,
		RegionNodeDataTypeComplement = 5,
		RegionNodeDataTypeRect = 268435456,
		RegionNodeDataTypePath = 268435457,
		RegionNodeDataTypeEmpty = 268435458,
		RegionNodeDataTypeInfinite = 268435459
	}
	public enum EmfPlusStringAlignment
	{
		Near,
		Center,
		Far
	}
	public enum EmfPlusStringTrimming
	{
		None,
		Character,
		Word,
		EllipsisCharacter,
		EllipsisWord,
		EllipsisPath
	}
	public enum EmfPlusHotkeyPrefix
	{
		None,
		Show,
		Hide
	}
	public class EmfPlusStringFormat : EmfPlusObject
	{
		private const float defaultMarginFactor = 1f / 6f;

		private const float defaultTracking = 1.03f;

		public EmfPlusStringFormatFlags FormatFlags { get; }

		public EmfPlusStringAlignment Alignment { get; }

		public EmfPlusStringAlignment LineAlignment { get; }

		public EmfPlusHotkeyPrefix HotkeyPrefix { get; }

		public float LeadingMarginFactor { get; }

		public float TrailingMarginFactor { get; }

		public EmfPlusStringTrimming Trimming { get; }

		public float FirstTabOffset { get; }

		public float[] TabStops { get; }

		public override EmfPlusObjectType Type => EmfPlusObjectType.ObjectTypeStringFormat;

		public override int Size => 4 * (15 + ((TabStops != null) ? TabStops.Length : 0));

		public EmfPlusStringFormat(EmfPlusReader reader)
		{
			reader.ReadInt32();
			FormatFlags = (EmfPlusStringFormatFlags)reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			Alignment = (EmfPlusStringAlignment)reader.ReadInt32();
			LineAlignment = (EmfPlusStringAlignment)reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadBytes(8);
			FirstTabOffset = reader.ReadSingle();
			HotkeyPrefix = (EmfPlusHotkeyPrefix)reader.ReadInt32();
			LeadingMarginFactor = reader.ReadSingle();
			TrailingMarginFactor = reader.ReadSingle();
			reader.ReadSingle();
			Trimming = (EmfPlusStringTrimming)reader.ReadInt32();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			if (num > 0)
			{
				TabStops = new float[num];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					TabStops[i] = reader.ReadSingle();
				}
			}
		}

		public EmfPlusStringFormat(DXStringFormat format)
		{
			FormatFlags = (EmfPlusStringFormatFlags)format.FormatFlags;
			Alignment = (EmfPlusStringAlignment)format.Alignment;
			LineAlignment = (EmfPlusStringAlignment)format.LineAlignment;
			FirstTabOffset = 0f;
			HotkeyPrefix = (EmfPlusHotkeyPrefix)format.HotkeyPrefix;
			LeadingMarginFactor = format.LeadingMarginFactor;
			TrailingMarginFactor = format.TrailingMarginFactor;
			Trimming = (EmfPlusStringTrimming)format.Trimming;
			TabStops = format.TabStops;
		}

		public EmfPlusStringFormat(EmfPlusStringFormatFlags formatFlags, EmfPlusStringAlignment alignment, EmfPlusStringAlignment lineAlignment, EmfPlusStringTrimming trimming, float firstTabOffset, float[] tabStops)
		{
			FormatFlags = formatFlags;
			Alignment = alignment;
			LineAlignment = lineAlignment;
			FirstTabOffset = firstTabOffset;
			HotkeyPrefix = EmfPlusHotkeyPrefix.None;
			if (Environment.OSVersion.Platform != PlatformID.Win32NT)
			{
				LeadingMarginFactor = 0f;
				TrailingMarginFactor = 0f;
			}
			else
			{
				LeadingMarginFactor = 1f / 6f;
				TrailingMarginFactor = 1f / 6f;
			}
			Trimming = trimming;
			TabStops = tabStops;
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(-608169982);
			writer.Write((int)FormatFlags);
			writer.Write(0);
			writer.Write((int)Alignment);
			writer.Write((int)LineAlignment);
			writer.Write(new byte[8]);
			writer.Write(FirstTabOffset);
			writer.Write((int)HotkeyPrefix);
			writer.Write(LeadingMarginFactor);
			writer.Write(TrailingMarginFactor);
			writer.Write(1.03f);
			writer.Write((int)Trimming);
			int num = ((TabStops != null) ? TabStops.Length : 0);
			writer.Write(num);
			writer.Write(0);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				writer.Write(TabStops[i]);
			}
		}

		public DXStringFormat ToDxStringFormat()
		{
			EmfPlusStringFormatFlags formatFlags = FormatFlags;
			DXStringFormatFlags dXStringFormatFlags = (DXStringFormatFlags)0;
			if (formatFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusStringFormatFlags.StringFormatLineLimit))
			{
				dXStringFormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.LineLimit;
			}
			if (formatFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusStringFormatFlags.StringFormatNoClip))
			{
				dXStringFormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.NoClip;
			}
			if (formatFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusStringFormatFlags.StringFormatNoWrap))
			{
				dXStringFormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			}
			if (formatFlags.HasFlag(EmfPlusStringFormatFlags.StringFormatMeasureTrailingSpaces))
			{
				dXStringFormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces;
			}
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = new DXStringFormat();
			dXStringFormat.FormatFlags = dXStringFormatFlags;
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = ConvertAlignment(Alignment);
			dXStringFormat.LineAlignment = ConvertAlignment(LineAlignment);
			dXStringFormat.LeadingMarginFactor = LeadingMarginFactor;
			dXStringFormat.TrailingMarginFactor = TrailingMarginFactor;
			if (HotkeyPrefix == EmfPlusHotkeyPrefix.Hide)
			{
				dXStringFormat.HotkeyPrefix = DXHotkeyPrefix.Hide;
			}
			switch (Trimming)
			{
			case EmfPlusStringTrimming.Character:
				dXStringFormat.Trimming = DXStringTrimming.Character;
				break;
			case EmfPlusStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter:
				dXStringFormat.Trimming = DXStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter;
				break;
			case EmfPlusStringTrimming.EllipsisWord:
				dXStringFormat.Trimming = DXStringTrimming.EllipsisWord;
				break;
			case EmfPlusStringTrimming.Word:
				dXStringFormat.Trimming = DXStringTrimming.Word;
				break;
			default:
				dXStringFormat.Trimming = DXStringTrimming.None;
				break;
			}
			if (TabStops != null)
			{
				dXStringFormat.TabStops = (float[])TabStops.Clone();
			}
			return dXStringFormat;
		}

		private static DXStringAlignment ConvertAlignment(EmfPlusStringAlignment value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				EmfPlusStringAlignment.Center => DXStringAlignment.Center, 
				EmfPlusStringAlignment.Far => DXStringAlignment.Far, 
				_ => DXStringAlignment.Near, 
			};
		}
	}

	public class EmfLogFont
	{
		public int Height { get; }

		public int Width { get; }

		public int Escapement { get; }

		public int Orientation { get; }

		public int Weight { get; }

		public bool Italic { get; }

		public bool Underline { get; }

		public bool StrikeOut { get; }

		public EmfCharacterSet CharSet { get; }

		public EmfOutPrecision OutPrecision { get; }

		public EmfClipPrecision ClipPrecision { get; }

		public EmfFontQuality Quality { get; }

		public EmfFamilyFont Family { get; }

		public EmfPitchFont Pitch { get; }

		public string FaceName { get; }

		public EmfLogFont(EmfReader reader)
		{
			Height = reader.ReadInt32();
			Width = reader.ReadInt32();
			Escapement = reader.ReadInt32();
			Orientation = reader.ReadInt32();
			Weight = reader.ReadInt32();
			Italic = reader.ReadByte() != 0;
			Underline = reader.ReadByte() != 0;
			StrikeOut = reader.ReadByte() != 0;
			CharSet = (EmfCharacterSet)reader.ReadByte();
			OutPrecision = (EmfOutPrecision)reader.ReadByte();
			ClipPrecision = (EmfClipPrecision)reader.ReadByte();
			Quality = (EmfFontQuality)reader.ReadByte();
			byte b = reader.ReadByte();
			Family = (EmfFamilyFont)(b >> 4);
			Pitch = (EmfPitchFont)(b & 3);
			FaceName = reader.ReadUnicodeNullTerminatedString(32);
		}
	}

				DashPattern = new int[num];

					DashPattern[i] = reader.ReadInt32();
				}

		}

	public class EmrText
	{
		public Point Reference { get; }

		public EmfExtTextOutOptions Options { get; }

		public EmfRectL? Rectangle { get; }

		public string Text { get; }

		public short[] GlyphIndices { get; }

		public long[] OutputDx { get; }

		public EmrText(EmfReader reader, bool useUnicode)
		{
			Reference = reader.ReadPoint();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
			Options = (EmfExtTextOutOptions)reader.ReadInt32();
			if ((Options & EmfExtTextOutOptions.NO_RECT) == 0)
			{
				Rectangle = reader.ReadRect();
			}
			int num3 = reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.BaseStream.Position = num2 - 8;
			if ((Options & EmfExtTextOutOptions.GLYPH_INDEX) != 0)
			{
				GlyphIndices = new short[num];
				bool flag = useUnicode && !Options.HasFlag(EmfExtTextOutOptions.SMALL_CHARS);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						GlyphIndices[i] = reader.ReadInt16();
					}
					else
					{
						GlyphIndices[i] = reader.ReadByte();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (useUnicode)
			{
				byte[] bytes = ((!Options.HasFlag(EmfExtTextOutOptions.SMALL_CHARS)) ? reader.ReadBytes(num * 2) : reader.ReadBytes(num).SelectMany((byte c) => new byte[2] { c, 0 }).ToArray());
				Text = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(bytes);
			}
			else
			{
				Text = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(reader.ReadBytes(num));
			}
			if (num3 != 0)
			{
				int num4 = (((Options & EmfExtTextOutOptions.PDY) != 0) ? (num * 2) : num);
				OutputDx = new long[num4];
				reader.BaseStream.Position = num3 - 8;
				for (int num5 = 0; num5 < num4; num5++)
				{
					OutputDx[num5] = reader.ReadUInt32();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class EmfPlusCircleSegmentRecord : EmfPlusPenDrawingRecord
	{
		private readonly float startAngle;

		private readonly float sweepAngle;

		private readonly RectangleF bounds;

		public float StartAngle => startAngle;

		public float SweepAngle => sweepAngle;

		public RectangleF Bounds => bounds;

		protected override int DataSize => 24;

		protected EmfPlusCircleSegmentRecord(short flags, EmfPlusReader reader)
			: base(flags)
		{
			startAngle = reader.ReadSingle();
			sweepAngle = reader.ReadSingle();
			bounds = reader.ReadRectangleF((flags & 0x4000) != 0);
		}

		protected EmfPlusCircleSegmentRecord(byte penId, RectangleF bounds, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
			: base(penId)
		{
			this.bounds = bounds;
			this.startAngle = startAngle;
			this.sweepAngle = sweepAngle;
		}

		protected override void WriteEmfPlusRecord(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			short flags = base.Flags;
			flags &= -16385;
			WriteHeader(writer, flags);
			writer.Write(startAngle);
			writer.Write(sweepAngle);
			writer.Write(bounds);
		}
	}
	public class EmfPlusClearRecord : EmfPlusRecord
	{
		public Color Color { get; }

		protected override EmfPlusRecordType Type => EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusClear;

		protected override int DataSize => 4;

		public EmfPlusClearRecord(Color color)
			: base(0)
		{
			Color = color;
		}

		public EmfPlusClearRecord(short flags, EmfPlusReader reader)
			: base(flags)

			Color = reader.ReadColor();

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		protected override void WriteEmfPlusRecord(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteHeader(writer);
			writer.Write(Color);
		}
	}

	public class EmfPlusDrawDriverStringRecord : EmfPlusRecord
	{
		private EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor;

		public int FontId => base.ObjectId;

		public int BrushId => brushOrColor.BrushId;

		public Color? BrushColor => brushOrColor.Color;

		public char[] Glyphs { get; }

		public PointF[] GlyphPos { get; }

		public EmfPlusDriverStringOptions StringOptions { get; }

		public DXMatrix TransformMatrix { get; }

		protected override EmfPlusRecordType Type => EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawDriverString;

		protected override int DataSize => Glyphs.Length * 10 + ((TransformMatrix == null) ? 16 : 40);

		public EmfPlusDrawDriverStringRecord(byte fontId, EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor, char[] glyphs, PointF[] glyphPos, EmfPlusDriverStringOptions options)
			: base(EmfPlusFillBase.GetFlags(brushOrColor, fontId))
		{
			this.brushOrColor = brushOrColor;
			Glyphs = glyphs;
			GlyphPos = glyphPos;
			StringOptions = options;
		}

		public EmfPlusDrawDriverStringRecord(short flags, EmfPlusReader reader)
			: base(flags)
		{
			if ((base.Flags & 0x8000) != 0)
			{
				brushOrColor = new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(reader.ReadColor());
			}
			else
			{
				brushOrColor = new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(reader.ReadInt32());
			}
			StringOptions = (EmfPlusDriverStringOptions)reader.ReadInt32();
			bool flag = reader.ReadInt32() != 0;
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			Glyphs = new char[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Glyphs[i] = (char)reader.ReadUInt16();
			}
			GlyphPos = new PointF[num];
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				GlyphPos[j] = reader.ReadPointF();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				TransformMatrix = reader.ReadTransformMatrix();
			}
		}

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		protected override void WriteEmfPlusRecord(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteHeader(writer);
			writer.Write(BrushColor.HasValue ? BrushColor.Value.ToArgb() : BrushId);
			writer.Write((int)StringOptions);
			writer.Write((TransformMatrix != null) ? 1 : 0);
			writer.Write(Glyphs.Length);
			char[] glyphs = Glyphs;
			foreach (char value in glyphs)
			{
				writer.Write((ushort)value);
			}
			PointF[] glyphPos = GlyphPos;
			foreach (PointF point in glyphPos)
			{
				writer.Write(point);
			}
			if (TransformMatrix != null)
			{
				writer.Write(TransformMatrix);
			}
		}
	}

	public class EmfPlusDrawRectsRecord : EmfPlusPenDrawingRecord
	{
		private readonly RectangleF[] rectangles;

		private bool IsCompressed => (base.Flags & 0x4000) != 0;

		private int RectangleWriteSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsCompressed)
				{
					return 16;
				}
				return 8;
			}
		}

		public RectangleF[] Rectangles => rectangles;

		protected override EmfPlusRecordType Type => EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawRects;

		protected override int DataSize => 4 + RectangleWriteSize * rectangles.Length;

		public EmfPlusDrawRectsRecord(short flags, EmfPlusReader reader)
			: base(flags)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			rectangles = new RectangleF[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				rectangles[i] = reader.ReadRectangleF(IsCompressed);
			}
		}

		public EmfPlusDrawRectsRecord(byte id, RectangleF rectangle)
			: base(id)
		{
			rectangles = new RectangleF[1] { rectangle };
		}

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		protected override void WriteEmfPlusRecord(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteHeader(writer);
			writer.Write(rectangles.Length);
			RectangleF[] array = rectangles;
			foreach (RectangleF rectangle in array)
			{
				writer.Write(rectangle, IsCompressed);
			}
		}
	}
	public class EmfPlusDrawStringRecord : EmfPlusRecord
	{
		private EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor;

		public int BrushId => brushOrColor.BrushId;

		public Color? BrushColor => brushOrColor.Color;

		public int FormatId { get; }

		public RectangleF LayoutRect { get; }

		public string Text { get; }

		protected override EmfPlusRecordType Type => EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawString;

		protected override int DataSize => 28 + Text.Length * 2 + PaddingSize;

		private int PaddingSize => EmfPlusRecord.GetPadding(Text.Length * 2);

		public EmfPlusDrawStringRecord(short flags, EmfPlusReader reader)
			: base(flags)
		{
			if ((flags & -32768) != 0)
			{
				brushOrColor = new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(reader.ReadColor());
			}
			else
			{
				brushOrColor = new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(reader.ReadInt32());
			}
			FormatId = reader.ReadInt32();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			LayoutRect = reader.ReadRectangleF(compressed: false);
			Text = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(reader.ReadBytes(num * 2));
		}

		public EmfPlusDrawStringRecord(string text, RectangleF layoutRect, EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor, byte fontId, byte formatId)
			: base(EmfPlusFillBase.GetFlags(brushOrColor, fontId))
		{
			Text = text;
			LayoutRect = layoutRect;
			FormatId = formatId;
			this.brushOrColor = brushOrColor;
		}

		public EmfPlusDrawStringRecord(string text, RectangleF layoutRect, Color color, byte fontId, byte formatId)
			: this(text, layoutRect, new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(color), fontId, formatId)
		{
		}

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		protected override void WriteEmfPlusRecord(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteHeader(writer);
			EmfPlusFillBase.WriteBrushOrColor(writer, BrushColor, BrushId);
			writer.Write(FormatId);
			writer.Write(Text.Length);
			writer.Write(LayoutRect);
			writer.Write(Encoding.Unicode.GetBytes(Text));
			int paddingSize = PaddingSize;
			if (paddingSize != 0)
			{
				writer.Write(new byte[paddingSize]);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class EmfPlusFillBase : EmfPlusRecord
	{
		private readonly EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor;

		public int BrushId => brushOrColor.BrushId;

		public Color? Color => brushOrColor.Color;

		protected EmfPlusFillBase(short flags, EmfPlusReader reader)
			: base(flags)
		{
			if ((base.Flags & -32768) != 0)
			{
				brushOrColor = new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(reader.ReadColor());
			}
			else
			{
				brushOrColor = new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(reader.ReadInt32());
			}
		}

		protected EmfPlusFillBase(EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor, byte id)
			: base(GetFlags(brushOrColor, id))
		{
			this.brushOrColor = brushOrColor;
		}

		protected EmfPlusFillBase(EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor)
			: this(brushOrColor, 0)
		{
		}

		protected EmfPlusFillBase(Color color, byte id)
			: this(new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(color), id)
		{
		}

		protected EmfPlusFillBase(Color color)
			: this(color, 0)
		{
		}

		protected EmfPlusFillBase(byte brushId, byte objectId)
			: this(new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(brushId), objectId)
		{
		}

		protected EmfPlusFillBase(byte brushId)
			: this(brushId, 0)
		{
		}

		public static short GetFlags(EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor, byte objectId)
		{
			if (!brushOrColor.Color.HasValue)
			{
				return objectId;
			}
			return (short)(-32768 | objectId);
		}

		protected void WriteBrushOrColor(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteBrushOrColor(writer, Color, BrushId);
		}

		internal static void WriteBrushOrColor(EmfContentWriter writer, Color? color, int brushId)
		{
			writer.Write(color.HasValue ? color.Value.ToArgb() : brushId);
		}
	}

	public class EmfPlusObjectRecord : EmfPlusRecord
	{
		protected override EmfPlusRecordType Type => EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusObject;

		public EmfPlusObjectType ObjectType => FlagsHelper.FlagsToObjectType(base.Flags);

		public bool IsContinued => FlagsHelper.FlagsToContinuedObject(base.Flags);

		protected override int DataSize => ObjectData.Length;

		public byte[] ObjectData { get; }

		public EmfPlusObjectRecord(short flags, byte[] content)
			: base(flags)
		{
			ObjectData = content;
		}

		public EmfPlusObjectRecord(byte id, EmfPlusObject obj)
			: base(FlagsHelper.GetObjectFlags(id, obj.Type))
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using EmfContentWriter emfContentWriter = new EmfContentWriter(memoryStream);
			obj.Write(emfContentWriter);
			int padding = EmfPlusRecord.GetPadding((int)memoryStream.Position);
			if (padding != 0)
			{
				emfContentWriter.Write(new byte[padding]);
			}
			ObjectData = memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		protected override void WriteEmfPlusRecord(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteHeader(writer);
			writer.Write(ObjectData);
		}
	}

	public abstract class EmfPlusRecord : EmfRecord
	{
		private const short emfPlusObjectIdMask = 255;

		protected const short CompressedFlagMask = 16384;

		protected const short SpecifiedColorFlagMask = short.MinValue;

		protected short Flags { get; }

		public int ObjectId => Flags & 0xFF;

		public int RecordSize => DataSize + 12;

		protected abstract EmfPlusRecordType Type { get; }

		protected abstract int DataSize { get; }

		public static EmfPlusRecord Create(EmfPlusRecordType type, short flags, byte[] content)
		{
			using EmfPlusReader reader = new EmfPlusReader(new MemoryStream(content));
			return type switch
			{
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusHeader => new EmfPlusHeaderRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusEndOfFile => new EmfPlusEofRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusGetDC => new EmfPlusGetDCRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusObject => new EmfPlusObjectRecord(flags, content), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawRects => new EmfPlusDrawRectsRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawBeziers => new EmfPlusDrawBeziersRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawArc => new EmfPlusDrawArcRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawEllipse => new EmfPlusDrawEllipseRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawLines => new EmfPlusDrawLinesRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawPie => new EmfPlusDrawPieRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawPath => new EmfPlusDrawPathRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusFillPolygon => new EmfPlusFillPolygonRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusFillRects => new EmfPlusFillRectsRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusFillEllipse => new EmfPlusFillEllipseRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusFillPath => new EmfPlusFillPathRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusFillPie => new EmfPlusFillPieRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusFillRegion => new EmfPlusFillRegionRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusClear => new EmfPlusClearRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawImage => new EmfPlusDrawImageRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawImagePoints => new EmfPlusDrawImagePointsRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawString => new EmfPlusDrawStringRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusDrawDriverString => new EmfPlusDrawDriverStringRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusMultiplyWorldTransform => new EmfPlusMultiplyWorldTransformRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusScaleWorldTransform => new EmfPlusScaleWorldTransformRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetWorldTransform => new EmfPlusSetWorldTransformRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusTranslateWorldTransform => new EmfPlusTranslateWorldTransformRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusResetWorldTransform => new EmfPlusResetWorldTransformRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusRotateWorldTransform => new EmfPlusRotateWorldTransformRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetPageTransform => new EmfPlusSetPageTransformRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSave => new EmfPlusSaveRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusRestore => new EmfPlusRestoreRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusBeginContainer => new EmfPlusBeginContainerRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusBeginContainerNoParams => new EmfPlusBeginContainerNoParamsRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusEndContainer => new EmfPlusEndContainerRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetClipRegion => new EmfPlusSetClipRegionRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetClipRect => new EmfPlusSetClipRectRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetClipPath => new EmfPlusSetClipPathRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusResetClip => new EmfPlusResetClipRecord(flags, reader), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetAntiAliasMode => new EmfPlusSetAntiAliasModeRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetCompositingMode => new EmfPlusSetComposingModeRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetCompositingQuality => new EmfPlusSetComposingQualityRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetInterpolationMode => new EmfPlusSetInterpolationModeRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetPixelOffsetMode => new EmfPlusSetPixelOffsetModeRecord(flags), 
				EmfPlusRecordType.EmfPlusSetTextRenderingHint => new EmfPlusSetTextRenderingHintRecord(flags), 
				_ => new EmfPlusUnparsedRecord(type, flags, content), 
			};
		}

		protected static int GetPadding(int size)
		{
			int num = 4 - size % 4;
			if (num == 4)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected EmfPlusRecord(short flags)
		{
			Flags = flags;
		}

		public sealed override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteEmfPlusRecord(writer);
		}

		protected abstract void WriteEmfPlusRecord(EmfContentWriter writer);

		protected void WriteHeader(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			WriteHeader(writer, Flags);
		}

		protected void WriteHeader(EmfContentWriter writer, short writeFlags)
		{
			writer.Write((short)Type);
			writer.Write(writeFlags);
			int dataSize = DataSize;
			writer.Write(RecordSize);
			writer.Write(dataSize);
		}
	}

			: base(type, content)

			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			int num2 = reader.ReadInt32();
			int num3 = reader.ReadInt32();
			int num4 = reader.ReadInt32();
			Dest = new EmfRectL(num, num2, num + num3, num2 + num4);
			int num5 = reader.ReadInt32();
			Alpha = (byte)(num5 >> 16);
			BitmapWithAlpha = num5 >> 24 != 0;
			int num6 = reader.ReadInt32();
			int num7 = reader.ReadInt32();
			Transform = reader.ReadMatrix();
			BkColorSrc = reader.ReadColor();
			EmfDIBColors colors = (EmfDIBColors)reader.ReadInt32();

			int num11 = reader.ReadInt32();
			int num12 = reader.ReadInt32();
			Src = new EmfRectL(num6, num7, num6 + num11, num7 + num12);
			reader.BaseStream.Position = num8 - 8;
			Bitmap = new EmfBitmap(reader, colors, dataOffset);
		}

	public class EmfBitmap
	{
		public int Width { get; }

		public int Height { get; }

		public EmfCompression Compression { get; }

		public EmfBitCount BitCount { get; }

		public bool IsTopDown { get; }

		public byte[] ImageData { get; }

		public IEmfBitmapPalete Palette { get; }

		public int RedMask { get; }

		public int GreenMask { get; }

		public int BlueMask { get; }

		public EmfBitmap(EmfReader reader, EmfDIBColors colors, int dataOffset)
		{
			BitmapInfoHeader bitmapInfoHeader = BitmapInfoHeader.Read(reader);
			Width = bitmapInfoHeader.Width;
			Height = bitmapInfoHeader.Height;
			if (Height < 0)
			{
				Height = -Height;
				IsTopDown = true;
			}
			BitCount = (EmfBitCount)bitmapInfoHeader.BitsPerPixels;
			Compression = (EmfCompression)bitmapInfoHeader.Compression;
			int num = 0;
			switch (BitCount)
			{
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_1:
				num = 2;
				break;
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_2:
				num = 16;
				break;
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_3:
				num = 256;
				break;
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_4:
				RedMask = 31744;
				GreenMask = 992;
				BlueMask = 31;
				break;
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_5:
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_6:
				RedMask = 16711680;
				GreenMask = 65280;
				BlueMask = 255;
				break;
			}
			int num2 = bitmapInfoHeader.PaletteSize;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			else if (num2 == 0 || num2 > num)
			{
				num2 = num;
			}
			if (num2 != 0)
			{
				switch (colors)
				{
				case EmfDIBColors.RGB_COLORS:
				{
					Color[] array2 = new Color[num2];
					for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
					{
						byte blue = reader.ReadByte();
						byte green = reader.ReadByte();
						byte red = reader.ReadByte();
						reader.ReadByte();
						array2[j] = Color.FromArgb(red, green, blue);
					}
					Palette = new EmfPredefinedPalette(array2);
					break;
				}
				case EmfDIBColors.PAL_COLORS:
				{
					ushort[] array = new ushort[num2];
					for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
					{
						array[i] = (ushort)reader.ReadInt16();
					}
					Palette = new EmfIndexedPalette(array);
					break;
				}
				case EmfDIBColors.PAL_INDICES:
					Palette = new EmfSystemPalette(num2);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (Compression == EmfCompression.BITFIELDS)
			{
				RedMask = bitmapInfoHeader.RMask;
				GreenMask = bitmapInfoHeader.GMask;
				BlueMask = bitmapInfoHeader.BMask;
			}
			reader.BaseStream.Position = dataOffset - 8;
			ImageData = reader.ReadBytes(bitmapInfoHeader.GetActualImageSize());
		}
	}

	public class EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord : EmfRecord
	{
		public const int EmfPlusCommentIdentifier = 726027589;

		private readonly IList<EmfPlusRecord> records;

		private readonly int recordsSize;

		public IList<EmfPlusRecord> Records => records;

		public static EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord Parse(BinaryReader reader, int dataSize)
		{
			int num = 8;
			IList<EmfPlusRecord> list = new List<EmfPlusRecord>();
			while (num < dataSize)
			{
				EmfPlusRecordType type = (EmfPlusRecordType)reader.ReadInt16();
				short flags = reader.ReadInt16();
				num += reader.ReadInt32();
				int count = reader.ReadInt32();
				EmfPlusRecord emfPlusRecord = EmfPlusRecord.Create(type, flags, reader.ReadBytes(count));
				if (emfPlusRecord == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				list.Add(emfPlusRecord);
			}
			return new EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord(list, dataSize - 4);
		}

		public EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord()
			: this(new List<EmfPlusRecord>())
		{
		}

		public EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord(IList<EmfPlusRecord> records)
			: this(records, 0)
		{
		}

		public EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord(IList<EmfPlusRecord> records, int recordsSize)
		{
			this.records = records;
			this.recordsSize = recordsSize;
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(70);
			writer.Write(recordsSize + 4 + 12);
			writer.Write(recordsSize + 4);
			writer.Write(726027589);
			long position = writer.BaseStream.Position;
			foreach (EmfPlusRecord record in records)
			{
				record.Write(writer);
			}
			int num = (int)(writer.BaseStream.Position - position);
			if (num != recordsSize)
			{
				long position2 = writer.BaseStream.Position;
				writer.BaseStream.Position = position - 12;
				writer.Write(num + 4 + 12);
				writer.Write(num + 4);
				writer.BaseStream.Position = position2;
			}
		}

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			foreach (EmfPlusRecord record in records)
			{
				record.Accept(visitor);
			}
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			foreach (EmfPlusRecord record in records)
			{
				record.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override EmfRecord Clone()
		{
			List<EmfPlusRecord> list = new List<EmfPlusRecord>(records.Count);
			foreach (EmfPlusRecord record in records)
			{
				list.Add((EmfPlusRecord)record.Clone());
			}
			return new EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord(list, recordsSize);
		}
	}

	public class EmfMetafileHeaderRecord : EmfRecord
	{
		public const int MinRecordSize = 88;

		private const uint ENHMETA_SIGNATURE = 1179469088u;

		private const uint emfVersion = 65536u;

		private const int emfRecordsCount = 3;

		public EmfRectL Bounds { get; }

		public EmfRectL Frame { get; }

		public int Size { get; }

		public int RecordsCount { get; private set; }

		public int HandlesCount { get; private set; }

		public int PalEntries { get; private set; }

		public EmfSizeL Device { get; }

		public EmfSizeL Millimeters { get; }

		public static bool TryRead(byte[] content, out EmfMetafileHeaderRecord header)
		{
			if (content.Length < 80)
			{
				header = null;
				return false;
			}
			using BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(new MemoryStream(content));
			bool result = true;
			EmfRectL bounds = new EmfRectL(binaryReader);
			EmfRectL frame = new EmfRectL(binaryReader);
			uint num = binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
			if (num != 1179469088)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			uint num2 = binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
			if (num2 != 65536)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			uint size = binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
			uint recordsCount = binaryReader.ReadUInt32();
			ushort handlesCount = binaryReader.ReadUInt16();
			binaryReader.ReadBytes(10);
			int palEntries = binaryReader.ReadInt32();
			EmfSizeL device = new EmfSizeL(binaryReader);
			EmfSizeL millimeters = new EmfSizeL(binaryReader);
			header = new EmfMetafileHeaderRecord(bounds, frame, (int)size, device, millimeters)
			{
				RecordsCount = (int)recordsCount,
				HandlesCount = handlesCount,
				PalEntries = palEntries
			};
			return result;
		}

		public static EmfMetafileHeaderRecord Read(byte[] content)
		{
			TryRead(content, out var header);
			return header;
		}

		public EmfMetafileHeaderRecord(EmfRectL bounds, EmfRectL frame, int size, EmfSizeL device, EmfSizeL millimeters)
		{
			Bounds = bounds;
			Frame = frame;
			Size = size;
			Device = device;
			Millimeters = millimeters;
			RecordsCount = 3;
			HandlesCount = 1;
		}

		public static EmfMetafileHeaderRecord CreateFromSize(SizeF sizePixels, float hRes, float vRes)
		{
			float num = UnitConverterHelper.PixelToMm(sizePixels.Width - 1f, hRes);
			float num2 = UnitConverterHelper.PixelToMm(sizePixels.Height - 1f, vRes);
			float num3 = UnitConverterHelper.PixelToMm(1280f, hRes);
			float num4 = UnitConverterHelper.PixelToMm(1024f, vRes);
			return new EmfMetafileHeaderRecord(new EmfRectL(0, 0, (int)Math.Round(sizePixels.Width), (int)Math.Round(sizePixels.Height)), new EmfRectL(0, 0, (int)Math.Round(num * 100f), (int)Math.Round(num2 * 100f)), 0, new EmfSizeL(1280L, 1024L), new EmfSizeL((int)Math.Round(num3), (int)Math.Round(num4)));
		}

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(1);
			writer.Write(88);
			writer.Write(Bounds);
			writer.Write(Frame);
			writer.Write(1179469088u);
			writer.Write(65536u);
			writer.Write((uint)Size);
			writer.Write((uint)RecordsCount);
			writer.Write((ushort)HandlesCount);
			writer.Write(new byte[10]);
			writer.Write((uint)PalEntries);
			writer.Write(Device);
			writer.Write(Millimeters);
		}

		public static void UpdateMetafileSize(EmfContentWriter writer, long actualLength)
		{
			long position = writer.BaseStream.Position;
			writer.BaseStream.Position = 48L;
			writer.Write((uint)actualLength);
			writer.BaseStream.Position = position;
		}
	}

	public class EmfPolygonRecord : EmfUnparsedRecord
	{
		public EmfRectL Bounds { get; }

		public Point[][] Points { get; }

		public static EmfPolygonRecord ReadPolyPolygonRecord(EmfReader reader, Func<EmfReader, Point> readPoint, EmfRecordType type, byte[] content)
		{
			EmfRectL bounds = reader.ReadRect();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			int[] array = new int[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = reader.ReadInt32();
			}
			Point[][] array2 = new Point[num][];
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				int num2 = array[j];
				Point[] array3 = new Point[num2];
				for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
				{
					array3[k] = readPoint(reader);
				}
				array2[j] = array3;
			}
			return new EmfPolygonRecord(bounds, array2, type, content);
		}

		public static EmfPolygonRecord ReadPolygonRecord(EmfReader reader, Func<EmfReader, Point> readPoint, EmfRecordType type, byte[] content)
		{
			EmfRectL bounds = reader.ReadRect();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			Point[] array = new Point[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = readPoint(reader);
			}
			return new EmfPolygonRecord(bounds, new Point[1][] { array }, type, content);
		}

		private EmfPolygonRecord(EmfRectL bounds, Point[][] points, EmfRecordType type, byte[] content)
			: base(type, content)
		{
			Bounds = bounds;
			Points = points;
		}

		public override void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}

		{
			EmfRectL bounds = reader.ReadRect();
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			int[] array = new int[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = reader.ReadInt32();
			}
			Point[][] array2 = new Point[num][];
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				int num2 = array[j];
				Point[] array3 = new Point[num2];
				for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
				{
					array3[k] = readPoint(reader);
				}
				array2[j] = array3;
			}
			return new EmfPolylineRecord(bounds, array2, type, content);
		}

	public abstract class EmfRecord : IDisposable
	{
		protected const int HeaderSize = 8;

		public static EmfRecord Create(EmfRecordType type, byte[] content)
		{
			using EmfReader reader = new EmfReader(new MemoryStream(content));
			switch (type)
			{
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_RESTOREDC:
				return new EmfRestoreDCRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SAVEDC:
				return new EmfSaveDCRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETBKMODE:
				return new EmfSetBackgroundModeRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETTEXTALIGN:
				return new EmfSetTextAlignmentRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETTEXTCOLOR:
				return new EmfSetTextColorRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETVIEWPORTEXTEX:
				return new EmfSetViewportExtentRecord(reader);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETVIEWPORTORGEX:
				return new EmfSetViewportOriginRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETWINDOWEXTEX:
				return new EmfSetWindowExtentRecord(reader);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETWINDOWORGEX:
				return new EmfSetWindowOriginRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETMETARGN:
				return new EmfSetMetaRegionRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_EXTSELECTCLIPRGN:
				return new EmfSelectClipRegionRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_MODIFYWORLDTRANSFORM:
				return new EmfModifyWorldTransformRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SELECTOBJECT:
				return new EmfSelectObjectRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_DELETEOBJECT:
				return new EmfDeleteObjectRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_EXTCREATEFONTINDIRECTW:
				return new EmfExCreateFontIndirectRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_EXTTEXTOUTW:
				return new EmfExtTextOutRecord(reader, useUnicode: true, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_EXTTEXTOUTA:
				return new EmfExtTextOutRecord(reader, useUnicode: false, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_FILLRGN:
				return new EmfFillRegionRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_CREATEBRUSHINDIRECT:
				return new EmfCreateBrushIndirectRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETMAPMODE:
				return new EmfSetMappingModeRecord(reader);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETBKCOLOR:
				return new EmfSetBackgroundColorRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_CREATEPEN:
				return new EmfCreatePenIndirectRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_RECTANGLE:
				return new EmfDrawRectangleRecord(reader);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_MOVETOEX:
				return new EmfMoveToEx(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_ABORTPATH:
				return new EmfAbortPathRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_BEGINPATH:
				return new EmfBeginPathRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_CLOSEFIGURE:
				return new EmfCloseFigureRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_ENDPATH:
				return new EmfEndPathRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_FLATTENPATH:
				return new EmfFlattenPathRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_WIDENPATH:
				return new EmfWidenPathRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_LINETO:
				return new EmfLineToRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_FILLPATH:
				return new EmfFillPathRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_BITBLT:
				return new EmfBitBltRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETPOLYFILLMODE:
				return new EmfSetPolygonFillModeRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETARCDIRECTION:
				return new EmfSetArcDirectionRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETSTRETCHBLTMODE:
				return new EmfSetStretchBitmapRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_CREATEPALETTE:
				return new EmfCreatePaletteRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SELECTPALETTE:
				return new EmfSelectPaletteRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_REALIZEPALETTE:
				return new EmfRealizePaletteRecord();
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_STRETCHDIBITS:
				return new EmfStretchDIBBitsRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYBEZIER:
				return new EmfPolyBezierRecord(reader, ReadPoint, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYBEZIER16:
				return new EmfPolyBezierRecord(reader, ReadPointS, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYBEZIERTO:
				return new EmfPolyBezierToRecord(reader, ReadPoint, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYBEZIERTO16:
				return new EmfPolyBezierToRecord(reader, ReadPointS, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYLINE:
				return EmfPolylineRecord.ReadPolylineRecord(reader, ReadPoint, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYLINE16:
				return EmfPolylineRecord.ReadPolylineRecord(reader, ReadPointS, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYLINETO:
				return EmfPolylineToRecord.ReadPolylineToRecord(reader, ReadPoint, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYLINETO16:
				return EmfPolylineToRecord.ReadPolylineToRecord(reader, ReadPointS, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYPOLYLINE:
				return EmfPolylineRecord.ReadPolyPolylineRecord(reader, ReadPoint, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYPOLYLINE16:
				return EmfPolylineRecord.ReadPolyPolylineRecord(reader, ReadPointS, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYGON:
				return EmfPolygonRecord.ReadPolygonRecord(reader, ReadPoint, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYGON16:
				return EmfPolygonRecord.ReadPolygonRecord(reader, ReadPointS, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYPOLYGON:
				return EmfPolygonRecord.ReadPolyPolygonRecord(reader, ReadPoint, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYPOLYGON16:
				return EmfPolygonRecord.ReadPolyPolygonRecord(reader, ReadPointS, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_ARC:
				return new EmfArcRecord(reader, updateCurrentPosition: false, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_ARCTO:
				return new EmfArcRecord(reader, updateCurrentPosition: true, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_ANGLEARC:
				return new EmfAngleArcRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_PIE:
				return new EmfPieRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_CHORD:
				return new EmfChordRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_ELLIPSE:
				return new EmfEllipseRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_ROUNDRECT:
				return new EmfRoundRectRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYDRAW16:
				return new EmfPolyDrawRecord(reader, ReadPointS, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYDRAW:
				return new EmfPolyDrawRecord(reader, ReadPoint, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_STROKEANDFILLPATH:
				return new EmfStrokeAndFillPathRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_STROKEPATH:
				return new EmfStrokePathRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_EXTCREATEPEN:
				return new EmfExtCreatePenRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_CREATEMONOBRUSH:
				return new EmfCreateMonoBrushRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_CREATEDIBPATTERNBRUSHPT:
				return new EmfCreateDIBPatternBrushRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETMITERLIMIT:
				return new EmfSetMiterLimitRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_EXCLUDECLIPRECT:
				return new EmfExcludeClipRectRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_INTERSECTCLIPRECT:
				return new EmfIntersectClipRectRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_OFFSETCLIPRGN:
				return new EmfOffsetClipRegionRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SELECTCLIPPATH:
				return new EmfSelectClipPathRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SCALEVIEWPORTEXTEX:
				return new EmfScaleViewportExtExRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SCALEWINDOWEXTEX:
				return new EmfScaleWindowExtExRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETWORLDTRANSFORM:
				return new EmfSetWorldTransformRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETBRUSHORGEX:
				return new EmfSetBrushOriginRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETROP2:
				return new EmfSetROP2Record(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETLAYOUT:
				return new EmfSetLayoutRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_ALPHABLEND:
				return new EmfAlphaBlendRecord(reader, type, content);
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETPIXELV:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETPALETTEENTRIES:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_RESIZEPALETTE:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_EXTFLOODFILL:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_FRAMERGN:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_INVERTRGN:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_PAINTRGN:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_STRETCHBLT:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_MASKBLT:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_PLGBLT:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETDIBITSTODEVICE:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYTEXTOUTA:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_POLYTEXTOUTW:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SMALLTEXTOUT:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_TRANSPARENTBLT:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_GRADIENTFILL:
			case EmfRecordType.EMR_SETTEXTJUSTIFICATION:
				return new EmfUnparsedRecord(type, content);
			default:
				return new EmfUnparsedRecord(type, content);
			}
		}

		private static Point ReadPoint(EmfReader reader)
		{
			return reader.ReadPoint();
		}

		private static Point ReadPointS(EmfReader reader)
		{
			return reader.ReadPointS();
		}

		public abstract void Accept(IEmfMetafileVisitor visitor);

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
		}

		public virtual void Write(EmfContentWriter writer)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public virtual EmfRecord Clone()
		{
			return (EmfRecord)MemberwiseClone();
		}

		protected void WriteHeader(EmfContentWriter writer, EmfRecordType type, int dataSize)
		{
			writer.Write((int)type);
			writer.Write(dataSize + 8);
		}
	}

	public class EmfBitmapData : IDXBitmapData, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly ArrayMarshaler marshaler;

		public int RowBytes { get; }

		public IntPtr DataPointer => ((Marshaler)marshaler).Pointer;

		public byte[] Data { get; }

		public int Height { get; }

		public EmfBitmapData(byte[] data, int rowBytes, int height)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			marshaler = new ArrayMarshaler((Array)data);

		}

		public void Dispose()
