	public class EmfBitmapDataReader
	{
		private struct ComponentInfo
		{
			public uint ComponentMask { get; }

			public int ComponentShift { get; }

			public float Factor { get; }

			public ComponentInfo(uint componentMask, int componentShift, int maskLength)
			{
				ComponentMask = componentMask;
				ComponentShift = componentShift;
				Factor = 255f / (float)((1 << maskLength) - 1);
			}

			public byte GetValue(uint sample)
			{
				return (byte)((float)((sample & ComponentMask) >> ComponentShift) * Factor + 0.5f);
			}
		}

		private readonly ComponentInfo[] components;

		private readonly int sampleSize;

		private static int GetStride(int width, int sampleBitsize)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Ceiling((float)width * (float)sampleBitsize / 8f);
			return num + GetRowPadding(num);
		}

		private static ComponentInfo CreateComponentInfo(uint mask)
		{
			uint componentMask = mask;
			int? num = null;
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < 32; i++)
			{
				if ((mask & 1) == 1)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
				mask >>= 1;
			}
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				return new ComponentInfo(mask, 0, 8);
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			for (; i < 32; i++)
			{
				if ((mask & 1) != 1)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2++;
				mask >>= 1;
			}
			if (num2 > 8)
			{
				return new ComponentInfo(componentMask, num.Value + num2 - 8, 8);
			}
			return new ComponentInfo(componentMask, num.Value, num2);
		}

		private static EmfBitmapData CreateIndexedBitmapData(EmfBitmap bitmap, int sampleBitsize)
		{
			byte[] array = bitmap.ImageData;
			int stride = GetStride(bitmap.Width, sampleBitsize);
			if (array.Length < stride)
			{
				byte[] array2 = new byte[stride];
				Buffer.BlockCopy(array, 0, array2, 0, array.Length);
				array = array2;
			}
			return new EmfBitmapData(array, stride, bitmap.Height);
		}

		public static int GetRowPadding(int value)
		{
			int num = 4 - value % 4;
			if (num < 4)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public static EmfBitmapData ConvertImageData(EmfBitmap bitmap, bool hasAlpha)
		{
			EmfCompression compression = bitmap.Compression;
			bool flag = compression == EmfCompression.CMYK || compression == EmfCompression.CMYKRLE4 || compression == EmfCompression.CMYKRLE8;
			switch (compression)
			{
			case EmfCompression.RLE8:
			case EmfCompression.CMYKRLE8:
				return EmfRLE8BitmapDataReader.Read(bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height, bitmap.ImageData);
			case EmfCompression.RLE4:
			case EmfCompression.CMYKRLE4:
				return EmfRLE4BitmapDataReader.Read(bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height, bitmap.ImageData);
			default:
			{
				EmfBitmapDataReader emfBitmapDataReader;
				switch (bitmap.BitCount)
				{
				case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_1:
					return CreateIndexedBitmapData(bitmap, 1);
				case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_2:
					return CreateIndexedBitmapData(bitmap, 4);
				case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_3:
					return CreateIndexedBitmapData(bitmap, 8);
				case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_4:
					emfBitmapDataReader = new EmfBitmapDataReader(bitmap.RedMask, bitmap.GreenMask, bitmap.BlueMask, 2);
					break;
				case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_5:
					emfBitmapDataReader = new EmfBitmapDataReader(16711680, 65280, 255, 3);
					break;
				case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_6:
					emfBitmapDataReader = ((!hasAlpha) ? new EmfBitmapDataReader(bitmap.RedMask, bitmap.GreenMask, bitmap.BlueMask, 4) : new EmfBitmapDataReader(4, new ComponentInfo[4]
					{
						new ComponentInfo(4278190080u, 24, 8),
						new ComponentInfo(16711680u, 16, 8),
						new ComponentInfo(65280u, 8, 8),
						new ComponentInfo(255u, 0, 8)
					}));
					break;
				default:
					return null;
				}
				return emfBitmapDataReader.ReadData(bitmap.ImageData, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
			}
			}
		}

		private EmfBitmapDataReader(int redMask, int greenMask, int blueMask, int sampleSize)
		{
			this.sampleSize = sampleSize;
			components = new ComponentInfo[3]
			{
				CreateComponentInfo((uint)redMask),
				CreateComponentInfo((uint)greenMask),
				CreateComponentInfo((uint)blueMask)
			};
		}

		private EmfBitmapDataReader(int sampleSize, ComponentInfo[] components)
		{
			this.sampleSize = sampleSize;
			this.components = components;
		}

		private uint ReadInt(byte[] source, int offset)
		{
			uint num = 0u;
			for (int num2 = sampleSize - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				num <<= 8;
				num |= source[offset + num2];
			}
			return num;
		}

		private EmfBitmapData ReadData(byte[] sourceData, int width, int height)
		{
			int rowPadding = GetRowPadding(width * sampleSize);
			int num = components.Length;
			int rowPadding2 = GetRowPadding(width * num);
			int num2 = width * num + rowPadding2;
			byte[] array = new byte[num2 * height];
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
				{
					uint sample = ReadInt(sourceData, num3);
					num3 += sampleSize;
					for (int num5 = num - 1; num5 >= 0; num5--)
					{
						array[num4++] = components[num5].GetValue(sample);
					}
				}
				num3 += rowPadding;
				num4 += rowPadding2;
			}
			return new EmfBitmapData(array, num2, height);
		}
	}
	public class EmfBitmapWrapper : IDXBitmap, IDXImage, IDisposable, IEquatable<IDXImage>, IEquatable<IDXBitmap>
	{
		private readonly EmfBitmap bitmap;

		private readonly DXImageProperties imageProperties = new DXImageProperties();

		public SizeF PhysicalDimension => new SizeF(Width, Height);

		public int Width => bitmap.Width;

		public int Height => bitmap.Height;

		public DXImageFormatOptions ImageFormatOptions => DXImageFormatOptions.Bmp;

		public DXPixelFormat PixelFormat { get; }

		public DXPalette Palette { get; }

		public bool CanGetPixels => true;

		public int NumberOfFrames => 1;

		public object NativeImage => bitmap;

		public float HorizontalResolution => 96f;

		public float VerticalResolution => 96f;

		public DXImageProperties ImageProperties => imageProperties;

		public static DXImage Create(EmfBitmap bitmap, DXPalette palette)
		{
			if (bitmap.Compression == EmfCompression.JPEG || bitmap.Compression == EmfCompression.PNG)
			{
				return DXImage.FromStream(new MemoryStream(bitmap.ImageData));
			}
			return Create(bitmap, palette, hasAlpha: false);
		}

		public static DXImage Create(EmfBitmap bitmap, DXPalette palette, bool hasAlpha)
		{
			DXColorSpace dXColorSpace;
			switch (bitmap.Compression)
			{
			case EmfCompression.JPEG:
			case EmfCompression.PNG:
				return DXImage.FromStream(new MemoryStream(bitmap.ImageData));
			case EmfCompression.CMYK:
			case EmfCompression.CMYKRLE8:
			case EmfCompression.CMYKRLE4:
				dXColorSpace = DXColorSpace.CMYK;
				break;
			default:
				dXColorSpace = DXColorSpace.RGB;
				break;
			}
			DXBitsPerPixel bitsPerPixel;
			bool flag;
			switch (bitmap.BitCount)
			{
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_1:
				bitsPerPixel = DXBitsPerPixel.Format1Bpp;
				flag = true;
				break;
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_2:
				bitsPerPixel = DXBitsPerPixel.Format4Bpp;
				flag = true;
				break;
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_3:
				bitsPerPixel = DXBitsPerPixel.Format8Bpp;
				flag = true;
				break;
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_4:
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_5:
				bitsPerPixel = DXBitsPerPixel.Format24Bpp;
				flag = false;
				break;
			case EmfBitCount.BITCOUNT_6:
				bitsPerPixel = ((dXColorSpace != DXColorSpace.RGB || hasAlpha) ? DXBitsPerPixel.Format32Bpp : DXBitsPerPixel.Format24Bpp);
				flag = false;
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid BitCount value: {bitmap.BitCount}");
			}
			return new DXBitmap(new EmfBitmapWrapper(bitmap, new DXPixelFormat(bitsPerPixel, flag ? DXColorSpace.Gray : dXColorSpace, hasAlpha ? DXAlpha.Premul : DXAlpha.No, flag), palette));
		}

		private EmfBitmapWrapper(EmfBitmap bitmap, DXPixelFormat pixelFormat, DXPalette palette)
		{
			this.bitmap = bitmap;
			PixelFormat = pixelFormat;
			Palette = palette;
		}

		public IDXBitmap Clone()
		{
			return this;
		}

		public IDXBitmap Crop(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			using IDXBitmap iDXBitmap = ConvertToNativeBitmap();
			return iDXBitmap.Crop(rectangle);
		}

		public IDXBitmap Crop(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			using IDXBitmap iDXBitmap = ConvertToNativeBitmap();
			return iDXBitmap.Crop(rectangle);
		}

		public IDXBitmap Convert(DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			using IDXBitmap iDXBitmap = ConvertToNativeBitmap();
			return iDXBitmap.Convert(pixelFormat);
		}

		public void ConvertToJpeg(Stream stream, long jpegQuality)
		{
			using IDXBitmap iDXBitmap = ConvertToNativeBitmap();
			iDXBitmap.ConvertToJpeg(stream, jpegQuality);
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions)
		{
			using IDXBitmap iDXBitmap = ConvertToNativeBitmap();
			iDXBitmap.Save(stream, imageFormatOptions);
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			using IDXBitmap iDXBitmap = ConvertToNativeBitmap();
			iDXBitmap.Save(stream, imageFormat);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}

		public IDXBitmapData GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode lockMode)
		{
			return EmfBitmapDataReader.ConvertImageData(bitmap, PixelFormat.Alpha != DXAlpha.No);
		}

		public IDXBitmapData GetBitmapData(Rectangle rect, DXImageLockMode lockMode, DXPixelFormat format)
		{
			return EmfBitmapDataReader.ConvertImageData(bitmap, PixelFormat.Alpha != DXAlpha.No);
		}

		private IDXBitmap ConvertToNativeBitmap()
		{
			using EmfBitmapData emfBitmapData = (EmfBitmapData)GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode.ReadOnly);
			return DXDrawingEngine.CreateBitmap(bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height, emfBitmapData.RowBytes, PixelFormat, Palette, emfBitmapData.Data, 0);
		}

		public bool Equals(IDXBitmap other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}

		public bool Equals(IDXImage other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return bitmap.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is EmfBitmapWrapper emfBitmapWrapper)
			{
				return bitmap.Equals(emfBitmapWrapper.bitmap);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void FlipVertical()
		{
		}

		public Color GetPixel(int x, int y)
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public IDXGraphics CreateGraphics()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}

		public void SetResolution(float horizontalResolution, float verticalResolution)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public void RotateFlip(DXRotateFlipType rotateFlipType)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public bool IsDisposedOrInvalid()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}
	public class EmfRLE4BitmapDataReader
	{
		private readonly int height;

		private readonly int destinationStride;

		private readonly byte[] sourceData;

		private int sourceOffset;

		private int destinationOffset;

		private bool isEven = true;

		public static EmfBitmapData Read(int width, int height, byte[] sourceData)
		{
			return new EmfRLE4BitmapDataReader(width, height, sourceData).ReadRLEData();
		}

		private EmfRLE4BitmapDataReader(int width, int height, byte[] sourceData)
		{
			this.height = height;
			this.sourceData = sourceData;
			int num = width / 2 + width % 2;
			destinationStride = num + EmfBitmapDataReader.GetRowPadding(num);
		}

		private EmfBitmapData ReadRLEData()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[destinationStride * height];
			while (true)
			{
				byte b = ReadByte();
				byte b2 = ReadByte();
				if (b > 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < b / 2; i++)
					{
						WriteNextPixel(array, b2 >> 4);
						WriteNextPixel(array, b2);
					}
					if (b % 2 == 1)
					{
						WriteNextPixel(array, b2 >> 4);
					}
					continue;
				}
				switch (b2)
				{
				case 0:
					MoveToNextLine();
					continue;
				case 2:
					MoveToNextLine(ReadByte(), ReadByte());
					continue;
				case 1:
					return new EmfBitmapData(array, destinationStride, height);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < b2 / 2; j++)
				{
					byte b3 = ReadByte();
					WriteNextPixel(array, b3 >> 4);
					WriteNextPixel(array, b3);
				}
				if (b2 % 2 == 1)
				{
					WriteNextPixel(array, ReadByte() >> 4);
				}
				sourceOffset += sourceOffset % 2;
			}
		}

		private void WriteNextPixel(byte[] result, int value)
		{
			if (isEven)
			{
				result[destinationOffset] = (byte)(value << 4);
			}
			else
			{
				result[destinationOffset++] |= (byte)(value & 0xF);
			}
			isEven = !isEven;
		}

		private byte ReadByte()
		{
			return sourceData[sourceOffset++];
		}

		private void MoveToNextLine()
		{
			destinationOffset = (destinationOffset / destinationStride + 1) * destinationStride;
			isEven = true;
		}

		private void MoveToNextLine(int xOffset, int yOffset)
		{
			destinationOffset += destinationStride * yOffset + xOffset / 2;
			if (!isEven)
			{
				if (xOffset % 2 != 0)
				{
					destinationOffset++;
					isEven = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				isEven = xOffset % 2 == 0;
			}
		}
	}
	public class EmfRLE8BitmapDataReader
	{
		private readonly int height;

		private readonly int destinationStride;

		private readonly byte[] sourceData;

		private int sourceOffset;

		private int destinationOffset;

		public static EmfBitmapData Read(int width, int height, byte[] sourceData)
		{
			return new EmfRLE8BitmapDataReader(width, height, sourceData).ReadRLEData();
		}

		private EmfRLE8BitmapDataReader(int width, int height, byte[] sourceData)
		{
			this.height = height;
			this.sourceData = sourceData;
			destinationStride = width + EmfBitmapDataReader.GetRowPadding(width);
		}

		private EmfBitmapData ReadRLEData()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[destinationStride * height];
			while (true)
			{
				byte b = ReadByte();
				byte b2 = ReadByte();
				if (b > 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < b; i++)
					{
						array[destinationOffset++] = b2;
					}
					continue;
				}
				switch (b2)
				{
				case 0:
					MoveToNextLine();
					continue;
				case 2:
					MoveToNextLine(ReadByte(), ReadByte());
					continue;
				case 1:
					return new EmfBitmapData(array, destinationStride, height);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < b2; j++)
				{
					array[destinationOffset++] = ReadByte();
				}
				sourceOffset += sourceOffset % 2;
			}
		}

		private byte ReadByte()
		{
			return sourceData[sourceOffset++];
		}

		private void MoveToNextLine()
		{
			destinationOffset = (destinationOffset / destinationStride + 1) * destinationStride;
		}

		private void MoveToNextLine(int xOffset, int yOffset)
		{
			destinationOffset += destinationStride * yOffset + xOffset;
		}
	}
	public class EmfPlusClip
	{
		private readonly EmfPlusRegion clipRegion;

		public EmfPlusClip(EmfPlusRegion clipRegion)
		{
			this.clipRegion = clipRegion;
		}

		public void ApplyClip(EmfIsolatedGraphicsStateHandler stateHandler)
		{
			using DXRegion clipInMetafile = new DXRegion(clipRegion.RegionData);
			stateHandler.ApplyClip(clipInMetafile);
		}

		public EmfPlusClip Combine(EmfPlusCombineMode mode, EmfPlusClip newClip)
		{
			if (mode == EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeReplace)
			{
				return newClip;
			}
			return new EmfPlusClip(clipRegion.Combine(mode, newClip.clipRegion));
		}

		public EmfPlusClip Transform(DXMatrix matrix)
		{
			return new EmfPlusClip(clipRegion.GetTransformedRegion(matrix));
		}
	}
	public class EmfPlusExporter

		private readonly Dictionary<int, EmfPlusContinuedObject> continuedObjects = new Dictionary<int, EmfPlusContinuedObject>();

		private readonly EmfMetafileState sharedState;

		private readonly object fontCache;

		private float logicalDpiX = 96f;

		private float logicalDpiY = 96f;

		private bool isVideoDisplay = true;

		private DXGraphicsUnit pageUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;

		private float scaleFactor = 1f;

			this.logicalDpiX = logicalDpiX;
			this.logicalDpiY = logicalDpiY;
			this.isVideoDisplay = isVideoDisplay;
		}

		public void Save(int id)
		{
			State.Push(id);
		}

		public void Restore(int id)
		{
			int value;
			do
			{
				State.Pop();
				value = State.CurrentId.Value;
			}
			while (value != id);
		}

		private void PerformBrushFillAction(EmfPlusFillBase record, Action<IDXGraphics, DXBrush> action)

				});
			}

		private DXBrush GetDxBrush(Color? color, int brushId)
		{
			if (color.HasValue)

				return new DXSolidBrush(color.Value);

			return GetEmfPlusObject<EmfPlusBrush>(brushId)?.Brush;
		}

		public void DrawArc(int penId, RectangleF bounds, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)

		public void DrawImage(int id, PointF[] destinationPoints, RectangleF srcRect)
		{
			EmfPlusImage img = GetEmfPlusObject<EmfPlusImage>(id);
			if (img != null)
			{
				DXMatrix matrix = DXMatrix.CreateWarpMatrix(srcRect, destinationPoints);
				PerformDrawAction(delegate(IDXGraphics gr)
				{
					object state = gr.Save();
					gr.MultiplyTransform(matrix);
					gr.SetClip(srcRect, DXClipCombineMode.Intersect);
					gr.DrawImage(img.Image, new RectangleF(default(PointF), img.Image.Size), srcRect);
					gr.Restore(state);
				});
			}
		}

		public void DrawImage(int id, RectangleF bounds, RectangleF srcRect)

				PerformDrawAction(delegate(IDXGraphics gr)
				{
					gr.DrawImage(img.Image, bounds, srcRect);
				});
			}
		}

		public void ResetClip()
		{
			SetClip(new EmfPlusRegion(DXRegionDataNodeInfinite.Instance), EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeReplace);
		}

		public void SetPageUnit(DXGraphicsUnit unit, float scaleFactor)
		{
			if (unit == DXGraphicsUnit.Display && isVideoDisplay)
			{
				unit = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;
			}
			pageUnit = unit;
			this.scaleFactor = scaleFactor;
			float num = 1f;
			float num2 = 1f;
			switch (unit)
			{
			case DXGraphicsUnit.World:
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel:
				num = 1f;
				num2 = 1f;
				break;
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Display:
				num = logicalDpiX / 100f;
				num2 = logicalDpiY / 100f;
				break;
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Point:
				num = logicalDpiX / 72f;
				num2 = logicalDpiY / 72f;
				break;
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Inch:
				num = logicalDpiX;
				num2 = logicalDpiY;
				break;
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Document:
				num = logicalDpiX / 300f;
				num2 = logicalDpiY / 300f;
				break;
			case DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter:
				num = logicalDpiX / 25.4f;
				num2 = logicalDpiY / 25.4f;
				break;
			}
			if (unit != DXGraphicsUnit.Display)
			{
				num *= scaleFactor;
				num2 *= scaleFactor;
			}
			State.SetPageUnitTransform(DXMatrix.CreateScaleMatrix(num, num2));
		}

		public void SetClipPath(int id, EmfPlusCombineMode mode)
		{
			EmfPlusPath emfPlusObject = GetEmfPlusObject<EmfPlusPath>(id);
			if (emfPlusObject != null)
			{
				SetClip(new EmfPlusRegion(new DXRegionDataNodePath(emfPlusObject.PathData)), mode);
			}
		}

		public void SetClipRegion(int id, EmfPlusCombineMode mode)
		{
			EmfPlusRegion emfPlusObject = GetEmfPlusObject<EmfPlusRegion>(id);
			if (emfPlusObject != null)
			{
				SetClip(emfPlusObject, mode);
			}
		}

		public void SetClipRectangle(RectangleF rect, EmfPlusCombineMode mode)
		{
			SetClip(new EmfPlusRegion(new DXRegionDataNodeRectangle(rect)), mode);
		}

		public void DrawString(string text, RectangleF layoutRect, int fontId, Color? color, int brushId, int formatId)
		{
			DXBrush brush = GetDxBrush(color, brushId);
			if (brush != null)
			{
				DXFont font = GetDxFont(fontId);
				EmfPlusStringFormat emfPlusObject = GetEmfPlusObject<EmfPlusStringFormat>(formatId);
				DXStringFormat format = ((emfPlusObject != null) ? emfPlusObject.ToDxStringFormat() : DXStringFormat.CreateGenericDefault());
				PerformDrawAction(delegate(IDXGraphics gr)
				{
					gr.DrawString(text, font, brush, layoutRect, format);
				});
			}
		}

		private DXFont GetDxFont(int fontId)
		{
			EmfPlusFont emfPlusObject = GetEmfPlusObject<EmfPlusFont>(fontId);
			if (emfPlusObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXGraphicsUnit dXGraphicsUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;
			float num = 10f;
			string name = "Arial";
			DXFontStyle style = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			if (emfPlusObject != null)
			{
				dXGraphicsUnit = emfPlusObject.UnitType;
				num = emfPlusObject.EmSize;
				name = emfPlusObject.FontFamily;
				style = (DXFontStyle)emfPlusObject.FontStyle;
			}
			float num2 = ((pageUnit != DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel || dXGraphicsUnit == DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel || dXGraphicsUnit == DXGraphicsUnit.World) ? 1f : logicalDpiX);
			float size = num * (GetUnitScale(1f, dXGraphicsUnit) / GetUnitScale(scaleFactor, pageUnit)) * num2;
			return new DXFont(name, size, style, DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel);
		}

		public void DrawUnicodeString(char[] glyphs, PointF[] positions, int fontId, int brushId, Color? color)
		{
			DXBrush brush = GetDxBrush(color, brushId);
			if (brush == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DXFont font = GetDxFont(fontId);
			PerformDrawAction(delegate(IDXGraphics gr)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < glyphs.Length; i++)
				{
					PointF pointF = positions[i];
					gr.DrawString(glyphs[i].ToString(), font, brush, new PointF(pointF.X, pointF.Y), DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic());
				}
			});
		}

		public void Clear(Color color)
		{
			PerformDrawAction(delegate(IDXGraphics gr)
			{
				gr.Clear(color);
			});
		}

		public void ProcessEmfPlusObjectRecord(EmfPlusObjectRecord record)
		{
			if (continuedObjects.ContainsKey(record.ObjectId))
			{
				EmfPlusContinuedObject emfPlusContinuedObject = continuedObjects[record.ObjectId];
				emfPlusContinuedObject.Append(record.ObjectData);
				if (emfPlusContinuedObject.IsObjectFinished)
				{
					continuedObjects.Remove(record.ObjectId);
					AddEmfPlusObject(record.ObjectId, emfPlusContinuedObject.ParseObject());
				}
				return;
			}
			if (record.IsContinued)
			{
				EmfPlusContinuedObject emfPlusContinuedObject2 = new EmfPlusContinuedObject(record.ObjectType);
				emfPlusContinuedObject2.Append(record.ObjectData);
				continuedObjects.Add(record.ObjectId, emfPlusContinuedObject2);
				return;
			}
			using EmfPlusReader reader = new EmfPlusReader(new MemoryStream(record.ObjectData));
			AddEmfPlusObject(record.ObjectId, EmfPlusObject.CreateObject(record.ObjectType, reader));
		}

		private void AddEmfPlusObject(int index, EmfPlusObject obj)
		{
			if (objectTable.ContainsKey(index))
			{
				objectTable[index].Dispose();
				objectTable[index] = obj;
			}
			else
			{
				objectTable.Add(index, obj);
			}
		}

		public void SetWorldTransform(DXMatrix matrix)
		{
			State.SetTransform(matrix);
		}

		public void RotateTransform(float angle, bool isPostMultiplied)
		{
			MultiplyWorldTransform(DXMatrix.CreateRotateMatrix(angle), isPostMultiplied);
		}

		private T GetEmfPlusObject<T>(int id) where T : EmfPlusObject
		{
			if (objectTable.TryGetValue(id, out var value))
			{
				return value as T;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private float GetUnitScale(float scale, DXGraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			return unit switch
			{
				DXGraphicsUnit.Point => scale / 72f, 
				DXGraphicsUnit.Inch => scale, 
				DXGraphicsUnit.Document => scale / 300f, 
				DXGraphicsUnit.Millimeter => scale / 25.4f, 
				DXGraphicsUnit.Display => scale / 100f, 
				_ => 1f, 
			};
		}

		private void SetMatrix(DXMatrix matrix)
		{
			State.SetTransform(matrix);
		}

		public void MultiplyWorldTransform(DXMatrix matrix, bool isPostMultiplied)
		{
			DXMatrix transform = State.Transform;
			transform.Multiply(matrix, isPostMultiplied ? DXMatrixOrder.Append : DXMatrixOrder.Prepend);
			State.SetTransform(transform);
		}

		private void SetClip(EmfPlusRegion clipRegion, EmfPlusCombineMode mode)
		{
			clipRegion = clipRegion.GetTransformedRegion(State.GetFullTransformationMatrix());
			EmfPlusClip clip = State.Clip;
			if (clip != null)
			{
				State.Clip = clip.Combine(mode, new EmfPlusClip(clipRegion));
			}
			else
			{
				State.Clip = new EmfPlusClip(clipRegion);
			}
		}
	}

	}
	public class EmfMetafileState : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDXGraphics graphics;

		private readonly EmfIsolatedGraphicsStateHandler isolatedGraphicsStateHandler;

		public EmfPlusGraphicsStateStack EmfPlusState { get; }

		public IEmfGraphicsState EmfState { get; }

		public EmfMetafileState(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
			isolatedGraphicsStateHandler = new EmfIsolatedGraphicsStateHandler(graphics);
			EmfPlusState = new EmfPlusGraphicsStateStack();
		}

		public void StartMetafileDrawing(RectangleF srcRect, RectangleF dstRect)
		{
			isolatedGraphicsStateHandler.StartMetafileDrawing(srcRect, dstRect);
		}

		public void EndMetafileDrawing()
		{
			isolatedGraphicsStateHandler.EndMetafileDrawing();
		}

		private void PerformDrawAction(Action<IDXGraphics> action, IEmfGraphicsState state, IEmfGraphicsState anotherState)
		{
			if (state.IsChanged)
			{
				state.ApplyState(isolatedGraphicsStateHandler);
				anotherState?.MarkChanged();
			}
			action(graphics);
		}

		public void PerformEmfPlusDrawAction(Action<IDXGraphics> action)
		{
			PerformDrawAction(action, EmfPlusState, EmfState);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			isolatedGraphicsStateHandler.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public class EmfPlusGraphicsStateStack : IEmfGraphicsState
	{
		private class EmfPlusGraphicsState
		{
			private DXMatrix transform;

			private DXMatrix pageUnitTransformationMatrix;

			public EmfPlusClip Clip { get; set; }

			public int? StateId { get; }

			public DXMatrix Transform
			{
				get
				{
					return transform.Clone();
				}
				set
				{
					transform = value;
				}
			}

			public DXMatrix PageUnitTransformationMatrix
			{
				get
				{
					return pageUnitTransformationMatrix.Clone();
				}
				set
				{
					pageUnitTransformationMatrix = value;
				}
			}

			public EmfPlusGraphicsState()
			{
				Transform = new DXMatrix();
				PageUnitTransformationMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			}

			private EmfPlusGraphicsState(int newId, EmfPlusGraphicsState oldState)
			{
				StateId = newId;
				Clip = oldState.Clip;
				Transform = oldState.Transform;
				PageUnitTransformationMatrix = oldState.PageUnitTransformationMatrix;
			}

			public EmfPlusGraphicsState Clone(int newId)
			{
				return new EmfPlusGraphicsState(newId, this);
			}
		}

		private readonly Stack<EmfPlusGraphicsState> stack;

		private EmfPlusGraphicsState current;

		public EmfPlusClip Clip
		{
			get
			{
				return current.Clip;
			}
			set
			{
				IsChanged = true;
				current.Clip = value;
			}
		}

		public int? CurrentId => current.StateId;

		public DXMatrix Transform => current.Transform;

		public DXMatrix PageUnitTransform => current.PageUnitTransformationMatrix;

		public bool IsChanged { get; private set; }

		public EmfPlusGraphicsStateStack()
		{
			stack = new Stack<EmfPlusGraphicsState>();
			current = new EmfPlusGraphicsState();
			IsChanged = false;
		}

		public void Push(int id)
		{
			stack.Push(current.Clone(id));
		}

		public void Pop()
		{
			IsChanged = true;
			current = stack.Pop();
		}

		public void SetTransform(DXMatrix transform)
		{
			current.Transform = transform;
			IsChanged = true;
		}

		public void SetPageUnitTransform(DXMatrix transform)
		{
			current.PageUnitTransformationMatrix = transform;
			IsChanged = true;
		}

		public DXMatrix GetFullTransformationMatrix()
		{
			DXMatrix transform = Transform;
			transform.Multiply(PageUnitTransform, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			return transform;
		}

		public void ApplyState(EmfIsolatedGraphicsStateHandler stateHandler)
		{
			DXMatrix fullTransformationMatrix = GetFullTransformationMatrix();
			stateHandler.ApplyTransform(fullTransformationMatrix);
			Clip?.ApplyClip(stateHandler);
			IsChanged = false;
		}

		void IEmfGraphicsState.MarkChanged()
		{
			IsChanged = true;
		}
	}
	public interface IEmfGraphicsState
	{
		bool IsChanged { get; }

		void MarkChanged();

		void ApplyState(EmfIsolatedGraphicsStateHandler stateHandler);
	}
	public class EmfIsolatedGraphicsStateHandler : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDXGraphics graphics;

		private DXMatrix externalWorldToDeviceTransform;

		private DXRegion externalClipDevice;

		private object initialGraphicsState;

		private RectangleF srcRect;

		public EmfIsolatedGraphicsStateHandler(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
		}

		public void StartMetafileDrawing(RectangleF srcRect, RectangleF dstRect)
		{
			this.srcRect = srcRect;
			initialGraphicsState = graphics.Save();
			DXMatrix matrix = DXMatrix.CreateWarpMatrix(srcRect, dstRect);
			graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix);
			graphics.SetClip(srcRect, DXClipCombineMode.Intersect);
			GdiPlusTransformEmulation gdiPlusTransformEmulation = GdiPlusTransformEmulation.FromGraphics(graphics);
			externalWorldToDeviceTransform = gdiPlusTransformEmulation.GetWorldToDeviceTransform();
			externalClipDevice = graphics.GetClip();
			externalClipDevice.Transform(externalWorldToDeviceTransform);
			graphics.ResetTransform();
			graphics.PageScale = 1f;
			graphics.PageUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;
			graphics.SetClip(externalClipDevice);
			graphics.Transform = externalWorldToDeviceTransform;
		}

		public void EndMetafileDrawing()
		{
			if (initialGraphicsState != null)
			{
				graphics.Restore(initialGraphicsState);
				initialGraphicsState = null;
			}
		}

		public void ApplyTransform(DXMatrix currentToMetafileTransform)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = externalWorldToDeviceTransform.Clone();
			dXMatrix.Multiply(currentToMetafileTransform);
			graphics.Transform = dXMatrix;
		}

		public void ApplyClip(DXRegion clipInMetafile)
		{
			using DXRegion dXRegion = clipInMetafile.Clone();
			dXRegion.Transform(externalWorldToDeviceTransform);
			dXRegion.Intersect(externalClipDevice);
			DXMatrix transform = graphics.Transform;
			transform.Invert();
			dXRegion.Transform(transform);
			graphics.SetClip(dXRegion);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			EndMetafileDrawing();
			externalClipDevice?.Dispose();
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Drawing
{
	public sealed class DXBlend
	{
		public float[] Factors { get; set; }

		public float[] Positions { get; set; }

		public DXBlend()
		{
			Factors = new float[1];
			Positions = new float[1];
		}

		public DXBlend(int count)
		{
			Factors = new float[count];
			Positions = new float[count];
		}

		internal static DXBlend CreateSigmaBellBlend(float focus, float scale)
		{
			if (focus < 0f || focus > 1f || scale < 0f || scale > 1f)
			{
				return new DXBlend();
			}
			DXBlend dXBlend;
			if (focus == 0f)
			{
				dXBlend = new DXBlend(256);
				double num = 0.5;
				double mean = 0.5;
				double num2 = 1.0 / 255.0;
				double num3 = 0.5 * (1.0 - GdipErf(1.0, num, mean));
				double num4 = 0.5 * (1.0 - GdipErf(focus, num, mean));
				double curveHeight = num4 - num3;
				dXBlend.Positions[0] = focus;
				dXBlend.Factors[0] = scale;
				for (int i = 1; i < 255; i++)
				{
					double num5 = num2 * (double)i;
					dXBlend.Positions[i] = (float)num5;
					dXBlend.Factors[i] = SigmaFunction(scale, curveHeight, num3, num5, num, mean, leftPart: false);
				}
				dXBlend.Positions[255] = 1f;
				dXBlend.Factors[255] = 0f;
			}
			else if (focus == 1f)
			{
				dXBlend = new DXBlend(256);
				double num = 0.5;
				double mean = 0.5;
				double num2 = 1.0 / 255.0;
				double num3 = 0.5 * (1.0 + GdipErf(0.0, num, mean));
				double num4 = 0.5 * (1.0 + GdipErf(focus, num, mean));
				double curveHeight = num4 - num3;
				dXBlend.Positions[0] = 0f;
				dXBlend.Factors[0] = 0f;
				for (int j = 1; j < 255; j++)
				{
					double num6 = num2 * (double)j;
					dXBlend.Positions[j] = (float)num6;
					dXBlend.Factors[j] = SigmaFunction(scale, curveHeight, num3, num6, num, mean, leftPart: true);
				}
				dXBlend.Positions[255] = focus;
				dXBlend.Factors[255] = scale;
			}
			else
			{
				dXBlend = new DXBlend(511);
				double num = (double)focus / 4.0;
				double mean = (double)focus / 2.0;
				double num2 = (double)focus / 255.0;
				dXBlend.Positions[0] = 0f;
				dXBlend.Factors[0] = 0f;
				double num3 = 0.5 * (1.0 + GdipErf(0.0, num, mean));
				double num4 = 0.5 * (1.0 + GdipErf(focus, num, mean));
				double curveHeight = num4 - num3;
				for (int k = 1; k < 255; k++)
				{
					double num7 = num2 * (double)k;
					dXBlend.Positions[k] = (float)num7;
					dXBlend.Factors[k] = SigmaFunction(scale, curveHeight, num3, num7, num, mean, leftPart: true);
				}
				dXBlend.Positions[255] = focus;
				dXBlend.Factors[255] = scale;
				num = (1.0 - (double)focus) / 4.0;
				mean = (1.0 + (double)focus) / 2.0;
				num2 = (1.0 - (double)focus) / 255.0;
				num3 = 0.5 * (1.0 - GdipErf(1.0, num, mean));
				num4 = 0.5 * (1.0 - GdipErf(focus, num, mean));
				curveHeight = num4 - num3;
				for (int l = 256; l < 510; l++)
				{
					double num8 = (double)focus + num2 * (double)(l - 256);
					dXBlend.Positions[l] = (float)num8;
					dXBlend.Factors[l] = SigmaFunction(scale, curveHeight, num3, num8, num, mean, leftPart: false);
				}
				dXBlend.Positions[510] = 1f;
				dXBlend.Factors[510] = 0f;
			}
			return dXBlend;
		}

		private static float SigmaFunction(double scale, double curveHeight, double curveBottom, double pos, double sigma, double mean, bool leftPart)
		{
			double num = (leftPart ? 1 : (-1));
			return (float)(scale / curveHeight * (0.5 * (1.0 + num * GdipErf(pos, sigma, mean)) - curveBottom));
		}

		private static double GdipErf(double x, double std, double mean)
		{
			double num = 2.0 / Math.Sqrt(Math.PI);
			double num2 = (x - mean) / std;
			num2 /= Math.Sqrt(2.0);
			double num3 = num2 - Math.Pow(num2, 3.0) / 3.0 + Math.Pow(num2, 5.0) / 10.0 - Math.Pow(num2, 7.0) / 42.0 + Math.Pow(num2, 9.0) / 216.0 - Math.Pow(num2, 11.0) / 1420.0;
			return num * num3;
		}

		internal Color GetInterpolatedColor(Color startColor, Color endColor, float position)
		{
			if (position <= Positions[0])
			{
				float factor = InterpolateFactor(0f, Positions[0], 0f, Factors[0], position);
				return BlendHelper.InterpolateColor(startColor, endColor, factor);
			}
			if (position >= Positions[Positions.Length - 1])
			{
				float factor2 = InterpolateFactor(Positions[Positions.Length - 1], 1f, Factors[Positions.Length - 1], 1f, position);
				return BlendHelper.InterpolateColor(startColor, endColor, factor2);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Positions.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				if (position >= Positions[i] && position <= Positions[i + 1])
				{
					float factor3 = InterpolateFactor(Positions[i], Positions[i + 1], Factors[i], Factors[i + 1], position);
					return BlendHelper.InterpolateColor(startColor, endColor, factor3);
				}
			}
			return endColor;
		}

		private static float InterpolateFactor(float startPos, float endPos, float startFactor, float endFactor, float pos)
		{
			if (DXMathUtils.NearlyEquals(endPos, startPos))
			{
				return startFactor;
			}
			return startFactor + (endFactor - startFactor) * (pos - startPos) / (endPos - startPos);
		}
	}

		private static DXBrush GetOrCreate(ref DXBrush brush, Color color)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				lock (sync)
				{
					if (brush == null)
					{
						brush = new DXSolidBrush(color);
					}
				}
			}
			return brush;
		}

	public sealed class DXColorBlend
	{
		public Color[] Colors { get; set; }

		public float[] Positions { get; set; }

		public DXColorBlend()
		{
			Colors = new Color[1];
			Positions = new float[1];
		}

		public DXColorBlend(int count)
		{
			Colors = new Color[count];
			Positions = new float[count];
		}

		internal Color GetInterpolatedColor(float position)
		{
			if (position <= Positions[0])
			{
				return Colors[0];
			}
			if (position >= Positions[Positions.Length - 1])
			{
				return Colors[Positions.Length - 1];
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Positions.Length - 1; i++)
			{
				if (position >= Positions[i] && position <= Positions[i + 1])
				{
					float factor = (position - Positions[i]) / (Positions[i + 1] - Positions[i]);
					return BlendHelper.InterpolateColor(Colors[i], Colors[i + 1], factor);
				}
			}
			return Colors[0];
		}
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(DXMarginsConverter))]
	public class DXMargins : IEquatable<DXMargins>
	{
		private float left;

		private float top;

		private float right;

		private float bottom;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXMargins.Left")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXMargins.Left")]
		public float Left
		{
			get
			{
				return left;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMargin(value, "Left");
				left = value;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXMargins.Right")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXMargins.Right")]
		public float Right
		{
			get
			{
				return right;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMargin(value, "Right");
				right = value;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXMargins.Top")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXMargins.Top")]
		public float Top
		{
			get
			{
				return top;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMargin(value, "Top");
				top = value;
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXMargins.Bottom")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXMargins.Bottom")]
		public float Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				return bottom;
			}
			set
			{
				CheckMargin(value, "Bottom");
				bottom = value;
			}
		}

		public static implicit operator Margins(DXMargins margins)
		{
			return SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMargins(margins);
		}

		public static implicit operator DXMargins(Margins margins)
		{
			return SystemDrawingConverter.CreateDXMargins(margins);
		}

		internal static MarginsF ConvertToMarginF(DXMargins margins)
		{
			return ConvertToMarginF(margins, 100f);
		}

		internal static MarginsF ConvertToMarginF(DXMargins margins, float dpi)
		{
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new MarginsF(GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(margins.Left, dpi, 300f), GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(margins.Right, dpi, 300f), GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(margins.Top, dpi, 300f), GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(margins.Bottom, dpi, 300f));
		}

		internal static DXMargins ConvertFromMarginF(MarginsF margins)
		{
			return ConvertFromMarginF(margins, 100f);
		}

		internal static DXMargins ConvertFromMarginF(MarginsF margins, float dpi)
		{
			return new DXMargins(GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(((MarginsFBase)margins).Left, 300f, dpi), GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(((MarginsFBase)margins).Right, 300f, dpi), GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(((MarginsFBase)margins).Top, 300f, dpi), GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(((MarginsFBase)margins).Bottom, 300f, dpi));
		}

		private static void CheckMargin(float margin, string name)
		{
			if (margin < 0f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"Value of '{margin}' is not valid for '{name}'. '{name}' must be greater than or equal to 0");
			}
		}

		public DXMargins()
			: this(100f, 100f, 100f, 100f)
		{
		}

		public DXMargins(float left, float right, float top, float bottom)
		{
			Left = left;
			Right = right;
			Top = top;
			Bottom = bottom;
		}

		private DXMargins(DXMargins other)
		{
			left = other.left;
			right = other.right;
			top = other.top;
			bottom = other.bottom;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<float, float, float, float>(Left, Right, Top, Bottom);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as DXMargins);
		}

		public bool Equals(DXMargins other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Left == other.Left && Right == other.Right && Top == other.Top)
			{
				return Bottom == other.Bottom;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DXMargins Clone()
		{
			return new DXMargins(this);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DXMargins m1, DXMargins m2)
		{
			if ((object)m1 == null != ((object)m2 == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((object)m1 != null)
			{
				if (m1.Left == m2.Left && m1.Top == m2.Top && m1.Right == m2.Right)
				{
					return m1.Bottom == m2.Bottom;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DXMargins m1, DXMargins m2)
		{
			return !(m1 == m2);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "[{0}: Left={1}, Right={2}, Top={3}, Bottom={4}]", GetType().Name, Left, Right, Top, Bottom);
		}
	}

	public class DXFontRepository : IDisposable
	{
		private static DXFontRepository instance;

		private readonly object locker = new object();

		private readonly Dictionary<Type, IFontProvider> map;

		private readonly List<WeakReference<IFontRepositoryListener>> listeners;

		private readonly List<IFontSource> fontSources;

		public static DXFontRepository Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					lock (typeof(DXFontRepository))
					{
						if (instance == null)
						{
							instance = new DXFontRepository();
						}
					}
				}
				return instance;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEmpty => fontSources.Count == 0;

		protected DXFontRepository()
		{
			map = new Dictionary<Type, IFontProvider>();
			fontSources = new List<IFontSource>();
			listeners = new List<WeakReference<IFontRepositoryListener>>();
		}

		public void AddFont(string fontFileName)
		{
			AddFontSource(new FileFontSource(fontFileName));
		}

		public void AddFont(byte[] fontData)
		{
			AddFontSource(new InMemoryFontSource(fontData));
		}

		public void AddFont(Stream fontStream)
		{
			AddFontSource(new InMemoryFontSource(fontStream));
		}

		private void AddFontSource(IFontSource fontSource)
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				fontSources.Add(fontSource);
				foreach (IFontProvider value in map.Values)
				{
					fontSource.AddToProvider(value);
				}
			}
			RaiseOnChanged();
		}

		internal void RaiseOnChanged()
		{
			lock (listeners)
			{
				List<int> list = new List<int>();
				for (int i = 0; i < listeners.Count; i++)
				{
					if (listeners[i].TryGetTarget(out var target))
					{
						target.OnChanged();
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(i);
					}
				}
				for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					listeners.RemoveAt(list[num]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterListener(IFontRepositoryListener listener)
		{
			lock (listeners)
			{
				listeners.Add(new WeakReference<IFontRepositoryListener>(listener));
			}
		}

		internal T GetFontProvider<T>() where T : IFontProvider, new()
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
				if (map.TryGetValue(typeFromHandle, out var value))
				{
					return (T)value;
				}
				T val = new T();
				map[typeFromHandle] = val;
				foreach (IFontSource fontSource in fontSources)
				{
					fontSource.AddToProvider(val);
				}
				return val;
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			lock (locker)
			{
				foreach (IFontProvider value in map.Values)
				{
					value.Clear();
				}
				fontSources.Clear();
			}
			RaiseOnChanged();
		}

		public IList<DXFontData> GetFonts()
		{
			return GetFontProvider<DXFontDataProvider>().Fonts;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (locker)
			{
				foreach (IFontProvider value in map.Values)
				{
					value.Dispose();
				}
				map.Clear();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DXFontAdditionalPropertyCollection : Collection<DXFontAdditionalProperty>
	{
		public DXFontAdditionalProperty this[string name] => base.Items.FirstOrDefault((DXFontAdditionalProperty x) => x.Name == name);

		public void AddRange(IList<DXFontAdditionalProperty> items)
		{
			foreach (DXFontAdditionalProperty item in items)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		internal byte GetGdiCharSet()
		{
			return GetAttachedProperty("GdiCharSet", (byte)1);
		}

		internal bool GetGdiVerticalFont()
		{
			return GetAttachedProperty("GdiVerticalFont", defaultValue: false);
		}

		private T GetAttachedProperty<T>(string propertyName, T defaultValue)
		{
			object obj = this[propertyName]?.Value ?? ((object)defaultValue);
			return (T)obj;
		}
	}

	public class DXGraphicsPathData
	{
		public IReadOnlyList<PointF> PathPoints { get; }

		public IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> PathTypes { get; }

		public DXFillMode FillMode { get; }

		public DXGraphicsPathData()
		{
			PathPoints = new List<PointF>();
			PathTypes = new List<DXPathPointType>();
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathData(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types, DXFillMode fillMode)
		{
			PathPoints = points;
			PathTypes = types;
			FillMode = fillMode;
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathData(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types)
			: this(points, types, DXFillMode.Alternate)
		{
		}

		internal DXGraphicsPathData(IDXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			PathPoints = ((path.PointCount > 0) ? new List<PointF>(path.PathPoints) : new List<PointF>());
			PathTypes = ((path.PointCount > 0) ? new List<DXPathPointType>(path.PathTypes) : new List<DXPathPointType>());
			FillMode = path.FillMode;
		}

		internal static DXGraphicsPathData FromRectangle(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			return new DXGraphicsPathData(new PointF[4]
			{
				new PointF(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top),
				new PointF(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top),
				new PointF(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom),
				new PointF(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom)
			}, new DXPathPointType[4]
			{
				DXPathPointType.Start,
				DXPathPointType.Line,
				DXPathPointType.Line,
				(DXPathPointType)129
			});
		}

		public RectangleF GetBounds()
		{
			return DXGraphicsPathBuilder.GetBounds(PathPoints);
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathData Clone()
		{
			return new DXGraphicsPathData(new List<PointF>(PathPoints), new List<DXPathPointType>(PathTypes), FillMode);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DXFontTypeConverter))]
	[Editor("DevExpress.Drawing.Design.DXFontEditor,DevExpress.Utils.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public class DXFont : IEquatable<DXFont>
	{
		[NonSerialized]
		private DXFontAdditionalPropertyCollection additionalProperties = new DXFontAdditionalPropertyCollection();

		[NonSerialized]
		private Lazy<DXPlatformFontInfo> platformFontInfo;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Name")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Name")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(DXFontTypeConverter.DXFontNameConverter))]
		public string Name { get; }

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Size")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Size")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public float Size { get; }

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Unit")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Unit")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(DXFontTypeConverter.DXFontDXUnitConverter))]
		public DXGraphicsUnit Unit { get; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		public float SizeInPoints
		{
			get
			{
				if (Unit == DXGraphicsUnit.Point)
				{
					return Size;
				}
				return DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(Size, Unit, DXGraphicsUnit.Point);
			}
		}

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Bold")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Bold")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool Bold => (Style & DXFontStyle.Bold) != 0;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Italic")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Italic")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool Italic => (Style & DXFontStyle.Italic) != 0;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Strikeout")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Strikeout")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool Strikeout => (Style & DXFontStyle.Strikeout) != 0;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Underline")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXFont.Underline")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(BooleanTypeConverter))]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool Underline => (Style & DXFontStyle.Underline) != 0;

		[Description("Returns style information applied to the font.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public DXFontStyle Style { get; }

		[DXHelpExclude(true)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public DXFontAdditionalPropertyCollection AdditionalProperties => additionalProperties ?? (additionalProperties = new DXFontAdditionalPropertyCollection());

		internal Lazy<DXPlatformFontInfo> PlatformFontInfo => platformFontInfo ?? (platformFontInfo = new Lazy<DXPlatformFontInfo>(CreateMetrics));

		[Description("Obtains the font height.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public int Height => (int)Math.Ceiling(HeightF);

		private float HeightF => PlatformFontInfo.Value.Height;

		internal float Ascent => PlatformFontInfo.Value.Ascent;

		internal float Descent => PlatformFontInfo.Value.Descent;

		internal float LineSpacing => PlatformFontInfo.Value.LineSpacing;

		internal string ActualName => PlatformFontInfo.Value.Name;

		public static implicit operator Font(DXFont font)
		{
			return SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(font);
		}

		public static implicit operator DXFont(Font font)
		{
			return SystemDrawingConverter.CreateDXFont(font);
		}

		private bool ShouldSerializeAdditionalProperties()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public DXFont(string name, float size)
			: this(name, size, DXFontStyle.Regular)
		{
		}

		public DXFont(string name, float size, DXFontStyle style)
			: this(name, size, style, DXGraphicsUnit.Point)
		{
		}

		public DXFont(string name, float size, DXFontStyle style, DXGraphicsUnit unit)
			: this(name, size, style, unit, null)
		{
		}

		public DXFont(string name, float size, DXFontStyle style, DXGraphicsUnit unit, DXFontAdditionalProperty[] additionalProperties)
		{
			Name = name;
			Size = size;
			Style = style;
			Unit = unit;
			if (additionalProperties != null)
			{
				AdditionalProperties.AddRange(additionalProperties);
			}
		}

		public DXFont(DXFont prototype, DXFontStyle newStyle)
			: this(prototype, prototype.Size, newStyle)
		{
		}

		internal DXFont(DXFont prototype, float newSize)
			: this(prototype, newSize, prototype.Style)
		{
		}

		private DXFont(DXFont prototype, float newSize, DXFontStyle newStyle)
		{
			Name = prototype.Name;
			Size = newSize;
			Style = newStyle;
			Unit = prototype.Unit;
			AdditionalProperties.AddRange(prototype.AdditionalProperties);
		}

		private DXFont(DXFont other)
		{
			Name = other.Name;
			Size = other.Size;
			Style = other.Style;
			Unit = other.Unit;
			AdditionalProperties.AddRange(other.AdditionalProperties);
			platformFontInfo = other.platformFontInfo;
		}

		private DXPlatformFontInfo CreateMetrics()
		{
			using IDXPlatformFont font = DXDrawingEngine.CreatePlatformFont(this);
			return new DXPlatformFontInfo(font);
		}

		internal float GetHeight(float dpi)
		{
			return DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(HeightF, DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel), dpi);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, "[{0}: Name={1}, Size={2}, Units={3}]", GetType().Name, Name, Size, Unit);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			byte gdiCharSet = AdditionalProperties.GetGdiCharSet();
			bool gdiVerticalFont = AdditionalProperties.GetGdiVerticalFont();
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, float, int, int, int, bool>(Name, Size, (int)Style, (int)Unit, (int)gdiCharSet, gdiVerticalFont);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as DXFont);
		}

		public bool Equals(DXFont other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Name == other.Name && Size == other.Size && Style == other.Style && Unit == other.Unit)
			{
				return AdditionalPropertiesEquals(other);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool AdditionalPropertiesEquals(DXFont other)
		{
			if (AdditionalProperties.Count == 0 && other.AdditionalProperties.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (AdditionalProperties.Count != other.AdditionalProperties.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (AdditionalProperties.GetGdiCharSet() == other.AdditionalProperties.GetGdiCharSet())
			{
				return AdditionalProperties.GetGdiVerticalFont() == other.AdditionalProperties.GetGdiVerticalFont();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DXFont Clone()
		{
			return new DXFont(this);
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXBitmap")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DXImageTypeConverter))]
	public class DXBitmap : DXImage
	{
		private readonly IDXBitmap implementation;

		internal DXPixelFormat PixelFormat => implementation.PixelFormat;

		internal DXPalette Palette => implementation.Palette;

		internal bool CanGetPixels => implementation.CanGetPixels;

		protected internal override IDXImage Implementation => implementation;

		internal DXBitmap(IDXBitmap implementation)
		{
			this.implementation = implementation;
		}

		internal DXBitmap(int width, int height, int stride, PixelFormat pixelFormat, Color[] imagePalette, byte[] bitmapData, int offset)
		{
			implementation = DXDrawingEngine.CreateBitmap(width, height, stride, pixelFormat, imagePalette, bitmapData, offset);
		}

		internal DXBitmap(int width, int height, int stride, DXPixelFormat pixelFormat, DXPalette palette, byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			implementation = DXDrawingEngine.CreateBitmap(width, height, stride, pixelFormat, palette, data, offset);
		}

		internal DXBitmap(DXImage original, Action<IDXGraphics> customization = null)
			: this(original, original.Width, original.Height, customization)
		{
		}

		internal DXBitmap(DXImage original, int width, int height, Action<IDXGraphics> customization = null)
			: this(width, height)
		{
			IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = null;
			try
			{
				iDXGraphics = Implementation.CreateGraphics();
				customization?.Invoke(iDXGraphics);
				iDXGraphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(original, new RectangleF(0f, 0f, width, height));
			}
			finally
			{
				iDXGraphics?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal DXBitmap(int width, int height, DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			implementation = DXDrawingEngine.CreateBitmap(width, height, pixelFormat);
		}

		public DXBitmap(int width, int height)
		{
			implementation = DXDrawingEngine.CreateBitmap(width, height);
		}

		public DXBitmap Crop(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			return new DXBitmap(implementation.Crop(rectangle));
		}

		public DXBitmap Crop(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			return new DXBitmap(implementation.Crop(rectangle));
		}

		public Color GetPixel(int x, int y)
		{
			return implementation.GetPixel(x, y);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetResolution(float horizontalResolution, float verticalResolution)
		{
			implementation.SetResolution(horizontalResolution, verticalResolution);
		}

		public override DXImage Clone()
		{
			return CloneBitmap();
		}

		public bool Equals(DXBitmap other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return implementation.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DXBitmap dXBitmap)
			{
				return implementation.Equals(dXBitmap.implementation);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void RotateFlip(DXRotateFlipType rotateFlipType)
		{
			implementation.RotateFlip(rotateFlipType);
		}

		internal DXBitmap CloneBitmap()
		{
			return new DXBitmap(implementation.Clone());
		}

		internal IDXBitmapData GetBitmapData(DXImageLockMode lockMode = DXImageLockMode.ReadOnly)
		{
			return GetBitmapData(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, base.Size), lockMode, PixelFormat);
		}

		internal IDXBitmapData GetBitmapData(Rectangle rect, DXImageLockMode lockMode, DXPixelFormat format)
		{
			return implementation.GetBitmapData(rect, lockMode, format);
		}

		internal DXBitmap Convert(DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			return new DXBitmap(implementation.Convert(pixelFormat));
		}

		internal void ConvertToJpeg(Stream stream, long jpegQuality)
		{
			implementation.ConvertToJpeg(stream, jpegQuality);
		}
	}
	[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DXImageTypeConverter))]
	[Editor("DevExpress.Drawing.Design.DXImageEditor,DevExpress.Utils.v23.2.UI, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public abstract class DXImage : IDisposable, IEquatable<DXImage>
	{
		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.Width")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.Width")]
		public int Width => Implementation.Width;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.Height")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.Height")]
		public int Height => Implementation.Height;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.HorizontalResolution")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.HorizontalResolution")]
		public float HorizontalResolution => Implementation.HorizontalResolution;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.VerticalResolution")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.VerticalResolution")]
		public float VerticalResolution => Implementation.VerticalResolution;

		[DXLocalizedDescription(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.ImageFormat")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.ImageFormat")]
		public DXImageFormat ImageFormat => ImageFormatOptions.ImageFormat;

		[Description("")]
		[DXDisplayName(typeof(ResFinder), "DevExpress.Drawing.DXImage.ImageProperties")]
		internal DXImageProperties ImageProperties => Implementation.ImageProperties;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal DXImageFormatOptions ImageFormatOptions => Implementation.ImageFormatOptions;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public Size Size => new Size(Width, Height);

		internal int NumberOfFrames => Implementation.NumberOfFrames;

		internal SizeF PhysicalDimension => Implementation.PhysicalDimension;

		internal object NativeImage => Implementation.NativeImage;

		internal bool IsDisposedOrInvalid => Implementation.IsDisposedOrInvalid();

		internal virtual RectangleF Bounds => new RectangleF(0f, 0f, Width, Height);

		protected internal abstract IDXImage Implementation { get; }

		public static implicit operator Image(DXImage image)
		{
			return SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(image);
		}

		public static implicit operator DXImage(Image image)
		{
			return SystemDrawingConverter.WrapImage(image);
		}

		public static DXImage FromStream(Stream stream)
		{
			IDXImage iDXImage = DXDrawingEngine.CreateImage(stream);
			DXImage dXImage = null;
			if (iDXImage is IDXBitmap)
			{
				return new DXBitmap((IDXBitmap)iDXImage);
			}
			if (iDXImage is IDXMetafile)
			{
				return new DXMetafile((IDXMetafile)iDXImage);
			}
			if (iDXImage is IDXSvgImage)
			{
				return new DXSvgImage((IDXSvgImage)iDXImage);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static DXImage FromBase64String(string base64)
		{
			return DXImageHelper.LoadImageFromBase64(base64);
		}

		internal static bool Equals(DXImage image1, DXImage image2)
		{
			if (image1 == image2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (image1 == null || image2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return image1.NativeImage == image2.NativeImage;
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream)
		{
			Save(stream, ImageFormat);
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			Implementation.Save(stream, imageFormat);
		}

		public void Save(string fileName, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			using FileStream stream = File.OpenWrite(fileName);
			Implementation.Save(stream, imageFormat);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Implementation.Dispose();
		}

		public abstract DXImage Clone();

		public bool Equals(DXImage other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions)
		{
			Implementation.Save(stream, imageFormatOptions);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal void Save(string fileName, DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions)
		{
			using FileStream stream = File.OpenWrite(fileName);
			Implementation.Save(stream, imageFormatOptions);
		}

		internal void FlipVertical()
		{
			RotateFlip(DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipX);
		}

		public abstract void RotateFlip(DXRotateFlipType rotateFlipType);

		internal IDXGraphics CreateGraphics()
		{
			return Implementation.CreateGraphics();
		}
	}

		private static DXPen GetOrCreate(ref DXPen pen, Color color)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				lock (sync)
				{
					if (pen == null)
					{
						pen = new DXPen(color);
					}
				}
			}
			return pen;
		}

	public class DXAdjustableArrowCap : DXCustomLineCapBase
	{
		public float Width { get; set; }

		public float Height { get; set; }

		public float MiddleInset { get; set; }

		public bool Filled { get; set; }

		public DXAdjustableArrowCap(float width, float height, float widthScale, bool filled)
		{
			Width = width;
			Height = height;
			base.WidthScale = widthScale;
			Filled = filled;
		}

		public DXAdjustableArrowCap()
			: this(1f, 1f, 1f, filled: true)
		{
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.FinishGeneric<float, float, float, bool>(base.GetHashCode(), Width, Height, MiddleInset, Filled);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DXAdjustableArrowCap dXAdjustableArrowCap && base.Equals((object)dXAdjustableArrowCap) && Width == dXAdjustableArrowCap.Width && Height == dXAdjustableArrowCap.Height && base.WidthScale == dXAdjustableArrowCap.WidthScale)
			{
				return Filled == dXAdjustableArrowCap.Filled;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DXBrush : IEquatable<DXBrush>, IDisposable
	{
		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
		}

		internal abstract void Accept(IDXBrushVisitor visitor);

		public abstract DXBrush Clone();

		bool IEquatable<DXBrush>.Equals(DXBrush other)
		{
			return EqualsCore(other);
		}

		protected abstract bool EqualsCore(DXBrush other);
	}
	public class DXCustomLineCap : DXCustomLineCapBase
	{
		public DXLineCap BaseCap { get; set; }

		public float BaseInset { get; set; }

		public DXGraphicsPathData FillPath { get; set; }

		public DXGraphicsPathData StrokePath { get; set; }

		public DXCustomLineCap()
		{
			BaseCap = DXLineCap.Flat;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.FinishGeneric<int, float, DXGraphicsPathData, DXGraphicsPathData>(base.GetHashCode(), (int)BaseCap, BaseInset, FillPath, StrokePath);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap && base.Equals((object)dXCustomLineCap) && BaseCap == dXCustomLineCap.BaseCap && BaseInset == dXCustomLineCap.BaseInset && FillPath.Equals(dXCustomLineCap.FillPath))
			{
				return StrokePath.Equals(dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DXCustomLineCapBase
	{
		public DXLineCap StrokeStartCap { get; set; }

		public DXLineCap StrokeEndCap { get; set; }

		public DXLineJoin StrokeJoin { get; set; }

		public float StrokeMiterLimit { get; set; }

		public float WidthScale { get; set; }

		protected DXCustomLineCapBase()
		{
			StrokeStartCap = DXLineCap.Flat;
			StrokeEndCap = DXLineCap.Flat;
			StrokeJoin = DXLineJoin.Miter;
			StrokeMiterLimit = 10f;
			WidthScale = 1f;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, int, int, float, float>((int)StrokeStartCap, (int)StrokeEndCap, (int)StrokeJoin, StrokeMiterLimit, WidthScale);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DXCustomLineCapBase dXCustomLineCapBase && StrokeStartCap == dXCustomLineCapBase.StrokeStartCap && StrokeEndCap == dXCustomLineCapBase.StrokeEndCap && StrokeJoin == dXCustomLineCapBase.StrokeJoin && StrokeMiterLimit == dXCustomLineCapBase.StrokeMiterLimit)
			{
				return WidthScale == dXCustomLineCapBase.WidthScale;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class DXGraphicsPath : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDXGraphicsPath implementation;

		protected internal IDXGraphicsPath Implementation => implementation;

		public int PointCount => implementation.PointCount;

		public IReadOnlyList<PointF> PathPoints => implementation.PathPoints;

		public IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> PathTypes => implementation.PathTypes;

		public DXFillMode FillMode
		{
			get
			{
				return implementation.FillMode;
			}
			set
			{
				implementation.FillMode = value;
			}
		}

		public DXGraphicsPath(DXGraphicsPathData pathData)
			: this(DXDrawingEngine.CreateGraphicsPath(pathData))
		{
		}

		public DXGraphicsPath(DXFillMode fillMode = DXFillMode.Alternate)
			: this(DXDrawingEngine.CreateGraphicsPath(fillMode))
		{
		}

		public DXGraphicsPath(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types, DXFillMode fillMode = DXFillMode.Alternate)
			: this(DXDrawingEngine.CreateGraphicsPath(points, types, fillMode))
		{
		}

		internal DXGraphicsPath(IDXGraphicsPath implementation)
		{
			this.implementation = implementation;
		}

		internal void AddLines(IReadOnlyList<Point> points)
		{
			implementation.AddLines(points);
		}

		public void AddRectangle(RectangleF rect)
		{
			implementation.AddRectangle(rect);
		}

		public void AddRectangles(IReadOnlyList<RectangleF> rectangles)
		{
			implementation.AddRectangles(rectangles);
		}

		public void AddLine(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			implementation.AddLine(x1, y1, x2, y2);
		}

		public void AddLine(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			implementation.AddLine(startPoint, endPoint);
		}

		public void AddLines(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			implementation.AddLines(points);
		}

		public void AddEllipse(RectangleF rect)
		{
			implementation.AddEllipse(rect);
		}

		public void AddEllipse(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			implementation.AddEllipse(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public void AddPie(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			implementation.AddPie(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddPie(Rectangle rect, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			implementation.AddPie(rect, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddPath(DXGraphicsPath path, bool connect)
		{
			implementation.AddPath(path, connect);
		}

		public void AddBezier(PointF startPoint, PointF controlPoint1, PointF controlPoint2, PointF endPoint)
		{
			implementation.AddBezier(startPoint, controlPoint1, controlPoint2, endPoint);
		}

		public void AddBezier(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3, float x4, float y4)
		{
			implementation.AddBezier(new PointF(x1, y1), new PointF(x2, y2), new PointF(x3, y3), new PointF(x4, y4));
		}

		public void AddBeziers(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			implementation.AddBeziers(points);
		}

		public void AddArc(RectangleF rectangle, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			implementation.AddArc(rectangle, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			implementation.AddArc(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddPolygon(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			implementation.AddPolygon(points);
		}

		public void AddString(string text, DXFont font, PointF point, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			implementation.AddString(text, font, point, stringFormat);
		}

		public void AddString(string text, DXFont font, RectangleF rect, DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			implementation.AddString(text, font, rect, stringFormat);
		}

		public void AddCurve(PointF[] points, float tension)
		{
			implementation.AddCurve(points, tension);
		}

		public void AddCurve(PointF[] points)
		{
			implementation.AddCurve(points);
		}

		public void StartFigure()
		{
			implementation.StartFigure();
		}

		public void CloseFigure()
		{
			implementation.CloseFigure();
		}

		public void Transform(DXMatrix matrix)
		{
			implementation.Transform(matrix);
		}

		public RectangleF GetBounds()
		{
			return implementation.GetBounds();
		}

		public void Widen(DXPen pen, DXMatrix matrix)
		{
			implementation.Widen(pen, matrix);
		}

		public void Widen(DXPen pen)
		{
			implementation.Widen(pen);
		}

		public bool IsVisible(PointF hitPoint)
		{
			return implementation.IsVisible(hitPoint);
		}

		public bool IsVisible(float x, float y)
		{
			return implementation.IsVisible(new PointF(x, y));
		}

		public void Flatten()
		{
			implementation.Flatten();
		}

		public void Flatten(DXMatrix transform)
		{
			implementation.Flatten(transform);
		}

		public void Flatten(DXMatrix transform, float flatness)
		{
			implementation.Flatten(transform, flatness);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			implementation.Reset();
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathData GetPathData()
		{
			return new DXGraphicsPathData(implementation);
		}

		public DXGraphicsPath Clone()
		{
			return implementation.Clone();
		}

		public PointF GetLastPoint()
		{
			IReadOnlyList<PointF> pathPoints = PathPoints;
			if (pathPoints.Count < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return pathPoints[pathPoints.Count - 1];
		}

		internal void WindingOutline(float flatness)
		{
			implementation.WindingOutline(flatness);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			DisposeCore();
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeCore()
		{
			implementation.Dispose();
		}
	}
