	public class DXHatchBrush : DXBrush
	{
		private readonly DXHatchStyle hatchStyle;

		private readonly Color foregroundColor;

		private readonly Color backgroundColor;

		public DXHatchStyle HatchStyle => hatchStyle;

		public Color ForegroundColor => foregroundColor;

		public Color BackgroundColor => backgroundColor;

		public DXHatchBrush(DXHatchStyle hatchStyle, Color foregroundColor, Color backgroundColor)
		{
			this.hatchStyle = hatchStyle;
			this.foregroundColor = foregroundColor;
			this.backgroundColor = backgroundColor;
		}

		private DXHatchBrush(DXHatchBrush hatchBrush)
			: this(hatchBrush.hatchStyle, hatchBrush.foregroundColor, hatchBrush.backgroundColor)
		{
		}

		internal override void Accept(IDXBrushVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override DXBrush Clone()
		{
			return new DXHatchBrush(this);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, Color, Color>((int)HatchStyle, ForegroundColor, BackgroundColor);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return EqualsCore(obj as DXHatchBrush);
		}

		protected override bool EqualsCore(DXBrush otherBase)
		{
			if (otherBase is DXHatchBrush dXHatchBrush && HatchStyle == dXHatchBrush.HatchStyle && ForegroundColor == dXHatchBrush.ForegroundColor)
			{
				return BackgroundColor == dXHatchBrush.BackgroundColor;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class DXLinearGradientBrush : DXTilingBrush
	{
		private Color[] linearColors;

		private RectangleF rectangle;

		private DXBlend blend;

		private DXColorBlend interpolationColors;

		internal static DXBlend DefaultBlend { get; } = new DXBlend
		{
			Positions = new float[1],
			Factors = new float[1] { 1f }
		};

		internal DXLinearGradientMode Mode { get; }

		public DXColorBlend InterpolationColors
		{
			get
			{
				return interpolationColors;
			}
			set
			{
				blend = null;
				interpolationColors = value;
			}
		}

		public DXBlend Blend
		{
			get
			{
				return blend;
			}
			set
			{
				blend = value;
			}
		}

		public Color[] LinearColors
		{
			get
			{
				return linearColors;
			}
			set
			{
				linearColors = new Color[2]
				{
					value[0],
					value[1]
				};
			}
		}

		public RectangleF Rectangle
		{
			get
			{
				return rectangle;
			}
			set
			{
				rectangle = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool GammaCorrection { get; set; }

		private static double ConvertToRadians(double angle)
		{
			return Math.PI / 180.0 * angle;
		}

		private static RectangleF CalculateRectangle(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			RectangleF result = new RectangleF
			{
				X = ((startPoint.X < endPoint.X) ? startPoint.X : endPoint.X),
				Y = ((startPoint.Y < endPoint.Y) ? startPoint.Y : endPoint.Y),
				Width = Math.Abs(startPoint.X - endPoint.X),
				Height = Math.Abs(startPoint.Y - endPoint.Y)
			};
			if (result.Width == 0f)
			{
				result.X -= result.Height / 2f;
				result.Width = result.Height;
			}
			else if (result.Height == 0f)
			{
				result.Y -= result.Width / 2f;
				result.Height = result.Width;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static float GetGradientModeAngle(DXLinearGradientMode linearGradientMode)
		{
			return linearGradientMode switch
			{
				DXLinearGradientMode.Horizontal => 0f, 
				DXLinearGradientMode.Vertical => 90f, 
				DXLinearGradientMode.ForwardDiagonal => 45f, 
				DXLinearGradientMode.BackwardDiagonal => 135f, 
				_ => 0f, 
			};
		}

		private static DXMatrix CreateMatrix(RectangleF rectangle, DXLinearGradientMode linearGradientMode)
		{
			return CreateMatrix(rectangle, GetGradientModeAngle(linearGradientMode), isAngleScalable: true);
		}

		private static DXMatrix CreateMatrix(RectangleF rect, double angle, bool isAngleScalable)
		{
			angle %= 360.0;
			if (angle < 0.0)
			{
				angle += 360.0;
			}
			if (isAngleScalable)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				while (angle >= 90.0)
				{
					angle -= 180.0;
					num += Math.PI;
				}
				angle = ((angle == 90.0 || angle == -90.0) ? ConvertToRadians(angle) : Math.Atan((double)(rect.Width / rect.Height) * Math.Tan(ConvertToRadians(angle))));
				angle += num;
			}
			else
			{
				angle = ConvertToRadians(angle);
			}
			if (angle == 0.0)
			{
				return new DXMatrix();
			}
			double num2 = Math.Sin(angle);
			double num3 = Math.Cos(angle);
			double num4 = num2 * num3;
			float right = rect.Right;
			float bottom = rect.Bottom;
			PointF start = default(PointF);
			PointF end = default(PointF);
			if (num4 >= 0.0)
			{
				start.X = Math.Min(rect.X, right);
				start.Y = Math.Min(rect.Y, bottom);
				end.X = Math.Max(rect.X, right);
				end.Y = Math.Max(rect.Y, bottom);
			}
			else
			{
				start.X = Math.Max(rect.X, right);
				start.Y = Math.Min(rect.Y, bottom);
				end.X = Math.Min(rect.X, right);
				end.Y = Math.Max(rect.Y, bottom);
			}
			float num5;
			float num6;
			if (num4 >= 0.0)
			{
				num5 = (float)((double)rect.Height * num4 + (double)rect.Width * num3 * num3);
				num6 = (float)((double)rect.Height * num2 * num2 + (double)rect.Width * num4);
			}
			else
			{
				num5 = (float)((double)rect.Width * num2 * num2 + (double)rect.Height * num4);
				num6 = (float)((double)(0f - rect.Width) * num4 + (double)rect.Height * num2 * num2);
			}
			if (num2 >= 0.0)
			{
				end.X = rect.X + num5;
				end.Y = rect.Y + num6;
			}
			else
			{
				end.X = start.X;
				end.Y = start.Y;
				start.X = rect.X + num5;
				start.Y = rect.Y + num6;
			}
			return CreateLineGradientTransform(start, end, rect);
		}

		private static DXMatrix CreateLineGradientTransform(PointF start, PointF end, RectangleF rect)
		{
			float num = rect.X + rect.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = rect.Y + rect.Height / 2f;
			float num3 = end.X - start.X;
			float num4 = end.Y - start.Y;
			float num5 = (float)Math.Sqrt(num3 * num3 + num4 * num4);
			float num6 = num3 / num5;
			float num7 = num4 / num5;
			float scaleX = (Math.Abs(num6) * rect.Width + Math.Abs(num7) * rect.Height) / rect.Width;
			float scaleY = (Math.Abs(num7) * rect.Width + Math.Abs(num6) * rect.Height) / rect.Height;
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = new DXMatrix();
			DXMatrix matrix = new DXMatrix(num6, num7, -1f * num7, num6, 0f, 0f);
			dXMatrix.Translate(0f - num, 0f - num2, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			dXMatrix.Scale(scaleX, scaleY, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			dXMatrix.Multiply(matrix, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			dXMatrix.Translate(num, num2, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		public DXLinearGradientBrush(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint, Color color1, Color color2)
			: base(DXWrapMode.Tile)
		{
			RectangleF rect = CalculateRectangle(startPoint, endPoint);
			base.Transform = CreateLineGradientTransform(startPoint, endPoint, rect);
			Initialize(rect, color1, color2);
		}

		public DXLinearGradientBrush(RectangleF rectangle, Color color1, Color color2)
			: base(DXWrapMode.Tile)
		{
			Initialize(rectangle, color1, color2);
		}

		public DXLinearGradientBrush(RectangleF rectangle, Color color1, Color color2, float angle, bool isAngleScalable = false)
			: base(DXWrapMode.Tile, CreateMatrix(rectangle, angle, isAngleScalable))
		{
			Initialize(rectangle, color1, color2);
		}

		public DXLinearGradientBrush(RectangleF rectangle, Color color1, Color color2, DXLinearGradientMode linearGradientMode)
			: base(DXWrapMode.Tile, CreateMatrix(rectangle, linearGradientMode))
		{
			Initialize(rectangle, color1, color2);
			Mode = linearGradientMode;
		}

		private void Initialize(RectangleF rectangle, Color color1, Color color2)
		{
			this.rectangle = rectangle;
			linearColors = new Color[2] { color1, color2 };
			blend = BlendHelper.Clone(DefaultBlend);
		}

		private DXLinearGradientBrush(DXLinearGradientBrush brush)
			: base(brush)
		{
			interpolationColors = brush.interpolationColors;
			rectangle = brush.rectangle;
			blend = BlendHelper.Clone(brush.blend);
			linearColors = brush.linearColors;
			GammaCorrection = brush.GammaCorrection;
		}

		internal void SetSigmaBellShape(float focus, float scale = 1f)
		{
			DXBlend dXBlend = DXBlend.CreateSigmaBellBlend(focus, scale);
			if (dXBlend.Positions.Length > 1)
			{
				InterpolationColors = null;
				Blend = dXBlend;
			}
		}

		internal override void Accept(IDXBrushVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override DXBrush Clone()
		{
			return new DXLinearGradientBrush(this);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.FinishGeneric<RectangleF, DXBlend, DXColorBlend, Color[], bool>(base.GetHashCode(), Rectangle, Blend, InterpolationColors, LinearColors, GammaCorrection);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return EqualsCore(obj as DXLinearGradientBrush);
		}

		protected override bool EqualsCore(DXBrush otherBase)
		{
			if (otherBase is DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush && base.EqualsCore((DXBrush)dXLinearGradientBrush) && Rectangle == dXLinearGradientBrush.Rectangle && Blend == dXLinearGradientBrush.Blend && InterpolationColors == dXLinearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors && LinearColors == dXLinearGradientBrush.LinearColors)
			{
				return GammaCorrection == dXLinearGradientBrush.GammaCorrection;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetBlendTriangularShape(float focus)
		{
			SetBlendTriangularShape(focus, 1f);
		}

		public void SetBlendTriangularShape(float focus, float scale)
		{
			if (focus < 0f || focus > 1f || scale < 0f || scale > 1f)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Invalid parameter value");
			}
			if (focus == 0f)
			{
				blend.Positions = new float[2];
				blend.Factors = new float[2];
				blend.Positions[0] = focus;
				blend.Factors[0] = scale;
				blend.Positions[1] = 1f;
				blend.Factors[1] = 0f;
			}
			else if (focus == 1f)
			{
				blend.Positions = new float[2];
				blend.Factors = new float[2];
				blend.Positions[0] = 0f;
				blend.Factors[0] = 0f;
				blend.Positions[1] = focus;
				blend.Factors[1] = scale;
			}
			else
			{
				blend.Positions = new float[3];
				blend.Factors = new float[3];
				blend.Positions[0] = 0f;
				blend.Factors[0] = 0f;
				blend.Positions[1] = focus;
				blend.Factors[1] = scale;
				blend.Positions[2] = 1f;
				blend.Factors[2] = 0f;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DXMatrix
	{
		private InnerMatrix innerMatrix;

		public float[] Elements => InnerMatrix.Elements;

		public float OffsetX => InnerMatrix.OffsetX;

		public float OffsetY => InnerMatrix.OffsetY;

		public bool IsInvertible => InnerMatrix.IsInvertible;

		public bool IsIdentity => InnerMatrix.IsIdentity;

		public float A => InnerMatrix.A;

		public float B => InnerMatrix.B;

		public float C => InnerMatrix.C;

		public float D => InnerMatrix.D;

		public float E => InnerMatrix.E;

		public float F => InnerMatrix.F;

		private InnerMatrix InnerMatrix
		{
			get
			{
				return innerMatrix;
			}
			set
			{
				innerMatrix = value;
			}
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateRotateMatrix(float angle)
		{
			return new DXMatrix(InnerMatrix.GetRotateMatrix(angle));
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateScaleMatrix(float scaleX, float scaleY)
		{
			return new DXMatrix(InnerMatrix.GetScaleMatrix(scaleX, scaleY));
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateTranslateMatrix(float offsetX, float offsetY)
		{
			return new DXMatrix(InnerMatrix.GetTranslateMatrix(offsetX, offsetY));
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateShearMatrix(float shearX, float shearY)
		{
			return new DXMatrix(InnerMatrix.GetShearMatrix(shearX, shearY));
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateWarpMatrix(RectangleF src, RectangleF dst)
		{
			return CreateWarpMatrix(new PointF[3]
			{
				new PointF(src.Left, src.Top),
				new PointF(src.Right, src.Top),
				new PointF(src.Left, src.Bottom)
			}, new PointF[3]
			{
				new PointF(dst.Left, dst.Top),
				new PointF(dst.Right, dst.Top),
				new PointF(dst.Left, dst.Bottom)
			});
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateWarpMatrix(RectangleF source, IReadOnlyList<PointF> destinationPoints)
		{
			return CreateWarpMatrix(new PointF[3]
			{
				new PointF(source.Left, source.Top),
				new PointF(source.Right, source.Top),
				new PointF(source.Left, source.Bottom)
			}, destinationPoints);
		}

		internal static DXMatrix CreateWarpMatrix(IReadOnlyList<PointF> sourcePoints, IReadOnlyList<PointF> destinationPoints)
		{
			if (sourcePoints.Count != 3)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("sourcePoints must contain three distinct points");
			}
			if (destinationPoints.Count != 3)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("destinationPoints must contain three distinct points");
			}
			return DXMatrixCalculator.CalculateTransformationMatrix(sourcePoints, destinationPoints);
		}

		internal static DXMatrix CreateRotateFlipMatrix(DXRotateFlipType rotateFlipType, int width, int height)
		{
			return rotateFlipType switch
			{
				DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipXY => new DXMatrix(), 
				DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipY => new DXMatrix(-1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, width, 0f), 
				DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipX => new DXMatrix(1f, 0f, 0f, -1f, 0f, height), 
				DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipNone => new DXMatrix(-1f, 0f, 0f, -1f, width, height), 
				DXRotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipXY => new DXMatrix(0f, 1f, -1f, 0f, height, 0f), 
				DXRotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipY => new DXMatrix(0f, 1f, 1f, 0f, 0f, 0f), 
				DXRotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipX => new DXMatrix(0f, -1f, -1f, 0f, height, width), 
				DXRotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipNone => new DXMatrix(0f, -1f, 1f, 0f, 0f, width), 
				_ => new DXMatrix(), 
			};
		}

		public DXMatrix()
			: this(1f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 0f, 0f)
		{
		}

		public DXMatrix(float[] elements)
			: this(elements[0], elements[1], elements[2], elements[3], elements[4], elements[5])
		{
		}

		public DXMatrix(float m11, float m12, float m21, float m22, float dx, float dy)
		{
			InnerMatrix = new InnerMatrix(m11, m12, m21, m22, dx, dy);
		}

		private DXMatrix(InnerMatrix innerMatrix)
		{
			InnerMatrix = innerMatrix;
		}

		public DXMatrix Clone()
		{
			return new DXMatrix(InnerMatrix);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Identity;
		}

		public void Translate(float offsetX, float offsetY, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Translate(offsetX, offsetY, order);
		}

		public void Scale(float scaleX, float scaleY, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Scale(scaleX, scaleY, order);
		}

		public void Rotate(float angle, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Rotate(angle, order);
		}

		public void RotateAt(float angle, PointF point, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			if (order == DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
			{
				InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Translate(point.X, point.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Prepend).Rotate(angle, DXMatrixOrder.Prepend).Translate(0f - point.X, 0f - point.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Prepend);
			}
			else
			{
				InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Translate(0f - point.X, 0f - point.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Append).Rotate(angle, DXMatrixOrder.Append).Translate(point.X, point.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			}
		}

		public void Shear(float shearX, float shearY, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Shear(shearX, shearY, order);
		}

		public void Multiply(DXMatrix matrix, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			Multiply(matrix.InnerMatrix, order);
		}

		private void Multiply(InnerMatrix matrix, DXMatrixOrder order)
		{
			if (order == DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
			{
				InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Multiply(InnerMatrix, matrix);
			}
			else
			{
				InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Multiply(matrix, InnerMatrix);
			}
		}

		public void Invert()
		{
			InnerMatrix = InnerMatrix.Invert(InnerMatrix);
		}

		public void TransformPoints(PointF[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				points[i] = InnerMatrix.Multiply(points[i], InnerMatrix);
			}
		}

		public PointF TransformPoint(PointF point)
		{
			return InnerMatrix.Multiply(point, InnerMatrix);
		}

		public IReadOnlyList<PointF> TransformPoints(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[points.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = InnerMatrix.Multiply(points[i], InnerMatrix);
			}
			return array;
		}

		public bool Equals(DXMatrix matrix)
		{
			return InnerMatrix.Equals(matrix.InnerMatrix);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DXMatrix)
			{
				return Equals((DXMatrix)obj);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return InnerMatrix.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class DXPathGradientBrush : DXTilingBrush
	{
		private readonly DXGraphicsPathData pathData;

		private Color centerColor;

		private PointF? centerPoint;

		private Color[] surroundColors;

		private DXBlend blend;

		private DXColorBlend colorBlend;

		private PointF focusScales;

		internal static DXBlend DefaultBlend { get; } = new DXBlend
		{
			Positions = new float[2] { 0f, 1f },
			Factors = new float[2] { 0f, 1f }
		};

		public DXGraphicsPathData PathData => pathData;

		public DXBlend Blend
		{
			get
			{
				return blend;
			}
			set
			{
				blend = value;
			}
		}

		public DXColorBlend InterpolationColors
		{
			get
			{
				return colorBlend;
			}
			set
			{
				colorBlend = value;
			}
		}

		public PointF FocusScales
		{
			get
			{
				return focusScales;
			}
			set
			{
				focusScales = value;
			}
		}

		public Color CenterColor
		{
			get
			{
				return centerColor;
			}
			set
			{
				centerColor = value;
			}
		}

		public PointF? CenterPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return centerPoint;
			}
			set
			{
				centerPoint = value;
			}
		}

		public Color[] SurroundColors
		{
			get
			{
				return surroundColors;
			}
			set
			{
				surroundColors = value;
			}
		}

		public DXPathGradientBrush(DXGraphicsPathData pathData)
			: base(DXWrapMode.Clamp)
		{
			this.pathData = pathData;
			centerColor = Color.FromArgb(255, 255, 255);
			surroundColors = new Color[1] { Color.FromArgb(255, 255, 255) };
			blend = BlendHelper.Clone(DefaultBlend);
		}

		public DXPathGradientBrush(DXPathGradientBrush brush)
			: base(brush)
		{
			centerColor = brush.centerColor;
			centerPoint = brush.centerPoint;
			pathData = brush.pathData;
			surroundColors = brush.surroundColors;
			blend = BlendHelper.Clone(brush.blend);
			colorBlend = brush.colorBlend;
			FocusScales = brush.FocusScales;
		}

		internal PointF GetActualCenterPoint()
		{
			if (centerPoint.HasValue)
			{
				return centerPoint.Value;
			}
			float num = 0f;
			float num2 = 0f;
			foreach (PointF pathPoint in pathData.PathPoints)
			{
				num += pathPoint.X;
				num2 += pathPoint.Y;
			}
			num /= (float)pathData.PathPoints.Count;
			num2 /= (float)pathData.PathPoints.Count;
			return new PointF(num, num2);
		}

		internal Color GetSurroundingColor(int pointIndex)
		{
			if (surroundColors == null)
			{
				return Color.Transparent;
			}
			return SurroundColors[Math.Min(pointIndex, surroundColors.Length - 1)];
		}

		internal override void Accept(IDXBrushVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override DXBrush Clone()
		{
			return new DXPathGradientBrush(this);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.FinishGeneric<DXGraphicsPathData, Color, PointF?, Color[], DXBlend, DXColorBlend, PointF>(base.GetHashCode(), PathData, CenterColor, CenterPoint, SurroundColors, Blend, InterpolationColors, FocusScales);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return EqualsCore(obj as DXPathGradientBrush);
		}

		protected override bool EqualsCore(DXBrush otherBase)
		{
			if (otherBase is DXPathGradientBrush dXPathGradientBrush && base.EqualsCore((DXBrush)dXPathGradientBrush) && PathData.Equals(dXPathGradientBrush.PathData) && CenterColor == dXPathGradientBrush.CenterColor)
			{
				PointF? pointF = CenterPoint;
				PointF? pointF2 = dXPathGradientBrush.CenterPoint;
				if (pointF.HasValue == pointF2.HasValue && (!pointF.HasValue || pointF.GetValueOrDefault() == pointF2.GetValueOrDefault()) && SurroundColors == dXPathGradientBrush.SurroundColors && Blend == dXPathGradientBrush.Blend && InterpolationColors == dXPathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors)
				{
					return FocusScales == dXPathGradientBrush.FocusScales;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public enum DXPathPointType : byte
	{
		Start = 0,
		Line = 1,
		Bezier = 3,
		PathTypeMask = 7,
		CloseSubpath = 128
	}
	public enum DXDashCap
	{
		Flat,
		Square,
		Round,
		Triangle
	}
	public class DXPen : IEquatable<DXPen>, IDisposable
	{
		internal static readonly IDictionary<DXDashStyle, float[]> DashPatterns;

		private DXPenAlignment alignment;

		private DXBrush brush;

		private float width;

		private DXLineCap startCap;

		private DXLineCap endCap;

		private DXCustomLineCapBase customStartCap;

		private DXCustomLineCapBase customEndCap;

		private float miterLimit = 10f;

		private DXDashCap dashCap;

		private DXDashStyle dashStyle;

		private float dashOffset;

		private float[] dashPattern;

		private DXLineJoin lineJoin;

		private float[] compoundArray;

		private DXMatrix transform = new DXMatrix();

		internal bool IsLineJoinInvisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Width <= 2f)
				{
					return dashStyle == DXDashStyle.Solid;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal DXPenAlignment Alignment
		{
			get
			{
				return alignment;
			}
			set
			{
				alignment = value;
			}
		}

		public float Width
		{
			get
			{
				return width;
			}
			set
			{
				width = value;
			}
		}

		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				if (Brush is DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush)
				{
					return dXSolidBrush.Color;
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			set
			{
				Brush = new DXSolidBrush(value);
			}
		}

		public DXBrush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return brush;
			}
			set
			{
				brush = value;
			}
		}

		public DXLineCap StartCap
		{
			get
			{
				return startCap;
			}
			set
			{
				startCap = value;
			}
		}

		public DXLineCap EndCap
		{
			get
			{
				return endCap;
			}
			set
			{
				endCap = value;
			}
		}

		public float MiterLimit
		{
			get
			{
				return miterLimit;
			}
			set
			{
				miterLimit = value;
			}
		}

		public DXDashCap DashCap
		{
			get
			{
				return dashCap;
			}
			set
			{
				dashCap = value;
			}
		}

		public DXDashStyle DashStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return dashStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != DXDashStyle.Custom && value != DXDashStyle.Solid)
				{
					dashPattern = DashPatterns[value];
				}
				dashStyle = value;
			}
		}

		public float DashOffset
		{
			get
			{
				return dashOffset;
			}
			set
			{
				dashOffset = value;
			}
		}

		public float[] DashPattern
		{
			get
			{
				if (dashStyle != DXDashStyle.Solid)
				{
					return dashPattern;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				dashStyle = DXDashStyle.Custom;
				dashPattern = value;
			}
		}

		public DXLineJoin LineJoin
		{
			get
			{
				return lineJoin;
			}
			set
			{
				lineJoin = value;
			}
		}

		public DXCustomLineCapBase CustomStartCap
		{
			get
			{
				return customStartCap;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					StartCap = DXLineCap.Custom;
				}
				customStartCap = value;
			}
		}

		public DXCustomLineCapBase CustomEndCap
		{
			get
			{
				return customEndCap;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					EndCap = DXLineCap.Custom;
				}
				customEndCap = value;
			}
		}

		internal float[] CompoundArray
		{
			get
			{
				return compoundArray;
			}
			set
			{
				compoundArray = value;
			}
		}

		internal DXMatrix Transform
		{
			get
			{
				return transform;
			}
			set
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "transform");
				transform = value;
			}
		}

		public DXPenType PenType
		{
			get
			{
				if (brush is DXSolidBrush)
				{
					return DXPenType.SolidColor;
				}
				if (brush is DXLinearGradientBrush)
				{
					return DXPenType.LinearGradient;
				}
				if (brush is DXPathGradientBrush)
				{
					return DXPenType.PathGradient;
				}
				if (brush is DXTextureBrush)
				{
					return DXPenType.TextureFill;
				}
				if (brush is DXHatchBrush)
				{
					return DXPenType.HatchFill;
				}
				return DXPenType.SolidColor;
			}
		}

		static DXPen()
		{
			DashPatterns = new Dictionary<DXDashStyle, float[]>
			{
				{
					DXDashStyle.Dot,
					new float[2] { 1f, 1f }
				},
				{
					DXDashStyle.DashDotDot,
					new float[6] { 3f, 1f, 1f, 1f, 1f, 1f }
				},
				{
					DXDashStyle.DashDot,
					new float[4] { 3f, 1f, 1f, 1f }
				},
				{
					DXDashStyle.Dash,
					new float[2] { 3f, 1f }
				}
			};
		}

		public DXPen(Color color)
			: this(color, 1f)
		{
		}

		public DXPen(Color color, float width)
			: this(new DXSolidBrush(color), width)
		{
		}

		public DXPen(DXBrush brush)
			: this(brush, 1f)
		{
		}

		public DXPen(DXBrush brush, float width)
		{
			this.brush = brush;
			this.width = ((width < 0f) ? 0f : width);
		}

		public DXPen(Color color, float thickness, DXLineCap lineCap)
			: this(color, thickness)
		{
			StartCap = lineCap;
			EndCap = lineCap;
		}

		internal void MultiplyTransform(DXMatrix matrix, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			Transform = Transform.Clone();
			Transform.Multiply(matrix, order);
		}

		internal void ResetTransform()
		{
			Transform = new DXMatrix();
		}

		internal void RotateTransform(float angle, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			Transform = Transform.Clone();
			Transform.Rotate(angle, order);
		}

		internal void ScaleTransform(float sx, float sy, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			Transform = Transform.Clone();
			Transform.Scale(sx, sy, order);
		}

		internal void TranslateTransform(float dx, float dy, DXMatrixOrder order = DXMatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			Transform = Transform.Clone();
			Transform.Translate(dx, dy, order);
		}

		public DXPen Clone()
		{
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(brush, width);
			dXPen.Alignment = Alignment;
			dXPen.StartCap = StartCap;
			dXPen.EndCap = EndCap;
			dXPen.LineJoin = LineJoin;
			dXPen.DashCap = dashCap;
			dXPen.MiterLimit = MiterLimit;
			dXPen.CompoundArray = CompoundArray;
			dXPen.Transform = Transform.Clone();
			dXPen.dashStyle = DashStyle;
			dXPen.dashPattern = DashPattern;
			dXPen.dashOffset = DashOffset;
			dXPen.customStartCap = CustomStartCap;
			dXPen.customEndCap = CustomEndCap;
			return dXPen;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, float, int, int, int, int, float, int, int, float, int?, int?, float[], float[], int>(Brush.GetHashCode(), Width, (int)Alignment, (int)StartCap, (int)EndCap, (int)DashStyle, DashOffset, (int)LineJoin, (int)DashCap, MiterLimit, CustomStartCap?.GetHashCode(), CustomEndCap?.GetHashCode(), DashPattern, CompoundArray, transform.GetHashCode());
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as DXPen);
		}

		public bool Equals(DXPen other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Brush.Equals(other.Brush) && Width == other.Width && Alignment == other.Alignment && StartCap == other.StartCap && EndCap == other.EndCap && DashStyle == other.DashStyle && DashOffset == other.DashOffset && LineJoin == other.LineJoin && DashCap == other.DashCap && MiterLimit == other.MiterLimit && CustomStartCap == other.CustomStartCap && CustomEndCap == other.CustomEndCap && ArrayHelper.ArraysEqual<float>((IList<float>)DashPattern, (IList<float>)other.DashPattern) && ArrayHelper.ArraysEqual<float>((IList<float>)CompoundArray, (IList<float>)other.CompoundArray))
			{
				return Transform.Equals(other.Transform);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (brush != null)
			{
				brush.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class DXSolidBrush : DXBrush
	{
		private Color color;

		public Color Color
		{
			get
			{
				return color;
			}
			set
			{
				color = value;
			}
		}

		public DXSolidBrush(Color color)
		{
			this.color = color;
		}

		private DXSolidBrush(DXSolidBrush brush)
			: this(brush.color)
		{
		}

		internal override void Accept(IDXBrushVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override DXBrush Clone()
		{
			return new DXSolidBrush(this);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<Color>(Color);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return EqualsCore(obj as DXSolidBrush);
		}

		protected override bool EqualsCore(DXBrush otherBase)
		{
			if (otherBase is DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush)
			{
				return Color == dXSolidBrush.Color;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class DXStringFormat : IEquatable<DXStringFormat>
	{
		internal const DXStringFormatFlags DefaultFormatFlags = (DXStringFormatFlags)0;

		internal const DXStringAlignment DefaultAlignment = DXStringAlignment.Near;

		internal const DXStringAlignment DefaultLineAlignment = DXStringAlignment.Near;

		internal const DXStringTrimming DefaultTrimming = DXStringTrimming.Character;

		internal const DXHotkeyPrefix DefaultHotkeyPrefix = DXHotkeyPrefix.None;

		internal const DXStringFormatPrototypeKind DefaultStringFormatPrototypeKind = DXStringFormatPrototypeKind.GenericDefault;

		private float[] tabStops;

		public DXStringFormatFlags FormatFlags { get; set; }

		public DXStringAlignment Alignment { get; set; }

		public DXStringAlignment LineAlignment { get; set; }

		public DXStringTrimming Trimming { get; set; } = DXStringTrimming.Character;

		public DXHotkeyPrefix HotkeyPrefix { get; set; }

		public float[] TabStops
		{
			get
			{
				return tabStops;
			}
			set
			{
				if (tabStops == null || !ArrayHelper.ArraysEqual<float>((IList<float>)tabStops, (IList<float>)value))
				{
					tabStops = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal DXStringFormatPrototypeKind PrototypeKind { get; private set; }

		internal float LeadingMarginFactor { get; set; } = 1f / 6f;

		internal float TrailingMarginFactor { get; set; } = 1f / 6f;

		public static implicit operator StringFormat(DXStringFormat stringFormat)
		{
			return SystemDrawingConverter.CreateStringFormat(stringFormat);
		}

		internal static DXStringFormat Create(DXStringFormatPrototypeKind prototypeKind)
		{
			if (prototypeKind != DXStringFormatPrototypeKind.GenericDefault && prototypeKind == DXStringFormatPrototypeKind.GenericTypographic)
			{
				return CreateGenericTypographic();
			}
			return CreateGenericDefault();
		}

		public static DXStringFormat CreateGenericDefault()
		{
			return new DXStringFormat
			{
				PrototypeKind = DXStringFormatPrototypeKind.GenericDefault
			};
		}

		public static DXStringFormat CreateGenericTypographic()
		{
			return new DXStringFormat(0f, 0f)
			{
				PrototypeKind = DXStringFormatPrototypeKind.GenericTypographic,
				Trimming = DXStringTrimming.None,
				FormatFlags = (DXStringFormatFlags.FitBlackBox | DXStringFormatFlags.LineLimit | DXStringFormatFlags.NoClip)
			};
		}

		private DXStringFormat(float leadingMarginFactor, float trailingMarginFactor)
		{
			LeadingMarginFactor = leadingMarginFactor;
			TrailingMarginFactor = trailingMarginFactor;
		}

		public DXStringFormat()
		{
		}

		public DXStringFormat(DXStringFormat format)
		{
			LeadingMarginFactor = format.LeadingMarginFactor;
			TrailingMarginFactor = format.TrailingMarginFactor;
			FormatFlags = format.FormatFlags;
			Alignment = format.Alignment;
			LineAlignment = format.LineAlignment;
			Trimming = format.Trimming;
			HotkeyPrefix = format.HotkeyPrefix;
			PrototypeKind = format.PrototypeKind;
			TabStops = format.TabStops;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.Calculate((int)Alignment, (int)LineAlignment, (int)FormatFlags, (int)HotkeyPrefix, (int)Trimming, (int)PrototypeKind);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as DXStringFormat);
		}

		public bool Equals(DXStringFormat other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Alignment == other.Alignment && LineAlignment == other.LineAlignment && FormatFlags == other.FormatFlags && HotkeyPrefix == other.HotkeyPrefix && Trimming == other.Trimming)
			{
				return PrototypeKind == other.PrototypeKind;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DXStringFormat Clone()
		{
			return new DXStringFormat(this);
		}
	}
	public class DXTextureBrush : DXTilingBrush
	{
		private readonly DXImage image;

		public DXImage Image => image;

		internal DXTextureBrush(DXImage image, DXWrapMode wrapMode, DXImageAttributes imageAttributes)
			: base(wrapMode)
		{
			this.image = ((imageAttributes != null) ? ApplyImageAttributes(image, imageAttributes) : image.Clone());
		}

		public DXTextureBrush(DXImage image, DXWrapMode wrapMode)
			: this(image, wrapMode, null)
		{
		}

		private DXTextureBrush(DXTextureBrush brush)
			: base(brush)
		{
			image = brush.image.Clone();
		}

		private static DXImage ApplyImageAttributes(DXImage image, DXImageAttributes imageAttributes)
		{
			DXImage dXImage;
			if (image.Implementation is GdiPlusBitmap)
			{
				GdiPlusBitmap gdiPlusBitmap = new GdiPlusBitmap(new Bitmap(image.Width, image.Height));
				gdiPlusBitmap.SetResolution(image.HorizontalResolution, image.VerticalResolution);
				dXImage = new DXBitmap(gdiPlusBitmap);
			}
			else
			{
				dXImage = image.Clone();
			}
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXImage.CreateGraphics();
			iDXGraphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
			iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, new RectangleF(0f, 0f, image.Width, image.Height), new RectangleF(0f, 0f, image.Width, image.Height), DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
			return dXImage;
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			image.Dispose();
		}

		internal override void Accept(IDXBrushVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}

		public override DXBrush Clone()
		{
			return new DXTextureBrush(this);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.FinishGeneric<DXImage>(base.GetHashCode(), Image);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return EqualsCore(obj as DXTextureBrush);
		}

		protected override bool EqualsCore(DXBrush otherBase)
		{
			if (otherBase is DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush && base.EqualsCore((DXBrush)dXTextureBrush))
			{
				return Image == dXTextureBrush.Image;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DXTilingBrush : DXBrush
	{
		private DXWrapMode wrapMode;

		private DXMatrix transform;

		public DXMatrix Transform
		{
			get
			{
				return transform;
			}
			set
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "transform");
				transform = value;
			}
		}

		public DXWrapMode WrapMode
		{
			get
			{
				return wrapMode;
			}
			set
			{
				wrapMode = value;
			}
		}

		protected DXTilingBrush(DXWrapMode wrapMode)
			: this(wrapMode, new DXMatrix())
		{
		}

		protected DXTilingBrush(DXTilingBrush brush)
			: this(brush.wrapMode, brush.transform.Clone())
		{
		}

		protected DXTilingBrush(DXWrapMode wrapMode, DXMatrix transform)
		{
			this.wrapMode = wrapMode;
			this.transform = transform;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<DXMatrix, int>(Transform, (int)WrapMode);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return EqualsCore(obj as DXTilingBrush);
		}

		protected override bool EqualsCore(DXBrush otherBase)
		{
			if (otherBase is DXTilingBrush dXTilingBrush && WrapMode == dXTilingBrush.WrapMode)
			{
				return Transform.Equals(dXTilingBrush.Transform);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(DXImageFormatConverter))]
	public sealed class DXImageFormat
	{
		private static readonly DXImageFormat jpeg = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat tiff = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat bmp = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat png = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat gif = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat emf = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat wmf = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat icon = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat svg = new DXImageFormat();

		private static readonly DXImageFormat unknown = new DXImageFormat();

		[Description("Gets the Joint Photographic Experts Group (JPEG) image format.")]
		public static DXImageFormat Jpeg => jpeg;

		[Description("Gets the Tagged Image File Format (TIFF) image format.")]
		public static DXImageFormat Tiff => tiff;

		[Description("Gets the bitmap (BMP) image format.")]
		public static DXImageFormat Bmp => bmp;

		[Description("Gets the W3C Portable Network Graphics (PNG) image format.")]
		public static DXImageFormat Png => png;

		[Description("Gets the Graphics Interchange Format (GIF) image format.")]
		public static DXImageFormat Gif => gif;

		[Description("Gets the enhanced metafile (EMF) image format. Currently not supported.")]
		public static DXImageFormat Emf => emf;

		[Description("Gets the Windows metafile (WMF) image format. Currently not supported.")]
		public static DXImageFormat Wmf => wmf;

		[Description("Gets the Windows icon (.ico) image format.")]
		public static DXImageFormat Icon => icon;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Description("")]
		public static DXImageFormat Svg => svg;

		[Description("Gets the unknown image format.")]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static DXImageFormat Unknown => unknown;

		public static implicit operator DXImageFormat(ImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			return DXImageHelper.ToDXImageFormat(imageFormat);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (this == Jpeg)
			{
				return "Jpeg";
			}
			if (this == Tiff)
			{
				return "Tiff";
			}
			if (this == Bmp)
			{
				return "Bmp";
			}
			if (this == Png)
			{
				return "Png";
			}
			if (this == Gif)
			{
				return "Gif";
			}
			if (this == Emf)
			{
				return "Emf";
			}
			if (this == Wmf)
			{
				return "Wmf";
			}
			if (this == Icon)
			{
				return "Icon";
			}
			if (this == Svg)
			{
				return "Svg";
			}
			return "[DXImageFormat: " + GetType().Name + "]";
		}
	}
	public class DXRegion : IDisposable
	{
		protected internal IDXRegion Implementation { get; }

		public DXRegion()
		{
			Implementation = DXDrawingEngine.CreateRegion();
		}

		public DXRegion(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			Implementation = DXDrawingEngine.CreateRegion(rectangle);
		}

		public DXRegion(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Implementation = DXDrawingEngine.CreateRegion(path);
		}

		internal DXRegion(IDXRegion implementation)
		{
			Implementation = implementation;
		}

		internal DXRegion(DXRegionDataNode data)
		{
			Implementation = DXDrawingEngine.CreateRegion(data);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Implementation.Dispose();
		}

		public void Intersect(DXRegion right)
		{
			Implementation.Intersect(right.Implementation);
		}

		public void Intersect(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Implementation.Intersect(path);
		}

		public void Intersect(RectangleF rect)
		{
			Implementation.Intersect(rect);
		}

		public void Union(DXRegion right)
		{
			Implementation.Union(right.Implementation);
		}

		public void Union(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Implementation.Union(path);
		}

		public void Union(RectangleF rect)
		{
			Implementation.Union(rect);
		}

		public void Xor(DXRegion right)
		{
			Implementation.Xor(right.Implementation);
		}

		public void Xor(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Implementation.Xor(path);
		}

		public void Xor(RectangleF rect)
		{
			Implementation.Xor(rect);
		}

		public void Exclude(DXRegion right)
		{
			Implementation.Exclude(right.Implementation);
		}

		public void Exclude(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Implementation.Exclude(path);
		}

		public void Exclude(RectangleF rect)
		{
			Implementation.Exclude(rect);
		}

		public void Complement(DXRegion right)
		{
			Implementation.Complement(right.Implementation);
		}

		public void Complement(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			Implementation.Complement(path);
		}

		public void Complement(RectangleF rect)
		{
			Implementation.Complement(rect);
		}

		public void MakeEmpty()
		{
			Implementation.MakeEmpty();
		}

		public void MakeInfinite()
		{
			Implementation.MakeInfinite();
		}

		public RectangleF GetBounds()
		{
			return Implementation.GetBounds();
		}

		public bool IsVisible(PointF point)
		{
			return Implementation.IsVisible(point);
		}

		public bool IsVisible(Rectangle rect)
		{
			return Implementation.IsVisible(rect);
		}

		public DXRegion Clone()
		{
			return new DXRegion(Implementation.Clone());
		}

		public void Transform(DXMatrix transform)
		{
			Implementation.Transform(transform);
		}

		internal DXRegionDataNode GetData()
		{
			return Implementation.GetData();
		}

	public static class DXGraphicsUnitConverter
	{
		private static double GetScale(float fromDpi, float toDpi)
		{
			return (double)toDpi / (double)fromDpi;
		}

		private static int Conv(int val, double scale)
		{
			return System.Convert.ToInt32((double)val * scale);
		}

		private static float ConvF(float val, double scale)
		{
			return (float)((double)val * scale) + 0f;
		}

		public static int Convert(int val, float fromDpi, float toDpi)
		{
			if (fromDpi == toDpi)
			{
				return val;
			}
			double scale = GetScale(fromDpi, toDpi);
			return Conv(val, scale);
		}

		public static float Convert(float val, float fromDpi, float toDpi)
		{
			if (fromDpi == toDpi)
			{
				return val;
			}
			double scale = GetScale(fromDpi, toDpi);
			return ConvF(val, scale);
		}

		public static float Convert(float val, DXGraphicsUnit fromUnit, DXGraphicsUnit toUnit)
		{
			return Convert(val, DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(fromUnit), DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(toUnit));
		}

		public static Size Convert(Size size, float fromDpi, float toDpi)
		{
			if (fromDpi == toDpi)
			{
				return size;
			}
			double scale = GetScale(fromDpi, toDpi);
			return new Size(Conv(size.Width, scale), Conv(size.Height, scale));
		}

		public static SizeF Convert(SizeF size, float fromDpi, float toDpi)
		{
			if (fromDpi == toDpi)
			{
				return size;
			}
			double scale = GetScale(fromDpi, toDpi);
			return new SizeF(ConvF(size.Width, scale), ConvF(size.Height, scale));
		}

		public static SizeF Convert(SizeF size, DXGraphicsUnit fromUnit, DXGraphicsUnit toUnit)
		{
			return Convert(size, DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(fromUnit), DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(toUnit));
		}

		public static DXMargins Convert(DXMargins margins, float fromDpi, float toDpi)
		{
			if (fromDpi == toDpi)
			{
				return margins;
			}
			double scale = GetScale(fromDpi, toDpi);
			DXMargins dXMargins = new DXMargins();
			dXMargins.Left = ConvF(margins.Left, scale);
			dXMargins.Right = ConvF(margins.Right, scale);
			dXMargins.Top = ConvF(margins.Top, scale);
			dXMargins.Bottom = ConvF(margins.Bottom, scale);
			return dXMargins;
		}

		internal static MarginsF Convert(MarginsF val, float fromDpi, float toDpi)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (fromDpi == toDpi)
			{
				return val;
			}
			double scale = GetScale(fromDpi, toDpi);
			MarginsF val2 = new MarginsF();
			((MarginsFBase)val2).Left = ConvF(((MarginsFBase)val).Left, scale);
			((MarginsFBase)val2).Right = ConvF(((MarginsFBase)val).Right, scale);
			((MarginsFBase)val2).Top = ConvF(((MarginsFBase)val).Top, scale);
			((MarginsFBase)val2).Bottom = ConvF(((MarginsFBase)val).Bottom, scale);
			return val2;
		}

		internal static MarginsF Convert(MarginsF margins, DXGraphicsUnit fromUnit, DXGraphicsUnit toUnit)
		{
			return Convert(margins, DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(fromUnit), DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(toUnit));
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Design
{
	public class DXImageTypeConverter : LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (sourceType == typeof(string))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (sourceType == typeof(byte[]))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((TypeConverter)this).CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(byte[]))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value is string s)
			{
				byte[] buffer = Convert.FromBase64String(s);
				return DXImageHelper.ImageFromBytes(buffer);
			}
			if (value is byte[] buffer2)
			{
				return DXImageHelper.ImageFromBytes(buffer2);
			}
			return ((TypeConverter)this).ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
			}
			DXImage dXImage = value as DXImage;
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				if (dXImage == null)
				{
					return "(none)";
				}
				if (context == null)
				{
					byte[] imageBytes = DXImageHelper.GetImageBytes(dXImage);
					return Convert.ToBase64String(imageBytes);
				}
				return value.GetType().FullName;
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && dXImage != null)
			{
				Type[] types = new Type[1] { typeof(string) };
				string[] arguments = new string[1] { Convert.ToBase64String(DXImageHelper.GetImageBytes(dXImage)) };
				MemberInfo method = typeof(DXImage).GetMethod("FromBase64String", types);
				return new InstanceDescriptor(method, arguments);
			}
			if (destinationType == typeof(byte[]))
			{
				if (dXImage != null)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					MemoryStream memoryStream = null;
					DXImage dXImage2 = null;
					try
					{
						memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
						dXImage2 = dXImage;
						if (dXImage2.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Icon)
						{
							flag = true;
							dXImage2 = new DXBitmap(dXImage2, dXImage2.Width, dXImage2.Height);
						}
						dXImage2.Save(memoryStream);
					}
					finally
					{
						memoryStream?.Close();
						if (flag)
						{
							dXImage2?.Dispose();
						}
					}
					return memoryStream?.ToArray();
				}
				return new byte[0];
			}
			return ((LocalizableExpandableObjectTypeConverter)this).ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
		}
	}
}

	public static class DXImageExtensions
	{
		public static Image ConvertToGdiPlusImage(this DXImage image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (image.Implementation is GdiPlusImage gdiPlusImage)
			{
				return gdiPlusImage.Unwrap(cloneImage: true);
			}
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			image.Save(memoryStream, image.ImageFormat);
			memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			return Image.FromStream(memoryStream, useEmbeddedColorManagement: true, validateImageData: false);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static object GetNativeImage(this DXImage image)
		{
			return image?.Implementation?.NativeImage;
		}
	}

		public static bool TryDrawAsEmfMetafile(this IDXGraphics graphics, DXImage image, int x, int y)

			DXMetafile dXMetafile = image as DXMetafile;
			if (DXImageHelper.IsEmfMetafile(dXMetafile))

				GdiPlusTransformEmulation gdiPlusTransformEmulation = GdiPlusTransformEmulation.FromGraphics(graphics);
				SizeF imageSizeInPageUnits = gdiPlusTransformEmulation.GetImageSizeInPageUnits(image);
				DrawEmfMetafile(dstRect: new RectangleF(x, y, imageSizeInPageUnits.Width, imageSizeInPageUnits.Height), graphics: graphics, metafileModel: (EmfMetafileModel)dXMetafile.NativeImage, srcRect: dXMetafile.Header.Bounds);

		{

		}

		public static bool TryDrawSvgImage(this IDXGraphics graphics, DXImage image, RectangleF dstRect)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (image is DXSvgImage dXSvgImage)
			{
				DrawSvgImage(graphics, (SvgImage)dXSvgImage.NativeImage, dstRect, new RectangleF(PointF.Empty, image.Size));
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryDrawSvgImage(this IDXGraphics graphics, DXImage image, RectangleF dstRect, RectangleF srcRect)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (image is DXSvgImage dXSvgImage)
			{
				DrawSvgImage(graphics, (SvgImage)dXSvgImage.NativeImage, dstRect, srcRect);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryDrawSvgImage(this IDXGraphics graphics, DXImage image, RectangleF dstRect, RectangleF srcRect, DXImageAttributes imageAtt)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (image is DXSvgImage dXSvgImage)
			{
				DrawSvgImage(graphics, (SvgImage)dXSvgImage.NativeImage, dstRect, srcRect, imageAtt);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void DrawSvgImage(IDXGraphics graphics, SvgImage svgImage, RectangleF dstRect, RectangleF srcRect, DXImageAttributes imageAtt = null)
		{
			if (svgImage.Width == 0.0 || svgImage.Height == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			object state = graphics.Save();
			try
			{
				graphics.PixelOffsetMode = DXPixelOffsetMode.Half;
				DXMatrix matrix = DXMatrix.CreateWarpMatrix(srcRect, dstRect);
				graphics.MultiplyTransform(matrix);
				graphics.SetClip(srcRect, DXClipCombineMode.Intersect);
				if (imageAtt != null)
				{
					using (DXModifiedGraphics graphics2 = new DXModifiedGraphics(graphics, new DXGraphicsColorModifier(imageAtt.ColorMatrix, imageAtt.RemapTable)))
					{
						DrawSvgImageCore(graphics2, svgImage);
						return;
					}
				}
				DrawSvgImageCore(graphics, svgImage);
			}
			finally
			{
				graphics.Restore(state);
			}
		}

		private static void DrawSvgImageCore(IDXGraphics graphics, SvgImage svgImage)
		{
			SvgBitmap svgBitmap = SvgBitmap.Create(svgImage);
			lock (svgImage)
			{
				svgBitmap.RenderToDXGraphics(graphics, null, 1.0, (DefaultBoolean)2);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class EmfGraphics : IDXGraphics, IDisposable
	{

		private readonly EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord currentWritingRecord;

		private readonly DXGraphicsStateHandler stateHandler;

		private IDXMeasurer measurer;

		private readonly Stack<object> states = new Stack<object>();

		private const byte brushObjecId = 0;

		private const byte penObjectId = 1;

		private const byte pathObjecId = 2;

		private const byte regionObjecId = 3;

		private const byte imageObjecId = 4;

		private const byte fontObjecId = 5;

		private const byte imageAttributesObjecId = 7;

		internal EmfGraphics(EmfMetafileModel metafileModel)
		{
			if (!IsValidEmfPlus(metafileModel))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Only EMF+ metafiles are supported.");
			}
			this.metafileModel = metafileModel;
			stateHandler = new DXGraphicsStateHandler(metafileModel.Header.DpiX, metafileModel.Header.DpiY);
			currentWritingRecord = CreateWritingRecord(metafileModel);
		}

		private static EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord CreateWritingRecord(EmfMetafileModel metafile)
		{
			EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord emfCommentEmfPlusRecord = metafile.Records[metafile.Records.Count - 2] as EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord;
			if (emfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Records.Count > 1)
			{
				emfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Records.RemoveAt(emfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Records.Count - 1);
				emfCommentEmfPlusRecord = new EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord(new EmfPlusRecord[1]
				{
					new EmfPlusEofRecord()
				}, 0);
				metafile.Records.Insert(metafile.Records.Count - 2, emfCommentEmfPlusRecord);
			}
			EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord emfCommentEmfPlusRecord2 = new EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord();
			metafile.Records.Insert(metafile.Records.Count - 2, emfCommentEmfPlusRecord2);
			return emfCommentEmfPlusRecord2;
		}

		private static bool IsValidEmfPlus(EmfMetafileModel metafile)
		{
			if (metafile.Records.Count < 3)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(metafile.Records[0] is EmfMetafileHeaderRecord))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(metafile.Records[1] is EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord emfCommentEmfPlusRecord))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (emfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Records.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(emfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Records[0] is EmfPlusHeaderRecord))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(metafile.Records[metafile.Records.Count - 1] is EmfEofRecord))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(metafile.Records[metafile.Records.Count - 2] is EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord emfCommentEmfPlusRecord2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (emfCommentEmfPlusRecord2.Records.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(emfCommentEmfPlusRecord2.Records[emfCommentEmfPlusRecord2.Records.Count - 1] is EmfPlusEofRecord))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void AddRecord(EmfPlusRecord record)
		{
			currentWritingRecord.Records.Add(record);
		}

		private void AddObjectRecord(EmfPlusObject emfPlusObject, byte objectId)
		{
			AddRecord(new EmfPlusObjectRecord(objectId, emfPlusObject));
		}

		private byte AddPenRecord(DXPen pen)
		{
			EmfPlusPen emfPlusObject = new EmfPlusPen(pen);
			AddObjectRecord(emfPlusObject, 1);
			return 1;
		}

		private EmfPlusBrushOrColor AddBrushRecordIfNeeded(DXBrush brush)
		{
			if (brush is DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush)
			{
				return new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(dXSolidBrush.Color);
			}
			EmfPlusBrush emfPlusObject = new EmfPlusBrush(brush);
			AddObjectRecord(emfPlusObject, 0);
			return new EmfPlusBrushOrColor(0);
		}

		private byte AddPathRecord(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			EmfPlusPath emfPlusObject = new EmfPlusPath(path.GetPathData());
			AddObjectRecord(emfPlusObject, 2);
			return 2;
		}

		{
			EmfPlusRegion emfPlusObject = new EmfPlusRegion(region.GetData());
			AddObjectRecord(emfPlusObject, 3);
			return 3;
		}

		private byte AddImageRecord(DXImage image)
		{
			EmfPlusImage emfPlusObject = new EmfPlusImage(image);
			AddObjectRecord(emfPlusObject, 4);
			return 4;
		}

		{
			EmfPlusFont emfPlusObject = new EmfPlusFont(font.Name, font.Size, ConvertEnum(font.Style), font.Unit);
			AddObjectRecord(emfPlusObject, 5);
			return 5;
		}

		private byte AddStringFormatRecord(DXStringFormat format)
		{
			EmfPlusStringFormat emfPlusObject = new EmfPlusStringFormat(format);
			AddObjectRecord(emfPlusObject, 6);
			return 6;
		}

		public void DrawPolygon(DXPen dxPen, PointF[] points)
		{

		}

		public void DrawImage(DXImage image, RectangleF destRect, RectangleF srcRect, DXGraphicsUnit srcUnit, DXImageAttributes imageAttr)
		{
			if (this.TryDrawSvgImage(image, destRect, srcRect, imageAttr))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (image is DXBitmap)
			{
				using (DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(image.Width, image.Height))
				{
					using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics())
					{
						iDXGraphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
						iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, image.Bounds, image.Bounds, DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttr);
					}
					AddRecord(new EmfPlusDrawImageRecord(AddImageRecord(dXBitmap), destRect, srcRect, srcUnit));
					return;
				}
			}
			AddRecord(new EmfPlusDrawImageRecord(AddImageRecord(image), destRect, srcRect, srcUnit));
		}

		public void DrawGlyphRun(IList<DXCluster> glyphRun, DXFont dxFont, DXBrush dxBrush, PointF point)
		{
			byte fontId = AddFontRecord(dxFont);
			EmfPlusBrushOrColor brushOrColor = AddBrushRecordIfNeeded(dxBrush);
			List<char> list = new List<char>();
			List<PointF> list2 = new List<PointF>();
			PointF pointF = point;
			foreach (DXCluster item in glyphRun)
			{
				foreach (DXGlyph glyph in item.Glyphs)
				{
					list.Add((char)glyph.Index);
					list2.Add(new PointF(pointF.X + glyph.Offset.HorizontalOffset, pointF.Y + glyph.Offset.VerticalOffset));
					pointF = new PointF(pointF.X + glyph.Advance, pointF.Y);
				}
			}
			AddRecord(new EmfPlusDrawDriverStringRecord(fontId, brushOrColor, list.ToArray(), list2.ToArray(), EmfPlusDriverStringOptions.None));
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, float width, DXStringFormat dxStringFormat)
		{
			return MeasureString(text, font, new SizeF(width, 999999f), dxStringFormat);
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, SizeF size, DXStringFormat dxStringFormat)
		{
			bool flag = stateHandler.PageUnit == DXGraphicsUnit.Display;
			DXGraphicsUnit pageUnit = (flag ? DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel : stateHandler.PageUnit);
			SizeF result = Measurer.MeasureString(text, font, size, dxStringFormat, pageUnit);
			float pageScale = PageScale;
			if (pageScale == 1f || flag)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return new SizeF(result.Width / pageScale, result.Height / pageScale);
		}

		public object Save()
		{
			object obj = stateHandler.Save();
			AddRecord(new EmfPlusSaveRecord(states.Count));
			states.Push(obj);
			return obj;
		}

		public void Restore(object state)
		{
			stateHandler.Restore(state);
			while (states.Count > 0)
			{
				object obj = states.Pop();
				if (obj == state)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			AddRecord(new EmfPlusRestoreRecord(states.Count));
		}

		private static EmfPlusCombineMode ConvertEnum(DXClipCombineMode combineMode)
		{
			return combineMode switch
			{
				DXClipCombineMode.Replace => EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeReplace, 
				DXClipCombineMode.Intersect => EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeIntersect, 
				_ => EmfPlusCombineMode.CombineModeReplace, 
			};
		}

		private static EmfPlusFontStyle ConvertEnum(DXFontStyle style)
		{
			EmfPlusFontStyle emfPlusFontStyle = EmfPlusFontStyle.Regular;
			if ((style & DXFontStyle.Bold) != DXFontStyle.Regular)
			{
				emfPlusFontStyle |= EmfPlusFontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if ((style & DXFontStyle.Italic) != DXFontStyle.Regular)
			{
				emfPlusFontStyle |= EmfPlusFontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if ((style & DXFontStyle.Strikeout) != DXFontStyle.Regular)
			{
				emfPlusFontStyle |= EmfPlusFontStyle.Strikeout;
			}
			if ((style & DXFontStyle.Underline) != DXFontStyle.Regular)
			{
				emfPlusFontStyle |= EmfPlusFontStyle.Underline;
			}
			return emfPlusFontStyle;
		}

		private static EmfPlusSmoothingMode ConvertEnum(DXSmoothingMode value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				DXSmoothingMode.Default => EmfPlusSmoothingMode.SmoothingModeDefault, 
				DXSmoothingMode.HighSpeed => EmfPlusSmoothingMode.SmoothingModeHighSpeed, 
				DXSmoothingMode.HighQuality => EmfPlusSmoothingMode.SmoothingModeHighQuality, 
				DXSmoothingMode.None => EmfPlusSmoothingMode.SmoothingModeNone, 
				DXSmoothingMode.AntiAlias => EmfPlusSmoothingMode.SmoothingModeAntiAlias8x4, 
				_ => EmfPlusSmoothingMode.SmoothingModeDefault, 
			};
		}

		private static bool IsAntiAliasSmoothingMode(DXSmoothingMode value)
		{
			if (value == DXSmoothingMode.HighQuality || value == DXSmoothingMode.AntiAlias)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static EmfPlusComposingMode ConvertEnum(DXCompositingMode value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				DXCompositingMode.SourceOver => EmfPlusComposingMode.CompositingModeSourceOver, 
				DXCompositingMode.SourceCopy => EmfPlusComposingMode.CompositingModeSourceCopy, 
				_ => EmfPlusComposingMode.CompositingModeSourceOver, 
			};

				_ => EmfPlusComposingQuality.CompositingQualityDefault,

			return value switch
			{
				DXInterpolationMode.Default => EmfPlusInterpolationMode.InterpolationModeDefault, 
				DXInterpolationMode.Low => EmfPlusInterpolationMode.InterpolationModeLowQuality, 
				DXInterpolationMode.High => EmfPlusInterpolationMode.InterpolationModeHighQuality,

	public class EmfMetafile : IDXMetafile, IDXImage, IDisposable, IEquatable<IDXImage>, IEquatable<IDXMetafile>
	{
		private DXImageProperties imageProperties = new DXImageProperties();

		private readonly EmfMetafileModel parsedMetafile;

		public SizeF PhysicalDimension => Header.FrameDimension;

		public int Width => Header.Bounds.Width;

		public int Height => Header.Bounds.Height;

		public DXImageFormatOptions ImageFormatOptions => DXImageFormatOptions.WindowsMetafile;

		public DXMetafileHeader Header => parsedMetafile.Header;

		public float HorizontalResolution => Header.DpiX;

		public float VerticalResolution => Header.DpiY;

		public int NumberOfFrames => 1;

		public object NativeImage => parsedMetafile;

		public DXImageProperties ImageProperties => imageProperties;

		public static DXMetafile Wrap(EmfMetafileModel metafileModel)
		{
			return new DXMetafile(new EmfMetafile(metafileModel));
		}

		public static EmfMetafile Decode(Stream stream)
		{
			EmfMetafileModel emfMetafileModel = EmfMetafileModel.Create(stream);
			if (emfMetafileModel == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Metafile data cannot be parsed.");
			}
			return new EmfMetafile(emfMetafileModel);
		}

		public static bool TryCreateEmfMetafile(Stream stream, out IDXMetafile emfMetafile)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			long position = stream.Position;
			try
			{
				flag = MetafileHelper.IsEmfMetafile(stream);
			}
			finally
			{
				stream.Position = position;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				emfMetafile = Decode(stream);
				return true;
			}
			emfMetafile = null;
			return false;
		}

		public EmfMetafile(Size size, DXMetafileFrameUnit frameUnit)
			: this(new EmfMetafileModel(size, frameUnit))
		{
		}

		public EmfMetafile(EmfMetafileModel parsedMetafile)
		{
			this.parsedMetafile = parsedMetafile;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			parsedMetafile.Dispose();
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions)
		{
			if (imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Wmf || imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Emf)
			{
				EmfWriter emfWriter = new EmfWriter(parsedMetafile);
				emfWriter.Write(stream);
				return;
			}
			DXMetafile metafile = new DXMetafile(this);
			using DXBitmap dXBitmap = DXBitmapCreator.CreateFromMetafile(metafile, Width, Height);
			dXBitmap.Save(stream, imageFormatOptions);
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			Save(stream, new DXImageFormatOptions(imageFormat));
		}

		public IDXGraphics CreateGraphics()
		{
			return new EmfGraphics(parsedMetafile);
		}

		public EmfMetafileModel ToEmfMetafileModel()
		{
			return parsedMetafile.Clone();
		}

		public IDXMetafile Clone()
		{
			return new EmfMetafile(parsedMetafile.Clone());
		}

		public bool Equals(IDXImage other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}

		public bool Equals(IDXMetafile other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		public void RotateFlip(DXRotateFlipType rotateFlipType)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		public bool IsDisposedOrInvalid()
		{
			return parsedMetafile.IsDisposed;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Svg.Internal

	internal static class DXSvgGraphicsHelper
	{
		public static string ToHtml(this Color color)
		{
			if (color == Color.Empty)
			{
				return "none";
			}
			return DXColor.ToHtml(color).ToLowerInvariant();
		}

		public static SvgStrokeLineJoin ToSvgStrokeLineJoin(this DXLineJoin dxLineJoin)
		{
			return (SvgStrokeLineJoin)(dxLineJoin switch
			{
				DXLineJoin.Bevel => 1, 
				DXLineJoin.Round => 2, 
				_ => 0, 
			});
		}

		public static SvgPoint ToSvgPoint(this Point point)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new SvgPoint((double)point.X, (double)point.Y);
		}

		public static SvgPoint ToSvgPoint(this PointF point)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new SvgPoint((double)point.X, (double)point.Y);
		}

		public static SvgPoint[] ToSvgPoints(this Point[] points)
		{
			return points.Select((Point point) => point.ToSvgPoint()).ToArray();
		}

		public static SvgPoint[] ToSvgPoints(this PointF[] points)
		{
			return points.Select((PointF point) => point.ToSvgPoint()).ToArray();
		}

		public static SvgFontWeight ToSvgFontWeight(this DXFont dxFont)
		{
			if (dxFont.Bold)
			{
				return (SvgFontWeight)64;
			}
			return (SvgFontWeight)8;
		}

		public static SvgFontStyle ToSvgFontStyle(this DXFont dxFont)
		{
			if (dxFont.Italic)
			{
				return (SvgFontStyle)4;
			}
			return (SvgFontStyle)1;
		}

		public static SvgMatrix ToSvgMatrix(this DXMatrix dxMatrix)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new SvgMatrix(((IEnumerable<float>)dxMatrix.Elements).Select((Func<float, double>)((float value) => value)).ToArray());
		}

		public static string ToId(this Uri uri)
		{
			string text = uri.ToString();
			if (text.StartsWith("url("))
			{
				text = text.Substring(4).TrimEnd(')');
			}
			if (text.StartsWith("#", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				text = text.Substring(1);
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
	internal static class DXSvgImageHelper
	{
		public static bool IsSvgImage(Stream stream)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			long position = stream.Position;
			try
			{
				using StreamReader streamReader = new StreamReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8, detectEncodingFromByteOrderMarks: true, 1024, leaveOpen: true);
				char[] array = new char[1024];
				int length = streamReader.ReadBlock(array, 0, array.Length);
				string input = new string(array, 0, length);
				RegexOptions options = RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.CultureInvariant;
				flag |= Regex.Match(input, "<svg\\s", options).Success;
				flag &= Regex.Match(input, "\\sxmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"", options).Success;
			}
			catch
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				stream.Position = position;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public static IDXSvgImage CreateImage(Stream stream)
		{
			return new SvgImageWrapper(SvgLoader.LoadFromStream(stream));
		}

		public static IDXSvgImage CreateImage(SizeF size)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SvgUnit val = new SvgUnit(0.0);
			SvgUnit val2 = new SvgUnit(0.0);
			SvgUnit val3 = new SvgUnit((double)size.Width);
			SvgUnit val4 = new SvgUnit((double)size.Height);
			SvgViewBox val5 = new SvgViewBox(0.0, 0.0, (double)size.Width, (double)size.Height);
			SvgRoot val6 = SvgRoot.Create(new SvgElementProperties(), val, val2, val3, val4, val5);
			return new SvgImageWrapper(SvgImage.Create(val6));
		}
	}
	internal class SvgImageWrapper : IDXSvgImage, IDXImage, IDisposable, IEquatable<IDXImage>, IEquatable<IDXSvgImage>
	{
		private readonly SvgImage svgImage;

		private readonly SvgBitmap svgBitmap;

		private readonly DXImageProperties imageProperties = new DXImageProperties();

		internal IEnumerable<SvgElementWrapper> RootElements => svgBitmap.RootElements;

		internal SvgRoot SvgRoot => svgImage.Root;

		public int Width => (int)svgImage.Width;

		public int Height => (int)svgImage.Height;

		public DXImageFormatOptions ImageFormatOptions => DXImageFormatOptions.Svg;

		public DXImageProperties ImageProperties => imageProperties;

		public int NumberOfFrames => 1;

		public object NativeImage => svgImage;

		public float HorizontalResolution => 96f;

		public float VerticalResolution => 96f;

		public SizeF PhysicalDimension => new SizeF(Width, Height);

		public static DXSvgImage Wrap(SvgImage svgImage)
		{
			return new DXSvgImage(new SvgImageWrapper(svgImage));
		}

		private static byte[] GetImageBytes(SvgImage image)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			SvgSerializer.SaveSvgImageToXML((Stream)memoryStream, image);
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		internal SvgImageWrapper(SvgImage svgImage)
		{
			this.svgImage = svgImage;
			svgBitmap = new SvgBitmap(svgImage);
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions)
		{
			if (imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Svg)
			{
				svgImage.Save(stream);
				return;
			}
			if (imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Emf)
			{
				using (DXMetafile dXMetafile = new DXMetafile(new Size(Width, Height), DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel, DXEmfType.EmfOnly))
				{
					using (IDXGraphics g = dXMetafile.CreateGraphics())
					{
						svgBitmap.RenderToDXGraphics(g, null, 1.0, (DefaultBoolean)2);
					}
					dXMetafile.Save(stream, imageFormatOptions);

				}
			}
			using DXImage dXImage = svgBitmap.RenderDXImage(new Size(Width, Height));
			dXImage.Save(stream, imageFormatOptions);
		}

		private static SvgPathSegmentCollection CalculateSvgPathSegmentCollection(DXGraphicsPath dxPath)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ec: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0110: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SvgPathSegmentCollection val = new SvgPathSegmentCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < dxPath.PointCount; i++)
			{
				if ((dxPath.PathTypes[i] & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == 0)
				{
					val.Add((SvgPathSegment)new SvgPathMoveToSegment(dxPath.PathPoints[i].ToSvgPoint()));
				}
				else if ((dxPath.PathTypes[i] & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Line)
				{
					val.Add((SvgPathSegment)new SvgPathLineToSegment(dxPath.PathPoints[i - 1].ToSvgPoint(), dxPath.PathPoints[i].ToSvgPoint()));
				}
				else if ((dxPath.PathTypes[i] & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Bezier)
				{
					val.Add((SvgPathSegment)new SvgPathCurveToCubicSegment(dxPath.PathPoints[i - 1].ToSvgPoint(), dxPath.PathPoints[i].ToSvgPoint(), dxPath.PathPoints[++i].ToSvgPoint(), dxPath.PathPoints[++i].ToSvgPoint()));
				}
				if (dxPath.PathTypes[i].HasFlag(DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath))

		private static SvgPathArcSegment CalculateSvgPathArcSegment(RectangleF rect, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			//IL_00e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		private void Initialize(List<SvgElement> elements)
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			currentElement = (SvgElement)(object)root;
			PageUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;
			foreach (SvgElement element in elements)
			{
				if (defs == null && element is SvgDefinitions)
				{
					defs = (SvgDefinitions)element;
				}
				PrepareExistingElementId(element);
			}
		}

		private void PrepareExistingElementId(SvgElement element)
		{
			if (element.Id == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			elementIds.Add(element.Id, element);
			string tag = GetTag(element);
			if (element.Id.Length > tag.Length && int.TryParse(element.Id.Substring(tag.Length), out var result))
			{
				if (elementIdCounter.ContainsKey(tag))
				{
					elementIdCounter[tag] = result;
				}
				else
				{
					elementIdCounter[tag] = Math.Max(elementIdCounter[tag], result);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RegisterElementId(SvgElement element)
		{
			string tag = GetTag(element);
			if (!elementIdCounter.ContainsKey(tag))
			{
				elementIdCounter[tag] = 0;
			}
			element.Id = tag + elementIdCounter[tag];
			elementIdCounter[tag]++;
		}

		}

	public class DXPaperSize
	{
		private DXPaperKind kind;

		private string name;

		private int width;

		private int height;

		private bool createdByDefaultConstructor;

		public int Height
		{
			get
			{
				return height;
			}
			set
			{
				if (kind != DXPaperKind.Custom && !createdByDefaultConstructor)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				height = value;
			}
		}

		public DXPaperKind Kind
		{
			get
			{
				if (kind <= DXPaperKind.PrcEnvelopeNumber10Rotated && kind != (DXPaperKind)48 && kind != (DXPaperKind)49)
				{
					return kind;
				}
				return DXPaperKind.Custom;
			}
		}

		public string PaperName
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (kind != DXPaperKind.Custom && !createdByDefaultConstructor)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				name = value;
			}
		}

		public int RawKind
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)kind;
			}
			set
			{
				kind = (DXPaperKind)value;
			}
		}

		public int Width
		{
			get
			{
				return width;
			}
			set
			{
				if (kind != DXPaperKind.Custom && !createdByDefaultConstructor)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException();
				}
				width = value;
			}
		}

		public DXPaperSize()
		{
			kind = DXPaperKind.Custom;
			name = string.Empty;
			createdByDefaultConstructor = true;
		}

		internal DXPaperSize(DXPaperKind kind, string name, int width, int height)
		{
			this.kind = kind;
			this.name = name;
			this.width = width;
			this.height = height;
		}

		public DXPaperSize(string name, int width, int height)
		{
			kind = DXPaperKind.Custom;
			this.name = name;
			this.width = width;
			this.height = height;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "[DXPaperSize " + PaperName + " Kind=" + Kind.ToString() + " Height=" + Height.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " Width=" + Width.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + "]";
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Printing.Internal
{
	public class PrintDocumentPrinterSettings : DXPrinterSettings
	{
		private readonly PrintDocument printDocument;

		public override bool Collate
		{
			get
			{
				return printDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings.Collate;
			}
			set
			{
				printDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings.Collate = value;
			}
		}

		public override short Copies
		{
			get
			{
				return printDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings.Copies;
			}
			set
			{
				printDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings.Copies = value;
			}
		}

		public override DXDuplexMode Duplex
		{
			get
			{
				return (DXDuplexMode)printDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings.Duplex;
			}
			set
			{
				printDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings.Duplex = (Duplex)value;
			}
		}

		public override string PrinterName
		{
			get
			{
				return printDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings.PrinterName;
			}
			set
			{
				printDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings.PrinterName = value;
			}
		}

		public override string PageRange
		{
			get
			{
				if (printDocument is IPrintDocumentExtension)
				{
					PrintDocument obj = printDocument;
					return ((IPrintDocumentExtension)((obj is IPrintDocumentExtension) ? obj : null)).PageRange;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (printDocument is IPrintDocumentExtension)
				{
					PrintDocument obj = printDocument;
					((IPrintDocumentExtension)((obj is IPrintDocumentExtension) ? obj : null)).PageRange = value;
					PageScope pageScope = new PageScope(value, printDocument.PrinterSettings.MaximumPage);
					printDocument.PrinterSettings.FromPage = pageScope.FromPage;
					printDocument.PrinterSettings.ToPage = pageScope.ToPage;
					base.PageRange = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public PrintDocumentPrinterSettings(PrintDocument printDocument)
		{
			this.printDocument = printDocument;
		}
	}
