	public struct DXCubicBezierCurve
	{
		public PointF P0 { get; }

		public PointF P1 { get; }

		public PointF P2 { get; }

		public PointF P3 { get; }

		public DXCubicBezierCurve(PointF p0, PointF p1, PointF p2, PointF p3)
		{
			P0 = p0;
			P1 = p1;
			P2 = p2;
			P3 = p3;
		}

		public Tuple<DXCubicBezierCurve, DXCubicBezierCurve> Split(float splitFactor = 0.5f)
		{
			PointF[] array = new PointF[3]
			{
				DXMathUtils.Lerp(P0, P1, splitFactor),
				DXMathUtils.Lerp(P1, P2, splitFactor),
				DXMathUtils.Lerp(P2, P3, splitFactor)
			};
			PointF[] array2 = new PointF[2];
			for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = DXMathUtils.Lerp(array[i], array[i + 1], splitFactor);
			}
			PointF pointF = DXMathUtils.Lerp(array2[0], array2[1], splitFactor);
			return new Tuple<DXCubicBezierCurve, DXCubicBezierCurve>(new DXCubicBezierCurve(P0, array[0], array2[0], pointF), new DXCubicBezierCurve(pointF, array2[1], array[2], P3));
		}

		public IList<PointF> Flatten(float flatnessTolerance = 0.25f)
		{
			List<PointF> list = new List<PointF>();
			SplitForFlatten(this, flatnessTolerance, list, 0);
			list.Add(P3);
			return list;
		}

		private static void SplitForFlatten(DXCubicBezierCurve curve, float tolerance, List<PointF> result, int recursionLevel)
		{
			if (recursionLevel >= 10 || curve.IsFlat(tolerance))
			{
				result.Add(curve.P0);
				return;
			}
			Tuple<DXCubicBezierCurve, DXCubicBezierCurve> tuple = curve.Split();
			SplitForFlatten(tuple.Item1, tolerance, result, recursionLevel + 1);
			SplitForFlatten(tuple.Item2, tolerance, result, recursionLevel + 1);
		}

		public Tuple<PointF, PointF> GetLastFlatSegment()
		{
			DXCubicBezierCurve dXCubicBezierCurve = this;
			while (!dXCubicBezierCurve.IsFlat())
			{
				dXCubicBezierCurve = dXCubicBezierCurve.Split().Item2;
			}
			return new Tuple<PointF, PointF>(dXCubicBezierCurve.P0, dXCubicBezierCurve.P3);
		}

		public PointF CalculatePoint(float t)
		{
			float num = 1f - t;
			PointF pt = P0.Mul(num * num * num);
			PointF value = P1.Mul(3f * num * num * t);
			PointF value2 = P2.Mul(3f * num * t * t);
			PointF value3 = P3.Mul(t * t * t);
			return pt.Add(value).Add(value2).Add(value3);
		}

		private bool IsFlat(float flatnessTolerance = 1f)
		{
			double num = 3.0 * (double)P1.X - 2.0 * (double)P0.X - (double)P3.X;
			num *= num;
			double num2 = 3.0 * (double)P1.Y - 2.0 * (double)P0.Y - (double)P3.Y;
			num2 *= num2;
			double num3 = 3.0 * (double)P2.X - 2.0 * (double)P3.X - (double)P0.X;
			num3 *= num3;
			double num4 = 3.0 * (double)P2.Y - 2.0 * (double)P3.Y - (double)P0.Y;
			num4 *= num4;
			if (num < num3)
			{
				num = num3;
			}
			if (num2 < num4)
			{
				num2 = num4;
			}
			return num + num2 <= (double)flatnessTolerance;
		}
	}
	internal class DXGDIPlusCompatiblePathAdapter
	{
		private class ArcBuilder
		{
			private readonly List<PointF> points = new List<PointF>();

			private bool inverted;

			private PointF startPoint;

			public static PointF[] GetBeziers(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
			{
				if (sweepAngle == 0f)
				{
					return new PointF[0];
				}
				ArcBuilder arcBuilder = new ArcBuilder();
				arcBuilder.AddArc(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
				return arcBuilder.Build();
			}

			private static double GetEllipseRad(float angle, float rx, float ry)
			{
				double a = (double)angle * Math.PI / 180.0;
				double num = Math.Atan((double)rx * Math.Tan(a) / (double)ry);
				num += (double)((int)angle / 360 * 2) * Math.PI;
				angle = ((angle >= 0f) ? (angle % 360f) : (angle % 360f + 360f));
				if (angle > 270f)
				{
					num += Math.PI * 2.0;
				}
				if (angle > 90f && angle <= 270f)
				{
					return num + Math.PI;
				}
				return num;
			}

			private ArcBuilder()
			{
			}

			private void AddBezier(PointF startPoint, PointF controlPoint1, PointF controlPoint2, PointF endPoint)
			{
				if (inverted)
				{
					points.Add(startPoint);
					points.Add(controlPoint1);
					points.Add(controlPoint2);
					this.startPoint = endPoint;
					return;
				}
				if (points.Count == 0)
				{
					this.startPoint = startPoint;
				}
				points.Add(controlPoint1);
				points.Add(controlPoint2);
				points.Add(endPoint);
			}

			private void AddArcPart(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
			{
				float num = width / 2f;
				float num2 = height / 2f;
				double ellipseRad = GetEllipseRad(startAngle, num, num2);
				double ellipseRad2 = GetEllipseRad(startAngle + sweepAngle, num, num2);
				double num3 = (ellipseRad2 - ellipseRad) / 2.0;
				double num4 = ellipseRad + num3;
				float num5 = (float)Math.Cos(num3);
				float num6 = (float)Math.Sin(num3);
				float num7 = (float)Math.Sin(num4);
				float num8 = (float)Math.Cos(num4);
				float num9 = (1f - num5) * 4f / 3f;
				float num10 = num6 - num9 * num5 / num6;
				float num11 = x + width / 2f;
				float num12 = y + height / 2f;
				float x2 = num11 + num * (num5 * num8 + num6 * num7);
				float y2 = num12 + num2 * (num5 * num7 - num6 * num8);
				if (DXMathUtils.NearlyZero(sweepAngle))
				{
					AddBezier(new PointF(x2, y2), new PointF(x2, y2), new PointF(x2, y2), new PointF(x2, y2));
					return;
				}
				float x3 = num11 + num * ((num5 + num9) * num8 + num10 * num7);
				float y3 = num12 + num2 * ((num5 + num9) * num7 - num10 * num8);
				float x4 = num11 + num * ((num5 + num9) * num8 - num10 * num7);
				float y4 = num12 + num2 * ((num5 + num9) * num7 + num10 * num8);
				float x5 = num11 + num * (num5 * num8 - num6 * num7);
				float y5 = num12 + num2 * (num5 * num7 + num6 * num8);
				AddBezier(new PointF(x2, y2), new PointF(x3, y3), new PointF(x4, y4), new PointF(x5, y5));
			}

			private void AddArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
			{
				if (sweepAngle < 0f)
				{
					inverted = true;
					startAngle += sweepAngle;
					sweepAngle = 0f - sweepAngle;
				}
				if (sweepAngle > 360f)
				{
					sweepAngle = 360f;
				}
				startAngle = ((startAngle > 0f) ? (startAngle % 360f) : (startAngle % 360f + 360f));
				while (sweepAngle > 90f)
				{
					AddArcPart(x, y, width, height, startAngle, 90f);
					startAngle += 90f;
					sweepAngle -= 90f;
				}
				AddArcPart(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			}

			private IEnumerable<PointF> BuildPoints()
			{
				if (inverted)
				{
					points.Reverse();
				}
				yield return startPoint;
				foreach (PointF point in points)
				{
					yield return point;
				}
			}

			public PointF[] Build()
			{
				return BuildPoints().ToArray();
			}
		}

		private readonly IDXLowLevelGraphicsPath lowLevelPath;

		private PointF lastPoint = PointF.Empty;

		private bool subPathStarted;

		public IReadOnlyList<PointF> PathPoints => lowLevelPath.PathPoints;

		public IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> PathTypes => lowLevelPath.PathTypes;

		public DXGDIPlusCompatiblePathAdapter(IDXLowLevelGraphicsPath lowLevelPath)
		{
			this.lowLevelPath = lowLevelPath;
		}

		public void StartFigure()
		{
			subPathStarted = false;
		}

		public void CloseFigure()
		{
			lowLevelPath.CloseFigure();
			subPathStarted = false;
		}

		private void BeginSubPath(PointF startPoint)
		{
			lowLevelPath.MoveTo(startPoint);
			subPathStarted = true;
		}

		private void EnsureSubPathsStarted(PointF startPoint)
		{
			if (subPathStarted)
			{
				if (startPoint != lastPoint)
				{
					lowLevelPath.LineTo(startPoint);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BeginSubPath(startPoint);
			}
		}

		public void AddLine(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			AddLine(new PointF(x1, y1), new PointF(x2, y2));
		}

		public void AddLine(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			EnsureSubPathsStarted(startPoint);
			lowLevelPath.LineTo(endPoint);
			lastPoint = endPoint;
		}

		private void CheckAddLinesParameters<T>(IReadOnlyList<T> points)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)points, "points");
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect number of points.");
			}
		}

		public void AddLines(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			CheckAddLinesParameters(points);
			EnsureSubPathsStarted(points[0]);
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				lowLevelPath.LineTo(points[i]);
			}
			lastPoint = points[points.Count - 1];
		}

		public void AddLines(IReadOnlyList<Point> points)
		{
			CheckAddLinesParameters(points);
			EnsureSubPathsStarted(points[0]);
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				lowLevelPath.LineTo(points[i]);
			}
			lastPoint = points[points.Count - 1];
		}

		public void AddBezier(PointF startPoint, PointF controlPoint1, PointF controlPoint2, PointF endPoint)
		{
			EnsureSubPathsStarted(startPoint);
			lowLevelPath.CubicTo(controlPoint1, controlPoint2, endPoint);
			lastPoint = endPoint;
		}

		public void AddBeziers(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			if (points.Count != 0)
			{
				if ((points.Count - 1) % 3 != 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Incorrect number of points.");
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Count - 1; i += 3)
				{
					AddBezier(points[i], points[i + 1], points[i + 2], points[i + 3]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddPolygon(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			if (points.Count <= 2)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The number of points must be more than 2");
			}
			BeginSubPath(points[0]);
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				lowLevelPath.LineTo(points[i]);
			}
			lastPoint = points[points.Count - 1];
			CloseFigure();
		}

		public void AddRectangle(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			BeginSubPath(rectangle.Location);
			lowLevelPath.LineTo(new PointF(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top));
			lowLevelPath.LineTo(new PointF(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom));
			lastPoint = new PointF(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom);
			lowLevelPath.LineTo(lastPoint);
			CloseFigure();
		}

		public void AddRectangles(IReadOnlyList<RectangleF> rectangles)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rectangles.Count; i++)
			{
				AddRectangle(rectangles[i]);
			}
		}

		public void AddArc(RectangleF rectangle, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			AddArc(rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			AddBeziers(ArcBuilder.GetBeziers(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle));
		}

		public void AddEllipse(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			StartFigure();
			AddBeziers(ArcBuilder.GetBeziers(x, y, width, height, 0f, 360f));
			CloseFigure();
		}

		public void AddEllipse(RectangleF rect)
		{
			AddEllipse(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		public void AddPie(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			BeginSubPath(new PointF(x + width / 2f, y + height / 2f));
			AddArc(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			CloseFigure();
		}

		public void AddPie(Rectangle rect, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			AddPie(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddPath(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types, bool connect)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (connect && subPathStarted)
			{
				lowLevelPath.LineTo(points[0]);
			}
			else
			{
				lowLevelPath.MoveTo(points[0]);
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				DXPathPointType dXPathPointType = types[i];
				if ((dXPathPointType & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == 0)
				{
					lowLevelPath.MoveTo(points[i]);
					subPathStarted = false;
				}
				if ((dXPathPointType & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Line)
				{
					lowLevelPath.LineTo(points[i]);
					subPathStarted = true;
				}
				if ((dXPathPointType & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Bezier)
				{
					lowLevelPath.CubicTo(points[i], points[i + 1], points[i + 2]);
					i += 2;
					dXPathPointType = types[i];
					subPathStarted = true;
				}
				if ((dXPathPointType & DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath) == DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath)
				{
					lowLevelPath.CloseFigure();
					subPathStarted = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Transform(DXMatrix transform)
		{
			lowLevelPath.Transform(transform);
		}

		public void Flatten(float flatnessTolerance)
		{
			IReadOnlyList<PointF> pathPoints = lowLevelPath.PathPoints;
			if (pathPoints.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> pathTypes = lowLevelPath.PathTypes;
			lowLevelPath.Reset();
			lowLevelPath.MoveTo(pathPoints[0]);
			for (int i = 1; i < pathPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((pathTypes[i] & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == 0)
				{
					lowLevelPath.MoveTo(pathPoints[i]);
				}
				if ((pathTypes[i] & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Line)
				{
					lowLevelPath.LineTo(pathPoints[i]);
				}
				if ((pathTypes[i] & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Bezier && i + 2 < pathPoints.Count)
				{
					IList<PointF> list = new DXCubicBezierCurve(pathPoints[i - 1], pathPoints[i], pathPoints[i + 1], pathPoints[i + 2]).Flatten(flatnessTolerance);
					foreach (PointF item in list)
					{
						lowLevelPath.LineTo(item);
					}
					i += 2;
				}
				if ((pathTypes[i] & DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath) == DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath)
				{
					lowLevelPath.CloseFigure();
				}
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			lowLevelPath.Reset();
		}

		private static PointF CalcBezierEndPoint(PointF p1, PointF p2, float tension)
		{
			return new PointF(tension * (p2.X - p1.X) + p1.X, tension * (p2.Y - p1.Y) + p1.Y);
		}

		public void AddCurve(PointF[] points, float tension = 1f)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)points, "points");
			if (points.Length < 2)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The number of points must be more than 2");
			}
			EnsureSubPathsStarted(points[0]);
			tension *= 0.3f;
			PointF p = CalcBezierEndPoint(points[0], points[1], tension);
			int num = points.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num - 2; i++)
			{
				PointF pointF = points[i];
				PointF p2 = points[i + 1];
				PointF pointF2 = points[i + 2];
				float num2 = tension * (pointF2.X - pointF.X);
				float num3 = tension * (pointF2.Y - pointF.Y);
				PointF p3 = new PointF(p2.X - num2, p2.Y - num3);
				PointF pointF3 = new PointF(p2.X + num2, p2.Y + num3);
				lowLevelPath.CubicTo(p, p3, p2);
				p = pointF3;
			}
			lowLevelPath.CubicTo(p, CalcBezierEndPoint(points[num - 1], points[num - 2], tension), points[num - 1]);
		}
	}
	internal interface IDXLowLevelGraphicsPath
	{
		IReadOnlyList<PointF> PathPoints { get; }

		IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> PathTypes { get; }

		void MoveTo(PointF point);

		void LineTo(PointF point);

		void CubicTo(PointF p1, PointF p2, PointF p3);

		void CloseFigure();

		void Transform(DXMatrix transform);

		void Reset();
	}
	internal class DXLowLevelGraphicsPath : IDXLowLevelGraphicsPath
	{
		private List<PointF> points;

		private List<DXPathPointType> types;

		public IReadOnlyList<PointF> PathPoints => points;

		public IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> PathTypes => types;

		public DXLowLevelGraphicsPath()
			: this(new List<PointF>(), new List<DXPathPointType>())
		{
		}

		public DXLowLevelGraphicsPath(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types)
			: this(new List<PointF>(points), new List<DXPathPointType>(types))
		{
		}

		public DXLowLevelGraphicsPath(DXGraphicsPathData initalData)
			: this(initalData.PathPoints, initalData.PathTypes)
		{
		}

		private DXLowLevelGraphicsPath(List<PointF> points, List<DXPathPointType> types)
		{
			this.points = points;
			this.types = types;
		}

		public virtual void CloseFigure()
		{
			if (types.Count > 0)
			{
				types[types.Count - 1] |= DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath;
			}
		}

		public virtual void CubicTo(PointF p1, PointF p2, PointF p3)
		{
			points.Add(p1);
			types.Add(DXPathPointType.Bezier);
			points.Add(p2);
			types.Add(DXPathPointType.Bezier);
			points.Add(p3);
			types.Add(DXPathPointType.Bezier);
		}

		public virtual void LineTo(PointF point)
		{
			points.Add(point);
			types.Add(DXPathPointType.Line);
		}

		public virtual void MoveTo(PointF point)
		{
			points.Add(point);
			types.Add(DXPathPointType.Start);
		}

		public virtual void Transform(DXMatrix transform)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				points[i] = transform.TransformPoint(points[i]);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			points = new List<PointF>();
			types = new List<DXPathPointType>();
		}
	}

		}

	internal static class UnitConverterHelper
	{
		private const float MmInInch = 25.4f;

		private const float PointsInInch = 72f;

		private const float DocumentsInInch = 300f;

		public static float PpiToPpm(float ppi)
		{
			return ppi / 25.4f * 1000f;
		}

		public static float PpiToPpcm(float ppi)
		{
			return ppi / 25.4f * 10f;
		}

		public static float PpmToPpi(float ppm)
		{
			return ppm * 25.4f / 1000f;
		}

		public static float PpcmToPpi(float ppcm)
		{
			return ppcm * 25.4f / 10f;
		}

		public static float PpmmToPpi(float ppcm)
		{
			return ppcm * 25.4f;
		}

		public static float PixelToInch(float pixel, float ppi)
		{
			return pixel / ppi;
		}

		public static float PixelToMm(float pixel, float ppi)
		{
			return PixelToInch(pixel, ppi) * 25.4f;
		}

		public static float PixelToPoint(float pixel, float ppi)
		{
			return PixelToInch(pixel, ppi) * 72f;
		}

		public static float InchToPixel(float inches, float ppi)
		{
			return inches * ppi;
		}

		public static float MmToPixel(float mms, float ppi)
		{
			return InchToPixel(mms / 25.4f, ppi);
		}

		public static float PointToPixel(float points, float ppi)
		{
			return InchToPixel(points / 72f, ppi);
		}

		public static float DocumentToPixel(float points, float ppi)
		{
			return InchToPixel(points / 300f, ppi);
		}
	}
	public class DXGraphicsPathBuilder
	{
		private readonly DXGDIPlusCompatiblePathAdapter builder;

		private readonly DXFillMode fillMode;

		internal static RectangleF GetBounds(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			if (points.Count == 0)
			{
				return default(RectangleF);
			}
			PointF pointF = points[0];
			float x = pointF.X;
			float x2 = pointF.X;
			float y = pointF.Y;
			float y2 = pointF.Y;
			for (int i = 1; i < points.Count; i++)
			{
				pointF = points[i];
				if (pointF.X < x)
				{
					x = pointF.X;
				}
				else if (pointF.X > x2)
				{
					x2 = pointF.X;
				}
				if (pointF.Y < y)
				{
					y = pointF.Y;
				}
				else if (pointF.Y > y2)
				{
					y2 = pointF.Y;
				}
			}
			return new RectangleF(x, y, x2 - x, y2 - y);
		}

		private DXGraphicsPathBuilder(List<PointF> points, List<DXPathPointType> types, DXFillMode fillMode)
		{
			builder = new DXGDIPlusCompatiblePathAdapter(new DXLowLevelGraphicsPath(points, types));
			this.fillMode = fillMode;
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathBuilder(DXFillMode fillMode = DXFillMode.Alternate)
			: this(new List<PointF>(), new List<DXPathPointType>(), fillMode)
		{
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathBuilder(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types, DXFillMode fillMode = DXFillMode.Alternate)
			: this(new List<PointF>(points), new List<DXPathPointType>(types), fillMode)
		{
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathBuilder(DXGraphicsPathData initalData)
			: this(initalData.PathPoints, initalData.PathTypes, initalData.FillMode)
		{
		}

		public void StartFigure()
		{
			builder.StartFigure();
		}

		public void CloseFigure()
		{
			builder.CloseFigure();
		}

		public void AddLine(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			builder.AddLine(x1, y1, x2, y2);
		}

		public void AddLine(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			builder.AddLine(startPoint, endPoint);
		}

		public void AddLines(PointF[] points)
		{
			builder.AddLines(points);
		}

		public void AddLines(Point[] points)
		{
			builder.AddLines(points);
		}

		public void AddArc(RectangleF rectangle, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			builder.AddArc(rectangle, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddArc(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			builder.AddArc(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddBezier(PointF startPoint, PointF controlPoint1, PointF controlPoint2, PointF endPoint)
		{
			builder.AddBezier(startPoint, controlPoint1, controlPoint2, endPoint);
		}

		public void AddBeziers(PointF[] points)
		{
			builder.AddBeziers(points);
		}

		public void AddCurve(PointF[] points, float tension)
		{
			builder.AddCurve(points, tension);
		}

		public void AddPolygon(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points)
		{
			builder.AddPolygon(points);
		}

		public void AddRectangle(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			builder.AddRectangle(rectangle);
		}

		public void AddRectangles(RectangleF[] rectangles)
		{
			builder.AddRectangles(rectangles);
		}

		public void AddEllipse(float x, float y, float width, float height)
		{
			builder.AddEllipse(x, y, width, height);
		}

		public void AddEllipse(RectangleF rect)
		{
			builder.AddEllipse(rect);
		}

		public void AddPie(float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			builder.AddPie(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddPie(Rectangle rect, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			builder.AddPie(rect, startAngle, sweepAngle);
		}

		public void AddPath(DXGraphicsPathData path, bool connect)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)path, "path");
			builder.AddPath(path.PathPoints, path.PathTypes, connect);
		}

		public void Transform(DXMatrix matrix)
		{
			builder.Transform(matrix);
		}

		public void Flatten(float flatness)
		{
			builder.Flatten(flatness);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			builder.Reset();
		}

		public RectangleF GetBounds()
		{
			return GetBounds(builder.PathPoints);
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathData GetPathData()
		{
			return new DXGraphicsPathData(new List<PointF>(builder.PathPoints), new List<DXPathPointType>(builder.PathTypes), fillMode);
		}

		public DXGraphicsPathBuilder Clone()
		{
			return new DXGraphicsPathBuilder(builder.PathPoints, builder.PathTypes, fillMode);
		}
	}

	public class DXStringClipper
	{
		public virtual DXTextLineBounds CalculateActualLineBounds(double firstLineY, double lineSpacing, int lineCount)
		{
			return new DXTextLineBounds(0, lineCount);
		}
	}
	public class DXRectangleStringClipper : DXStringClipper
	{
		private readonly double clipTop;

		private readonly double clipBottom;

		public DXRectangleStringClipper(RectangleF clipRectangle)
		{
			clipTop = clipRectangle.Top;
			clipBottom = clipRectangle.Bottom;
		}

		public override DXTextLineBounds CalculateActualLineBounds(double firstLineY, double lineSpacing, int lineCount)
		{
			int num = (int)Math.Floor((clipTop - firstLineY) / lineSpacing + 0.1);
			int val = (int)Math.Ceiling((clipBottom - firstLineY) / lineSpacing - 0.1);
			if (num > lineCount - 1)
			{
				return new DXTextLineBounds(0, 0);
			}
			return new DXTextLineBounds(Math.Max(0, num), Math.Min(val, lineCount));
		}
	}
	public abstract class DXStringPaintingStrategy
	{
		private readonly DXStringClipper clipper;

		protected DXStringFormat Format { get; }

		protected float LeadingOffset { get; }

		protected float TrailingOffset { get; }

		public virtual RectangleF? ClipRect => null;

		protected DXStringPaintingStrategy(DXStringFormat format, float fontSize, DXStringClipper clipper)
		{
			Format = format;
			LeadingOffset = format.LeadingMarginFactor * fontSize;
			TrailingOffset = format.TrailingMarginFactor * fontSize;
			this.clipper = clipper;
		}

		protected float MeasureStringHeight(int lineCount, float lineSpacing, float ascent, float descent)
		{
			float result = 0f;
			if (lineCount > 0)
			{
				result = ((lineCount == 1) ? (ascent + descent) : ((float)lineCount * lineSpacing));
				result += TrailingOffset * 3f / 4f;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public abstract float GetHorizontalPosition(DXTextLine line);

		public abstract float GetFirstLineVerticalPosition(int count, float lineSpacing, float ascent, float descent);

		public DXTextLineBounds CalculateActualLineBounds(double firstLineY, double lineSpacing, int lineCount)
		{
			return clipper.CalculateActualLineBounds(firstLineY, lineSpacing, lineCount);
		}

		protected DXStringAlignment GetActualAlignment(DXStringAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (Format.FormatFlags.HasFlag(DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft))
			{
				switch (alignment)
				{
				case DXStringAlignment.Near:
					return DXStringAlignment.Far;
				case DXStringAlignment.Far:
					return DXStringAlignment.Near;
				}
			}
			return alignment;
		}
	}
	public class DXStringPaintingAtPointStrategy : DXStringPaintingStrategy
	{
		private readonly PointF location;

		public DXStringPaintingAtPointStrategy(PointF location, DXStringFormat format, float fontSize)
			: base(format, fontSize, new DXStringClipper())
		{
			this.location = location;
		}

		public override float GetHorizontalPosition(DXTextLine line)
		{
			return GetActualAlignment(base.Format.Alignment) switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Center => location.X - line.GetWidth() / 2f, 
				DXStringAlignment.Far => location.X - line.GetWidth() - base.TrailingOffset, 
				_ => location.X + base.LeadingOffset, 
			};
		}

		public override float GetFirstLineVerticalPosition(int lineCount, float lineSpacing, float ascent, float descent)
		{
			return base.Format.LineAlignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Center => location.Y - MeasureStringHeight(lineCount, lineSpacing, ascent, descent) / 2f, 
				DXStringAlignment.Far => location.Y - MeasureStringHeight(lineCount, lineSpacing, ascent, descent), 
				_ => location.Y, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class DXStringPaintingInsideRectStrategy : DXStringPaintingStrategy
	{
		private readonly RectangleF layoutRect;

		public override RectangleF? ClipRect
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Format.FormatFlags.HasFlag(DXStringFormatFlags.NoClip))
				{
					return base.ClipRect;
				}
				return layoutRect;
			}
		}

		public DXStringPaintingInsideRectStrategy(RectangleF layoutRect, DXStringFormat format, float fontSize)
			: base(format, fontSize, new DXRectangleStringClipper(layoutRect))
		{
			this.layoutRect = layoutRect;
		}

		public override float GetHorizontalPosition(DXTextLine line)
		{
			return GetActualAlignment(base.Format.Alignment) switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Center => layoutRect.Left + (layoutRect.Width - line.GetWidth()) / 2f, 
				DXStringAlignment.Far => layoutRect.Right - line.GetWidth() - base.TrailingOffset, 
				_ => layoutRect.Left + base.LeadingOffset, 
			};
		}

		public override float GetFirstLineVerticalPosition(int lineCount, float lineSpacing, float ascent, float descent)
		{
			return base.Format.LineAlignment switch
			{
				DXStringAlignment.Center => layoutRect.Top + (layoutRect.Height - MeasureStringHeight(lineCount, lineSpacing, ascent, descent)) / 2f, 
				DXStringAlignment.Far => layoutRect.Top + (layoutRect.Height - MeasureStringHeight(lineCount, lineSpacing, ascent, descent)), 
				_ => layoutRect.Top, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class GdiPlusMeasurer : IDXMeasurer, IDisposable
	{
		private SystemDrawingStringFormatCache stringFormatCache = new SystemDrawingStringFormatCache();

		private SystemDrawingFontCache fontCache = new SystemDrawingFontCache();

		private GraphicsUnit currentPageUnit;

		private Graphics Graphics { get; set; }

		public GdiPlusMeasurer()
		{
			Graphics = GraphicsHelper.CreateGraphics();
			currentPageUnit = Graphics.PageUnit;
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, float width, DXStringFormat stringFormat, DXGraphicsUnit pageUnit)
		{
			return MeasureString(text, font, new SizeF(width, 999999f), stringFormat, pageUnit);
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, SizeF size, DXStringFormat stringFormat, DXGraphicsUnit pageUnit)
		{
			SetPageUnit((GraphicsUnit)pageUnit);
			Font font2 = fontCache.GetFont(font);
			StringFormat stringFormat2 = stringFormatCache.GetStringFormat(stringFormat);
			return Graphics.MeasureString(text, font2, size, stringFormat2);
		}

		private void SetPageUnit(GraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			if (currentPageUnit != unit)
			{
				currentPageUnit = unit;
				Graphics.PageUnit = unit;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (Graphics != null)
			{
				Graphics.Dispose();
				Graphics = null;
			}
			if (stringFormatCache != null)
			{
				stringFormatCache.Dispose();
				stringFormatCache = null;
			}
			if (fontCache != null)
			{
				fontCache.Dispose();
				fontCache = null;
			}
		}
	}

		public void DrawImage(DXImage image, int x, int y)

			if (!this.TryDrawAsEmfMetafile(image, x, y) && !this.TryDrawSvgImage(image, x, y))
			{
				Image image2 = SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(image);
				graphics.DrawImage(image2, x, y);
			}
		}

		public void DrawImage(DXImage image, RectangleF destRect, RectangleF srcRect, DXGraphicsUnit srcUnit, DXImageAttributes imageAttr)
		{
			if (this.TryDrawAsEmfMetafile(image, destRect, srcRect, imageAttr) || this.TryDrawSvgImage(image, destRect, srcRect, imageAttr))
			{
				return;
			}
			Image image2 = SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(image);
			using ImageAttributes imageAttr2 = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateImageAttributes(imageAttr);
			PointF[] destPoints = new PointF[3]
			{
				new PointF(destRect.Left, destRect.Top),
				new PointF(destRect.Right, destRect.Top),
				new PointF(destRect.Left, destRect.Bottom)
			};
			graphics.DrawImage(image2, destPoints, srcRect, (GraphicsUnit)srcUnit, imageAttr2);
		}

		public void DrawGlyphRun(IList<DXCluster> glyphRun, DXFont dxFont, DXBrush dxBrush, PointF location)
		{
			float num = DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(PageUnit);
			float num2 = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(dxFont.Size, DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(dxFont.Unit), num);
			List<ushort> list = new List<ushort>();
			List<PointF> list2 = new List<PointF>();
			IList<DXStringLine> list3 = new List<DXStringLine>();
			using Font font = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(dxFont);
			float num3 = font.FontFamily.GetEmHeight(font.Style);
			float num4 = (float)font.FontFamily.GetCellAscent(font.Style) / num3 * num2;
			float num5 = (float)font.FontFamily.GetCellDescent(font.Style) / num3 * num2;
			bool flag = (dxFont.Style & DXFontStyle.Underline) != DXFontStyle.Regular || (dxFont.Style & DXFontStyle.Strikeout) != 0;
			float num6 = location.X;
			float y = location.Y;
			foreach (DXCluster item in glyphRun)
			{
				foreach (DXGlyph glyph in item.Glyphs)
				{
					list2.Add(new PointF(num6 + glyph.Offset.HorizontalOffset, y - glyph.Offset.VerticalOffset));
					list.Add(glyph.Index);
					num6 += glyph.Advance;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				float x = location.X;
				float y2 = location.Y;
				if ((dxFont.Style & DXFontStyle.Underline) != DXFontStyle.Regular)
				{
					float y3 = y2 + num5 / 2f;
					list3.Add(new DXStringLine(new PointF(x, y3), new PointF(num6, y3)));
				}
				if ((dxFont.Style & DXFontStyle.Strikeout) != DXFontStyle.Regular)
				{
					float y4 = y2 - num4 / 2f + num5;
					list3.Add(new DXStringLine(new PointF(x, y4), new PointF(num6, y4)));
				}
			}
			using Font font2 = new Font(font, font.Style & ~(FontStyle.Underline | FontStyle.Strikeout));
			using Brush brush = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateBrush(dxBrush);
			using Pen pen = new Pen(brush);
			graphics.DrawDriverString(list.ToArray(), font2, brush, list2.ToArray());
			foreach (DXStringLine item2 in list3)
			{
				graphics.DrawLine(pen, item2.Begin, item2.End);
			}
		}

	public class DXImageFormatOptions
	{
		public static DXImageFormatOptions Jpeg { get; } = new DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat.Jpeg);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions Bmp { get; } = new DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat.Bmp);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions Png { get; } = new DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat.Png);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions Gif { get; } = new DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat.Gif);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions Icon { get; } = new DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat.Icon);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions WindowsMetafile { get; } = new DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat.Emf);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions Svg { get; } = new DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat.Svg);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions Tiff { get; } = new DXTiffImageFormatOptions(DXTiffCompression.Unknown);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions TiffLZW { get; } = new DXTiffImageFormatOptions(DXTiffCompression.LZW);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions TiffCCITT3 { get; } = new DXTiffImageFormatOptions(DXTiffCompression.CCITT3);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions TiffCCITT4 { get; } = new DXTiffImageFormatOptions(DXTiffCompression.CCITT4);

		public static DXImageFormatOptions Unknown { get; } = new DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat.Unknown);

		public DXImageFormat ImageFormat { get; }

		public DXImageFormatOptions(DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			ImageFormat = imageFormat;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DXImageFormatOptions dXImageFormatOptions)
			{
				return ImageFormat == dXImageFormatOptions.ImageFormat;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<DXImageFormat>(ImageFormat);
		}
	}
	public class DXTiffImageFormatOptions : DXImageFormatOptions
	{
		public DXTiffCompression TiffCompression { get; set; } = DXTiffCompression.Unknown;

		public DXTiffImageFormatOptions(DXTiffCompression tiffCompression)
			: base(DXImageFormat.Tiff)
		{
			TiffCompression = tiffCompression;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is DXTiffImageFormatOptions dXTiffImageFormatOptions && base.Equals(obj))
			{
				return TiffCompression == dXTiffImageFormatOptions.TiffCompression;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.FinishGeneric<int>(base.GetHashCode(), (int)TiffCompression);
		}
	}

	public class DXMetafileHeader
	{
		public Rectangle Bounds { get; }

		public SizeF FrameDimension { get; }

		public float DpiX { get; }

		public float DpiY { get; }

		public DXMetafileHeader(Rectangle bounds, SizeF frame, float dpiX, float dpiY)
		{
			Bounds = bounds;
			FrameDimension = frame;
			DpiX = dpiX;
			DpiY = dpiY;
		}

		internal static DXMetafileHeader FromEmfHeaderRecord(EmfMetafileHeaderRecord record)
		{
			float num = (float)record.Device.Width / (float)record.Millimeters.Width;
			float num2 = (float)record.Device.Height / (float)record.Millimeters.Height;
			float num3 = (float)record.Frame.Left / 100f * num;
			float num4 = (float)record.Frame.Right / 100f * num;
			float num5 = (float)record.Frame.Top / 100f * num2;
			float num6 = (float)record.Frame.Bottom / 100f * num2;
			return new DXMetafileHeader(new Rectangle((int)Math.Round(num3), (int)Math.Round(num5), (int)Math.Round(num4 - num3 + 1f), (int)Math.Round(num6 - num5 + 1f)), new SizeF((float)record.Frame.Width + 100f / num, (float)record.Frame.Height + 100f / num2), UnitConverterHelper.PpmmToPpi(num), UnitConverterHelper.PpmmToPpi(num2));
		}
	}

	internal class DXLineCapsBuilder
	{
		private class PathFigure
		{
			public IReadOnlyList<PointF> PathPoints { get; }

			public IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> PointTypes { get; }

			public int StartIndex { get; set; }

			public int EndIndex { get; set; }

			public int PointsCount => EndIndex - StartIndex + 1;

			public bool IsClosed => (PointTypes[EndIndex] & DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath) != 0;

			public PathFigure(DXGraphicsPathData path)
			{
				PathPoints = path.PathPoints;
				PointTypes = path.PathTypes;
			}
		}

		private readonly DXGraphicsPathData path;

		private readonly DXBrush penBrush;

		private readonly float penWidth;

		private readonly DXLineCap startCap;

		private readonly DXLineCap endCap;

		private readonly DXCustomLineCapBase customEndCap;

		private readonly DXCustomLineCapBase customStartCap;

		private readonly DXGraphicsPathBuilder startCapBuilder = new DXGraphicsPathBuilder();

		private readonly DXGraphicsPathBuilder endCapBuilder = new DXGraphicsPathBuilder();

		private List<PointF> alteredPoints;

		private bool alteredPointsChanged;

		private float startOffset;

		private float endOffset;

		private DXLineCapsBuilder(DXGraphicsPathData path, DXBrush brush, float penWidth, DXLineCap startCap, DXLineCap endCap, DXCustomLineCapBase customStartCap, DXCustomLineCapBase customEndCap)
		{
			this.path = path;
			penBrush = brush;
			this.penWidth = penWidth;
			this.startCap = startCap;
			this.endCap = endCap;
			this.customStartCap = customStartCap;
			this.customEndCap = customEndCap;
			startOffset = GetOffset(startCap, customStartCap);
			endOffset = GetOffset(endCap, customEndCap);
			alteredPoints = new List<PointF>(path.PathPoints);
		}

		public static DXLineCapsBuilderResult BuildCaps(DXGraphicsPathData path, DXPen pen)
		{
			return BuildCaps(path, pen, pen.Width);
		}

		public static DXLineCapsBuilderResult BuildCaps(DXGraphicsPathData path, DXPen pen, float penWidth)
		{
			return BuildCaps(path, pen.Brush, penWidth, pen.StartCap, pen.EndCap, pen.CustomStartCap, pen.CustomEndCap);
		}

		public static DXLineCapsBuilderResult BuildCaps(DXGraphicsPathData path, DXPen pen, DXLineCap startCap, DXLineCap endCap, DXCustomLineCapBase customStartCap, DXCustomLineCapBase customEndCap)
		{
			return BuildCaps(path, pen.Brush, pen.Width, startCap, endCap, customStartCap, customEndCap);
		}

		public static DXLineCapsBuilderResult BuildCaps(DXGraphicsPathData path, DXBrush brush, float penWidth, DXLineCap startCap, DXLineCap endCap, DXCustomLineCapBase customStartCap, DXCustomLineCapBase customEndCap)
		{
			if (path.PathPoints.Count < 2)
			{
				return new DXLineCapsBuilderResult();
			}
			List<PathFigure> list = ParseFigures(path);
			DXLineCapsBuilder dXLineCapsBuilder = new DXLineCapsBuilder(path, brush, penWidth, startCap, endCap, customStartCap, customEndCap);
			foreach (PathFigure item in list)
			{
				dXLineCapsBuilder.ProcessFigure(item);
			}
			return dXLineCapsBuilder.GetResult();
		}

		private DXLineCapsBuilderResult GetResult()
		{
			DXLineCapsBuilderResult dXLineCapsBuilderResult = new DXLineCapsBuilderResult();
			DXGraphicsPathData pathData = startCapBuilder.GetPathData();
			if (pathData.PathPoints.Count > 0)
			{
				if (IsStroke(startCap, customStartCap))
				{
					dXLineCapsBuilderResult.StartCapStroke = pathData;
					dXLineCapsBuilderResult.StartCapStrokePen = GetCustomCapStrokePen(customStartCap);
				}
				else
				{
					dXLineCapsBuilderResult.StartCapFill = pathData;
				}
			}
			DXGraphicsPathData pathData2 = endCapBuilder.GetPathData();
			if (pathData2.PathPoints.Count > 0)
			{
				if (IsStroke(endCap, customEndCap))
				{
					dXLineCapsBuilderResult.EndCapStroke = pathData2;
					dXLineCapsBuilderResult.EndCapStrokePen = GetCustomCapStrokePen(customEndCap);
				}
				else
				{
					dXLineCapsBuilderResult.EndCapFill = pathData2;
				}
			}
			if (alteredPointsChanged)
			{
				dXLineCapsBuilderResult.AlteredPath = new DXGraphicsPathData(alteredPoints, path.PathTypes, path.FillMode);
			}
			return dXLineCapsBuilderResult;
		}

		private static bool IsStroke(DXLineCap style, DXCustomLineCapBase cap)
		{
			if (style != DXLineCap.Custom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (cap is DXAdjustableArrowCap dXAdjustableArrowCap)
			{
				return !dXAdjustableArrowCap.Filled;
			}
			if (cap is DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap)
			{
				return dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static List<PathFigure> ParseFigures(DXGraphicsPathData path)
		{
			List<PathFigure> list = new List<PathFigure>();
			PathFigure pathFigure = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < path.PathPoints.Count; i++)
			{
				DXPathPointType dXPathPointType = path.PathTypes[i];
				if ((dXPathPointType & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == 0)
				{
					if (pathFigure != null)
					{
						pathFigure.EndIndex = i - 1;
						list.Add(pathFigure);
					}
					pathFigure = new PathFigure(path);
					pathFigure.StartIndex = i;
				}
				if ((dXPathPointType & DXPathPointType.CloseSubpath) != DXPathPointType.Start && pathFigure != null)
				{
					pathFigure.EndIndex = i;
					list.Add(pathFigure);
					pathFigure = null;
				}
			}
			if (pathFigure != null)
			{
				pathFigure.EndIndex = path.PathPoints.Count - 1;
				list.Add(pathFigure);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void ProcessFigure(PathFigure figure)
		{
			if (figure.PointsCount >= 2 && !figure.IsClosed && !DXMathUtils.NearlyEquals(path.PathPoints[figure.StartIndex], path.PathPoints[figure.EndIndex]))
			{
				if (alteredPoints != null)
				{
					OffsetPoint(figure.StartIndex, forward: false, startOffset);
					OffsetPoint(figure.EndIndex, forward: true, endOffset);
				}
				BuildSingleCap(figure.StartIndex, isStart: true);
				BuildSingleCap(figure.EndIndex, isStart: false);
			}
		}

		private PointF GetStartPointForCapDirection(int capPointIndex, bool isStartCap)
		{
			if (isStartCap)
			{
				if ((path.PathTypes[capPointIndex + 1] & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Bezier)
				{
					return GetBezierDirectionPoint(capPointIndex, isStartCap);
				}
				return path.PathPoints[capPointIndex + 1];
			}
			if ((path.PathTypes[capPointIndex] & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Bezier)
			{
				return GetBezierDirectionPoint(capPointIndex, isStartCap);
			}
			return path.PathPoints[capPointIndex - 1];
		}

		private PointF GetBezierDirectionPoint(int capPointIndex, bool isStartCap)
		{
			if (!DXMathUtils.NearlyEquals(path.PathPoints[capPointIndex], alteredPoints[capPointIndex]))
			{
				return alteredPoints[capPointIndex];
			}
			if (isStartCap)
			{
				return new DXCubicBezierCurve(path.PathPoints[capPointIndex + 3], path.PathPoints[capPointIndex + 2], path.PathPoints[capPointIndex + 1], path.PathPoints[capPointIndex]).CalculatePoint(0.95f);
			}
			return new DXCubicBezierCurve(path.PathPoints[capPointIndex - 3], path.PathPoints[capPointIndex - 2], path.PathPoints[capPointIndex - 1], path.PathPoints[capPointIndex]).CalculatePoint(0.95f);
		}

		private void OffsetPoint(int index, bool forward, float offset)
		{
			if (offset != 0f)
			{
				DXPathPointType dXPathPointType = path.PathTypes[index];
				int num = ((!forward) ? 1 : (-1));
				int num2 = index + num;
				DXPathPointType dXPathPointType2 = path.PathTypes[num2];
				if ((dXPathPointType & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Line || (dXPathPointType2 & DXPathPointType.PathTypeMask) == DXPathPointType.Line)
				{
					OffsetLine(index, num2, offset);
				}
				else
				{
					OffsetBezier(index, num2, num2 + num, num2 + num * 2, offset);
				}
				alteredPointsChanged = true;
			}
		}

		private static float GetOffset(DXLineCap capStyle, DXCustomLineCapBase cap)
		{
			switch (capStyle)
			{
			case DXLineCap.ArrowAnchor:
				return 1.6f;
			default:
				return 0f;
			case DXLineCap.Custom:
				if (cap is DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap)
				{
					float num = 1f;
					if (dXCustomLineCap.FillPath != null && dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath != null)
					{
						num = 2f;
					}
					return dXCustomLineCap.BaseInset * cap.WidthScale * num;
				}
				if (cap is DXAdjustableArrowCap dXAdjustableArrowCap)
				{
					if (DXMathUtils.NearlyZero(dXAdjustableArrowCap.Width))
					{
						return 0f;
					}
					return (dXAdjustableArrowCap.Filled ? dXAdjustableArrowCap.Height : 0.5f) * cap.WidthScale;
				}
				return 0f;
			}
		}

		private void OffsetLine(int index, int prevIndex, float offset)
		{
			PointF pointF = path.PathPoints[index];
			PointF pointF2 = path.PathPoints[prevIndex];
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = CalcTransformationMatrix(pointF2, pointF, penWidth);
			PointF pointF3 = dXMatrix.TransformPoint(new PointF(0f, 0f - offset));
			if (DXMathUtils.NearlyEquals(pointF, pointF2) || GeometryUtils.DotVectors(pointF2, pointF3, pointF2, pointF) < 0f)
			{
				pointF3 = pointF;
			}
			alteredPoints[index] = pointF3;
		}

		private void OffsetBezier(int p0, int p1, int p2, int p3, float offset)
		{
			DXCubicBezierCurve dXCubicBezierCurve = new DXCubicBezierCurve(alteredPoints[p0], alteredPoints[p1], alteredPoints[p2], alteredPoints[p3]);
			float num = penWidth * 0.001f;
			float num2 = 0.5f;
			float num3 = num2 / 2f;
			float num4 = offset * penWidth;
			do
			{
				PointF p4 = dXCubicBezierCurve.CalculatePoint(num2);
				double num5 = GeometryUtils.GetDistance(p4, dXCubicBezierCurve.P0);
				if (Math.Abs(num5 - (double)num4) <= (double)num)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 = ((!(num5 > (double)num4)) ? (num2 + num3) : (num2 - num3));
				num3 /= 2f;
			}
			while (!(num2 <= float.Epsilon) && !(1f - num2 <= float.Epsilon) && !(num3 <= float.Epsilon));
			DXCubicBezierCurve item = dXCubicBezierCurve.Split(num2).Item2;
			alteredPoints[p0] = item.P0;
			alteredPoints[p1] = item.P1;
			alteredPoints[p2] = item.P2;
			alteredPoints[p3] = item.P3;
		}

		private void BuildSingleCap(int pointIndex, bool isStart)
		{
			DXLineCap dXLineCap = (isStart ? startCap : endCap);
			DXGraphicsPathBuilder dXGraphicsPathBuilder = (isStart ? startCapBuilder : endCapBuilder);
			PointF pointF = path.PathPoints[pointIndex];
			PointF startPointForCapDirection = GetStartPointForCapDirection(pointIndex, isStart);
			float lineAngle = GetLineAngle(startPointForCapDirection, pointF);
			dXGraphicsPathBuilder.StartFigure();
			if (dXLineCap == DXLineCap.Custom)
			{
				DXCustomLineCapBase dXCustomLineCapBase = (isStart ? customStartCap : customEndCap);
				if (dXCustomLineCapBase is DXAdjustableArrowCap)
				{
					DXAdjustableArrowCap cap = (DXAdjustableArrowCap)dXCustomLineCapBase;
					BuildAdjustableArrowCap(dXGraphicsPathBuilder, cap, pointF, lineAngle, penWidth);
				}
				else if (dXCustomLineCapBase is DXCustomLineCap)
				{
					DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap = (DXCustomLineCap)dXCustomLineCapBase;
					if (dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath != null)
					{
						BuildCustomCap(dXGraphicsPathBuilder, dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath, pointF, lineAngle, penWidth, dXCustomLineCap.WidthScale);
					}
					else if (dXCustomLineCap.FillPath != null)
					{
						BuildCustomCap(dXGraphicsPathBuilder, dXCustomLineCap.FillPath, pointF, lineAngle, penWidth, dXCustomLineCap.WidthScale);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BuildSimpleLineCap(dXGraphicsPathBuilder, dXLineCap, pointF, lineAngle, penWidth);
			}
		}

		private static void BuildSimpleLineCap(DXGraphicsPathBuilder builder, DXLineCap capType, PointF capPoint, float angle, float penWidth)
		{
			switch (capType)
			{
			case DXLineCap.Triangle:
				BuildPolygonCap(builder, new PointF[5]
				{
					new PointF(0.5f, -0.1f),
					new PointF(0.5f, 0f),
					new PointF(0f, 0.5f),
					new PointF(-0.5f, 0f),
					new PointF(-0.5f, -0.1f)
				}, capPoint, angle, penWidth);
				break;
			case DXLineCap.DiamondAnchor:
				BuildPolygonCap(builder, new PointF[4]
				{
					new PointF(-1f, 0f),
					new PointF(0f, 1f),
					new PointF(1f, 0f),
					new PointF(0f, -1f)
				}, capPoint, angle, penWidth);
				break;
			case DXLineCap.SquareAnchor:
				BuildPolygonCap(builder, new PointF[4]
				{
					new PointF(-0.7f, -0.7f),
					new PointF(0.7f, -0.7f),
					new PointF(0.7f, 0.7f),
					new PointF(-0.7f, 0.7f)
				}, capPoint, angle, penWidth);
				break;
			case DXLineCap.ArrowAnchor:
				BuildPolygonCap(builder, new PointF[3]
				{
					new PointF(0f, 0f),
					new PointF(1f, -1.7f),
					new PointF(-1f, -1.7f)
				}, capPoint, angle, penWidth);
				break;
			case DXLineCap.Square:
				BuildPolygonCap(builder, new PointF[4]
				{
					new PointF(-0.5f, 0f),
					new PointF(0.5f, 0f),
					new PointF(0.5f, 0.5f),
					new PointF(-0.5f, 0.5f)
				}, capPoint, angle, penWidth);
				break;
			case DXLineCap.RoundAnchor:
				BuildRoundCap(builder, 1f, capPoint, penWidth);
				break;
			case DXLineCap.Round:
				BuildRoundCap(builder, 0.5f, capPoint, penWidth);
				break;
			}
		}

		private static void BuildPolygonCap(DXGraphicsPathBuilder builder, PointF[] points, PointF capPoint, float angle, float penWidth)
		{
			CalcTransformationMatrix(capPoint, angle, penWidth).TransformPoints(points);
			builder.AddPolygon(points);
		}

		private static void BuildRoundCap(DXGraphicsPathBuilder builder, float radius, PointF capPoint, float penWidth)
		{
			radius *= penWidth;
			builder.AddEllipse(capPoint.X - radius, capPoint.Y - radius, 2f * radius, 2f * radius);
		}

		private static void BuildAdjustableArrowCap(DXGraphicsPathBuilder builder, DXAdjustableArrowCap cap, PointF capPoint, float angle, float penWidth)
		{
			if (!DXMathUtils.NearlyZero(cap.WidthScale) && (!DXMathUtils.NearlyZero(cap.Width) || !DXMathUtils.NearlyZero(cap.Height)))
			{
				float height = cap.Height;
				float num = cap.Width / 2f;
				PointF[] points = new PointF[3]
				{
					new PointF(num, 0f - height),
					new PointF(0f, 0f),
					new PointF(0f - num, 0f - height)
				};
				CalcTransformationMatrix(capPoint, angle, penWidth, cap.WidthScale).TransformPoints(points);
				builder.AddLines(points);
			}
		}

		private DXPen GetCustomCapStrokePen(DXCustomLineCapBase cap)
		{
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(penBrush);
			dXPen.Width = penWidth * cap.WidthScale;
			dXPen.LineJoin = cap.StrokeJoin;
			dXPen.MiterLimit = cap.StrokeMiterLimit;
			dXPen.StartCap = cap.StrokeStartCap;
			dXPen.EndCap = cap.StrokeEndCap;
			return dXPen;
		}

		private static void BuildCustomCap(DXGraphicsPathBuilder builder, DXGraphicsPathData capPath, PointF capPoint, float angle, float penWidth, float widthScale)
		{
			IReadOnlyList<PointF> points = CalcTransformationMatrix(capPoint, angle, penWidth, widthScale).TransformPoints(capPath.PathPoints);
			builder.AddPath(new DXGraphicsPathData(points, capPath.PathTypes, capPath.FillMode), connect: false);
		}

		private static DXMatrix CalcTransformationMatrix(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint, float penWidth, float widthScale = 1f)
		{
			return CalcTransformationMatrix(startPoint, endPoint, endPoint, penWidth, widthScale);
		}

		private static DXMatrix CalcTransformationMatrix(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint, PointF endPointWithOffset, float penWidth, float widthScale = 1f)
		{
			float lineAngle = GetLineAngle(startPoint, endPointWithOffset);
			return CalcTransformationMatrix(endPoint, lineAngle, penWidth, widthScale);
		}

		private static float GetLineAngle(PointF startPoint, PointF endPoint)
		{
			double y = endPoint.X - startPoint.X;
			double x = endPoint.Y - startPoint.Y;
			return (float)GeometryUtils.RadiansToDegrees(0.0 - Math.Atan2(y, x));
		}

		private static DXMatrix CalcTransformationMatrix(PointF capPoint, float angle, float penWidth, float widthScale = 1f)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = DXMatrix.CreateScaleMatrix(penWidth * widthScale, penWidth * widthScale);
			dXMatrix.Translate(capPoint.X, capPoint.Y, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			dXMatrix.RotateAt(angle, capPoint, DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			return dXMatrix;
		}
	}
	internal class DXLineCapsBuilderResult
	{
		public DXGraphicsPathData AlteredPath { get; set; }

		public DXGraphicsPathData StartCapFill { get; set; }

		public DXGraphicsPathData EndCapFill { get; set; }

		public DXGraphicsPathData StartCapStroke { get; set; }

		public DXPen StartCapStrokePen { get; set; }

		public DXGraphicsPathData EndCapStroke { get; set; }

		public DXPen EndCapStrokePen { get; set; }
	}
	public class DXMatrixCalculator
	{
		private readonly int rowsCount;

		private readonly int columnsCount;

		private readonly double[][] matrix;

		public static DXMatrix CalculateTransformationMatrix(IReadOnlyList<PointF> sourcePoints, IReadOnlyList<PointF> destinationPoints)
		{
			float[] array = new DXMatrixCalculator(new double[3][]
			{
				new double[4]
				{
					sourcePoints[0].X,
					sourcePoints[0].Y,
					1.0,
					destinationPoints[0].X
				},
				new double[4]
				{
					sourcePoints[1].X,
					sourcePoints[1].Y,
					1.0,
					destinationPoints[1].X
				},
				new double[4]
				{
					sourcePoints[2].X,
					sourcePoints[2].Y,
					1.0,
					destinationPoints[2].X
				}
			}).Solve();
			float[] array2 = new DXMatrixCalculator(new double[3][]
			{
				new double[4]
				{
					sourcePoints[0].X,
					sourcePoints[0].Y,
					1.0,
					destinationPoints[0].Y
				},
				new double[4]
				{
					sourcePoints[1].X,
					sourcePoints[1].Y,
					1.0,
					destinationPoints[1].Y
				},
				new double[4]
				{
					sourcePoints[2].X,
					sourcePoints[2].Y,
					1.0,
					destinationPoints[2].Y
				}
			}).Solve();
			return new DXMatrix(array[0], array2[0], array[1], array2[1], array[2], array2[2]);
		}

		private DXMatrixCalculator(double[][] matrix)
		{
			this.matrix = matrix;
			rowsCount = matrix.Length;
			columnsCount = matrix[0].Length;
		}

		private void SwapMaxRow(int rowIndex)
		{
			int num = rowIndex;
			double num2 = Math.Abs(matrix[num][rowIndex]);
			for (int i = rowIndex + 1; i < rowsCount; i++)
			{
				double num3 = Math.Abs(matrix[i][rowIndex]);
				if (num3 > num2)
				{
					num = i;
					num2 = num3;
				}
			}
			double[] array = matrix[rowIndex];
			matrix[rowIndex] = matrix[num];
			matrix[num] = array;
		}

		private float[] Solve()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rowsCount - 1; i++)
			{
				SwapMaxRow(i);
				double[] array = matrix[i];
				for (int j = i + 1; j < rowsCount; j++)
				{
					double[] array2 = matrix[j];
					double num = (0.0 - array2[i]) / array[i];
					for (int k = i; k < columnsCount; k++)
					{
						array2[k] += array[k] * num;
					}
				}
			}
			float[] array3 = new float[rowsCount];
			int num2 = columnsCount - 1;
			for (int num3 = rowsCount - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				double[] array4 = matrix[num3];
				double num4 = array4[num2];
				for (int l = num3 + 1; l < rowsCount; l++)
				{
					num4 -= array4[l] * (double)array3[l];
				}
				array3[num3] = (float)(num4 / array4[num3]);
			}
			return array3;
		}
	}
	public class DXDrawingPrimitivesCache : IDisposable
	{
		private struct PenKey : IEquatable<PenKey>
		{
			public Color Color { get; }

			public float Width { get; }

			public PenKey(Color color, float width)
			{
				Color = color;
				Width = width;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is PenKey)
				{
					return Equals((PenKey)obj);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool Equals(PenKey other)
			{
				if (Color == other.Color)
				{
					return Width == other.Width;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, float>(Color.GetHashCode(), Width);
			}
		}

		private class ColorComparer : IEqualityComparer<Color>
		{
			public bool Equals(Color x, Color y)
			{
				return x == y;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(Color obj)
			{
				return obj.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static DXDrawingPrimitivesCache defaultCache;

		private Dictionary<Color, DXSolidBrush> solidBrushes;

		private Dictionary<PenKey, DXPen> pens;

		public static DXDrawingPrimitivesCache DefaultCache
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultCache == null)
				{
					defaultCache = new DXDrawingPrimitivesCache();
				}
				return defaultCache;
			}
		}

		public DXDrawingPrimitivesCache()
		{
			solidBrushes = new Dictionary<Color, DXSolidBrush>(new ColorComparer());
			pens = new Dictionary<PenKey, DXPen>();
		}

		public DXSolidBrush GetSolidBrush(Color color)
		{
			if (solidBrushes.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = new DXSolidBrush(color);
			solidBrushes.Add(color, value);
			return value;
		}

		public DXPen GetPen(Color color)
		{
			return GetPen(color, 1f);
		}

		public DXPen GetPen(Color color, float width)
		{
			PenKey key = new PenKey(color, width);
			if (pens.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = new DXPen(color, width);
			pens.Add(key, value);
			return value;
		}

		private void Clear()
		{
			ClearCache(pens);
			ClearCache(solidBrushes);
		}

		private void ClearCache(IDictionary cache)
		{
			if (cache == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IDisposable value in cache.Values)
			{
				value.Dispose();
			}
			cache.Clear();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~DXDrawingPrimitivesCache()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				Clear();
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IDXBrushVisitor
	{
		void Visit(DXSolidBrush brush);

		void Visit(DXHatchBrush brush);

		void Visit(DXLinearGradientBrush brush);

		void Visit(DXPathGradientBrush brush);

		void Visit(DXTextureBrush brush);
	}

		No,
		Unpremul,
		Premul
	}

	{

		Format1Bpp = 1,
		Format4Bpp = 4,
		Format8Bpp = 8,
		Format24Bpp = 24,
		Format32Bpp = 32
	}

	{
		Undefined,
		RGB,
		CMYK,
		YCCK,
		Gray
	}

	{
		public DXColorSpace BaseColorSpace { get; }

		public Color[] Colors { get; }

		public DXPalette(DXColorSpace baseColorSpace, Color[] colors)
		{
			BaseColorSpace = baseColorSpace;
			Colors = colors;
		}
	}
	public class DXPixelFormat : IEquatable<DXPixelFormat>
	{
		public static DXPixelFormat Gray1bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format1Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, DXAlpha.No);

		public static DXPixelFormat Gray4bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format4Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, DXAlpha.No);

		public static DXPixelFormat Gray8bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format8Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, DXAlpha.No);

		public static DXPixelFormat Indexed1bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format1Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, DXAlpha.No, indexed: true);

		public static DXPixelFormat Indexed4bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format4Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, DXAlpha.No, indexed: true);

		public static DXPixelFormat Indexed8bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format8Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, DXAlpha.No, indexed: true);

		public static DXPixelFormat RGB24bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format24Bpp, DXColorSpace.RGB, DXAlpha.No);

		public static DXPixelFormat RGB32bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format32Bpp, DXColorSpace.RGB, DXAlpha.No);

		public static DXPixelFormat ARGB32bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format32Bpp, DXColorSpace.RGB, DXAlpha.Unpremul);

		public static DXPixelFormat ARGB32bppPremultiplied { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format32Bpp, DXColorSpace.RGB, DXAlpha.Premul);

		public static DXPixelFormat CMYK32bpp { get; } = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format32Bpp, DXColorSpace.CMYK, DXAlpha.No);

		public DXBitsPerPixel BitsPerPixel { get; }

		public DXColorSpace ColorSpace { get; }

		public DXAlpha Alpha { get; }

		public bool Indexed { get; }

		public static bool operator ==(DXPixelFormat first, DXPixelFormat second)
		{
			if ((object)first == second)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return first?.Equals(second) ?? false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DXPixelFormat first, DXPixelFormat second)
		{
			if ((object)first == null)
			{
				return (object)second != null;
			}
			return !first.Equals(second);
		}

		public DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel bitsPerPixel, DXColorSpace colorSpace, DXAlpha alpha, bool indexed = false)
		{
			BitsPerPixel = bitsPerPixel;
			ColorSpace = colorSpace;
			Alpha = alpha;
			Indexed = indexed;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as DXPixelFormat);
		}

		public bool Equals(DXPixelFormat other)
		{
			if (other != null && BitsPerPixel == other.BitsPerPixel && ColorSpace == other.ColorSpace && Alpha == other.Alpha)
			{
				return Indexed == other.Indexed;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, int, int, bool>((int)BitsPerPixel, (int)ColorSpace, (int)Alpha, Indexed);
		}
	}

	public class DXRegionDataNodeComplex : DXRegionDataNode
	{
		public DXRegionDataNode Left { get; }

		public DXRegionDataNode Right { get; }

		public DXRegionDataCombineMode CombineMode { get; }

		public override bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				switch (CombineMode)
				{
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Intersect:
					if (!Left.IsEmpty)
					{
						return Right.IsEmpty;
					}
					return true;
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Union:
					if (Left.IsEmpty)
					{
						return Right.IsEmpty;
					}
					return false;
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.XOR:
					if (!Left.IsEmpty || !Right.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (Left.IsInfinite)
						{
							return Right.IsInfinite;
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Exclude:
					if (!Left.IsEmpty)
					{
						return Right.IsInfinite;
					}
					return true;
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Complement:
					if (!Left.IsInfinite)
					{
						return Right.IsEmpty;
					}
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool IsInfinite
		{
			get
			{
				switch (CombineMode)
				{
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Intersect:
					if (Left.IsInfinite)
					{
						return Right.IsInfinite;
					}
					return false;
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Union:
					if (!Left.IsInfinite)
					{
						return Right.IsInfinite;
					}
					return true;
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.XOR:
					if (!Left.IsInfinite || !Right.IsEmpty)
					{
						if (Left.IsEmpty)
						{
							return Right.IsInfinite;
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Exclude:
					if (Left.IsInfinite)
					{
						return Right.IsEmpty;
					}
					return false;
				case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Complement:
					if (Left.IsEmpty)
					{
						return Right.IsInfinite;
					}
					return false;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public DXRegionDataNodeComplex(DXRegionDataNode left, DXRegionDataNode right, DXRegionDataCombineMode combineMode)
		{
			Left = left;
			Right = right;
			CombineMode = combineMode;
		}

		public override DXRegionDataNode Transform(DXMatrix transformMatrix)
		{
			return new DXRegionDataNodeComplex(Left.Transform(transformMatrix), Right.Transform(transformMatrix), CombineMode);
		}

		public override void Accept(IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}

		public override bool IsEmpty => true;

		private DXRegionDataNodeEmpty()

		}

	public abstract class DXRegionDataNode
	{
		public virtual bool IsEmpty => false;

		public virtual bool IsInfinite => false;

		public abstract DXRegionDataNode Transform(DXMatrix transformMatrix);

		public abstract void Accept(IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor visitor);

		public DXRegionDataNode Combine(DXRegionDataNode right, DXRegionDataCombineMode combineMode)
		{
			DXRegionDataNodeComplex dXRegionDataNodeComplex = new DXRegionDataNodeComplex(this, right, combineMode);
			if (dXRegionDataNodeComplex.IsInfinite)
			{
				return DXRegionDataNodeInfinite.Instance;
			}
			if (dXRegionDataNodeComplex.IsEmpty)
			{
				return DXRegionDataNodeEmpty.Instance;
			}
			switch (combineMode)
			{
			case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Intersect:
				if (IsInfinite)
				{
					return right;
				}
				if (right.IsInfinite)
				{
					return this;
				}
				break;
			case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Union:
				if (IsEmpty)
				{
					return right;
				}
				if (right.IsEmpty)
				{
					return this;
				}
				break;
			case DXRegionDataCombineMode.XOR:
				if (IsEmpty)
				{
					return right;
				}
				if (right.IsEmpty)
				{
					return this;
				}
				break;
			case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Exclude:
				if (right.IsEmpty)
				{
					return this;
				}
				break;
			case DXRegionDataCombineMode.Complement:
				if (IsEmpty)
				{
					return right;
				}
				break;
			}
			return dXRegionDataNodeComplex;
		}
	}
	public class DXRegionDataNodePath : DXRegionDataNode
	{
		public DXGraphicsPathData PathData { get; }

		public DXRegionDataNodePath(PointF[] points, byte[] types, bool isWindingFillMode)
		{
			PathData = new DXGraphicsPathData(points, SystemDrawingConverter.ConvertPathPointTypes(types), isWindingFillMode ? DXFillMode.Winding : DXFillMode.Alternate);
		}

		public DXRegionDataNodePath(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types, DXFillMode fillMode)
		{
			PathData = new DXGraphicsPathData(points, types, fillMode);
		}

		public DXRegionDataNodePath(DXGraphicsPathData pathData)
		{
			PathData = pathData;
		}

		public override DXRegionDataNode Transform(DXMatrix transformMatrix)
		{
			IReadOnlyList<PointF> points = transformMatrix.TransformPoints(PathData.PathPoints);
			return new DXRegionDataNodePath(new DXGraphicsPathData(points, PathData.PathTypes, PathData.FillMode));
		}

		public override void Accept(IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}
	public class DXRegionDataNodeRectangle : DXRegionDataNode
	{
		public RectangleF Rectangle { get; }

		private static bool IsZeroComponent(float component)
		{
			return Math.Abs(component) < float.Epsilon;
		}

		public DXRegionDataNodeRectangle(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			Rectangle = rectangle;
		}

		public override DXRegionDataNode Transform(DXMatrix transformMatrix)
		{
			if ((IsZeroComponent(transformMatrix.A) && IsZeroComponent(transformMatrix.D)) || (IsZeroComponent(transformMatrix.B) && IsZeroComponent(transformMatrix.C)))
			{
				IReadOnlyList<PointF> readOnlyList = transformMatrix.TransformPoints(new List<PointF>
				{
					new PointF(Rectangle.Left, Rectangle.Top),
					new PointF(Rectangle.Right, Rectangle.Bottom)
				});
				return new DXRegionDataNodeRectangle(RectangleF.FromLTRB(Math.Min(readOnlyList[0].X, readOnlyList[1].X), Math.Min(readOnlyList[0].Y, readOnlyList[1].Y), Math.Max(readOnlyList[0].X, readOnlyList[1].X), Math.Max(readOnlyList[0].Y, readOnlyList[1].Y)));
			}
			DXGraphicsPathBuilder dXGraphicsPathBuilder = new DXGraphicsPathBuilder();
			dXGraphicsPathBuilder.AddRectangle(Rectangle);
			dXGraphicsPathBuilder.Transform(transformMatrix);
			return new DXRegionDataNodePath(dXGraphicsPathBuilder.GetPathData());
		}

		public override void Accept(IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor visitor)
		{
			visitor.Visit(this);
		}
	}
	public interface IDXRegionDataNodeVisitor
	{
		void Visit(DXRegionDataNodeRectangle node);

		void Visit(DXRegionDataNodePath node);

		void Visit(DXRegionDataNodeEmpty node);

		void Visit(DXRegionDataNodeInfinite node);

		void Visit(DXRegionDataNodeComplex node);
	}

	public abstract class DXToPlatformDrawingCache<TDX, TPlatform> : IDisposable
	{
		private Dictionary<int, TPlatform> cache = new Dictionary<int, TPlatform>();

		private static TValue GetOrAdd<TValue>(IDictionary<int, TValue> dictionary, int key, Func<TValue> valueFactory)
		{
			if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				value = (dictionary[key] = valueFactory());
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void Clear<TKey, TValue>(Dictionary<TKey, TValue> dictionary)
		{
			foreach (TValue value in dictionary.Values)
			{
				(value as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
			}
			dictionary.Clear();
		}

		protected abstract TPlatform CreatePlatformValue(TDX dxValue);

		protected abstract int GetKey(TDX dxValue);

		protected TPlatform GetPlatformValue(TDX dxValue)
		{
			lock (cache)
			{
				return GetOrAdd(cache, GetKey(dxValue), () => CreatePlatformValue(dxValue));
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (cache != null)
			{
				Clear(cache);
				cache = null;
			}
		}
	}

		}
