	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public static class SystemDrawingConverter
	{
		private static string GetInvalidCastMessage(Type from, Type to, string additionalInfo = null)
		{
			string text = $"Unable to cast object of type '{from}' to type {to}.";
			if (additionalInfo != null)
			{
				text = text + " " + additionalInfo;
			}
			return text;
		}

		private static DashCap ToGDIPlusDashCap(DXDashCap cap)
		{
			return cap switch
			{
				DXDashCap.Flat => DashCap.Flat, 
				DXDashCap.Round => DashCap.Round, 
				DXDashCap.Triangle => DashCap.Triangle, 
				_ => DashCap.Flat, 
			};
		}

		public static IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> ConvertPathPointTypes(byte[] types)
		{
			DXPathPointType[] array = new DXPathPointType[types.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < types.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (DXPathPointType)types[i];
			}
			return array;
		}

		public static PixelFormat ConvertPixelFormat(DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Gray1bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format1bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Gray4bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format4bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Gray8bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Indexed1bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format1bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Indexed4bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format4bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.Indexed8bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.RGB24bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.RGB32bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bpp)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.ARGB32bppPremultiplied)
			{
				return PixelFormat.Format32bppPArgb;
			}
			if (pixelFormat == DXPixelFormat.CMYK32bpp)
			{
				return (PixelFormat)8207;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("Specific pixel format is not supported");
		}

		public static Brush CreateBrush(DXBrush dxBrush)
		{
			if (dxBrush == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXSolidBrush dXSolidBrush)
			{
				return new SolidBrush(dXSolidBrush.Color);
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXHatchBrush dXHatchBrush)
			{
				return new HatchBrush((HatchStyle)dXHatchBrush.HatchStyle, dXHatchBrush.ForegroundColor, dXHatchBrush.BackgroundColor);
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXLinearGradientBrush brush)
			{
				return CreateFromDXLinearGradientBrush(brush);
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXPathGradientBrush brush2)
			{
				return CreateFromDXPathGradientBrush(brush2);
			}
			if (dxBrush is DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush)
			{
				TextureBrush textureBrush = new TextureBrush(UnwrapImage(dXTextureBrush.Image), (WrapMode)dXTextureBrush.WrapMode);
				float[] elements = dXTextureBrush.Transform.Elements;
				if (elements[0] != 0f && elements[3] != 0f)
				{
					using Matrix transform = CreateMatrix(dXTextureBrush.Transform);
					textureBrush.Transform = transform;
				}
				return textureBrush;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Custom brushes are not supported.", "brush");
		}

		public static DXBrush CreateDXBrush(Brush brush)
		{
			if (brush == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (brush is SolidBrush solidBrush)
			{
				return new DXSolidBrush(solidBrush.Color);
			}
			if (brush is HatchBrush hatchBrush)
			{
				return new DXHatchBrush((DXHatchStyle)hatchBrush.HatchStyle, hatchBrush.ForegroundColor, hatchBrush.BackgroundColor);
			}
			if (brush is LinearGradientBrush brush2)
			{
				return CreateFromLinearGradientBrush(brush2);
			}
			if (brush is PathGradientBrush brush3)
			{
				return CreateFromPathGradientBrush(brush3);
			}
			if (brush is TextureBrush textureBrush)
			{
				DXTextureBrush dXTextureBrush = new DXTextureBrush(GdiPlusImage.Wrap((Image)textureBrush.Image.Clone()), (DXWrapMode)textureBrush.WrapMode);
				using Matrix matrix = textureBrush.Transform;
				dXTextureBrush.Transform = CreateDXMatrix(matrix);
				return dXTextureBrush;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Custom brushes are not supported.", "brush");
		}

		public static Pen CreatePen(DXPen dxPen)
		{
			if (dxPen == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Pen pen = new Pen(CreateBrush(dxPen.Brush), dxPen.Width)
			{
				Alignment = (PenAlignment)dxPen.Alignment,
				StartCap = (LineCap)dxPen.StartCap,
				EndCap = (LineCap)dxPen.EndCap,
				DashStyle = (DashStyle)dxPen.DashStyle,
				DashOffset = dxPen.DashOffset,
				LineJoin = (LineJoin)dxPen.LineJoin,
				DashCap = ToGDIPlusDashCap(dxPen.DashCap),
				MiterLimit = dxPen.MiterLimit,
				Transform = CreateMatrix(dxPen.Transform)
			};
			if (dxPen.DashStyle == DXDashStyle.Custom && dxPen.DashPattern != null)
			{
				pen.DashPattern = dxPen.DashPattern;
			}
			if (dxPen.StartCap == DXLineCap.Custom)
			{
				CustomLineCap customLineCap = CreateCustomCap(dxPen.CustomStartCap);
				if (customLineCap != null)
				{
					pen.CustomStartCap = customLineCap;
				}
			}
			if (dxPen.EndCap == DXLineCap.Custom)
			{
				CustomLineCap customLineCap2 = CreateCustomCap(dxPen.CustomEndCap);
				if (customLineCap2 != null)
				{
					pen.CustomEndCap = customLineCap2;
				}
			}
			float[] compoundArray = dxPen.CompoundArray;
			if (compoundArray != null)
			{
				pen.CompoundArray = compoundArray;
			}
			return pen;
		}

		private static CustomLineCap CreateCustomCap(DXCustomLineCapBase customLineCap)
		{
			if (customLineCap is DXAdjustableArrowCap dXAdjustableArrowCap)
			{
				return new AdjustableArrowCap(dXAdjustableArrowCap.Width, dXAdjustableArrowCap.Height)
				{
					WidthScale = dXAdjustableArrowCap.WidthScale,
					Filled = dXAdjustableArrowCap.Filled
				};
			}
			DXCustomLineCap dXCustomLineCap = customLineCap as DXCustomLineCap;
			if (dXCustomLineCap?.FillPath != null || dXCustomLineCap?.StrokePath != null)
			{
				return new CustomLineCap(UnwrapGraphicsPathData(dXCustomLineCap.FillPath), UnwrapGraphicsPathData(dXCustomLineCap.StrokePath), (LineCap)dXCustomLineCap.BaseCap, dXCustomLineCap.BaseInset)
				{
					WidthScale = dXCustomLineCap.WidthScale
				};
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static DXPen CreateDXPen(Pen pen)
		{
			DXPen dXPen = new DXPen(CreateDXBrush(pen.Brush), pen.Width)
			{
				Alignment = (DXPenAlignment)pen.Alignment,
				StartCap = (DXLineCap)pen.StartCap,
				EndCap = (DXLineCap)pen.EndCap,
				MiterLimit = pen.MiterLimit,
				DashCap = (DXDashCap)pen.DashCap,
				DashStyle = (DXDashStyle)pen.DashStyle,
				DashOffset = pen.DashOffset,
				LineJoin = (DXLineJoin)pen.LineJoin,
				Transform = CreateDXMatrix(pen.Transform)
			};
			if (pen.DashStyle == DashStyle.Custom)
			{
				dXPen.DashPattern = pen.DashPattern;
			}
			if (pen.StartCap == LineCap.Custom)
			{
				dXPen.CustomStartCap = CreateDXCustomCap(pen.CustomStartCap);
			}
			if (pen.EndCap == LineCap.Custom)
			{
				dXPen.CustomEndCap = CreateDXCustomCap(pen.CustomEndCap);
			}
			float[] compoundArray = pen.CompoundArray;
			if (compoundArray != null && compoundArray.Length != 0)
			{
				dXPen.CompoundArray = pen.CompoundArray;
			}
			return dXPen;
		}

		private static DXCustomLineCapBase CreateDXCustomCap(CustomLineCap customLineCap)
		{
			if (customLineCap is AdjustableArrowCap adjustableArrowCap)
			{
				return new DXAdjustableArrowCap(adjustableArrowCap.Width, adjustableArrowCap.Height, adjustableArrowCap.WidthScale, adjustableArrowCap.Filled);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Font CreateFont(DXFont dxFont, GdiPlusFontProvider localFontProvider = null)
		{
			Font font = localFontProvider?.GetFont(dxFont.Name, dxFont.Size, (FontStyle)dxFont.Style, (GraphicsUnit)dxFont.Unit);
			if (font == null && !DXFontRepository.Instance.IsEmpty)
			{
				GdiPlusFontProvider fontProvider = DXFontRepository.Instance.GetFontProvider<GdiPlusFontProvider>();
				font = fontProvider.GetFont(dxFont.Name, dxFont.Size, (FontStyle)dxFont.Style, (GraphicsUnit)dxFont.Unit);
			}
			if (font == null)
			{
				byte gdiCharSet = dxFont.AdditionalProperties.GetGdiCharSet();
				bool gdiVerticalFont = dxFont.AdditionalProperties.GetGdiVerticalFont();
				font = new Font(dxFont.Name, dxFont.Size, (FontStyle)dxFont.Style, (GraphicsUnit)dxFont.Unit, gdiCharSet, gdiVerticalFont);
			}
			return font;
		}

		public static DXFont CreateDXFont(Font font)
		{
			DXFont dXFont = new DXFont(font.Name, font.Size, (DXFontStyle)font.Style, (DXGraphicsUnit)font.Unit);
			if (font.GdiCharSet != 1)
			{
				dXFont.AdditionalProperties.Add(new DXFontAdditionalProperty("GdiCharSet", font.GdiCharSet));
			}
			if (font.GdiVerticalFont)
			{
				dXFont.AdditionalProperties.Add(new DXFontAdditionalProperty("GdiVerticalFont", font.GdiVerticalFont));
			}
			return dXFont;
		}

		public static Matrix CreateMatrix(DXMatrix dxMatrix)
		{
			if (dxMatrix == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			float[] elements = dxMatrix.Elements;
			return new Matrix(elements[0], elements[1], elements[2], elements[3], elements[4], elements[5]);
		}

		public static DXMatrix CreateDXMatrix(Matrix matrix)
		{
			if (matrix != null)
			{
				return new DXMatrix(matrix.Elements);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static Margins CreateMargins(DXMargins dxMargins)
		{
			return new Margins(Convert.ToInt32(dxMargins.Left), Convert.ToInt32(dxMargins.Right), Convert.ToInt32(dxMargins.Top), Convert.ToInt32(dxMargins.Bottom));
		}

		public static DXMargins CreateDXMargins(Margins margins)
		{
			return new DXMargins(margins.Left, margins.Right, margins.Top, margins.Bottom);
		}

		public static StringFormat GetStringFormatByPrototypeKind(DXStringFormatPrototypeKind prototypeKind)
		{
			if (prototypeKind == DXStringFormatPrototypeKind.GenericTypographic)
			{
				return StringFormat.GenericTypographic;
			}
			return StringFormat.GenericDefault;
		}

		public static StringFormat CreateStringFormat(DXStringFormat dXStringFormat)
		{
			StringFormat stringFormat = new StringFormat(GetStringFormatByPrototypeKind(dXStringFormat.PrototypeKind));
			stringFormat.FormatFlags = (StringFormatFlags)dXStringFormat.FormatFlags;
			stringFormat.Alignment = (StringAlignment)dXStringFormat.Alignment;
			stringFormat.LineAlignment = (StringAlignment)dXStringFormat.LineAlignment;
			stringFormat.Trimming = (StringTrimming)dXStringFormat.Trimming;
			stringFormat.HotkeyPrefix = (HotkeyPrefix)dXStringFormat.HotkeyPrefix;
			if (dXStringFormat.TabStops != null)
			{
				stringFormat.SetTabStops(0f, dXStringFormat.TabStops);
			}
			return stringFormat;
		}

		public static DXStringFormat CreateDXStringFormat(StringFormat stringFormat, DXStringFormatPrototypeKind prototypeKind)
		{
			DXStringFormat dXStringFormat = DXStringFormat.Create(prototypeKind);
			dXStringFormat.FormatFlags = (DXStringFormatFlags)stringFormat.FormatFlags;
			dXStringFormat.Alignment = (DXStringAlignment)stringFormat.Alignment;
			dXStringFormat.LineAlignment = (DXStringAlignment)stringFormat.LineAlignment;
			dXStringFormat.Trimming = (DXStringTrimming)stringFormat.Trimming;
			dXStringFormat.HotkeyPrefix = (DXHotkeyPrefix)stringFormat.HotkeyPrefix;
			float firstTabOffset;
			float[] tabStops = stringFormat.GetTabStops(out firstTabOffset);
			if (tabStops.Length != 0)
			{
				dXStringFormat.TabStops = tabStops;
			}
			return dXStringFormat;
		}

		internal static ImageAttributes CreateImageAttributes(DXImageAttributes attributes)
		{
			if (attributes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
			if (attributes.ColorMatrix != null)
			{
				imageAttributes.SetColorMatrix(CreateColorMatrix(attributes.ColorMatrix), ColorMatrixFlag.Default, ColorAdjustType.Bitmap);
			}
			if (attributes.RemapTable != null && attributes.RemapTable.Length != 0)
			{
				ColorMap[] array = new ColorMap[attributes.RemapTable.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < attributes.RemapTable.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = new ColorMap
					{
						NewColor = attributes.RemapTable[i].NewColor,
						OldColor = attributes.RemapTable[i].OldColor
					};
				}
				imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(array, ColorAdjustType.Bitmap);
			}
			if (attributes.WrapMode.HasValue)
			{
				imageAttributes.SetWrapMode((WrapMode)attributes.WrapMode.Value);
			}
			return imageAttributes;
		}

		internal static ColorMatrix CreateColorMatrix(DXColorMatrix colorMatrix)
		{
			return new ColorMatrix(colorMatrix.Matrix);
		}

		private static DXLinearGradientBrush CreateFromLinearGradientBrush(LinearGradientBrush brush)
		{
			DXLinearGradientBrush dXLinearGradientBrush = new DXLinearGradientBrush(brush.Rectangle, brush.LinearColors[0], brush.LinearColors[1]);
			dXLinearGradientBrush.WrapMode = (DXWrapMode)brush.WrapMode;
			dXLinearGradientBrush.GammaCorrection = brush.GammaCorrection;
			using (Matrix matrix = brush.Transform)
			{
				dXLinearGradientBrush.Transform = CreateDXMatrix(matrix);
			}
			if (brush.Blend == null)
			{
				DXColorBlend dXColorBlend = new DXColorBlend();
				ColorBlend interpolationColors = brush.InterpolationColors;
				dXColorBlend.Positions = interpolationColors.Positions.ToArray();
				dXColorBlend.Colors = interpolationColors.Colors.ToArray();
				dXLinearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = dXColorBlend;
			}
			else
			{
				DXBlend dXBlend = new DXBlend();
				dXBlend.Positions = brush.Blend.Positions.ToArray();
				dXBlend.Factors = brush.Blend.Factors.ToArray();
				dXLinearGradientBrush.Blend = dXBlend;
			}
			return dXLinearGradientBrush;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static DXPathGradientBrush CreateFromPathGradientBrushViaMetafile(PathGradientBrush brush)
		{
			DXPathGradientBrush result = null;
			using Bitmap image = new Bitmap(1, 1);
			using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image);
			IntPtr hdc = graphics.GetHdc();
			using (MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream())
			{
				using (Metafile image2 = new Metafile(memoryStream, hdc, EmfType.EmfPlusOnly))
				{
					using Graphics graphics2 = Graphics.FromImage(image2);
					graphics2.FillRectangle(brush, new Rectangle(0, 0, 100, 100));
				}
				EmfMetafileModel emfMetafileModel = EmfMetafileModel.Create(memoryStream.ToArray());
				if (emfMetafileModel != null)
				{
					foreach (EmfRecord record in emfMetafileModel.Records)
					{
						if (!(record is EmfCommentEmfPlusRecord emfCommentEmfPlusRecord))
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (EmfPlusRecord record2 in emfCommentEmfPlusRecord.Records)
						{
							if (record2 is EmfPlusObjectRecord emfPlusObjectRecord)
							{
								if (!(EmfPlusObject.CreateObject(emfPlusObjectRecord.ObjectType, emfPlusObjectRecord.ObjectData) is EmfPlusBrush emfPlusBrush))
								{
									return null;
								}
								result = emfPlusBrush.Brush as DXPathGradientBrush;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			graphics.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
			return result;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static DXPathGradientBrush CreateFromPathGradientBrush(PathGradientBrush brush)
		{
			return CreateFromPathGradientBrushViaMetafile(brush);
		}

		private static LinearGradientBrush CreateFromDXLinearGradientBrush(DXLinearGradientBrush brush)
		{
			LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(brush.Rectangle, brush.LinearColors[0], brush.LinearColors[1], LinearGradientMode.Horizontal)
			{
				WrapMode = (WrapMode)brush.WrapMode,
				GammaCorrection = brush.GammaCorrection
			};
			using (Matrix transform = CreateMatrix(brush.Transform))
			{
				linearGradientBrush.Transform = transform;
			}
			if (brush.Blend == null)
			{
				linearGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = FromDXColorBlend(brush.InterpolationColors);
			}
			else
			{
				linearGradientBrush.Blend = FromDXBlend(brush.Blend);
			}
			return linearGradientBrush;
		}

		private static ColorBlend FromDXColorBlend(DXColorBlend colorBlend)
		{
			return new ColorBlend
			{
				Positions = colorBlend.Positions.ToArray(),
				Colors = colorBlend.Colors.ToArray()
			};
		}

		private static Blend FromDXBlend(DXBlend blend)
		{
			return new Blend
			{
				Positions = blend.Positions.ToArray(),
				Factors = blend.Factors.ToArray()
			};
		}

		private static PathGradientBrush CreateBrushCore(DXPathGradientBrush brush)
		{
			try
			{
				return new PathGradientBrush(UnwrapGraphicsPathData(brush.PathData));
			}
			catch
			{
				return new PathGradientBrush(new PointF[3]
				{
					new Point(0, 0),
					new Point(1, 1),
					new Point(2, 2)
				});
			}
		}

		private static PathGradientBrush CreateFromDXPathGradientBrush(DXPathGradientBrush brush)
		{
			PathGradientBrush pathGradientBrush = CreateBrushCore(brush);
			pathGradientBrush.CenterColor = brush.CenterColor;
			pathGradientBrush.WrapMode = (WrapMode)brush.WrapMode;
			pathGradientBrush.FocusScales = brush.FocusScales;
			if (brush.CenterPoint.HasValue)
			{
				pathGradientBrush.CenterPoint = brush.CenterPoint.Value;
			}
			if (brush.Blend != null)
			{
				pathGradientBrush.Blend = FromDXBlend(brush.Blend);
			}
			if (brush.InterpolationColors != null)
			{
				pathGradientBrush.InterpolationColors = FromDXColorBlend(brush.InterpolationColors);
			}
			if (brush.SurroundColors != null)
			{
				pathGradientBrush.SurroundColors = brush.SurroundColors;
			}
			using Matrix transform = CreateMatrix(brush.Transform);
			pathGradientBrush.Transform = transform;
			return pathGradientBrush;
		}

		public static GraphicsPath UnwrapGraphicsPathData(DXGraphicsPathData pathData)
		{
			if (pathData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new GraphicsPath(pathData.PathPoints.ToArray(), pathData.PathTypes.Select((DXPathPointType pd) => (byte)pd).ToArray(), (FillMode)pathData.FillMode);
		}

		public static GraphicsPath UnwrapGraphicsPath(DXGraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			if (graphicsPath == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (graphicsPath.Implementation is GdiPlusGraphicsPath path)
			{
				return GdiPlusGraphicsPath.Unwrap(path);
			}
			throw new InvalidCastException(GetInvalidCastMessage(typeof(DXGraphicsPath), typeof(GraphicsPath)));
		}

		public static DXGraphicsPath WrapGraphicsPath(GraphicsPath graphicsPath)
		{
			if (graphicsPath == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GdiPlusGraphicsPath.Wrap(graphicsPath);
		}

		public static Image UnwrapImage(DXImage image, bool throwException = true)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (image.Implementation is GdiPlusImage gdiPlusImage)
			{
				return gdiPlusImage.Unwrap(cloneImage: false);
			}
			if (!throwException)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string additionalInfo = (DXDrawingEngine.IsGDIPlusAvailable ? "Use the DevExpress.Drawing.Extensions.DXImageExtensions.ConvertToGdiPlusImage method to convert DXImage object to Image." : null);
			throw new InvalidCastException(GetInvalidCastMessage(typeof(DXImage), typeof(Image), additionalInfo));
		}

		public static DXImage WrapImage(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GdiPlusImage.Wrap(image);
		}

		public static Region UnwrapRegion(DXRegion region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (region.Implementation is GdiPlusRegion)
			{
				return GdiPlusRegion.Unwrap(region);
			}
			throw new InvalidCastException(GetInvalidCastMessage(typeof(DXRegion), typeof(Region)));
		}

		public static DXRegion WrapRegion(Region region)
		{
			if (region == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GdiPlusRegion.Wrap(region);
		}

		public static DXRegionDataNode CreateRegionData(Region region)
		{
			try
			{
				byte[] data = region.GetRegionData().Data;
				using EmfPlusReader emfPlusReader = new EmfPlusReader(new MemoryStream(data));
				emfPlusReader.BaseStream.Position = 8L;
				EmfPlusRegion emfPlusRegion = new EmfPlusRegion(emfPlusReader);
				return emfPlusRegion.RegionData;
			}
			catch
			{
				return DXRegionDataNodeEmpty.Instance;
			}
		}

		}

	public class SystemDrawingGlobalCache : IDisposable
	{
		private SystemDrawingBrushCache brushCache;

		private SystemDrawingPenCache penCache;

		private SystemDrawingStringFormatCache stringFormatCache;

		private SystemDrawingFontCache fontCache;

		public SystemDrawingGlobalCache(IFontProvider fontProvider = null)
		{
			brushCache = new SystemDrawingBrushCache();
			penCache = new SystemDrawingPenCache();
			stringFormatCache = new SystemDrawingStringFormatCache();
			fontCache = new SystemDrawingFontCache(fontProvider);
		}

		public Brush GetBrush(DXBrush dxBrush)
		{
			return brushCache.GetBrush(dxBrush);
		}

		public Pen GetPen(DXPen dxPen)
		{
			return penCache.GetPen(dxPen);
		}

		public StringFormat GetStringFormat(DXStringFormat dxStringFormat)
		{
			return stringFormatCache.GetStringFormat(dxStringFormat);
		}

		public Font GetFont(DXFont dxFont)
		{
			return fontCache.GetFont(dxFont);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (brushCache != null)
			{
				brushCache.Dispose();
				brushCache = null;
			}
			if (penCache != null)
			{
				penCache.Dispose();
				penCache = null;
			}
			if (stringFormatCache != null)
			{
				stringFormatCache.Dispose();
				stringFormatCache = null;
			}
			if (fontCache != null)
			{
				fontCache.Dispose();
				fontCache = null;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class BlendHelper
	{
		internal static DXBlend Clone(DXBlend blend)
		{
			if (blend == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXBlend dXBlend = new DXBlend();
			float[] factors = blend.Factors;
			dXBlend.Factors = new float[factors.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < factors.Length; i++)
			{
				dXBlend.Factors[i] = factors[i];
			}
			float[] positions = blend.Positions;
			dXBlend.Positions = new float[positions.Length];
			for (int j = 0; j < positions.Length; j++)
			{
				dXBlend.Positions[j] = positions[j];
			}
			return dXBlend;
		}

		internal static Color InterpolateColor(Color start, Color end, float factor)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(InterpolateComponent(start.R, end.R, factor), InterpolateComponent(start.G, end.G, factor), InterpolateComponent(start.B, end.B, factor));
		}

		private static byte InterpolateComponent(byte start, byte end, float factor)
		{
			return (byte)((float)(int)start + (float)(end - start) * factor);
		}
	}
	public class DXBitmapCreator
	{
		private class SizeInfo
		{
			internal int Width { get; private set; }

			internal int Height { get; private set; }

			internal bool IsSizeLimited { get; private set; }

			public SizeInfo(Size size, bool isSizeLimited)
			{
				Width = size.Width;
				Height = size.Height;
				IsSizeLimited = isSizeLimited;
			}
		}

		private const int defaultMaxResolution = 600;

		private const int defaultMinResolution = 96;

		public const int MaxImageSampleCount = 13107000;

		private static SizeInfo LimitBitmapSize(int width, int height)
		{
			if (width * height <= 13107000)
			{
				return new SizeInfo(new Size(width, height), isSizeLimited: false);
			}
			double num = Math.Sqrt(13107000.0 / ((double)width / (double)height));
			double a = 13107000.0 / num;
			return new SizeInfo(new Size((int)Math.Ceiling(a), (int)Math.Ceiling(num)), isSizeLimited: true);
		}

		private static float GetActualResolution(float resolution, bool limitResolution)
		{
			float num = Math.Max(resolution, 96f);
			if (limitResolution)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, 600f);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void CopyContentFromSource(DXImage original, DXBitmap newBitmap, Color backgroundColor, bool useImageSize)
		{
			CopyContentFromSourceCore(original, newBitmap, useImageSize, delegate(IDXGraphics graphics)
			{
				if (!DXColor.IsEmpty(backgroundColor))
				{
					graphics.Clear(backgroundColor);
				}
			});
		}

		private static void CopyContentFromSource(DXImage original, DXBitmap newBitmap, bool useImageSize)
		{
			CopyContentFromSourceCore(original, newBitmap, useImageSize, delegate(IDXGraphics graphics)
			{
				graphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
			});
		}

		private static void CopyContentFromSourceCore(DXImage original, DXBitmap newBitmap, bool useImageSize, Action<IDXGraphics> prepareGraphics)
		{
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = newBitmap.CreateGraphics();
			prepareGraphics(iDXGraphics);
			if (useImageSize)
			{
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(original, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, newBitmap.Size));
			}
			else
			{
				iDXGraphics.DrawImage(original, 0, 0);
			}
		}

		public static DXBitmap Create(DXImage image, Color backgroundColor)
		{
			if (image is DXBitmap)
			{
				return CreateFromBitmap((DXBitmap)image, backgroundColor);
			}
			if (image is DXMetafile)
			{
				return CreateFromMetafile((DXMetafile)image, backgroundColor);
			}
			if (image is DXSvgImage)
			{
				return CreateFromSvgImage((DXSvgImage)image, backgroundColor);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateFromBitmap(DXBitmap bitmap, Color backgroundColor)
		{
			return CreateFromBitmapSimple(bitmap, backgroundColor);
		}

		private static DXBitmap CreateFromBitmapSimple(DXBitmap bitmap, Color backgroundColor)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height);
			dXBitmap.SetResolution(bitmap.HorizontalResolution, bitmap.VerticalResolution);
			CopyContentFromSource(bitmap, dXBitmap, backgroundColor, useImageSize: false);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateFromMetafile(DXMetafile metafile, Color backgroundColor, float resolution = 96f, bool limitResolution = false)
		{
			float actualResolution = GetActualResolution(resolution, limitResolution);
			int width = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(metafile.Width, metafile.HorizontalResolution, actualResolution);
			int height = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(metafile.Height, metafile.VerticalResolution, actualResolution);
			SizeInfo sizeInfo = LimitBitmapSize(width, height);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height);
			dXBitmap.SetResolution(actualResolution, actualResolution);
			CopyContentFromSource(metafile, dXBitmap, backgroundColor, sizeInfo.IsSizeLimited);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateFromMetafile(DXMetafile metafile, int width, int height, float resolution = 96f, bool limitResolution = false)
		{
			float actualResolution = GetActualResolution(resolution, limitResolution);
			SizeInfo sizeInfo = LimitBitmapSize(width, height);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height);
			CopyContentFromSource(metafile, dXBitmap, useImageSize: true);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateFromSvgImage(DXSvgImage svgImage, Color backgroundColor, float resolution = 96f, bool limitResolution = false)
		{
			float actualResolution = GetActualResolution(resolution, limitResolution);
			int width = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(svgImage.Width, svgImage.HorizontalResolution, actualResolution);
			int height = DXGraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(svgImage.Height, svgImage.VerticalResolution, actualResolution);
			SizeInfo sizeInfo = LimitBitmapSize(width, height);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height);
			dXBitmap.SetResolution(svgImage.HorizontalResolution, svgImage.VerticalResolution);
			CopyContentFromSource(svgImage, dXBitmap, backgroundColor, useImageSize: true);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateFromSvgImage(DXSvgImage svgImage, int width, int height, float resolution = 96f, bool limitResolution = false)
		{
			float actualResolution = GetActualResolution(resolution, limitResolution);
			SizeInfo sizeInfo = LimitBitmapSize(width, height);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(sizeInfo.Width, sizeInfo.Height);
			dXBitmap.SetResolution(actualResolution, actualResolution);
			CopyContentFromSource(svgImage, dXBitmap, useImageSize: true);
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateFromImage(DXImage image, DXColorMatrix colorMatrix)
		{
			DXImageAttributes imageAttributes = new DXImageAttributes
			{
				ColorMatrix = colorMatrix
			};
			return CreateFromImage(image, imageAttributes);
		}

		public static DXBitmap CreateFromImage(DXImage image, DXColorMap[] colorMap)
		{
			DXImageAttributes imageAttributes = new DXImageAttributes
			{
				RemapTable = colorMap
			};
			return CreateFromImage(image, imageAttributes);
		}

		private static DXBitmap CreateFromImage(DXImage image, DXImageAttributes imageAttributes)
		{
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(image.Width, image.Height);
			dXBitmap.SetResolution(image.HorizontalResolution, image.VerticalResolution);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXBitmap.CreateGraphics();
			iDXGraphics.Clear(Color.Transparent);
			iDXGraphics.DrawImage(image, new Rectangle(Point.Empty, image.Size), new Rectangle(Point.Empty, image.Size), DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
			return dXBitmap;
		}
	}

	{

		public static void SaveImage(DXImage image, string path)
		{
			SaveImage(image, path, image.ImageFormat);
		}

		public static void SaveImage(DXImage image, string path, DXImageFormat imageFormat)

			image.Save(path, GetValidImageFormat(imageFormat));

		{
			SaveImage(image, stream, image.ImageFormat);

		public static DXImage LoadImageFromFile(string path)
		{
			using FileStream stream = File.OpenRead(path);
			return DXImage.FromStream(stream);
		}

		public static DXImage LoadImageFromBase64(string base64)
		{
			return ImageFromBytes(Convert.FromBase64String(base64));
		}

		public static string GetMimeType(DXImage image)
		{
			if (mimeHT.TryGetValue(image.ImageFormat, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return "image/png";
		}

		public static DXImageFormat GetValidImageFormat(ImageFormat format)
		{
			return GetValidImageFormat(ToDXImageFormat(format));
		}

		public static DXImageFormat GetValidImageFormat(DXImageFormat format)
		{
			return (format == DXImageFormat.Unknown) ? DXImageFormat.Png : format;
		}

		public static DXImageFormat ToDXImageFormat(ImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			if (imageFormat == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (imageFormat == ImageFormat.Png)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Png;
			}
			if (imageFormat == ImageFormat.Jpeg)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Jpeg;
			}
			if (imageFormat == ImageFormat.Bmp)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Bmp;
			}
			if (imageFormat == ImageFormat.Gif)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Gif;
			}
			if (imageFormat == ImageFormat.Tiff)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Tiff;
			}
			if (imageFormat == ImageFormat.Emf)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Emf;
			}
			if (imageFormat == ImageFormat.Wmf)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Wmf;
			}
			if (imageFormat == ImageFormat.Icon)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Icon;
			}
			return DXImageFormat.Unknown;
		}

		public static ImageFormat ToImageFormat(DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			if (imageFormat == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Gif)
			{
				return ImageFormat.Gif;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Jpeg)
			{
				return ImageFormat.Jpeg;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Bmp)
			{
				return ImageFormat.Bmp;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Tiff)
			{
				return ImageFormat.Tiff;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Emf)
			{
				return ImageFormat.Emf;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Wmf)
			{
				return ImageFormat.Wmf;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Icon)
			{
				return ImageFormat.Icon;
			}
			_ = DXImageFormat.Png;
			return ImageFormat.Png;
		}

		public static DXImage CreateBitmapWithImageFormat(int width, int height, float dpiX, float dpiY, DXImageFormat newImageFormat)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			using (DXBitmap dXBitmap = new DXBitmap(width, height))
			{
				DXImageFormat validNewImageFormat = GetValidNewImageFormat(newImageFormat);
				dXBitmap.Save(memoryStream, validNewImageFormat);
			}
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			DXBitmap dXBitmap2 = (DXBitmap)DXImage.FromStream(memoryStream);
			dXBitmap2.SetResolution(dpiX, dpiY);
			return dXBitmap2;
		}

		public static DXImageFormat GetValidNewImageFormat(DXImageFormat format)
		{
			if (format != DXImageFormat.Bmp && format != DXImageFormat.Jpeg && format != DXImageFormat.Png && format != DXImageFormat.Tiff)
			{
				return DXImageFormat.Png;
			}
			return format;
		}

		public static DXImage ChangeBitmapImageFormat(DXBitmap bitmap, DXImageFormat newImageFormat, bool allowDisposeOriginalImage = true)
		{
			DXImageFormat dXImageFormat = GetValidImageFormat(newImageFormat);
			if (bitmap.ImageFormat == dXImageFormat)
			{
				return bitmap;
			}
			if (dXImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Emf || dXImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Wmf)
			{
				dXImageFormat = DXImageFormat.Png;
			}
			MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
			bitmap.Save(stream, dXImageFormat);
			DXBitmap dXBitmap = (DXBitmap)DXImage.FromStream(stream);
			dXBitmap.SetResolution(bitmap.HorizontalResolution, bitmap.VerticalResolution);
			if (allowDisposeOriginalImage)
			{
				bitmap.Dispose();
			}
			return dXBitmap;
		}

		public static DXImage PatchMetafileResolution(DXMetafile dxMetafile, int newResolution, bool allowDisposeOriginalImage = true)
		{
			if (SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(dxMetafile, throwException: false) is Metafile metafile)
			{
				Metafile image = EmfMetafilePatcher.PatchResolution(metafile, newResolution, allowDisposeOriginalImage);
				return SystemDrawingConverter.WrapImage(image);
			}
			return dxMetafile;
		}

		public static byte[] GetImageBytes(DXImage image)
		{
			return GetImageBytes(image, image.ImageFormat);
		}

		public static byte[] GetImageBytes(DXImage image, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			return GetImageBytesInternal(image, imageFormat);
		}

		public static byte[] GetImageBytesInternal(DXImage image, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			lock (image.GetSyncObject())
			{
				image.Save(memoryStream, GetValidImageFormat(imageFormat));
			}
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		public static DXImage ImageFromBytes(byte[] buffer)
		{
			if (buffer == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXImage dXImage = null;
			if (buffer.Length > 78 && buffer[0] == 21 && buffer[1] == 28)
			{
				dXImage = ImageFromBytesCore(buffer, 78);
			}
			if (dXImage == null)
			{
				dXImage = ImageFromBytesCore(buffer, 0);
			}
			return dXImage;
		}

		private static DXImage ImageFromBytesCore(byte[] buffer, int offset)
		{
			try
			{
				MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream(buffer, offset, buffer.Length - offset);
				return DXImage.FromStream(stream);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static int GetHashCodeFromImageBytes(DXImage image)
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateByteList(GetImageBytes(image));
		}

		public static SizeF GetResolutionImageSize(DXImage img)
		{
			return GetResolutionImageSize(img, 96f);
		}

		public static SizeF GetResolutionImageSize(DXImage img, float dpi)
		{
			if (img == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("img");
			}
			SizeF sizeF;
			lock (img.GetSyncObject())
			{
				float horizontalResolution = img.HorizontalResolution;
				float verticalResolution = img.VerticalResolution;
				sizeF = new SizeF((float)img.Width / horizontalResolution, (float)img.Height / verticalResolution);
			}
			return GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(sizeF, 1f, dpi);
		}

		internal static object GetSyncObject(this DXImage dxImage)
		{
			return dxImage?.NativeImage ?? new object();
		}

		public static bool IsEmfMetafile(DXImage image)
		{
			return IsEmfMetafile(image as DXMetafile);
		}

		public static bool IsEmfMetafile(DXMetafile image)
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				return image.Implementation is EmfMetafile;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static DXImage CreateTileImage(DXImage baseImage, Size imgSize)
		{
			return CreateTileImage(baseImage, imgSize, zoomImage: false);
		}

		public static DXImage CreateTileImage(DXImage baseImage, Size imgSize, bool zoomImage)
		{
			if (!(baseImage is DXMetafile))
			{
				return CreateTileBitmap(baseImage, imgSize, zoomImage);
			}
			return CreateTileMetafile(baseImage as DXMetafile, imgSize, zoomImage);
		}

		public static DXImage CreateTileBitmap(DXImage baseImage, Size imgSize, bool zoomImage)
		{
			float num = (float)imgSize.Width * baseImage.HorizontalResolution / 96f;
			float num2 = (float)imgSize.Height * baseImage.VerticalResolution / 96f;
			float num3 = (zoomImage ? GetZoomFactor(baseImage.Size, new SizeF(num, num2)) : 1f);
			SizeF sizeF = new SizeF((float)baseImage.Width * num3, (float)baseImage.Height * num3);
			DXImage dXImage = CreateBitmapWithImageFormat((int)num, (int)num2, baseImage.HorizontalResolution, baseImage.VerticalResolution, DXImageFormat.Png);
			using IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXImage.CreateGraphics();
			int num4 = (int)Math.Ceiling(num / sizeF.Width);
			int num5 = (int)Math.Ceiling(num2 / sizeF.Height);
			SizeF sizeF2 = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(sizeF, baseImage.VerticalResolution, DXGraphicsDpi.GetGraphicsDpi(iDXGraphics));
			for (int i = 0; i < num4; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < num5; j++)
				{
					iDXGraphics.DrawImage(baseImage, new RectangleF(new PointF((float)i * sizeF2.Width, (float)j * sizeF2.Height), new SizeF(sizeF2.Width, sizeF2.Height)));
				}
			}
			return dXImage;
		}

		private static DXImage CreateTileMetafile(DXMetafile baseImage, SizeF clientSize, bool zoomImage)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF(0f, 0f, clientSize.Width, clientSize.Height);
			float num = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(baseImage.Width, baseImage.HorizontalResolution, 96f);
			float num2 = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(baseImage.Height, baseImage.VerticalResolution, 96f);
			float num3 = (zoomImage ? GetZoomFactor(new SizeF(num, num2), rectangleF.Size) : 1f);
			SizeF sizeF = new SizeF(num * num3, num2 * num3);
			DXMetafile dXMetafile = new DXMetafile(rectangleF.Size.ToSize(), DXMetafileFrameUnit.Pixel, DXEmfType.EmfPlusDual);
			using (IDXGraphics iDXGraphics = dXMetafile.CreateGraphics())
			{
				DXMetafileHeader header = dXMetafile.Header;
				iDXGraphics.ScaleTransform(header.DpiX / iDXGraphics.DpiX, header.DpiY / iDXGraphics.DpiY);
				iDXGraphics.PageUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;
				SizeF sizeF2 = GraphicsUnitConverter.Convert(sizeF, baseImage.VerticalResolution, DXGraphicsDpi.GetGraphicsDpi(iDXGraphics));
				for (float num4 = (int)rectangleF.Left; num4 < rectangleF.Right; num4 += sizeF2.Width - 1f)
				{
					for (float num5 = (int)rectangleF.Top; num5 < rectangleF.Bottom; num5 += sizeF2.Height - 1f)
					{
						iDXGraphics.DrawImage(baseImage, new RectangleF(num4, num5, sizeF2.Width, sizeF2.Height));
					}
				}
			}
			return PatchMetafileResolution(dXMetafile, 96);
		}

		private static float GetZoomFactor(SizeF imageSize, SizeF clientSize)
		{
			return Math.Min(clientSize.Width / imageSize.Width, clientSize.Height / imageSize.Height);
		}
	}
	internal static class GeometryUtils
	{
		public static float GetDistance(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			float num = x1 - x2;
			float num2 = y1 - y2;
			return (float)Math.Sqrt(num * num + num2 * num2);
		}

		public static float GetDistance(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			return GetDistance(p1.X, p1.Y, p2.X, p2.Y);
		}

		public static float DotVectors(PointF v1, PointF v2)
		{
			return v1.X * v2.X + v1.Y * v2.Y;
		}

		public static float DotVectors(PointF v1Start, PointF v1End, PointF v2Start, PointF v2End)
		{
			return DotVectors(new PointF(v1End.X - v1Start.X, v1End.Y - v1Start.Y), new PointF(v2End.X - v2Start.X, v2End.Y - v2Start.Y));
		}

		public static double NormalizeAngleRadians(double angle)
		{
			while (angle < 0.0 || angle > Math.PI * 2.0)
			{
				angle = ((!(angle < 0.0)) ? (angle - Math.PI * 2.0) : (angle + Math.PI * 2.0));
			}
			return angle;
		}

		public static double RadiansToDegrees(double angle)
		{
			return angle / Math.PI * 180.0;
		}

		public static PointF MiddlePoint(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			return p1.Add(p2).Mul(0.5f);
		}
	}
	public class DXMetafileCreator
	{
		private static int MetafileBugFixAddition
		{
			get
			{
				if (DXDrawingEngine.CurrentBackend != DXDrawingBackend.GdiPlus || !PlatformHelpers.IsWindows || AzureCompatibility.Enable)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public static DXMetafile Create(Size size, DXMetafileFrameUnit unit, DXEmfType emfType)
		{
			return Create(null, size, unit, emfType);
		}

		public static DXMetafile Create(Stream stream, Size size, DXMetafileFrameUnit unit, DXEmfType emfType)
		{
			Size size2 = new Size(size.Width + MetafileBugFixAddition, size.Height + MetafileBugFixAddition);
			if (stream == null)
			{
				return new DXMetafile(size2, unit, emfType);
			}
			return new DXMetafile(stream, size2, unit, emfType);
		}
	}

			//IL_003c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)textAlignment <= 64)
			{

					}

				}
			}

			IL_0066:

			IL_0064:

			IL_0062:
			return DXStringAlignment.Near;
		}

	internal class GdiPlusTransformEmulation
	{
		public DXMatrix WorldTransform { get; set; } = new DXMatrix();

		public DXGraphicsUnit PageUnit { get; set; } = DXGraphicsUnit.Pixel;

		public float PageScale { get; set; } = 1f;

		public float PpiX { get; set; }

		public float PpiY { get; set; }

		public static GdiPlusTransformEmulation FromGraphics(IDXGraphics graphics)
		{
			return new GdiPlusTransformEmulation
			{
				PpiX = graphics.DpiX,
				PpiY = graphics.DpiY,
				PageScale = graphics.PageScale,
				PageUnit = graphics.PageUnit,
				WorldTransform = graphics.Transform
			};
		}

		public float GetEffectivePageScale()
		{
			if (PageUnit != DXGraphicsUnit.Display)
			{
				return PageScale;
			}
			return 1f;
		}

		public SizeF InchesToGraphicsUnits(SizeF inches)
		{
			return new SizeF(inches.Width * GetPageUnitPerInchesRatio(PpiX) / GetEffectivePageScale(), inches.Height * GetPageUnitPerInchesRatio(PpiY) / GetEffectivePageScale());
		}

		private static bool IsPixelUnit(DXGraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			if ((uint)unit <= 2u)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsPhysicalUnit(DXGraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			return !IsPixelUnit(unit);
		}

		private static float GetUnitPerInchesRatio(DXGraphicsUnit unit, float graphicsPpi)
		{
			if (IsPixelUnit(unit))
			{
				return graphicsPpi;
			}
			return DXGraphicsDpi.UnitToDpi(unit);
		}

		private float GetPageUnitPerInchesRatio(float graphicsPpi)
		{
			return GetUnitPerInchesRatio(PageUnit, graphicsPpi);
		}

		public float GetFontSizeInGraphicsUnits(DXGraphicsUnit fontUnits, float fontSize)
		{
			float num = fontSize / GetUnitPerInchesRatio(fontUnits, PpiX) * GetUnitPerInchesRatio(PageUnit, PpiX);
			if (IsPhysicalUnit(PageUnit) && IsPixelUnit(fontUnits))
			{
				num = fontSize;
			}
			if (IsPhysicalUnit(fontUnits))
			{
				num /= GetEffectivePageScale();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public SizeF GetImageSizeInPageUnits(DXImage image)
		{
			SizeF inches = new SizeF((float)image.Width / image.HorizontalResolution, (float)image.Height / image.VerticalResolution);
			return InchesToGraphicsUnits(inches);
		}

		public DXMatrix GetWorldToDeviceTransform()
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = WorldTransform.Clone();
			dXMatrix.Scale(GetPageTransformScale(PpiX), GetPageTransformScale(PpiY), DXMatrixOrder.Append);
			return dXMatrix;
		}

		private float GetPageTransformScale(float graphicsPpi)
		{
			return graphicsPpi / GetPageUnitPerInchesRatio(graphicsPpi) * GetEffectivePageScale();
		}

		public GdiPlusTransformEmulation Clone()
		{
			return new GdiPlusTransformEmulation
			{
				PpiX = PpiX,
				PpiY = PpiY,
				PageUnit = PageUnit,
				PageScale = PageScale,
				WorldTransform = WorldTransform.Clone()
			};
		}
	}
	public class ResourceDXImageHelper
	{
		public static DXImage CreateDXImageFromResources(string name, Type type)
		{
			return CreateDXImageFromResources(ResourceStreamHelper.GetResourceName(type, name), type.Assembly);
		}

		public static DXImage CreateDXImageFromResources(string name, Assembly asm)
		{
			return CreateDXImageFromResources<DXImage>(name, asm);
		}

		public static T CreateDXImageFromResources<T>(string name, Assembly asm) where T : DXImage
		{
			Stream manifestResourceStream = asm.GetManifestResourceStream(name);
			if (manifestResourceStream == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXImage dXImage = DXImage.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
			return (T)dXImage;
		}
	}

	internal class SvgDXGraphics : ISvgGraphics, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IDXGraphics dxGraphics;

		public bool IsGdiPlusGraphics => dxGraphics.GraphicsKind == DXGraphicsKind.GdiPlus;

		public SmoothingMode SmoothingMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (SmoothingMode)dxGraphics.SmoothingMode;
			}
			set
			{
				dxGraphics.SmoothingMode = (DXSmoothingMode)value;
			}
		}

		public IDxMatrix DxTransform
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
				return (IDxMatrix)new DirectXMatrix(dxGraphics.Transform.Elements);
			}
			set
			{
				dxGraphics.Transform = new DXMatrix(value.Elements);
			}
		}

		public SvgDXGraphics(IDXGraphics dxGraphics)
		{
			this.dxGraphics = dxGraphics;
		}

		public IDxGraphicsPath CreatePath()
		{
			return (IDxGraphicsPath)(object)new SvgDXGraphicsPath();
		}

		public void DrawImage(DXImage image, RectangleF destRect, RectangleF srcRect)
		{
			dxGraphics.DrawImage(image, destRect, srcRect);
		}

		public void DrawLine(DXPen pen, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2)
		{
			dxGraphics.DrawLine(pen, x1, y1, x2, y2);
		}

		public void DrawPath(DXPen pen, IDxGraphicsPath path)
		{
			try
			{
				dxGraphics.DrawPath(pen, (SvgDXGraphicsPath)(object)path);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public void FillPath(DXBrush brush, IDxGraphicsPath path)
		{
			try
			{
				dxGraphics.FillPath(brush, (SvgDXGraphicsPath)(object)path);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font)
		{
			object state = dxGraphics.Save();
			dxGraphics.PageUnit = DXGraphicsUnit.Display;
			dxGraphics.PageScale = 1f;
			DXStringFormat format = DXStringFormat.CreateGenericTypographic();
			SizeF result = dxGraphics.MeasureString(text, font, SizeF.Empty, format);
			dxGraphics.Restore(state);
			return result;
		}

		public object Save()
		{
			return dxGraphics.Save();
		}

		public void Restore(object graphicsState)
		{
			dxGraphics.Restore(graphicsState);
		}

		public void ScaleTransform(float sx, float sy, MatrixOrder order = MatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			dxGraphics.ScaleTransform(sx, sy, (DXMatrixOrder)order);
		}

		public void IntersectClip(IDxGraphicsPath path)
		{
			dxGraphics.SetClip((SvgDXGraphicsPath)(object)path, DXClipCombineMode.Intersect);
		}

		public void TranslateTransform(float dx, float dy, MatrixOrder order = MatrixOrder.Prepend)
		{
			dxGraphics.TranslateTransform(dx, dy, (DXMatrixOrder)order);
		}

		public float GetFontAscent(DXFont font)
		{
			return font.Ascent;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}

	internal static class LibJpegTurboInterop62
	{
		private const int JPEG_LIB_VERSION = 62;

		private static readonly Lazy<ILibJpegTurboInterop62> interop;

		private static ILibJpegTurboInterop62 Interop => interop.Value;

		static LibJpegTurboInterop62()
		{
			interop = new Lazy<ILibJpegTurboInterop62>(delegate
			{
				string libJpegTurboPath = NativeDependenciesLocations.LibJpegTurboPath;
				UnmanagedLibrary loader = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(libJpegTurboPath) ? NativeLibraryLoader.Loader.Load("jpeg", "62") : NativeLibraryLoader.Loader.Load(libJpegTurboPath));
				return InteropHelperBuilder.CreateInteropHelper<ILibJpegTurboInterop62>(loader);
			});
		}

		private static void CheckException(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, bool throwException = true)
		{
			IntPtr clientData = cinfo.ClientData;
			cinfo.ClientData = IntPtr.Zero;
			if (!(clientData != IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				return;
			}
			GCHandle gCHandle = GCHandle.FromIntPtr(clientData);
			if (gCHandle.IsAllocated)
			{
				Exception ex = gCHandle.Target as Exception;
				gCHandle.Free();
				if (ex != null && throwException)
				{
					throw ex;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void EnsureLoaded()
		{
			new LibJpegTurboWrapper62().Dispose();
		}

		public static byte jpeg_start_decompress(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo)
		{
			byte result = Interop.jpeg_start_decompress(ref cinfo);
			CheckException(ref cinfo);
			return result;
		}

		public static uint jpeg_read_scanlines(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, IntPtr scanlines, uint max_lines)
		{
			uint result = Interop.jpeg_read_scanlines(ref cinfo, scanlines, max_lines);
			CheckException(ref cinfo);
			return result;
		}

		public static void jpeg_destroy_decompress(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo)
		{
			Interop.jpeg_destroy_decompress(ref cinfo);
			CheckException(ref cinfo, throwException: false);
		}

		public static IntPtr jpeg_std_error(IntPtr err)
		{
			return Interop.jpeg_std_error(err);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void jpeg_CreateDecompress(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo)
		{
			Interop.jpeg_CreateDecompress(ref cinfo, 62, Marshal.SizeOf(default(jpeg_decompress_struct62)));
			CheckException(ref cinfo);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static int jpeg_read_header(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo)
		{
			int result = Interop.jpeg_read_header(ref cinfo, 1);
			CheckException(ref cinfo);
			return result;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static byte jpeg_resync_to_restart(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, int desired)
		{
			byte result = Interop.jpeg_resync_to_restart(ref cinfo, desired);
			CheckException(ref cinfo);
			return result;
		}
	}

				string libJpegTurboPath = NativeDependenciesLocations.LibJpegTurboPath;
				UnmanagedLibrary loader = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(libJpegTurboPath) ? NativeLibraryLoader.Loader.Load("jpeg", "8") : NativeLibraryLoader.Loader.Load(libJpegTurboPath));
				return InteropHelperBuilder.CreateInteropHelper<ILibJpegTurboInterop8>(loader);
			});
		}

		private static void CheckException(ref jpeg_decompress_struct8 cinfo, bool throwException = true)
		{
			IntPtr clientData = cinfo.ClientData;
			cinfo.ClientData = IntPtr.Zero;
			if (!(clientData != IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				return;
			}
			GCHandle gCHandle = GCHandle.FromIntPtr(clientData);
			if (gCHandle.IsAllocated)
			{
				Exception ex = gCHandle.Target as Exception;
				gCHandle.Free();
				if (ex != null && throwException)
				{
					throw ex;
				}
			}
		}

			new LibJpegTurboWrapper8().Dispose();
		}

	public abstract class LibJpegTurboWrapper : IDisposable
	{
		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate void ErrorHandlerDelegate(IntPtr cinfo);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate void EmitHandlerDelegate(IntPtr cinfo, int msgLevel);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate void FormatMessageDelegate(IntPtr cinfo, IntPtr messageBuffer);

		private const int JMSG_LENGTH_MAX = 200;

		private readonly jpeg_error_mgr error;

		private readonly ErrorHandlerDelegate errorExitDelegate = ErrorHandler;

		private readonly ErrorHandlerDelegate outputMessageDelegate = OutputMessage;

		private readonly EmitHandlerDelegate emitMessageDelegate = EmitMessage;

		private bool disposed;

		protected IntPtr ErrHandle { get; }

		private static void ErrorHandler(IntPtr cinfo)
		{
			InvalidOperationException value = new InvalidOperationException();
			GCHandle value2 = GCHandle.Alloc(value, GCHandleType.Normal);
			Marshal.WriteIntPtr(cinfo, Marshal.SizeOf<IntPtr>() * 3, GCHandle.ToIntPtr(value2));
		}

		private static void EmitMessage(IntPtr cinfo, int msgLevel)
		{
		}

		private static void OutputMessage(IntPtr cinfo)
		{
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public LibJpegTurboWrapper()
		{
			error = default(jpeg_error_mgr);
			ErrHandle = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(jpeg_error_mgr)));
			Marshal.StructureToPtr(error, ErrHandle, fDeleteOld: true);
		}

		protected void SetUpErrorHandling()
		{
			jpeg_error_mgr structure = (jpeg_error_mgr)Marshal.PtrToStructure(ErrHandle, typeof(jpeg_error_mgr));
			structure.Error_exit = Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(errorExitDelegate);
			structure.Output_message = Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(outputMessageDelegate);
			structure.Emit_message = Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(emitMessageDelegate);
			Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, ErrHandle, fDeleteOld: true);
		}

		public abstract void SetData(byte[] jpegData);

		public abstract J_COLOR_SPACE GetOutColorSpace(byte[] jpegData);

		public abstract void FillBuffer(byte[] dataBuffer);

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~LibJpegTurboWrapper()
		{
			try
			{
				Dispose(disposing: false);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (!disposed)
			{
				disposed = true;
				DisposeCore(disposing);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected virtual void DisposeCore(bool disposing)
		{
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(ErrHandle);
		}
	}
	public class LibJpegTurboWrapper62 : LibJpegTurboWrapper
	{
		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate void InitSourceDelegate(IntPtr cinfo);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate void FillInputBufferDelegate(IntPtr cinfo);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate void SkipInputDataDelegate(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, int num_bytes);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate void TermSourceDelegate(IntPtr cinfo);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate byte ResyncToRestartDelegate(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, int desired);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate IntPtr Alloc_small(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, int pool_id, IntPtr sizeofobject);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.Cdecl)]
		private delegate IntPtr Alloc_sarrayDelegate(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, int pool_id, uint samplesperrow, uint numrows);

		private static readonly InitSourceDelegate initSourceDelegate = InitSource;

		private static readonly FillInputBufferDelegate fillInputBufferDelegate = FillInputBuffer;

		private static readonly SkipInputDataDelegate skipInputDataDelegate = SkipInputData;

		private static readonly TermSourceDelegate termSourceDelegate = TermSource;

		private static readonly ResyncToRestartDelegate resyncToRestartDelegate = ResyncToRestart;

		private jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo;

		private GCHandle? dataHandle;

		private long row_stride;

		private IntPtr buffer;

		private static void InitSource(IntPtr cinfo)
		{
		}

		private static void FillInputBuffer(IntPtr cinfo)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		private static void SkipInputData(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, int num_bytes)
		{
			if (num_bytes > 0)
			{
				jpeg_source_mgr structure = Marshal.PtrToStructure<jpeg_source_mgr>(cinfo.Src);
				structure.NextInputByte += num_bytes;
				structure.BytesInBuffer -= num_bytes;
				Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, cinfo.Src, fDeleteOld: true);
			}
		}

		private static void TermSource(IntPtr cinfo)
		{
		}

		private static byte ResyncToRestart(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, int desired)
		{
			return LibJpegTurboInterop62.jpeg_resync_to_restart(ref cinfo, desired);
		}

		private static void jpeg_mem_src(ref jpeg_decompress_struct62 cinfo, IntPtr buffer, long nbytes)
		{
			if (cinfo.Src == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				Alloc_small alloc_small = (Alloc_small)Marshal.GetDelegateForFunctionPointer(((jpeg_memory_mgr)Marshal.PtrToStructure(cinfo.Mem, typeof(jpeg_memory_mgr))).Alloc_small, typeof(Alloc_small));
				cinfo.Src = alloc_small(ref cinfo, 0, (IntPtr)Marshal.SizeOf<jpeg_source_mgr>());
			}
			jpeg_source_mgr structure = Marshal.PtrToStructure<jpeg_source_mgr>(cinfo.Src);
			structure.InitSource = Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(initSourceDelegate);
			structure.FillInputBuffer = Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(fillInputBufferDelegate);
			structure.SkipInputData = Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(skipInputDataDelegate);
			structure.ResyncToRestart = Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(resyncToRestartDelegate);
			structure.TermSource = Marshal.GetFunctionPointerForDelegate(termSourceDelegate);
			structure.BytesInBuffer = new IntPtr(nbytes);
			structure.NextInputByte = buffer;
			Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, cinfo.Src, fDeleteOld: true);
		}

		public LibJpegTurboWrapper62()
		{
			cinfo = default(jpeg_decompress_struct62);
			cinfo.Err = LibJpegTurboInterop62.jpeg_std_error(base.ErrHandle);
			SetUpErrorHandling();
			LibJpegTurboInterop62.jpeg_CreateDecompress(ref cinfo);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void SetData(byte[] jpegData)
		{
			dataHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(jpegData, GCHandleType.Pinned);
			jpeg_mem_src(ref cinfo, dataHandle.Value.AddrOfPinnedObject(), jpegData.Length);
			LibJpegTurboInterop62.jpeg_read_header(ref cinfo);
			LibJpegTurboInterop62.jpeg_start_decompress(ref cinfo);
			row_stride = cinfo.Output_width * cinfo.Output_components;
			Alloc_sarrayDelegate alloc_sarrayDelegate = (Alloc_sarrayDelegate)Marshal.GetDelegateForFunctionPointer(((jpeg_memory_mgr)Marshal.PtrToStructure(cinfo.Mem, typeof(jpeg_memory_mgr))).Alloc_sarray, typeof(Alloc_sarrayDelegate));
			buffer = alloc_sarrayDelegate(ref cinfo, 1, (uint)row_stride, 1u);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override J_COLOR_SPACE GetOutColorSpace(byte[] jpegData)
		{
			dataHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(jpegData, GCHandleType.Pinned);
			jpeg_mem_src(ref cinfo, dataHandle.Value.AddrOfPinnedObject(), jpegData.Length);
			LibJpegTurboInterop62.jpeg_read_header(ref cinfo);
			return cinfo.Out_color_space;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void FillBuffer(byte[] dataBuffer)
		{
			if (LibJpegTurboInterop62.jpeg_read_scanlines(ref cinfo, buffer, 1u) != 1)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			IntPtr source = Marshal.ReadIntPtr(buffer);
			Marshal.Copy(source, dataBuffer, 0, (int)row_stride);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DisposeCore(bool disposing)
		{
			LibJpegTurboInterop62.jpeg_destroy_decompress(ref cinfo);
			dataHandle?.Free();
		}
	}

	public abstract class ExternalObject : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly bool ownsNativeObject;

		public IntPtr NativeObject { get; private set; }

		protected ExternalObject(IntPtr nativeObject, bool ownsNativeObject = true)
		{
			NativeObject = nativeObject;
			this.ownsNativeObject = ownsNativeObject;
		}

		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (ownsNativeObject && NativeObject != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				DisposeCore(disposing);
				NativeObject = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		~ExternalObject()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		protected abstract void DisposeCore(bool disposing);
	}
	public class NativeLibraryLoadResult
	{
		public IntPtr Handle { get; }

		public string ErrorMessage { get; }

		public NativeLibraryLoadResult(IntPtr handle, string errorMessage)
		{
			Handle = handle;
			ErrorMessage = errorMessage;
		}
	}
	public interface INativeLibraryNameConstructor
	{
		string GetLibraryFullName(string libraryName, string version);
	}
	public abstract class NativeLibraryLoader
	{
		private readonly INativeLibraryNameConstructor nameConstructor;

		public static NativeLibraryLoader Loader { get; }

		static NativeLibraryLoader()
		{
			Loader = new WindowsNativeLibraryLoader();
		}

		protected NativeLibraryLoader(INativeLibraryNameConstructor nameConstructor)
		{
			this.nameConstructor = nameConstructor;
		}

		protected string GetLibraryFullPath(string name, string version)
		{
			return nameConstructor.GetLibraryFullName(name, version);
		}

		protected abstract NativeLibraryLoadResult LoadLibrary(string path);

		public abstract IntPtr GetFunctionPointer(IntPtr libraryHandle, string name);

		public abstract void FreeLibrary(IntPtr libraryHandle);

		public UnmanagedLibrary TryLoad(string libraryName, string version)
		{
			string libraryFullPath = GetLibraryFullPath(libraryName, version);
			NativeLibraryLoadResult nativeLibraryLoadResult = LoadLibrary(libraryFullPath);
			if (nativeLibraryLoadResult.Handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new UnmanagedLibrary(nativeLibraryLoadResult.Handle, this, libraryFullPath);
		}

		public UnmanagedLibrary TryLoad(string libraryName)
		{
			NativeLibraryLoadResult nativeLibraryLoadResult = LoadLibrary(libraryName);
			if (nativeLibraryLoadResult.Handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new UnmanagedLibrary(nativeLibraryLoadResult.Handle, this, libraryName);
		}

		public UnmanagedLibrary Load(string fullPath)
		{
			NativeLibraryLoadResult nativeLibraryLoadResult = LoadLibrary(fullPath);
			if (nativeLibraryLoadResult.Handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				throw new DllNotFoundException($"Unable to load shared library \"{fullPath}\" or one of its dependencies: \"{nativeLibraryLoadResult.ErrorMessage}\"");
			}
			return new UnmanagedLibrary(nativeLibraryLoadResult.Handle, this, fullPath);
		}

		public UnmanagedLibrary Load(string libraryName, string version)
		{
			return Load(GetLibraryFullPath(libraryName, version));
		}
	}
	public class WindowsNativeLibraryNameConstructor : INativeLibraryNameConstructor
	{
		public string GetLibraryFullName(string libraryName, string version)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(version))
			{
				return libraryName + version + ".dll";
			}
			return libraryName + ".dll";
		}
	}
	public class WindowsNativeLibraryLoader : NativeLibraryLoader
	{
		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static string GetErrorMessage(int error)
		{
			FormatMessageFlags dwFlags = FormatMessageFlags.FROM_SYSTEM | FormatMessageFlags.IGNORE_INSERTS | FormatMessageFlags.ARGUMENT_ARRAY;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(256);
			do
			{
				int num = Kernel32Interop.FormatMessage(dwFlags, IntPtr.Zero, (uint)error, 0, stringBuilder, stringBuilder.Capacity + 1, null);
				if (num > 0)
				{
					return stringBuilder.ToString(0, num);
				}
				if (Marshal.GetLastWin32Error() != 122)
				{
					return "";
				}
				stringBuilder.Capacity *= 4;
			}
			while (stringBuilder.Capacity < 65536);
			return "";
		}

		public WindowsNativeLibraryLoader()
			: base(new WindowsNativeLibraryNameConstructor())
		{
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void FreeLibrary(IntPtr libraryHandle)
		{
			Kernel32Interop.FreeLibrary(libraryHandle);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override IntPtr GetFunctionPointer(IntPtr libraryHandle, string name)
		{
			return Kernel32Interop.GetProcAddress(libraryHandle, name);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override NativeLibraryLoadResult LoadLibrary(string path)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = Kernel32Interop.LoadLibraryEx(path, IntPtr.Zero, 0);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return new NativeLibraryLoadResult(intPtr, GetErrorMessage(Marshal.GetLastWin32Error()));
			}
			return new NativeLibraryLoadResult(intPtr, null);
		}
	}
	public class InteropHelperBuilder
	{
		private static Lazy<Func<SafeBuffer, IntPtr>> acquirePointerFunction;

		private readonly DynamicAssemblyHelper dynamicAssemblyHelper;

		private readonly UnmanagedLibrary library;

		private readonly string nameSuffix;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		static InteropHelperBuilder()
		{
			acquirePointerFunction = new Lazy<Func<SafeBuffer, IntPtr>>(CreateAcquirePointerMethod, LazyThreadSafetyMode.ExecutionAndPublication);
		}

		public static TInterface CreateInteropHelper<TInterface>(UnmanagedLibrary loader)
		{
			return CreateInteropHelper<TInterface>(loader, "");
		}

		public static TInterface CreateInteropHelper<TInterface>(UnmanagedLibrary loader, string nameSuffix)
		{
			return new InteropHelperBuilder(DynamicAssemblyHelper.Instance, loader, nameSuffix).CreateInteropHelperImp<TInterface>();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static IntPtr AcquirePointer(SafeBuffer buffer)
		{
			return acquirePointerFunction.Value(buffer);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Func<SafeBuffer, IntPtr> CreateAcquirePointerMethod()
		{
			TypeBuilder typeBuilder = DynamicAssemblyHelper.Instance.ModuleBuilder.DefineType("AcquirePointerHelper");
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(SafeBuffer);
			MethodBuilder methodBuilder = typeBuilder.DefineMethod("AcquirePointer", MethodAttributes.Public | MethodAttributes.Static, typeof(IntPtr), new Type[1] { typeFromHandle });
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = methodBuilder.GetILGenerator();
			iLGenerator.DeclareLocal(typeof(byte).MakePointerType());
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4_0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Conv_U);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Stloc_0);
			ILGeneratorExtensions.EmitLoadArg(iLGenerator, 0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldloca_S, 0);
			iLGenerator.EmitCall(OpCodes.Callvirt, typeFromHandle.GetMethod("AcquirePointer"), null);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldloc_0);
			iLGenerator.EmitCall(OpCodes.Call, typeof(IntPtr).GetMethod("op_Explicit", new Type[1] { typeof(void).MakePointerType() }), null);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			return (Func<SafeBuffer, IntPtr>)typeBuilder.CreateType().GetMethod("AcquirePointer").CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<SafeBuffer, IntPtr>));
		}

		private InteropHelperBuilder(DynamicAssemblyHelper dynamicAssemblyHelper, UnmanagedLibrary loader, string nameSuffix)
		{
			this.dynamicAssemblyHelper = dynamicAssemblyHelper;
			this.nameSuffix = nameSuffix;
			library = loader;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private TInteraface CreateInteropHelperImp<TInteraface>()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(TInteraface);
			Type typeFromHandle2 = typeof(IList<Delegate>);
			Type typeFromHandle3 = typeof(UnmanagedLibrary);
			TypeBuilder typeBuilder = dynamicAssemblyHelper.ModuleBuilder.DefineType(typeFromHandle.Name + "Helper");
			typeBuilder.AddInterfaceImplementation(typeFromHandle);
			ConstructorBuilder constructorBuilder = typeBuilder.DefineConstructor(MethodAttributes.Public, CallingConventions.HasThis, new Type[2] { typeFromHandle2, typeFromHandle3 });
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = constructorBuilder.GetILGenerator();
			FieldBuilder field = typeBuilder.DefineField("delegates", typeFromHandle2, FieldAttributes.Private);
			FieldBuilder field2 = typeBuilder.DefineField("library", typeFromHandle3, FieldAttributes.Private);
			ILGeneratorExtensions.EmitLoadArg(iLGenerator, 0);
			ILGeneratorExtensions.EmitLoadArg(iLGenerator, 1);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Stfld, field);
			ILGeneratorExtensions.EmitLoadArg(iLGenerator, 0);
			ILGeneratorExtensions.EmitLoadArg(iLGenerator, 2);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Stfld, field2);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			IList<Delegate> list = new List<Delegate>();
			int num = 0;
			MethodInfo[] methods = typeFromHandle.GetMethods();
			foreach (MethodInfo methodInfo in methods)
			{
				Type[] array = (from p in methodInfo.GetParameters()
					select p.ParameterType).ToArray();
				MethodBuilder methodBuilder = typeBuilder.DefineMethod(methodInfo.Name, MethodAttributes.Public | MethodAttributes.Virtual, methodInfo.ReturnType, array);
				ILGenerator iLGenerator2 = methodBuilder.GetILGenerator();
				Type type = dynamicAssemblyHelper.CreateDelegateType(methodInfo, false);
				list.Add(Marshal.GetDelegateForFunctionPointer(library.GetFunctionPointer(methodInfo.Name + nameSuffix), type));
				ILGeneratorExtensions.EmitLoadArg(iLGenerator2, 0);
				iLGenerator2.Emit(OpCodes.Ldfld, field);
				iLGenerator2.Emit(OpCodes.Ldc_I4, num++);
				iLGenerator2.EmitCall(OpCodes.Callvirt, typeFromHandle2.GetMethod("get_Item"), null);
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < array.Length; num2++)
				{
					ILGeneratorExtensions.EmitLoadArg(iLGenerator2, num2 + 1);
				}
				iLGenerator2.EmitCall(OpCodes.Callvirt, type.GetMethod("Invoke"), null);
				iLGenerator2.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
				typeBuilder.DefineMethodOverride(methodBuilder, methodInfo);
			}
			return (TInteraface)Activator.CreateInstance(typeBuilder.CreateType(), list, library);
		}
	}

	public class UnmanagedLibrary : ExternalObject
	{
		private readonly NativeLibraryLoader loader;

		private readonly string libraryPath;

		public UnmanagedLibrary(IntPtr libraryHandle, NativeLibraryLoader loader, string libraryPath)
			: base(libraryHandle)
		{
			this.loader = loader;
			this.libraryPath = libraryPath;
		}

		public IntPtr TryGetFunctionPointer(string name)
		{
			return loader.GetFunctionPointer(base.NativeObject, name);
		}

		public IntPtr GetFunctionPointer(string name)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = TryGetFunctionPointer(name);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				throw new EntryPointNotFoundException($"Unable to find an entry point named \"{name}\" in shared library \"{libraryPath}\"");
			}
			return intPtr;
		}

		protected override void DisposeCore(bool disposing)
		{
			loader.FreeLibrary(base.NativeObject);
		}
	}

	internal class GifBitCodeWriter
	{
		private readonly GifBufferedBlockWriter blockWriter;

		private byte curByte;

		private byte bitPosition;

		public GifBitCodeWriter(GifBinaryWriter writer)
		{
			blockWriter = new GifBufferedBlockWriter(writer);
		}

		public void WriteBitCode(int code, int bitCodeLen)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < bitCodeLen; i++)
			{
				WriteBit(code >> i);
			}
		}

		private void WriteBit(int value)
		{
			curByte |= (byte)((value & 1) << (int)bitPosition++);
			if (bitPosition == 8)
			{
				blockWriter.WriteByte(curByte);
				curByte = 0;
				bitPosition = 0;
			}
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			if (bitPosition > 0)
			{
				blockWriter.WriteByte(curByte);
			}
			blockWriter.Flush();
		}
	}
	internal class GifBufferedBlockWriter
	{
		private readonly GifBinaryWriter writer;

		private byte[] buffer = new byte[255];

		private byte bufferPosition;

		public GifBufferedBlockWriter(GifBinaryWriter writer)
		{
			this.writer = writer;
		}

		public void WriteByte(byte val)
		{
			buffer[bufferPosition++] = val;
			if (bufferPosition >= buffer.Length)
			{
				writer.WriteDataBlock(buffer, (byte)buffer.Length);
				bufferPosition = 0;
			}
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			if (bufferPosition > 0)
			{
				writer.WriteDataBlock(buffer, bufferPosition);
				bufferPosition = 0;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class GifColorTable
	{
		private readonly Color[] colors;

		private static readonly byte[] rbTable = new byte[6] { 0, 51, 102, 153, 204, 255 };

		private static readonly byte[] gTable = new byte[7] { 0, 43, 85, 128, 170, 213, 255 };

		private static readonly byte[] rbThresholds = new byte[5] { 25, 76, 127, 178, 229 };

		private static readonly byte[] gThresholds = new byte[6] { 21, 63, 106, 148, 191, 233 };

		private static readonly float rbSpread = 51f;

		private static readonly float gSpread = 42.5f;

		public IReadOnlyCollection<Color> Colors => (IReadOnlyCollection<Color>)(object)colors;

		public byte TransparentIndex => 252;

		public byte LzwMinimumCodeSize => 8;

		public float RSpread => rbSpread;

		public float GSpread => gSpread;

		public float BSpread => rbSpread;

		public GifColorTable()
		{
			colors = new Color[256];
			for (int i = 0; i < rbTable.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < gTable.Length; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < rbTable.Length; k++)
					{
						colors[ComponentsToColorIndex(i, j, k)] = Color.FromArgb(rbTable[i], gTable[j], rbTable[k]);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int l = rbTable.Length * rbTable.Length * gTable.Length; l < colors.Length; l++)
			{
				colors[l] = Color.Black;
			}
		}

		public byte GetColorIndex(byte r, byte g, byte b)
		{
			int componentIndex = GetComponentIndex(r, rbThresholds);
			int componentIndex2 = GetComponentIndex(g, gThresholds);
			int componentIndex3 = GetComponentIndex(b, rbThresholds);
			return ComponentsToColorIndex(componentIndex, componentIndex2, componentIndex3);
		}

		private byte ComponentsToColorIndex(int r, int g, int b)
		{
			return (byte)(b + rbTable.Length * g + rbTable.Length * gTable.Length * r);
		}

		private static int GetComponentIndex(byte component, byte[] threshold)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < threshold.Length; i++)
			{
				if (component <= threshold[i])
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return threshold.Length;
		}
	}

	internal class GifLzwEncoder
	{
		private const int maxCodeLen = 12;

		private readonly GifBitCodeWriter codeWriter;

		private readonly int minimumCodeSize;

		private readonly List<List<byte>> codeTable = new List<List<byte>>(4096);

		private int currentCodeLen;

		private int clearCode;

		private int endCode;

		private List<byte> indexBuffer = new List<byte>();

		private int indexBufferCode;

		public GifLzwEncoder(GifBinaryWriter writer, int minimumCodeSize)
		{
			this.minimumCodeSize = minimumCodeSize;
			codeWriter = new GifBitCodeWriter(writer);
			currentCodeLen = minimumCodeSize + 1;
			clearCode = 1 << minimumCodeSize;
			endCode = clearCode + 1;
		}

		public void ClearCode()
		{
			WriteCode(clearCode);
			currentCodeLen = minimumCodeSize + 1;
			codeTable.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < 1 << minimumCodeSize; i++)
			{
				codeTable.Add(new List<byte> { (byte)i });
			}
			codeTable.Add(null);
			codeTable.Add(null);
		}

		private void WriteCode(int code)
		{
			codeWriter.WriteBitCode(code, currentCodeLen);
		}

		public void WriteIndex(byte index)
		{
			if (indexBuffer.Count == 0)
			{
				InitIndexBuffer(index);
				return;
			}
			int num = CheckNewIndex(index);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				indexBufferCode = num;
				indexBuffer.Add(index);
			}
			else
			{
				WriteCode(indexBufferCode);
				AddBufferToCodeTable(index);
				InitIndexBuffer(index);
			}
		}

		private void InitIndexBuffer(byte index)
		{
			indexBuffer.Clear();
			indexBufferCode = CheckNewIndex(index);
			indexBuffer.Add(index);
		}

		private int CheckNewIndex(byte k)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < codeTable.Count; i++)
			{
				if (CheckTableItem(k, codeTable[i]))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private bool CheckTableItem(byte k, List<byte> tableItem)
		{
			if (tableItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (tableItem.Count != indexBuffer.Count + 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < indexBuffer.Count; i++)
			{
				if (indexBuffer[i] != tableItem[i])
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return k == tableItem[tableItem.Count - 1];
		}

		private void AddBufferToCodeTable(byte k)
		{
			if (codeTable.Count == 1 << currentCodeLen)
			{
				currentCodeLen++;
			}
			if (currentCodeLen > 12)
			{
				currentCodeLen = 12;
				ClearCode();
			}
			else
			{
				List<byte> item = new List<byte>(indexBuffer) { k };
				codeTable.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void End()
		{
			if (indexBuffer.Count != 0)
			{
				WriteCode(indexBufferCode);
			}
			WriteCode(endCode);
			codeWriter.Flush();
		}
	}
	internal class GifBinaryWriter
	{
		private readonly BinaryWriter writer;

		public GifBinaryWriter(Stream outStream)
		{
			writer = new BinaryWriter(outStream);
		}

		public void WriteDataBlock(byte[] data, byte dataLength)
		{
			writer.Write(dataLength);
			writer.Write(data, 0, dataLength);
		}

		public void WriteBlockTerminator()
		{
			writer.Write((byte)0);
		}

		public void WriteHeader()
		{
			writer.Write((byte)71);
			writer.Write((byte)73);
			writer.Write((byte)70);
			writer.Write((byte)56);
			writer.Write((byte)57);
			writer.Write((byte)97);
		}

		public void WriteLogicalScreenDescriptor(int widht, int height)
		{
			writer.Write((ushort)widht);
			writer.Write((ushort)height);
			writer.Write((byte)247);
			writer.Write((byte)0);
			writer.Write((byte)0);
		}

		public void WriteColorTable(IReadOnlyCollection<Color> table)
		{
			foreach (Color item in table)
			{
				writer.Write(item.R);
				writer.Write(item.G);
				writer.Write(item.B);
			}
		}

		public void WriteImageDescriptor(int left, int top, int width, int height)
		{
			writer.Write((byte)44);
			writer.Write((ushort)left);
			writer.Write((ushort)top);
			writer.Write((ushort)width);
			writer.Write((ushort)height);
			writer.Write((byte)0);
		}

		public void WriteStartImageData(byte minCodeSize)
		{
			writer.Write(minCodeSize);
		}

		public void WriteGraphicControlExtension(byte transparentColorIndex)
		{
			writer.Write((byte)33);
			writer.Write((byte)249);
			writer.Write((byte)4);
			writer.Write((byte)1);
			writer.Write((ushort)0);
			writer.Write(transparentColorIndex);
			WriteBlockTerminator();
		}

		public void WriteTrailer()
		{
			writer.Write((byte)59);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.Images.Bmp
