	internal enum BitmapCompressionMethod
	{
		Rgb = 0,
		Rle8 = 1,
		Rle4 = 2,
		BitFields = 3,
		Jpeg = 4,
		Png = 5,
		AlphaBitFields = 6,
		Cmyk = 11,
		CmykRle8 = 12,
		CmykRle4 = 13
	}
	internal class BmpHelper
	{
		public static void WriteBmpHeader(BinaryWriter writer, BitmapInfoHeader header)
		{
			int num = 14 + header.GetHeaderSize();
			writer.Write((short)19778);
			writer.Write(num + header.GetActualImageSize());
			writer.Write((short)0);
			writer.Write((short)0);
			writer.Write(num);
			header.Write(writer);
		}

		internal static SizeF ParseResolution(Stream stream)
		{
			stream.Position += 14L;
			BitmapInfoHeader bitmapInfoHeader = BitmapInfoHeader.Read(stream);
			return new SizeF(DXGraphicsDpi.GetSafeResolution(UnitConverterHelper.PpmToPpi(bitmapInfoHeader.HorizontalResolutionPpm)), DXGraphicsDpi.GetSafeResolution(UnitConverterHelper.PpmToPpi(bitmapInfoHeader.VerticalResolutionPpm)));
		}
	}
	internal class BitmapInfoHeader
	{
		public int Width { get; set; }

		public int Height { get; set; }

		public ushort BitsPerPixels { get; set; }

		public BitmapCompressionMethod Compression { get; set; }

		public int ImageSize { get; set; }

		public int HorizontalResolutionPpm { get; set; }

		public int VerticalResolutionPpm { get; set; }

		public int PaletteSize { get; set; }

		public bool BitMaskPresent { get; set; }

		public int RMask { get; set; }

		public int GMask { get; set; }

		public int BMask { get; set; }

		public int AMask { get; set; }

		private bool IsImageSizeExplicit
		{
			get
			{
				if (Compression != BitmapCompressionMethod.Rgb && Compression != BitmapCompressionMethod.Cmyk)
				{
					return Compression != BitmapCompressionMethod.BitFields;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int GetActualImageSize()
		{
			if (!IsImageSizeExplicit)
			{
				return ((Width * BitsPerPixels + 31) & -32) / 8 * Math.Abs(Height);
			}
			return ImageSize;
		}

		public int GetHeaderSize()
		{
			if (!BitMaskPresent)
			{
				return 40;
			}
			return 56;
		}

		public void Write(BinaryWriter writer)
		{
			writer.Write(GetHeaderSize());
			writer.Write(Width);
			writer.Write(Height);
			writer.Write((ushort)1);
			writer.Write(BitsPerPixels);
			writer.Write((int)Compression);
			writer.Write(GetActualImageSize());
			writer.Write(HorizontalResolutionPpm);
			writer.Write(VerticalResolutionPpm);
			writer.Write(PaletteSize);
			writer.Write(0);
			if (BitMaskPresent)
			{
				writer.Write(RMask);
				writer.Write(GMask);
				writer.Write(BMask);
				writer.Write(AMask);
			}
		}

		public static BitmapInfoHeader Read(Stream stream)
		{
			using BinaryReader reader = new BinaryReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8, leaveOpen: true);
			return Read(reader);
		}

		public static BitmapInfoHeader Read(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			int num = reader.ReadInt32();
			if (num == 12)
			{
				return ReaderCoreHeader(reader);
			}
			BitmapInfoHeader bitmapInfoHeader = new BitmapInfoHeader();
			bitmapInfoHeader.Width = reader.ReadInt32();
			bitmapInfoHeader.Height = reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadUInt16();
			bitmapInfoHeader.BitsPerPixels = reader.ReadUInt16();
			bitmapInfoHeader.Compression = (BitmapCompressionMethod)reader.ReadInt32();
			bitmapInfoHeader.ImageSize = reader.ReadInt32();
			bitmapInfoHeader.HorizontalResolutionPpm = reader.ReadInt32();
			bitmapInfoHeader.VerticalResolutionPpm = reader.ReadInt32();
			bitmapInfoHeader.PaletteSize = reader.ReadInt32();
			reader.ReadInt32();
			if (num >= 52 || bitmapInfoHeader.Compression == BitmapCompressionMethod.BitFields)
			{
				bitmapInfoHeader.BitMaskPresent = true;
				bitmapInfoHeader.RMask = reader.ReadInt32();
				bitmapInfoHeader.GMask = reader.ReadInt32();
				bitmapInfoHeader.BMask = reader.ReadInt32();
				if (num >= 56)
				{
					bitmapInfoHeader.AMask = reader.ReadInt32();
				}
			}
			return bitmapInfoHeader;
		}

		private static BitmapInfoHeader ReaderCoreHeader(BinaryReader reader)
		{
			BitmapInfoHeader bitmapInfoHeader = new BitmapInfoHeader();
			bitmapInfoHeader.Width = reader.ReadUInt16();
			bitmapInfoHeader.Height = reader.ReadUInt16();
			reader.ReadUInt16();
			bitmapInfoHeader.BitsPerPixels = reader.ReadUInt16();
			bitmapInfoHeader.Compression = BitmapCompressionMethod.Rgb;
			return bitmapInfoHeader;
		}
	}
}

	internal class PngCrc32
	{
		private ulong[] crcTable = new ulong[256];

		private bool computed;

		private void MakeCrcTable()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
			{
				ulong num = (ulong)i;
				for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++)
				{
					num = (((num & 1) == 0L) ? (num >> 1) : (0xEDB88320u ^ (num >> 1)));
				}
				crcTable[i] = num;
			}
			computed = true;
		}

		private ulong UpdateCrc(ulong crc, byte[] buf, int len)
		{
			ulong num = crc;
			if (!computed)
			{
				MakeCrcTable();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < len; i++)
			{
				num = crcTable[(num ^ buf[i]) & 0xFF] ^ (num >> 8);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public uint Crc(byte[] buf, int len)
		{
			return (uint)(UpdateCrc(4294967295uL, buf, len) ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu);
		}
	}
	internal static class PngHelper
	{
		public static bool IsPng(Stream stream)
		{
			return new PngReader(stream).TryReadHeader();
		}

		public static SizeF ParseResolution(Stream stream)
		{
			PngReader pngReader = new PngReader(stream);
			if (!pngReader.TryReadHeader())
			{
				return DXGraphicsDpi.DefaultImageResolutionSize;
			}
			while (pngReader.ReadNextChunkHeader())
			{
				if (pngReader.ChunkType == "pHYs")
				{
					ChunkDataPhys chunkDataPhys = pngReader.ReadPhysChunkData();
					if (chunkDataPhys.UnitSpecifier == 1)
					{
						return new SizeF(DXGraphicsDpi.GetSafeResolution(UnitConverterHelper.PpmToPpi(chunkDataPhys.PixelPerUnitX)), DXGraphicsDpi.GetSafeResolution(UnitConverterHelper.PpmToPpi(chunkDataPhys.PixelPerUnitY)));
					}
					return DXGraphicsDpi.DefaultImageResolutionSize;
				}
				if (pngReader.ChunkType == "IDAT")
				{
					return DXGraphicsDpi.DefaultImageResolutionSize;
				}
			}
			return DXGraphicsDpi.DefaultImageResolutionSize;
		}

		public static MemoryStream AppendResolution(MemoryStream stream, SizeF resolution)
		{
			Tuple<long, long> requiredResolutionPositions = GetRequiredResolutionPositions(stream);
			if (requiredResolutionPositions == null)
			{
				return stream;
			}
			long item = requiredResolutionPositions.Item1;
			long item2 = requiredResolutionPositions.Item2;
			if (item == 0L)
			{
				return stream;
			}
			if (item2 != 0L)
			{
				UpdatePhysChunk(stream, item2, resolution);
				return stream;
			}
			return InsertPhysChunk(stream, item, resolution);
		}

		private static Tuple<long, long> GetRequiredResolutionPositions(MemoryStream stream)
		{
			PngReader pngReader = new PngReader(stream);
			if (!pngReader.TryReadHeader())
			{
				return null;
			}
			long item = 0L;
			while (pngReader.ReadNextChunkHeader())
			{
				switch (pngReader.ChunkType)
				{
				case "IHDR":
					item = pngReader.NextChunkStartPosition;
					break;
				case "pHYs":
					return new Tuple<long, long>(item, pngReader.ChunkDataPosition);
				case "IDAT":
					return new Tuple<long, long>(item, 0L);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static void UpdatePhysChunk(MemoryStream stream, long physDataLocation, SizeF resolution)
		{
			stream.Position = physDataLocation;
			WritePhysChunkData(stream, resolution);
			WritePhysChunkCrc(stream, resolution);
		}

		private static void WritePhysChunkCrc(MemoryStream strean, SizeF resolution)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			BinaryHelper.WriteAsciiString(memoryStream, "pHYs");
			WritePhysChunkData(memoryStream, resolution);
			WriteCrc(strean, memoryStream.ToArray());
		}

		private static void WritePhysChunkData(MemoryStream stream, SizeF resolution)
		{
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt32Be(stream, (uint)UnitConverterHelper.PpiToPpm(resolution.Width));
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt32Be(stream, (uint)UnitConverterHelper.PpiToPpm(resolution.Height));
			stream.WriteByte(1);
		}

		private static void WriteCrc(MemoryStream stream, byte[] chunkData)
		{
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt32Be(stream, new PngCrc32().Crc(chunkData, chunkData.Length));
		}

		private static MemoryStream InsertPhysChunk(MemoryStream inStream, long ihdrEndLocation, SizeF resolution)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			inStream.Position = 0L;
			StreamHelper.CopyStream((Stream)inStream, (Stream)memoryStream, ihdrEndLocation);
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt32Be(memoryStream, 9u);
			BinaryHelper.WriteAsciiString(memoryStream, "pHYs");
			WritePhysChunkData(memoryStream, resolution);
			WritePhysChunkCrc(memoryStream, resolution);
			inStream.Position = ihdrEndLocation;
			StreamHelper.CopyStream((Stream)inStream, (Stream)memoryStream);
			return memoryStream;
		}
	}
	internal class PngReader
	{
		private static readonly byte[] headerSignature = new byte[8] { 137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10 };

		public const string ChunkTypeIhdr = "IHDR";

		public const string ChunkTypePhys = "pHYs";

		public const string ChunkTypeIdat = "IDAT";

		public const string ChunkTypeIend = "IEND";

		private readonly Stream stream;

		public long ChunkLenght { get; private set; }

		public string ChunkType { get; private set; }

		public long ChunkDataPosition { get; private set; }

		public long NextChunkStartPosition { get; private set; }

		public PngReader(Stream stream)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
		}

		public bool TryReadHeader()
		{
			byte[] a = BinaryHelper.ReadBytes(stream, headerSignature.Length);
			if (!BinaryHelper.AreEqual(a, headerSignature))
			{
				return false;
			}
			NextChunkStartPosition = stream.Position;
			return true;
		}

		public bool ReadNextChunkHeader()
		{
			if (ChunkType == "IEND")
			{
				return false;
			}
			stream.Position = NextChunkStartPosition;
			long position = stream.Position;
			if (stream.Position + 12 > stream.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			long num = ReadUInt32Be();
			if (stream.Position + num - 4 > stream.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ChunkLenght = num;
			ChunkType = ReadChunkType();
			ChunkDataPosition = stream.Position;
			NextChunkStartPosition += num + 12;
			return true;
		}

		public ChunkDataPhys ReadPhysChunkData()
		{
			return new ChunkDataPhys
			{
				PixelPerUnitX = ReadUInt32Be(),
				PixelPerUnitY = ReadUInt32Be(),
				UnitSpecifier = (byte)stream.ReadByte()
			};
		}

		private uint ReadUInt32Be()
		{
			return BinaryHelper.ReadUInt32Be(stream);
		}

		private string ReadChunkType()
		{
			return BinaryHelper.ReadAsciiString(stream, 4);
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.Images.Jpeg
{
	internal static class JpegHelper
	{
		private const ushort markerSoi = 65496;

		private const ushort markerApp0 = 65504;

		private const string identifierJfif = "JFIF\0";

		private const ushort minJfifLen = 16;

		private const ushort jfifVersion11 = 257;

		private const byte unitsNoUnits = 0;

		private const byte unitsPpi = 1;

		private const byte unitsPpcm = 2;

		public static SizeF ParseResolution(Stream stream)
		{
			ushort num = BinaryHelper.ReadUInt16Be(stream);
			if (num != 65496)
			{
				return DXGraphicsDpi.DefaultImageResolutionSize;
			}
			if (!CheckJfifMarkerHeader(stream))
			{
				return DXGraphicsDpi.DefaultImageResolutionSize;
			}
			byte units = BinaryHelper.ReadByte(stream);
			ushort num2 = BinaryHelper.ReadUInt16Be(stream);
			ushort num3 = BinaryHelper.ReadUInt16Be(stream);
			return new SizeF(GetActualDensity((int)num2, units), GetActualDensity((int)num3, units));
		}

		private static float GetActualDensity(float density, byte units)
		{
			if (density == 0f)
			{
				return 96f;
			}
			return units switch
			{
				1 => density, 
				2 => UnitConverterHelper.PpcmToPpi(density), 
				_ => 96f, 
			};
		}

		public static MemoryStream AppendResolution(MemoryStream stream, SizeF resolution)
		{
			ushort num = BinaryHelper.ReadUInt16Be(stream);
			if (num != 65496)
			{
				return stream;
			}
			if (CheckJfifMarkerHeader(stream))
			{
				WriteJfifResolution(stream, resolution);
				return stream;
			}
			return InsertJfifMarker(stream, resolution);
		}

		private static bool CheckJfifMarkerHeader(Stream stream)
		{
			ushort num = BinaryHelper.ReadUInt16Be(stream);
			if (num != 65504)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ushort num2 = BinaryHelper.ReadUInt16Be(stream);
			if (num2 < 16)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = BinaryHelper.ReadAsciiString(stream, 5);
			if (text != "JFIF\0")
			{
				return false;
			}
			stream.Position += 2L;
			return true;
		}

		private static void WriteJfifResolution(MemoryStream stream, SizeF resolution)
		{
			stream.WriteByte(1);
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt16Be(stream, (ushort)resolution.Width);
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt16Be(stream, (ushort)resolution.Height);
		}

		private static MemoryStream InsertJfifMarker(MemoryStream inStream, SizeF resolution)
		{
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt16Be(memoryStream, 65496);
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt16Be(memoryStream, 65504);
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt16Be(memoryStream, 16);
			BinaryHelper.WriteAsciiString(memoryStream, "JFIF\0");
			BinaryHelper.WriteUInt16Be(memoryStream, 257);
			WriteJfifResolution(memoryStream, resolution);
			memoryStream.WriteByte(0);
			memoryStream.WriteByte(0);
			inStream.Position = 2L;
			StreamHelper.CopyStream((Stream)inStream, (Stream)memoryStream);
			return memoryStream;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.Images.Tiff
{
	internal static class TiffHelper
	{
		public static bool IsTiffStream(Stream stream)
		{
			long position = stream.Position;
			byte[] array = new byte[8];
			int num = StreamHelper.FillBuffer(stream, array, 0, 8);
			stream.Position = position;
			if (num != 8)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = array[0] == 73 && array[1] == 73;
			bool flag2 = array[0] == 77 && array[1] == 77;
			if (!flag && !flag2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flag && array[2] != 42 && array[3] != 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (flag2 && array[2] != 0 && array[3] != 42)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
}

	[CLSCompliant(false)]
	public sealed class TiffClientStream : IDisposable
	{
		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		public delegate int ReadDelegate(IntPtr handle, IntPtr buf, int size);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		public delegate int WriteDelegate(IntPtr fd, IntPtr buf, int size);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		public delegate uint SeekDelegate(IntPtr fd, uint offset, int origin);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		public delegate int CloseDelegate(IntPtr fd);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		public delegate uint SizeDelegate(IntPtr fd);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		public delegate int MapDelegate(IntPtr fd, IntPtr phase, out uint psize);

		[UnmanagedFunctionPointer(CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		public delegate void UnmapDelegate(IntPtr fd, IntPtr baseBuf, int size);

		private readonly Stream baseStream;

		private readonly GCHandle ReadDelegateHandle;

		private readonly GCHandle WriteDelegateHandle;

		private readonly GCHandle SeekDelegateHandle;

		private readonly GCHandle CloseDelegateHandle;

		private readonly GCHandle SizeDelegateHandle;

		private readonly GCHandle MapDelegateHandle;

		private readonly GCHandle UnmapDelegateHandle;

		public ReadDelegate ReadDelegateInstance { get; }

		public WriteDelegate WriteDelegateInstance { get; }

		public SeekDelegate SeekDelegateInstance { get; }

		public CloseDelegate CloseDelegateInstance { get; }

		public SizeDelegate SizeDelegateInstance { get; }

		public MapDelegate MapDelegateInstance { get; }

		public UnmapDelegate UnmapDelegateInstance { get; }

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public TiffClientStream(Stream baseStream)
		{
			this.baseStream = baseStream;
			ReadDelegateInstance = Read;
			WriteDelegateInstance = Write;
			SeekDelegateInstance = Seek;
			CloseDelegateInstance = Close;
			SizeDelegateInstance = Size;
			MapDelegateInstance = Map;
			UnmapDelegateInstance = Unmap;
			ReadDelegateHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(ReadDelegateInstance, GCHandleType.Normal);
			WriteDelegateHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(WriteDelegateInstance, GCHandleType.Normal);
			SeekDelegateHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(SeekDelegateInstance, GCHandleType.Normal);
			CloseDelegateHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(CloseDelegateInstance, GCHandleType.Normal);
			SizeDelegateHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(SizeDelegateInstance, GCHandleType.Normal);
			MapDelegateHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(MapDelegateInstance, GCHandleType.Normal);
			UnmapDelegateHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(UnmapDelegateInstance, GCHandleType.Normal);
		}

		public int Read(IntPtr handle, IntPtr buf, int size)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[size];
			int num = baseStream.Read(array, 0, size);
			Marshal.Copy(array, 0, buf, num);
			return num;
		}

		public int Write(IntPtr fd, IntPtr buf, int size)
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[size];
			Marshal.Copy(buf, array, 0, size);
			baseStream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
			return size;
		}

		public uint Seek(IntPtr fd, uint offset, int origin)
		{
			return (uint)baseStream.Seek(offset, GetSeekOrigin(origin));
		}

		private static SeekOrigin GetSeekOrigin(int value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				0 => SeekOrigin.Begin, 
				1 => SeekOrigin.Current, 
				2 => SeekOrigin.End, 
				_ => SeekOrigin.Begin, 
			};
		}

		public int Close(IntPtr fd)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public uint Size(IntPtr fd)
		{
			return (uint)baseStream.Length;
		}

		public int Map(IntPtr fd, IntPtr phase, out uint psize)
		{
			psize = 0u;
			return 0;
		}

		public void Unmap(IntPtr fd, IntPtr baseBuf, int size)
		{
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			ReadDelegateHandle.Free();
			WriteDelegateHandle.Free();
			SeekDelegateHandle.Free();
			CloseDelegateHandle.Free();
			SizeDelegateHandle.Free();
			MapDelegateHandle.Free();
			UnmapDelegateHandle.Free();
		}
	}

			}

					return Interop.TIFFOpen(((Marshaler)utf8StringMarshaler).Pointer, ((Marshaler)utf8StringMarshaler2).Pointer);

			Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 317u, 2);
			Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 296u, 2);
			Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 282u, (double)hRes);
			Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 283u, (double)vRes);
			Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 262u, 2);
			if (alphaChannel)

				Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 277u, 4);
				Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 258u, 8, 8, 8, 8);
				Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 338u, 1, new ushort[1] { 2 });

			else

				Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 258u, 8, 8, 8);
			}
			Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 284u, 1);

			Interop.TIFFSetField(tif, 278u, value);

	[CLSCompliant(false)]
	public interface ILibTiffInterop
	{
		IntPtr TIFFOpen(IntPtr path, IntPtr mode);

		void TIFFClose(IntPtr tif);

		int TIFFGetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, out uint output);

		int TIFFGetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, out ushort output);

		int TIFFGetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, out double output);

		int TIFFGetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, out float output);

		int TIFFSetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, uint value);

		int TIFFSetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, ushort value);

		int TIFFSetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, float value);

		int TIFFSetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, double value);

		int TIFFSetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, ushort v1, ushort[] arr);

		int TIFFSetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, ushort v1, ushort v2);

		int TIFFSetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, ushort v1, ushort v2, ushort v3);

		int TIFFSetField(IntPtr tif, uint tag, ushort v1, ushort v2, ushort v3, ushort v4);

		int TIFFReadRGBAImageOriented(IntPtr tif, uint width, uint height, IntPtr raster, int orientation, int stopOnError);

		int TIFFWriteScanline(IntPtr tif, IntPtr buf, uint row, ushort sample);

		uint TIFFDefaultStripSize(IntPtr tif, uint estimate);

		int TIFFWriteDirectory(IntPtr tif);

		IntPtr _TIFFmalloc(uint size);

		void _TIFFfree(IntPtr buffer);

		IntPtr TIFFClientOpen(IntPtr filename, IntPtr mode, IntPtr clientdata, TiffClientStream.ReadDelegate readproc, TiffClientStream.WriteDelegate writeproc, TiffClientStream.SeekDelegate seekproc, TiffClientStream.CloseDelegate closeproc, TiffClientStream.SizeDelegate sizeproc, TiffClientStream.MapDelegate mapproc, TiffClientStream.UnmapDelegate unmapproc);
	}
	internal sealed class Tiff : IDisposable
	{
		private const string readMode = "r";

		private const string writeMode = "w";

		private readonly TiffNativeObject nativeObject;

		private readonly TiffClientStream clientStream;

		private IntPtr TiffPtr => nativeObject.NativeObject;

		public bool IsOpened => nativeObject.IsOpened;

		private Tiff(IntPtr tiffPtr, TiffClientStream clientStream)
		{
			nativeObject = new TiffNativeObject(tiffPtr);
			this.clientStream = clientStream;
		}

		public static Tiff OpenFileRead(string filePath)
		{
			return new Tiff(LibTiffInterop.TiffOpenFile(filePath, "r"), null);
		}

		public static Tiff OpenFileWrite(string filePath)
		{
			return new Tiff(LibTiffInterop.TiffOpenFile(filePath, "w"), null);
		}

		public static Tiff OpenStreamRead(Stream stream)
		{
			TiffClientStream tiffClientStream = new TiffClientStream(stream);
			IntPtr tiffPtr = LibTiffInterop.TiffClientOpen(tiffClientStream, "r");
			return new Tiff(tiffPtr, tiffClientStream);
		}

		public static Tiff OpenStreamWrite(Stream stream)
		{
			TiffClientStream tiffClientStream = new TiffClientStream(stream);
			IntPtr tiffPtr = LibTiffInterop.TiffClientOpen(tiffClientStream, "w");
			return new Tiff(tiffPtr, tiffClientStream);
		}

		public Size GetSize()
		{
			return LibTiffInterop.GetImageSzie(TiffPtr);
		}

		public SizeF GetResolution()
		{
			return LibTiffInterop.GetImageResolution(TiffPtr);
		}

		public byte[] ReadRgba()
		{
			Size size = GetSize();
			using TiffMalloc tiffMalloc = new TiffMalloc(size.Width * size.Height * 4);
			LibTiffInterop.ReadRgba(TiffPtr, (uint)size.Width, (uint)size.Height, tiffMalloc.NativeObject);
			return tiffMalloc.CopyToByteArray();
		}

		public void SetImageTags(int width, int height, bool alphaChannel, float hRes, float vRes)
		{
			LibTiffInterop.SetImageTags(TiffPtr, width, height, alphaChannel, hRes, vRes);
		}

		public void WriteScanline(TiffMalloc scanline, int row)
		{
			LibTiffInterop.WriteScanline(TiffPtr, scanline.NativeObject, row);
		}

		public void WriteDirectory()
		{
			LibTiffInterop.TiffWriteDirectory(nativeObject.NativeObject);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			nativeObject.Dispose();
			clientStream?.Dispose();
		}
	}
	internal class TiffMalloc : ExternalObject
	{
		public int Size { get; private set; }

		public TiffMalloc(int size)
			: base(LibTiffInterop.TiffMalloc((uint)size))
		{
			Size = size;
		}

		public byte[] CopyToByteArray()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[Size];
			Marshal.Copy(base.NativeObject, array, 0, Size);
			return array;
		}

		protected override void DisposeCore(bool disposing)
		{
			LibTiffInterop.TiffFree(base.NativeObject);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.Fonts
{
	public interface IDXFontFallback
	{
		DXFontFace GetFallbackFont(StringView str, DXFontDescriptor descriptor);
	}
	public abstract class DXShaper<TAnalysisRun> : IDXShaper, IDisposable where TAnalysisRun : class, IDXTextAnalysisRun
	{
		private readonly IDXFontFallback fontFallback;

		private readonly bool supportsKerning;

		protected abstract DXFontDescriptor Descriptor { get; }

		private static IList<DXCluster> ShapeNonVisualRun(TAnalysisRun run)
		{
			StringView text = run.Text;
			IList<DXCluster> list = new DXCluster[text.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				list[i] = new DXCluster(new DXGlyph[1]
				{
					new DXGlyph(0, 0f, default(DXGlyphOffset))
				}, text.CreateSegment(i, 1), run.GetBreakpoint(i), run.BidiLevel, text[i] == '\t');
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected DXShaper(IDXFontFallback fontFallback, bool supportsKerning)
		{
			this.fontFallback = fontFallback;
			this.supportsKerning = supportsKerning;
		}

		public IList<DXCluster> ShapeText(string text, bool directionRightToLeft, float fontSizeInPoints, bool useKerning)
		{
			if (text.Length == 0)
			{
				return new DXCluster[0];
			}
			if (!supportsKerning)
			{
				useKerning = false;
			}
			List<DXCluster> list = new List<DXCluster>(text.Length);
			foreach (TAnalysisRun item in CreateTextAnalysisRuns(text, directionRightToLeft))
			{
				if (item.IsNonVisual)
				{
					list.AddRange(ShapeNonVisualRun(item));
					continue;
				}
				if (!FontHasCharacters(item.Text))
				{
					using DXFontFace dXFontFace = fontFallback?.GetFallbackFont(item.Text, Descriptor);
					if (dXFontFace != null)
					{
						list.AddRange(PerformFallback(dXFontFace, item, fontSizeInPoints, useKerning));
						continue;
					}
				}
				list.AddRange(ShapeVisualTextAnalysisRun(item, fontSizeInPoints, useKerning));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<DXCluster> PerformFallback(DXFontFace fallbackFace, TAnalysisRun run, float fontSizeInPoints, bool useKerning)
		{
			using IDXShaper iDXShaper = fallbackFace.CreateShaper();
			if (!iDXShaper.FontHasCharacters(run.Text))
			{
				return PerformFallbackIndividualChars(run, fallbackFace, iDXShaper, fontSizeInPoints, useKerning);
			}
			return GetFallbackClusters(run, fallbackFace, iDXShaper, fontSizeInPoints, useKerning);
		}

		private IEnumerable<DXCluster> GetFallbackClusters(TAnalysisRun run, DXFontFace fallbackFace, IDXShaper fallbackShaper, float fontSizeInPoints, bool useKerning)
		{
			string fallbackFamily = fallbackFace.GetWin32FamilyName();
			DXFontStyle fallbackStyle = ((fallbackFace.Slant == DXFontStyleSlant.Italic) ? DXFontStyle.Italic : DXFontStyle.Regular);
			if (fallbackFace.Weight > DXFontWeight.Normal)
			{
				fallbackStyle |= DXFontStyle.Bold;
			}
			IList<DXCluster> fallbackClusters = fallbackShaper.ShapeText(run.Text.GetText(), run.BidiLevel % 2 != 0, fontSizeInPoints, useKerning);
			for (int i = 0; i < fallbackClusters.Count; i++)
			{
				DXCluster dXCluster = fallbackClusters[i];
				if (!dXCluster.IsNotDefGlyph)
				{
					dXCluster.FallbackFontFamily = fallbackFamily;
					dXCluster.FallbackFontStyle = fallbackStyle;
				}
				yield return dXCluster;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<DXCluster> PerformFallbackIndividualChars(TAnalysisRun run, DXFontFace fallbackFace, IDXShaper fallbackShaper, float fontSizeInPoints, bool useKerning)
		{
			int? startBaseFontRange = null;
			int stringPos = 0;
			while (stringPos < run.Text.Length)
			{
				int charStartPos = stringPos;
				int utf32Char = run.Text.GetUtf32Char(charStartPos);
				int utf16Lenght = UnicodeHelper.GetUtf16Lenght(utf32Char);
				StringView charSegment = run.Text.CreateSegment(charStartPos, utf16Lenght);
				stringPos += utf16Lenght;
				if (FontHasCharacters(charSegment))
				{
					if (!startBaseFontRange.HasValue)
					{
						startBaseFontRange = charStartPos;
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (startBaseFontRange.HasValue)
				{
					foreach (DXCluster item in ShapeTextRunNoFallback(run.Text.CreateSegment(startBaseFontRange.Value, charStartPos - startBaseFontRange.Value), fontSizeInPoints, useKerning, run.BidiLevel % 2 != 0))
					{
						yield return item;
					}
				}
				startBaseFontRange = null;
				if (fallbackShaper.FontHasCharacters(charSegment))
				{
					foreach (TAnalysisRun item2 in CreateTextAnalysisRuns(charSegment.GetText(), run.BidiLevel % 2 != 0))
					{
						foreach (DXCluster fallbackCluster in GetFallbackClusters(item2, fallbackFace, fallbackShaper, fontSizeInPoints, useKerning))
						{
							yield return fallbackCluster;
						}
					}
					continue;
				}
				using (DXFontFace charFallbackFace = fontFallback?.GetFallbackFont(charSegment, Descriptor))
				{
					if (charFallbackFace != null)
					{
						using (IDXShaper charFallbackShaper = charFallbackFace.CreateShaper())
						{
							foreach (TAnalysisRun item3 in CreateTextAnalysisRuns(charSegment.GetText(), run.BidiLevel % 2 != 0))
							{
								foreach (DXCluster fallbackCluster2 in GetFallbackClusters(item3, charFallbackFace, charFallbackShaper, fontSizeInPoints, useKerning))
								{
									yield return fallbackCluster2;
								}
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (!startBaseFontRange.HasValue)
				{
					startBaseFontRange = charStartPos;
				}
			}
			if (!startBaseFontRange.HasValue)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			foreach (DXCluster item4 in ShapeTextRunNoFallback(run.Text.CreateSegment(startBaseFontRange.Value, run.Text.Length - startBaseFontRange.Value), fontSizeInPoints, useKerning, run.BidiLevel % 2 != 0))
			{
				yield return item4;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<IDXTextAnalysisRun> AnalyzeText(string text, bool directionRightToLeft)
		{
			return CreateTextAnalysisRuns(text, directionRightToLeft);
		}

		private IEnumerable<DXCluster> ShapeTextRunNoFallback(StringView text, float fontSizePoints, bool useKerning, bool isRtl)
		{
			foreach (TAnalysisRun item in CreateTextAnalysisRuns(text.GetText(), isRtl))
			{
				foreach (DXCluster item2 in ShapeVisualTextAnalysisRun(item, fontSizePoints, useKerning))
				{
					yield return item2;
				}
			}
		}

		public abstract bool FontHasCharacters(StringView text);

		protected abstract IList<DXCluster> ShapeVisualTextAnalysisRun(TAnalysisRun run, float fontSizeInPoints, bool useKerning);

		protected abstract IEnumerable<TAnalysisRun> CreateTextAnalysisRuns(string text, bool directionRightToLeft);

		public abstract void Dispose();
	}
	public class DXTextLine : List<DXClusterRun>
	{
		public static DXTextLine[] CreateGlyphRunLines(IList<DXCluster> glyphRun)
		{
			if (glyphRun.Count == 0)
			{
				return new DXTextLine[0];
			}
			return new DXTextLine[1]
			{
				new DXTextLine
				{
					new DXClusterRun(glyphRun, null, DXFontStyle.Regular)
				}
			};
		}

		public static DXTextLine Create(IList<DXCluster> clusters)
		{
			if (clusters.Count == 0)
			{
				return new DXTextLine();
			}
			string text = null;
			DXFontStyle dXFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
			int num = 0;
			DXTextLine dXTextLine = new DXTextLine();
			for (int i = 0; i < clusters.Count; i++)
			{
				DXCluster dXCluster = clusters[i];
				if (dXCluster.FallbackFontFamily != text || dXCluster.FallbackFontStyle != dXFontStyle)
				{
					if (num != i)
					{
						dXTextLine.Add(new DXClusterRun(new ClusterListSegment(clusters, num, i), text, dXFontStyle));
					}
					text = dXCluster.FallbackFontFamily;
					dXFontStyle = dXCluster.FallbackFontStyle;
					num = i;
				}
			}
			dXTextLine.Add(new DXClusterRun(new ClusterListSegment(clusters, num, clusters.Count), text, dXFontStyle));
			return dXTextLine;
		}

		private DXTextLine()
		{
		}

		public float GetWidth()
		{
			return this.Sum((DXClusterRun l) => l.GetWidth());
		}
	}
	public struct DXClusterRun
	{
		public string FallbackFontFamily { get; }

		public DXFontStyle FallbackFontStyle { get; }

		public IEnumerable<DXCluster> Clusters { get; }

		public DXClusterRun(IEnumerable<DXCluster> clusters, string fallbackFontFamily, DXFontStyle fallbackFontStyle)
		{
			Clusters = clusters;
			FallbackFontFamily = fallbackFontFamily;
			FallbackFontStyle = fallbackFontStyle;
		}

		public float GetWidth()
		{
			return Clusters.Sum((DXCluster c) => c.Width);
		}
	}
	public static class DXJustifyHelper
	{
		public static void Justify(IList<DXCluster> clusters, float lineMaxWidth)
		{
			float num = clusters.Sum((DXCluster x) => x.Width);
			if (clusters.Count == 0 || num == lineMaxWidth)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num2 = clusters.Where((DXCluster x) => x.Breakpoint.IsWhitespace).Count();
			float num3 = (lineMaxWidth - num) / (float)num2;
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < clusters.Count; num4++)
			{
				if (clusters[num4].Breakpoint.IsWhitespace)
				{
					DXCluster dXCluster = clusters[num4];
					DXGlyph dXGlyph = dXCluster.Glyphs[0];
					DXGlyph glyph = new DXGlyph(dXGlyph.Index, dXGlyph.Advance + num3, dXGlyph.Offset);
					clusters[num4] = new DXCluster(glyph, dXCluster.Text, dXCluster.Breakpoint, dXCluster.BidiLevel, dXCluster.IsTabCluster);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DXLineFormatterFont : IDXLineFormatterFont, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly DXFontFace fontFace;

		private readonly IDXFontFallback fallback;

		public float Size { get; }

		public double Ascent { get; }

		public double Descent { get; }

		public double LineSpacing { get; }

		public DXLineFormatterFont(DXFontFace fontFace, float fontSize, IDXFontFallback fallback)
		{
			this.fallback = fallback;
			this.fontFace = fontFace;
			DXFontMetrics metrics = fontFace.Metrics;
			double num = metrics.UnitsPerEm;
			Ascent = (double)metrics.EmAscent / num * (double)fontSize;
			Descent = (double)metrics.EmDescent / num * (double)fontSize;
			LineSpacing = (double)metrics.EmLineSpacing / num * (double)fontSize;
			Size = fontSize;
		}

		public IList<DXCluster> ShapeText(string text, bool directionRightToLeft, bool useKerning)
		{
			using IDXShaper iDXShaper = fontFace.CreateShaper(fallback);
			return iDXShaper.ShapeText(text, directionRightToLeft, Size, useKerning);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}
	}
	public class DXLineFormatterOptions
	{
		public DXKerningMode KerningMode { get; set; }

		public bool JustifyText { get; set; }

		public DXLineFormatterOptions(DXKerningMode kerningMode, bool justifyText = false)
		{
			KerningMode = kerningMode;
			JustifyText = justifyText;
		}
	}
	public interface IDXLineFormatterFont : IDisposable
	{
		double Ascent { get; }

		double Descent { get; }

		double LineSpacing { get; }

		float Size { get; }

		IList<DXCluster> ShapeText(string text, bool directionRightToLeft, bool useKerning);
	}
	public interface IDXShaper : IDisposable
	{
		IEnumerable<IDXTextAnalysisRun> AnalyzeText(string text, bool directionRightToLeft);

		IList<DXCluster> ShapeText(string text, bool directionRightToLeft, float fontSizeInPoints, bool useKerning);

		bool FontHasCharacters(StringView text);
	}
	public abstract class DXTextAnalysisRun<T> : DXTextBufferRun<T>, IDXTextAnalysisRun where T : IDXTextBufferRun<T>
	{
		public StringView Text { get; private set; }

		public byte BidiLevel { get; set; }

		public bool IsNonVisual { get; set; }

		protected DXTextAnalysisRun(int offset, int length, StringView text, byte bidiLevel)
			: base(offset, length)
		{
			Text = text;
			BidiLevel = bidiLevel;
		}

		public abstract DXLineBreakpoint GetBreakpoint(int index);

		protected override T CreateAndUpdateRun(int offset, int length)
		{
			StringView text = Text;
			Text = text.CreateSegment(0, base.Length);
			return CreateTextAnalysisRun(offset, length, text.CreateSegment(offset - base.Offset), BidiLevel);
		}

		protected abstract T CreateTextAnalysisRun(int offset, int length, StringView text, byte bidiLevel);
	}

		private static int[] panoseWeights = new int[10] { 100, 10, 1, 5, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1 };

		private readonly string defaultFontFamily;

		private readonly Lazy<IDXFontCollection> systemFontCollection;

		private readonly Lazy<IDXFontCollection> customGlobalFontCollection;

		private readonly Lazy<IDXPrivateFontCollection> customLocalFontCollection;

		public DXFontFace MatchFontFace(string win32Family, DXFontStyle style)
		{
			IDXFontFamily iDXFontFamily = FindFamily(win32Family);
			if (iDXFontFamily != null)
			{
				DXFontDescriptor descriptor = DXFontNamesHelper.GetDescriptor(win32Family, style);
				return iDXFontFamily.GetFirstMatchingFontFace(descriptor.Weight, descriptor.Stretch, descriptor.Slant);
			}
			DXFontFace dXFontFace = MatchFaceUsingWin32Name(win32Family, style);
			if (dXFontFace != null)
			{
				return dXFontFace;
			}
			return MatchFontFaceFallback(DXFontNamesHelper.GetDescriptor(win32Family, style));
		}

		private DXFontFace MatchFaceUsingWin32Name(string win32Family, DXFontStyle style)
		{
			DXFontFace dXFontFace = customLocalFontCollection.Value.MatchFaceByWin32Name(win32Family, style);
			if (dXFontFace != null)
			{
				return dXFontFace;
			}
			if (!DXFontRepository.Instance.IsEmpty)
			{
				dXFontFace = customGlobalFontCollection.Value.MatchFaceByWin32Name(win32Family, style);
				if (dXFontFace != null)
				{
					return dXFontFace;
				}
			}
			return systemFontCollection.Value.MatchFaceByWin32Name(win32Family, style);
		}

		public DXFontFace MatchFontFace(DXFontDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			IDXFontFamily iDXFontFamily = FindFamily(descriptor.FamilyName);
			if (iDXFontFamily != null)
			{
				return iDXFontFamily.GetFirstMatchingFontFace(descriptor.Weight, descriptor.Stretch, descriptor.Slant);
			}
			return MatchFontFaceFallback(descriptor);
		}

		private DXFontFace MatchFontFaceFallback(DXFontDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			string familyName = descriptor.FamilyName;
			DXFontWeight weight = descriptor.Weight;
			DXFontStretch stretch = descriptor.Stretch;
			DXFontStyleSlant slant = descriptor.Slant;
			IDXFontFamily iDXFontFamily = MatchFamilyMappingTable(familyName);
			if (iDXFontFamily == null && fontPanoseTable.TryGetValue(familyName, out var value))
			{
				string familyName2 = FindMostMatchingFont(value, weight, stretch, slant);
				iDXFontFamily = FindFamily(familyName2);
			}
			if (iDXFontFamily == null && defaultFontFamily != null)
			{
				iDXFontFamily = FindFamily(defaultFontFamily);
			}
			if (iDXFontFamily == null)
			{
				iDXFontFamily = systemFontCollection.Value.Families.FirstOrDefault();
			}
			if (iDXFontFamily == null)
			{
				iDXFontFamily = customLocalFontCollection.Value.Families.FirstOrDefault();
			}
			if (iDXFontFamily == null && !DXFontRepository.Instance.IsEmpty)
			{
				iDXFontFamily = customGlobalFontCollection.Value.Families.FirstOrDefault();
			}
			return iDXFontFamily?.GetFirstMatchingFontFace(weight, stretch, slant);
		}

		private IEnumerable<IDXFontFamily> EnumerateFamilies()
		{
			foreach (IDXFontFamily family in customLocalFontCollection.Value.Families)
			{
				yield return family;
			}
			if (!DXFontRepository.Instance.IsEmpty)
			{
				foreach (IDXFontFamily family2 in customGlobalFontCollection.Value.Families)
				{
					yield return family2;
				}
			}
			foreach (IDXFontFamily family3 in systemFontCollection.Value.Families)
			{
				yield return family3;
			}
		}

		private string FindMostMatchingFont(byte[] panose, DXFontWeight weight, DXFontStretch stretch, DXFontStyleSlant style)
		{
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			string result = null;
			foreach (IDXFontFamily item in EnumerateFamilies())
			{
				DXFontFace firstMatchingFontFace = item.GetFirstMatchingFontFace(weight, stretch, style);
				if (firstMatchingFontFace == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				byte[] panose2 = firstMatchingFontFace.Panose;
				if (panose2 != null && panose.Length == panose2.Length && panose2[0] == 2)
				{
					if (panose.SequenceEqual(panose2))
					{
						return firstMatchingFontFace.FamilyName;
					}
					int num2 = int.MaxValue;
					for (int i = 1; i < panose.Length; i++)
					{
						num2 += Math.Abs(panose[i] - panose2[i]) * panoseWeights[i];
					}
					if (num2 < num)
					{
						num = num2;
						result = firstMatchingFontFace.FamilyName;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private IDXFontFamily MatchFamilyMappingTable(string familyName)
		{
			if (fontMapTable.TryGetValue(familyName, out var value))
			{
				foreach (string item in value)
				{
					IDXFontFamily iDXFontFamily = FindFamily(item);
					if (iDXFontFamily != null)
					{
						return iDXFontFamily;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IDXFontFamily FindFamily(string familyName)
		{
			IDXFontFamily iDXFontFamily = customLocalFontCollection.Value.FindFamily(familyName);
			if (iDXFontFamily != null)
			{
				return iDXFontFamily;
			}
			if (!DXFontRepository.Instance.IsEmpty)
			{
				iDXFontFamily = customGlobalFontCollection.Value.FindFamily(familyName);
			}
			return iDXFontFamily ?? systemFontCollection.Value.FindFamily(familyName);
		}

		protected DXFontEngine(string defaultFontFamily)
		{
			this.defaultFontFamily = defaultFontFamily;
			systemFontCollection = new Lazy<IDXFontCollection>(CreateSystemFontCollection);
			customGlobalFontCollection = new Lazy<IDXFontCollection>(CreateGlobalPrivateFontCollection);
			customLocalFontCollection = new Lazy<IDXPrivateFontCollection>(CreateLocalPrivateFontCollection);
		}

		public IEnumerable<DXFontInfo> GetFontsInfo()
		{
			return systemFontCollection.Value.GetFontsInfo().Concat(customGlobalFontCollection.Value.GetFontsInfo()).Distinct();
		}

		public string[] AddMemoryFont(byte[] fontFileData)
		{
			return customLocalFontCollection.Value.AddFont(fontFileData);
		}

		public abstract IEnumerable<DXFontData> CreateFontData(byte[] fontFile);

		public abstract IEnumerable<DXFontData> CreateFontData(string fileName);

		protected abstract IDXFontCollection CreateSystemFontCollection();

		protected abstract IDXFontCollection CreateGlobalPrivateFontCollection();

		protected abstract IDXPrivateFontCollection CreateLocalPrivateFontCollection();

		public virtual DXFontFace GetFallbackFont(StringView str, DXFontDescriptor sourceFont)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			if (systemFontCollection.IsValueCreated)
			{
				systemFontCollection.Value.Dispose();
			}
			if (customGlobalFontCollection.IsValueCreated)
			{
				customGlobalFontCollection.Value.Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IDXTextAnalysisRun
	{
		StringView Text { get; }

		byte BidiLevel { get; }

		bool IsNonVisual { get; }

		DXLineBreakpoint GetBreakpoint(int index);
	}
	public abstract class DXTextBufferRun<T> : IDXTextBufferRun<T> where T : IDXTextBufferRun<T>
	{
		public int Offset { get; }

		public int Length { get; private set; }

		protected DXTextBufferRun(int offset, int length)
		{
			Offset = offset;
			Length = length;
		}

		public T Split(int splitOffset)
		{
			int length = Length;
			Length = splitOffset - Offset;
			return CreateAndUpdateRun(splitOffset, length - Length);
		}

		protected abstract T CreateAndUpdateRun(int offset, int length);
	}

	internal class DXLineBreakAnalyzer : IDXLineBreakAnalyzer
	{
		protected enum LineBreakClass : byte
		{
			SOT,
			EOT,
			CM,
			BA,
			LF,
			BK,
			CR,
			SP,
			EX,
			QU,
			AL,
			PR,
			PO,
			OP,
			CP,
			IS,
			HY,
			SY,
			NU,
			CL,
			NL,
			GL,
			AI,
			BB,
			HL,
			SA,
			JL,
			JV,
			JT,
			NS,
			ZW,
			ZWJ,
			B2,
			IN,
			WJ,
			ID,
			EB,
			CJ,
			H2,
			H3,
			SG,
			XX,
			CB,
			RI,
			EM
		}

		private class LB25
		{
			private readonly bool[] isProcessed;

			private static LineBreakClass GetNext(int i, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess)
			{
				if (i >= breakClasess.Length - 1)
				{
					return LineBreakClass.EOT;
				}
				return breakClasess[i + 1];
			}

			public LB25(int length)
			{
				isProcessed = new bool[length];
			}

			public void MatchPRPO(int i, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess, AnalyzerContext context)
			{
				if (isProcessed[i])
				{
					return;
				}
				switch (GetNext(i, breakClasess))
				{
				case LineBreakClass.OP:
				case LineBreakClass.HY:
					if (GetNext(i + 1, breakClasess) == LineBreakClass.NU)
					{
						Match(i, i + 2, breakClasess, context);
					}
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.NU:
					Match(i, i + 1, breakClasess, context);
					break;
				}
			}

			public void MatchOPNY(int i, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess, AnalyzerContext context)
			{
				if (!isProcessed[i] && GetNext(i, breakClasess) == LineBreakClass.NU)
				{
					Match(i, i + 1, breakClasess, context);
				}
			}

			public void Match(int i, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess, AnalyzerContext context)
			{
				if (!isProcessed[i])
				{
					Match(i, i, breakClasess, context);
				}
			}

			private void Match(int start, int end, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess, AnalyzerContext context)
			{
				while (true)
				{
					switch (GetNext(end, breakClasess))
					{
					case LineBreakClass.CP:
					case LineBreakClass.CL:
					{
						end++;
						LineBreakClass next = GetNext(end, breakClasess);
						if (next == LineBreakClass.PR || next == LineBreakClass.PO)
						{
							end++;
						}
						break;
					}
					case LineBreakClass.PR:
					case LineBreakClass.PO:
						end++;
						break;
					case LineBreakClass.IS:
					case LineBreakClass.SY:
					case LineBreakClass.NU:
						goto IL_0050;
					}
					break;
					IL_0050:
					end++;
				}
				while (start < end)
				{
					isProcessed[start] = true;
					context.Assign(start, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 25);
					start++;
				}
			}
		}

		private class SpaceGroupRule
		{
			private readonly LineBreakClass breakClass;

			private readonly byte priority;

			public SpaceGroupRule(LineBreakClass breakClass, byte priority)
			{
				this.breakClass = breakClass;
				this.priority = priority;
			}

			public void Match(int i, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess, AnalyzerContext context)
			{
				int j = i;
				int num = breakClasess.Length;
				while (i < num - 1 && breakClasess[i + 1] == LineBreakClass.SP)
				{
					i++;
				}
				if (i < num - 1 && breakClasess[i + 1] == breakClass)
				{
					for (; j <= i; j++)
					{
						context.Assign(j, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, priority);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected struct RuleInfo
		{
			public byte Priority { get; }

			public DXBreakCondition Value { get; }

			public RuleInfo(byte priority, DXBreakCondition value)
			{
				Priority = priority;
				Value = value;
			}
		}

		protected class RuleCollection
		{
			private readonly RuleInfo[] ruleLookupTable;

			public RuleCollection(RuleInfo[] ruleLookupTable)
			{
				this.ruleLookupTable = ruleLookupTable;
			}

			public void Match(int i, LineBreakClass left, LineBreakClass right, AnalyzerContext context)
			{
				RuleInfo ruleInfo = ruleLookupTable[((uint)left << 6) | (uint)right];
				if (ruleInfo.Priority > 0)
				{
					context.Assign(i, ruleInfo.Value, ruleInfo.Priority);
				}
			}
		}

		protected class RuleBuilder
		{
			private readonly RuleInfo[] ruleLookupTable;

			public static IList<LineBreakClass> AllClasses { get; }

			static RuleBuilder()
			{
				AllClasses = new List<LineBreakClass>();
				foreach (LineBreakClass value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(LineBreakClass)))
				{
					AllClasses.Add(value);
				}
			}

			public RuleBuilder()
			{
				ruleLookupTable = new RuleInfo[2925];
			}

			public void AddPairRule(IList<LineBreakClass> left, IList<LineBreakClass> right, DXBreakCondition value, byte priority)
			{
				RuleInfo ruleInfo = new RuleInfo(priority, value);
				foreach (LineBreakClass item in left)
				{
					foreach (LineBreakClass item2 in right)
					{
						int num = (int)((uint)item << 6) | (int)item2;
						if (ruleLookupTable[num].Priority == 0 || ruleLookupTable[num].Priority > priority)
						{
							ruleLookupTable[num] = ruleInfo;
						}
					}
				}
			}

			public void AddBeforeRule(IList<LineBreakClass> right, DXBreakCondition value, byte priority)
			{
				AddPairRule(AllClasses, right, value, priority);
			}

			public void AddAfterRule(IList<LineBreakClass> left, DXBreakCondition value, byte priority)
			{
				AddPairRule(left, AllClasses, value, priority);
			}

			public RuleCollection GetCollection()
			{
				return new RuleCollection(ruleLookupTable);
			}
		}

		protected class AnalyzerContext
		{
			public DXBreakCondition[] BreakConditionAfter { get; }

			public byte[] ResolvedPriority { get; }

			public AnalyzerContext(int count)
			{
				ResolvedPriority = new byte[count];
				BreakConditionAfter = new DXBreakCondition[count];
			}

			public void Assign(int index, DXBreakCondition value, byte priority)
			{
				if (ResolvedPriority[index] == 0 || priority < ResolvedPriority[index])
				{
					BreakConditionAfter[index] = value;
					ResolvedPriority[index] = priority;
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly LineBreakClass[] lineBreakClasses;

		private readonly RuleCollection rules;

		private readonly SpaceGroupRule lb15;

		private readonly SpaceGroupRule lb16;

		private readonly SpaceGroupRule lb17;

		public static IDXLineBreakAnalyzer Instance { get; }

		static DXLineBreakAnalyzer()
		{
			Instance = new DXLineBreakAnalyzer();
		}

		private static void SetRange(LineBreakClass[] lineBreakClasses, int start, int end, LineBreakClass value)
		{
			for (int i = start; i < end; i++)
			{
				lineBreakClasses[i] = value;
			}
		}

		private static int ReadCharCode(SfntStreamReader reader, bool isLong)
		{
			if (!isLong)
			{
				return reader.ReadUShort();
			}
			return reader.ReadInt();
		}

		private static void ParseLineBreakClasses(LineBreakClass[] lineBreakClasses)
		{
			using Stream stream = typeof(DXLineBreakAnalyzer).Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream("DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.Text.LineBreak.LineBreakClasses.bin");
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(stream);
			while (sfntStreamReader.Position != sfntStreamReader.Length)
			{
				byte b = sfntStreamReader.ReadByte();
				LineBreakClass lineBreakClass = (LineBreakClass)(b & 0x3F);
				bool isLong = (b & 0x80) != 0;
				if ((b & 0x40) != 0)
				{
					int num = ReadCharCode(sfntStreamReader, isLong);
					int num2 = ReadCharCode(sfntStreamReader, isLong);
					for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
					{
						lineBreakClasses[i] = lineBreakClass;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					lineBreakClasses[ReadCharCode(sfntStreamReader, isLong)] = lineBreakClass;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void MatchLB8(int i, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess, AnalyzerContext context)
		{
			context.Assign(i, DXBreakCondition.CanBreak, 8);
			int num = breakClasess.Length;
			while (i < num - 1 && breakClasess[i + 1] == LineBreakClass.SP)
			{
				i++;
			}
			context.Assign(i, DXBreakCondition.CanBreak, 8);
		}

		private static void MatchLB14(int i, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess, AnalyzerContext context)
		{
			int num = breakClasess.Length;
			while (i < num - 1 && breakClasess[i + 1] == LineBreakClass.SP)
			{
				context.Assign(i, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 14);
				i++;
			}
			context.Assign(i, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 14);
		}

		private static void MatchLB21A(int i, LineBreakClass[] breakClasess, AnalyzerContext context)
		{
			if (i < breakClasess.Length - 1)
			{
				LineBreakClass lineBreakClass = breakClasess[i + 1];
				if (lineBreakClass == LineBreakClass.HY || lineBreakClass == LineBreakClass.BA)
				{
					context.Assign(i + 1, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 21);
				}
			}
		}

		protected DXLineBreakAnalyzer()
		{
			lineBreakClasses = new LineBreakClass[1114110];
			SetRange(lineBreakClasses, 0, lineBreakClasses.Length - 1, LineBreakClass.XX);
			SetRange(lineBreakClasses, 13312, 19903, LineBreakClass.ID);
			SetRange(lineBreakClasses, 19968, 40959, LineBreakClass.ID);
			SetRange(lineBreakClasses, 63744, 64255, LineBreakClass.ID);
			SetRange(lineBreakClasses, 131072, 196605, LineBreakClass.ID);
			SetRange(lineBreakClasses, 196608, 262141, LineBreakClass.ID);
			SetRange(lineBreakClasses, 126976, 131069, LineBreakClass.ID);
			SetRange(lineBreakClasses, 8352, 8399, LineBreakClass.PR);
			ParseLineBreakClasses(lineBreakClasses);
			RuleBuilder ruleBuilder = new RuleBuilder();
			BuildLineBreakRules(ruleBuilder);
			rules = ruleBuilder.GetCollection();
			lb15 = new SpaceGroupRule(LineBreakClass.OP, 15);
			lb16 = new SpaceGroupRule(LineBreakClass.NS, 16);
			lb17 = new SpaceGroupRule(LineBreakClass.B2, 17);
		}

			builder.AddPairRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.CR }, new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.LF }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 5);
			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.CR }, DXBreakCondition.MustBreak, 5);
			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.LF }, DXBreakCondition.MustBreak, 5);
			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.NL }, DXBreakCondition.MustBreak, 5);
			builder.AddBeforeRule(new LineBreakClass[4]
			{
				LineBreakClass.BK,
				LineBreakClass.CR,
				LineBreakClass.LF,
				LineBreakClass.NL
			}, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 6);
			builder.AddBeforeRule(new LineBreakClass[2]
			{

				LineBreakClass.ZW

			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.ZWJ }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 8);

			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.WJ }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 11);
			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.GL }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 12);
			builder.AddPairRule(RuleBuilder.AllClasses.Where((LineBreakClass v) => v != LineBreakClass.SP && v != LineBreakClass.BA && v != LineBreakClass.HY).ToList(), new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.GL }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 12);
			builder.AddBeforeRule(new LineBreakClass[5]

				LineBreakClass.CP,
				LineBreakClass.EX,
				LineBreakClass.IS,
				LineBreakClass.SY
			}, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 13);
			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.SP }, DXBreakCondition.CanBreak, 18);
			builder.AddBeforeRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.QU }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 19);
			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.QU }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 19);
			builder.AddBeforeRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.CB }, DXBreakCondition.CanBreak, 20);
			builder.AddAfterRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.CB }, DXBreakCondition.CanBreak, 20);
			builder.AddBeforeRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.BA }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 21);
			builder.AddBeforeRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.HY }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 21);

			builder.AddPairRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.SY }, new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.HL }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 21);

			{
				LineBreakClass.AL,

			builder.AddPairRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.EX }, new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.IN }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 22);
			builder.AddPairRule(new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.IN }, new LineBreakClass[1] { LineBreakClass.IN }, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 22);

		public IList<DXBreakCondition> GetBreakPoints(string text)
		{
			LineBreakClass[] array = new LineBreakClass[text.Length];
			AnalyzerContext analyzerContext = new AnalyzerContext(text.Length);
			LB25 lB = new LB25(text.Length);
			int num = array.Length;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				LineBreakClass lineBreakClass;
				if (!char.IsHighSurrogate(c) || i >= num - 1)
				{
					lineBreakClass = ((!char.IsLowSurrogate(c) || i <= 0) ? lineBreakClasses[(uint)c] : array[i - 1]);
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = (((c & 0x3FF) << 10) | (text[i + 1] & 0x3FF)) + 65536;
					lineBreakClass = ((num2 < lineBreakClasses.Length) ? lineBreakClasses[num2] : LineBreakClass.XX);
					analyzerContext.Assign(i, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 1);
				}
				switch (lineBreakClass)
				{
				case LineBreakClass.AI:
				case LineBreakClass.SG:
				case LineBreakClass.XX:
					lineBreakClass = LineBreakClass.AL;
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.SA:
				{
					UnicodeCategory unicodeCategory = char.GetUnicodeCategory(text[i]);
					lineBreakClass = ((unicodeCategory != UnicodeCategory.NonSpacingMark && unicodeCategory != UnicodeCategory.SpacingCombiningMark) ? LineBreakClass.AL : LineBreakClass.CM);
					break;
				}
				case LineBreakClass.CJ:
					lineBreakClass = LineBreakClass.NS;
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.CM:
				case LineBreakClass.ZWJ:
					if (lineBreakClass == LineBreakClass.ZWJ)
					{
						analyzerContext.Assign(i, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 8);
					}
					if (i > 0)
					{
						LineBreakClass lineBreakClass2 = array[i - 1];
						if (lineBreakClass2 == LineBreakClass.BK || lineBreakClass2 == LineBreakClass.CR || lineBreakClass2 == LineBreakClass.LF || lineBreakClass2 == LineBreakClass.NL || lineBreakClass2 == LineBreakClass.SP || lineBreakClass2 == LineBreakClass.ZW)
						{
							lineBreakClass2 = LineBreakClass.AL;
						}
						else
						{
							analyzerContext.Assign(i - 1, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 10);
						}
						lineBreakClass = lineBreakClass2;
					}
					else
					{
						lineBreakClass = LineBreakClass.AL;
					}
					break;
				}
				array[i] = lineBreakClass;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				LineBreakClass left = array[j];
				LineBreakClass right = ((j >= num - 1) ? LineBreakClass.EOT : array[j + 1]);
				rules.Match(j, left, right, analyzerContext);
				switch (array[j])
				{
				case LineBreakClass.ZW:
					MatchLB8(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.OP:
					MatchLB14(j, array, analyzerContext);
					lB.MatchOPNY(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.QU:
					lb15.Match(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.CP:
				case LineBreakClass.CL:
					lb16.Match(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.B2:
					lb17.Match(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.HL:
					MatchLB21A(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.PR:
				case LineBreakClass.PO:
					lB.MatchPRPO(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.HY:
					lB.MatchOPNY(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.NU:
					lB.Match(j, array, analyzerContext);
					break;
				case LineBreakClass.RI:
				{
					if (j != 0 && array[j - 1] == LineBreakClass.RI)
					{
						break;
					}
					int k = j + 2;
					bool flag = true;
					for (; k < num && array[k] == LineBreakClass.RI; k += 2)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							analyzerContext.Assign(k - 1, DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, 30);
						}
						flag = !flag;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				analyzerContext.Assign(j, DXBreakCondition.CanBreak, byte.MaxValue);
			}
			return analyzerContext.BreakConditionAfter;
		}
	}
	public delegate T IFontProviderFactory<T>() where T : IFontProvider;
	public class CrossPlatformFontProvider : IFontProvider, IDisposable, IDXWin32FontCollection<FreeTypeFontFace>
	{
		private readonly object syncObject = new object();

		private readonly Dictionary<string, FreeTypeFontFamily> families = new Dictionary<string, FreeTypeFontFamily>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

		private Dictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FreeTypeFontFace>> win32Families;

		public IDictionary<string, FreeTypeFontFamily> Families => families;

		public void AddFontSource(string fontFileName)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				AddFonts(new MemoryMappedFileWrapper(fontFileName));
			}
		}

		public string[] AddFontSource(byte[] fontData)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				return AddFonts(new MemoryWrapper(fontData));
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				ClearCore();
			}
		}

		private string[] AddFonts(IFontFileDataContainer fontDataSource)
		{
			win32Families?.Clear();
			win32Families = null;
			using FontFileData fontFileData = new FontFileData(fontDataSource);
			FreeTypeFontFace freeTypeFontFace = new FreeTypeFontFace(fontFileData.Clone());
			int numFaces = freeTypeFontFace.NumFaces;
			string[] array = new string[numFaces];
			for (int i = 0; i < numFaces; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					freeTypeFontFace = new FreeTypeFontFace(fontFileData.Clone(), i);
				}
				array[i] = freeTypeFontFace.GetWin32FamilyName();
				string familyName = freeTypeFontFace.FamilyName;
				FreeTypeFontFamily value;
				bool flag = !families.TryGetValue(familyName, out value);
				if (flag)
				{
					value = new FreeTypeFontFamily(familyName, freeTypeFontFace);
					families.Add(familyName, value);
				}
				if (!flag && !value.AddFontFace(freeTypeFontFace))
				{
					freeTypeFontFace.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		public IDXFontFamily FindFamily(string familyName)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				if (families.TryGetValue(familyName, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public DXFontFace MatchFaceByWin32Name(string win32Name, DXFontStyle style)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				return DXWin32FontSearchHelper.MatchFaceByWin32Name(this, win32Name, style);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<DXFontInfo> GetFontsInfo()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				List<DXFontInfo> list = new List<DXFontInfo>();
				foreach (KeyValuePair<string, FreeTypeFontFamily> family in families)
				{
					list.AddRange(family.Value.GetFontsInfo());
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private void ClearCore()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, FreeTypeFontFamily> family in families)
			{
				family.Value.Dispose();
			}
			families.Clear();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				ClearCore();
			}
		}

		DXWin32Family<FreeTypeFontFace> IDXWin32FontCollection<FreeTypeFontFace>.FindWin32Family(string win32FamilyName)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				if (win32Families == null)
				{
					win32Families = CreateWin32Families();
				}
				if (win32Families.TryGetValue(win32FamilyName, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FreeTypeFontFace>> CreateWin32Families()
		{
			Dictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FreeTypeFontFace>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FreeTypeFontFace>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			foreach (FreeTypeFontFamily value2 in families.Values)
			{
				foreach (FreeTypeFontFace face in value2.Faces)
				{
					string win32FamilyName = face.GetWin32FamilyName();
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(win32FamilyName))
					{
						if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(win32FamilyName, out var value))
						{
							value = new DXWin32Family<FreeTypeFontFace>();
							dictionary.Add(win32FamilyName, value);
						}
						value.AddFont(face);
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}
	}
	public class DirectWriteFontProvider : IFontProvider, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly object syncObject = new object();

		private readonly IDictionary<DWriteFactory, int> registredFactories = new Dictionary<DWriteFactory, int>();

		private HashSet<IDirectWriteFontProviderListener> listeners = new HashSet<IDirectWriteFontProviderListener>();

		private CCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontFileLoader> fontFileLoader;

		public DirectWriteFontFileLoader FontFileLoader => fontFileLoader.Value;

		public DirectWriteFontProvider()
		{
			fontFileLoader = DirectWriteFontFileLoader.Create();
		}

		public void RegisterListener(IDirectWriteFontProviderListener listener)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				DWriteFactory factory = listener.Factory;
				if (!registredFactories.TryGetValue(factory, out var value))
				{
					factory.RegisterFontFileLoader((IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteFontFileLoaderCCW>)fontFileLoader.Value);
					value = 0;
				}
				value = (registredFactories[factory] = value + 1);
				listeners.Add(listener);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveListener(IDirectWriteFontProviderListener listener)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				DWriteFactory factory = listener.Factory;
				if (registredFactories.TryGetValue(factory, out var value))
				{
					if (value != 1)
					{
						value = (registredFactories[factory] = value - 1);
					}
					else
					{
						factory.UnregisterFontFileLoader((IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteFontFileLoaderCCW>)fontFileLoader.Value);
						registredFactories.Remove(factory);
					}
				}
				listeners.Remove(listener);
			}
		}

		private void AddFont(ICCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontFileStream> stream)
		{
			fontFileLoader.Value.Add(stream);
			NotifyProviderChanged();
		}

		public void AddFontSource(string fontFileName)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				AddFont(DirectWriteFileFontFileStream.Create(fontFileName));
			}
		}

		public string[] AddFontSource(byte[] fontData)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				AddFont(DirectWriteInMemoryFontFileStream.Create(fontData));
				return SfntFontHelpers.GetFontNames(fontData);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				fontFileLoader.Value.Clear();
				NotifyProviderChanged();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				fontFileLoader.Dispose();
				listeners.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void NotifyProviderChanged()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				foreach (IDirectWriteFontProviderListener listener in listeners)
				{
					listener.OnFontsChanged();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DXFontDataProvider : IFontProvider, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly object syncObject = new object();

		private readonly List<DXFontData> fonts = new List<DXFontData>();

		private DXFontEngine engine = DXDrawingEngine.CreateFontEngine();

		public IList<DXFontData> Fonts => fonts;

		public void AddFontSource(string fontFileName)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				fonts.AddRange(engine.CreateFontData(fontFileName));
			}
		}

		public string[] AddFontSource(byte[] fontFile)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				IEnumerable<DXFontData> collection = engine.CreateFontData(fontFile);
				fonts.AddRange(collection);
				return fonts.Select((DXFontData f) => f.Name).ToArray();
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				fonts.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (engine != null)
			{
				engine.Dispose();
			}
			engine = null;
		}
	}
	public class GdiPlusFontProvider : IFontProvider, IDisposable
	{
		private class TempFileHandle : IDisposable
		{
			private readonly FileStream fileStream;

			public string FileName { get; }

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private static void MarkFileToDelete(string fileName)
			{
				if (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
				{
					Kernel32Interop.MoveFileEx(fileName, null, MoveFileFlags.MOVEFILE_DELAY_UNTIL_REBOOT);
				}
			}

			private static string GetTempFileName()
			{
				return Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Path.GetRandomFileName());
			}

			public static TempFileHandle Create(byte[] fontFile)
			{
				string tempFileName = GetTempFileName();
				for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
				{
					try
					{
						FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(tempFileName, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.ReadWrite, FileShare.Read | FileShare.Delete, 4096, FileOptions.DeleteOnClose);
						MarkFileToDelete(tempFileName);
						fileStream.Write(fontFile, 0, fontFile.Length);
						fileStream.Flush();
						return new TempFileHandle(fileStream, tempFileName);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					tempFileName = GetTempFileName();
				}
				return null;
			}

			private TempFileHandle(FileStream fileStream, string fileName)
			{
				this.fileStream = fileStream;
				FileName = fileName;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				try
				{
					fileStream.Dispose();
					File.Delete(FileName);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private class GdiFontWrapper : ExternalObject
		{
			public GdiFontWrapper(IntPtr handle)
				: base(handle)
			{
			}

			protected override void DisposeCore(bool disposing)
			{
				Gdi32.RemoveFontMemResourceEx(base.NativeObject);
			}
		}

		private const int FR_PRIVATE = 16;

		private readonly object syncObject = new object();

		private IList<GdiFontWrapper> nativeFontWrappers;

		private readonly List<TempFileHandle> tempFiles = new List<TempFileHandle>();

		private readonly IList<string> fontFiles;

		private PrivateFontCollection fontCollection;

		public PrivateFontCollection PrivateFontCollection => fontCollection;

		public GdiPlusFontProvider()
		{
			fontCollection = new PrivateFontCollection();
			nativeFontWrappers = new List<GdiFontWrapper>();
			fontFiles = new List<string>();
		}

		public Font GetFont(string familyName, float emSize, FontStyle style, GraphicsUnit unit)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				FontFamily[] families = fontCollection.Families;
				int num = families.Length;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					FontFamily fontFamily = families[i];
					if (string.Equals(fontFamily.Name, familyName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
					{
						try
						{
							return new Font(fontFamily, emSize, style, unit);
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public void AddFontSource(string fontFileName)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				fontCollection.AddFontFile(fontFileName);
				fontFiles.Add(fontFileName);
			}
		}

		public string[] AddFontSource(byte[] fontData)
		{
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Expected O, but got Unknown
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				int pcFonts;
				IntPtr intPtr = Gdi32.AddFontMemResourceEx(fontData, fontData.Length, IntPtr.Zero, out pcFonts);
				if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero || pcFonts <= 0)
				{
					throw new ExternalException();
				}
				GdiFontWrapper item = new GdiFontWrapper(intPtr);
				nativeFontWrappers.Add(item);
				TempFileHandle tempFileHandle = TempFileHandle.Create(fontData);
				if (tempFileHandle != null)
				{
					tempFiles.Add(tempFileHandle);
					fontCollection.AddFontFile(tempFileHandle.FileName);
					fontFiles.Add(tempFileHandle.FileName);
				}
				else
				{
					ArrayMarshaler val = new ArrayMarshaler((Array)fontData);
					try
					{
						fontCollection.AddMemoryFont(((Marshaler)val).Pointer, fontData.Length);
					}
					finally
					{
						((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
					}
				}
				return SfntFontHelpers.GetFontNames(fontData);
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				ClearCore();
				fontCollection = new PrivateFontCollection();
			}
		}

		private void ClearCore()
		{
			fontCollection.Dispose();
			for (int i = 0; i < nativeFontWrappers.Count; i++)
			{
				nativeFontWrappers[i].Dispose();
			}
			nativeFontWrappers.Clear();
			for (int j = 0; j < fontFiles.Count; j++)
			{
				Gdi32.RemoveFontResourceEx(fontFiles[j], 16, IntPtr.Zero);
			}
			foreach (TempFileHandle tempFile in tempFiles)
			{
				tempFile.Dispose();
			}
			tempFiles.Clear();
			fontFiles.Clear();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				ClearCore();
				fontCollection = null;
			}
		}
	}
