	internal class FileFontSource : IFontSource
	{
		private readonly string fileName;

		public FileFontSource(string fileName)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentIsNotNullOrEmpty(fileName, "fileName");
			this.fileName = fileName;
		}

		public void AddToProvider(IFontProvider fontProvider)
		{
			fontProvider.AddFontSource(fileName);
		}
	}
	internal class InMemoryFontSource : IFontSource
	{
		private readonly byte[] fontData;

		public InMemoryFontSource(Stream fontStream)
		{
			if (!fontStream.CanRead)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("fontStream");
			}
			if (!fontStream.CanSeek && fontStream.Position != 0L)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("fontStream");
			}
			fontStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
			fontData = new byte[fontStream.Length];
			StreamHelper.FillBuffer(fontStream, fontData, 0, fontData.Length);
		}

		public InMemoryFontSource(byte[] fontData)
		{
			this.fontData = fontData;
		}

		public void AddToProvider(IFontProvider fontProvider)
		{
			fontProvider.AddFontSource(fontData);
		}
	}
	public static class DXFontExtensions
	{
		public static DXFontDecorations GetDecorations(this FontStyle style)
		{
			DXFontDecorations dXFontDecorations = DXFontDecorations.None;
			if ((style & FontStyle.Underline) != FontStyle.Regular)
			{
				dXFontDecorations |= DXFontDecorations.Underline;
			}
			if ((style & FontStyle.Strikeout) != FontStyle.Regular)
			{
				dXFontDecorations |= DXFontDecorations.Strikeout;
			}
			return dXFontDecorations;
		}
	}
	internal class ClusterListSegment : IReadOnlyList<DXCluster>, IReadOnlyCollection<DXCluster>, IEnumerable<DXCluster>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly IList<DXCluster> source;

		private readonly int startIndex;

		private readonly int endIndex;

		public static ClusterListSegment EmptyView { get; } = new ClusterListSegment();

		public DXCluster this[int index] => source[startIndex + index];

		public int Count => endIndex - startIndex;

		public float Width { get; }

		public bool Empty => Count == 0;

		private ClusterListSegment()
		{
		}

		public ClusterListSegment(IList<DXCluster> source, int startIndex, int endIndex)
		{
			this.source = source;
			this.startIndex = startIndex;
			this.endIndex = endIndex;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < endIndex; i++)
			{
				Width += source[i].Width;
			}
		}

		public ClusterListSegment(IList<DXCluster> source)
			: this(source, 0, source.Count)
		{
		}

		public ClusterListSegment Split(int startIndex)
		{
			if (startIndex < endIndex)
			{
				return new ClusterListSegment(source, this.startIndex + startIndex, endIndex);
			}
			return new ClusterListSegment();
		}

		public IEnumerator<DXCluster> GetEnumerator()
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i < endIndex; i++)
			{
				yield return source[i];
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class Line
	{
		private readonly float maxWidth;

		private readonly Lazy<ClusterListSegment> hyphenRun;

		private readonly bool measureTrailingSpaces;

		private ClusterListSegment trailingSpaces;

		private float currentWidth;

		private int additionalClusters;

		public bool Empty
		{
			get
			{
				if (!measureTrailingSpaces || trailingSpaces.Empty)
				{
					return Clusters.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool EmptyAndNoTrailingSpaces
		{
			get
			{
				if (Empty)
				{
					return trailingSpaces.Empty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldAppendSoftHyphen { get; private set; }

		private List<DXCluster> Clusters { get; } = new List<DXCluster>();

		private ClusterListSegment HyphenRun => hyphenRun.Value;

		public float Width => currentWidth + trailingSpaces.Width;

		public float MaxWidth => maxWidth;

		public bool EndWithSoftHyphen { get; private set; }

		public Line(float maxWidth, Lazy<ClusterListSegment> hyphenRun, bool measureTrailingSpaces)
		{
			trailingSpaces = ClusterListSegment.EmptyView;
			this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
			this.hyphenRun = hyphenRun;
			this.measureTrailingSpaces = measureTrailingSpaces;
		}

		public List<DXCluster> GetClusters()
		{
			if (measureTrailingSpaces)
			{
				AppendTraillingSpaces();
			}
			return Clusters;
		}

		public DXCluster? GetLineEndCluster()
		{
			if (!trailingSpaces.Empty)
			{
				return trailingSpaces.Last();
			}
			int num = Clusters.Count - additionalClusters - 1;
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return Clusters[num];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool IsFit(float width)
		{
			return Width + width <= maxWidth;
		}

		public void AddRange(Range range)
		{
			AppendTraillingSpaces();
			ShouldAppendSoftHyphen = range.EndsWithSoftHyphen;
			AddRange(range.Clusters);
			trailingSpaces = range.TrailingSpaces;
		}

		public Range AddRangePart(Range range)
		{
			AppendTraillingSpaces();
			for (int i = 0; i < range.Clusters.Count; i++)
			{
				DXCluster cluster = range.Clusters[i];
				if (!Empty && !IsFit(cluster.Width))
				{
					return range.Split(i);
				}
				Add(cluster);
			}
			trailingSpaces = range.TrailingSpaces;
			return null;
		}

		public bool TryAppendTabStop(DXCluster tabCluster, float tabStopSize)
		{
			float num = ((tabStopSize != 0f) ? ((float)Math.Ceiling(Width / tabStopSize) * tabStopSize - Width) : 0f);
			if (num == 0f)
			{
				num = tabStopSize;
			}
			if (!Empty && !IsFit(num))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Add(new DXCluster(new DXGlyph[1]
			{
				new DXGlyph(0, num, default(DXGlyphOffset))
			}, tabCluster.Text, tabCluster.Breakpoint, tabCluster.BidiLevel, isTabCluster: true));
			return true;
		}

		public void AddCluster(DXCluster cluster)
		{
			Add(cluster);
		}

		public bool TryEndLineWithEllipsis(ClusterListSegment ellipsis, bool ignoreHyphen)
		{
			bool flag = !ignoreHyphen && ShouldAppendSoftHyphen;
			float num = ellipsis.Width + (flag ? HyphenRun.Width : 0f);
			if (currentWidth + num <= maxWidth)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					AppendHyphen();
				}
				AddRange(ellipsis);
				additionalClusters += ellipsis.Count;
				ShouldAppendSoftHyphen = false;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void AppendHyphen()
		{
			AddRange(HyphenRun);
			EndWithSoftHyphen = true;
			additionalClusters += HyphenRun.Count;
			ShouldAppendSoftHyphen = false;
		}

		private void Add(DXCluster cluster)
		{
			AppendTraillingSpaces();
			Clusters.Add(cluster);
			currentWidth += cluster.Width;
		}

		private void AppendTraillingSpaces()
		{
			AddRange(trailingSpaces);
			trailingSpaces = ClusterListSegment.EmptyView;
		}

		private void AddRange(ClusterListSegment clusters)
		{
			Clusters.AddRange(clusters);
			currentWidth += clusters.Width;
		}
	}
	internal class LineTrimmingInfo
	{
		private const string ellipsisStr = "...";

		private readonly Lazy<ClusterListSegment> ellipsisCollection;

		public ClusterListSegment EllipsisCollection => ellipsisCollection.Value;

		public DXStringTrimming Trimming { get; }

		public float EllipsisWidth => EllipsisCollection.Width;

		public LineTrimmingInfo(DXStringTrimming trimming)
		{
			ellipsisCollection = new Lazy<ClusterListSegment>(() => ClusterListSegment.EmptyView);
			Trimming = trimming;
		}

		public LineTrimmingInfo(IDXLineFormatterFont font, DXStringTrimming trimming)
		{
			ellipsisCollection = new Lazy<ClusterListSegment>(() => new ClusterListSegment(font.ShapeText("...", directionRightToLeft: false, useKerning: false)));
			Trimming = trimming;
		}
	}
	internal class ParagraphInfo
	{
		private readonly int startPosition;

		private readonly int length;

		private readonly int endStringRunLength;

		private readonly string sourceString;

		private List<int> removedCharacters;

		public static IList<ParagraphInfo> SplitByParagraphs(string text)
		{
			List<ParagraphInfo> list = new List<ParagraphInfo>(1);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c != '\n')
				{
					if (c != '\r')
					{
						if (c != '\u2029')
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (i < text.Length - 1 && text[i + 1] == '\n')
					{
						i++;
						num2++;
					}
				}
				list.Add(new ParagraphInfo(num, i - num + 1 - num2 - 1, num2 + 1, text));
				num2 = 0;
				num = i + 1;
			}
			if (num < text.Length)
			{
				list.Add(new ParagraphInfo(num, text.Length - num, num2, text));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public ParagraphInfo(int startPosition, int length, int endStringRunLength, string sourceString)
		{
			this.startPosition = startPosition;
			this.length = length;
			this.endStringRunLength = endStringRunLength;
			this.sourceString = sourceString;
		}

		public string GetText(bool removeHotkeyPrefixes)
		{
			string text = sourceString.Substring(startPosition, length);
			if (!removeHotkeyPrefixes)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return RemoveHotkeyPrefixes(text);
		}

		public int GetActualCharactersCount(int paragraphsCharactersCount)
		{
			if (removedCharacters != null)
			{
				foreach (int removedCharacter in removedCharacters)
				{
					if (removedCharacter < paragraphsCharactersCount)
					{
						paragraphsCharactersCount++;
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			if (paragraphsCharactersCount == length)
			{
				return paragraphsCharactersCount + startPosition + endStringRunLength;
			}
			return paragraphsCharactersCount + startPosition;
		}

		private string RemoveHotkeyPrefixes(string text)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(text.Length);
			removedCharacters = new List<int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (c == '&' && !flag)
				{
					flag = true;
					removedCharacters.Add(i);
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	internal class Range
	{
		public float WidthWithoutTrailingSpaces => Clusters.Width;

		public ClusterListSegment Clusters { get; }

		public ClusterListSegment TrailingSpaces { get; }

		public bool EndsWithSoftHyphen { get; }

		public Range(ClusterListSegment clusters, ClusterListSegment trailingSpaces, bool endsWithSoftHyphen = false)
		{
			Clusters = clusters;
			TrailingSpaces = trailingSpaces;
			EndsWithSoftHyphen = endsWithSoftHyphen;
		}

		public Range Split(int i)
		{
			return new Range(Clusters.Split(i), TrailingSpaces, EndsWithSoftHyphen);
		}
	}
	internal class RangeBuilder
	{
		private int startRange = -1;

		private int endRange = -1;

		private int endTrailingSpaces = -1;

		public bool Empty => startRange == -1;

		private bool HasTrailingSpaces => endTrailingSpaces != -1;

		public void AppendGlyph(int index)
		{
			if (Empty)
			{
				startRange = index;
			}
			endTrailingSpaces = -1;
			endRange = index;
		}

		public void AppendSpace(int index)
		{
			if (Empty)
			{
				startRange = index;
			}
			endTrailingSpaces = index;
		}

		public Range GetRange(IList<DXCluster> clusters, bool endsWithSoftHyphen = false)
		{
			if (Empty)
			{
				return new Range(ClusterListSegment.EmptyView, ClusterListSegment.EmptyView);
			}
			if (endRange < 0)
			{
				return new Range(ClusterListSegment.EmptyView, HasTrailingSpaces ? new ClusterListSegment(clusters, startRange, endTrailingSpaces + 1) : ClusterListSegment.EmptyView, endsWithSoftHyphen);
			}
			return new Range(new ClusterListSegment(clusters, startRange, endRange + 1), HasTrailingSpaces ? new ClusterListSegment(clusters, endRange + 1, endTrailingSpaces + 1) : ClusterListSegment.EmptyView, endsWithSoftHyphen);
		}
	}

	public class DXFontInternal : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly DXFontFace fontFace;

		public string FamilyName => fontFace.FamilyName;

		public DXFontWeight Weight => fontFace.Weight;

		public DXFontStretch Stretch => fontFace.Stretch;

		public DXFontStyleSlant Slant => fontFace.Slant;

		public DXFontSimulations Simulations { get; }

		public DXFontDecorations Decorations { get; }

		public float Size { get; }

		internal float SizeInPoints => Size;

		internal byte[] Panose => fontFace.Panose;

		internal DXFontMetrics Metrics => fontFace.Metrics;

		public DXFontInternal(DXFontFace fontFace, float size, DXFontDecorations decorations = DXFontDecorations.None, bool forceEmulateBold = false)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fontFace, "fontFace");
			this.fontFace = fontFace;
			Size = size;
			Decorations = decorations;
			Simulations = fontFace.Simulations;
			if (forceEmulateBold && fontFace.Weight < DXFontWeight.Bold)
			{
				Simulations |= DXFontSimulations.Bold;
			}
		}

		public IList<DXCharRange> GetFontCharacterRanges()
		{
			return fontFace.GetFontCharacterRanges();
		}

		public bool IsComplexScript()
		{
			return fontFace.IsComplexScript;
		}

		public bool IsCjk()
		{
			return fontFace.IsCjk;
		}

		public DXFontFileInfo GetFontFileInfo()
		{
			return fontFace.GetFontFile();
		}

		public SizeF MeasureString(string text)
		{
			return fontFace.MeasureString(text, Size);
		}

		public float MeasureCharacterWidth(char character)
		{
			return fontFace.MeasureCharacterWidth(character, Size);
		}

		public DXShapedGlyphInfo GetShapedGlyphsInfo(string text)
		{
			return fontFace.GetShapedGlyphsInfo(text, Size);
		}

		public IDXShaper CreateShaper(IDXFontFallback fontFallback)
		{
			return fontFace.CreateShaper(fontFallback);
		}

		public string GetWin32FamilyName()
		{
			return fontFace.GetWin32FamilyName();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<string, float, int, int, int, int, int>(FamilyName, Size, (int)Weight, (int)Stretch, (int)Slant, (int)Simulations, (int)Decorations);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			return Equals(obj as DXFontInternal);
		}

		public bool Equals(DXFontInternal other)
		{
			if (other == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (FamilyName == other.FamilyName && Size == other.Size && Weight == other.Weight && Stretch == other.Stretch && Slant == other.Slant && Simulations == other.Simulations)
			{
				return Decorations == other.Decorations;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			fontFace.Dispose();
		}
	}

		public DXShapedGlyphInfo GetShapedGlyphsInfo(string text, float fontSizeInPoints)
		{
			using IDXShaper iDXShaper = CreateShaper();
			IList<DXCluster> list = iDXShaper.ShapeText(text, directionRightToLeft: false, fontSizeInPoints, useKerning: true);
			List<short> list2 = new List<short>();
			List<float> list3 = new List<float>();
			short num = 0;
			foreach (DXCluster item in list)
			{
				list2.AddRange(Enumerable.Repeat(num++, item.Glyphs.Count));
				list3.AddRange(item.Glyphs.Select((DXGlyph g) => g.Advance));
			}
			return new DXShapedGlyphInfo(list2.ToArray(), list3.ToArray());
		}

	public static class DXFontNamesHelper
	{
		private class RegexContext
		{
			private IDictionary<string, Action<DXFontDescriptorBuilder>> groupMapping;

			private Regex regex;

			public RegexContext(IDictionary<string, Action<DXFontDescriptorBuilder>> groupMapping, Regex regex)
			{
				this.groupMapping = groupMapping;
				this.regex = regex;
			}

			public void Match(string fontName, DXFontDescriptorBuilder builder)
			{
				MatchCollection matchCollection = regex.Matches(fontName);
				foreach (Match item in matchCollection)
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Action<DXFontDescriptorBuilder>> item2 in groupMapping)
					{
						if (item.Groups[item2.Key].Success)
						{
							item2.Value(builder);
						}
					}
				}
				builder.FamilyName = regex.Replace(fontName, "").Trim();
			}
		}

		private class DXFontDescriptorBuilder
		{
			private DXFontWeight? weight;

			private DXFontStretch? stretch;

			private DXFontStyleSlant? style;

			public string FamilyName { get; set; }

			public bool StyleDefined => style.HasValue;

			public bool StretchDefined => stretch.HasValue;

			public bool WeightDefined => weight.HasValue;

			public DXFontStyleSlant Style
			{
				get
				{
					return style.GetValueOrDefault();
				}
				set
				{
					if (!style.HasValue)
					{
						style = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public DXFontStretch Stretch
			{
				get
				{
					return stretch ?? DXFontStretch.Normal;
				}
				set
				{
					if (!stretch.HasValue)
					{
						stretch = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public DXFontWeight Weight
			{
				get
				{
					return weight ?? DXFontWeight.Normal;
				}
				set
				{
					if (!weight.HasValue)
					{
						weight = value;
					}
				}
			}

			public DXFontDescriptor CreateFontDescriptor()
			{
				return new DXFontDescriptor(FamilyName, Weight, Style, Stretch);
			}
		}

		private static RegexContext CreateRegex(IList<MappingInfo> mappingInfo)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			IDictionary<string, Action<DXFontDescriptorBuilder>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Action<DXFontDescriptorBuilder>>();
			stringBuilder.Append("(?i)(");
			stringBuilder.Append("([\\s|.|\\-|_|,]+)");
			stringBuilder.Append("(");
			for (int i = 0; i < mappingInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				string text = "A" + i;
				if (i > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("|");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("(?'" + text + "'(");
				IList<string> patterns = mappingInfo[i].Patterns;
				for (int j = 0; j < patterns.Count; j++)
				{
					if (j > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("|");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append("(");
					stringBuilder.Append(patterns[j].Replace(" ", "([\\s|.|\\-|_|,]+)"));
					stringBuilder.Append(")");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("))");
				dictionary.Add(text, mappingInfo[i].Action);
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("))+");
			return new RegexContext(dictionary, new Regex(stringBuilder.ToString()));
		}

		public static DXFontDescriptor GetDescriptor(string fontName, DXFontStyle style = DXFontStyle.Regular)
		{
			DXFontDescriptorBuilder dXFontDescriptorBuilder = new DXFontDescriptorBuilder();
			regex.Match(fontName, dXFontDescriptorBuilder);
			if (dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Style == DXFontStyleSlant.Regular && style.HasFlag(DXFontStyle.Italic))
			{
				dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Style = DXFontStyleSlant.Italic;
			}
			if (dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight == DXFontWeight.Normal && style.HasFlag(DXFontStyle.Bold))
			{
				dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight = DXFontWeight.Bold;
			}
			return dXFontDescriptorBuilder.CreateFontDescriptor();
		}

		public static DXFontDescriptor GetDescriptor(string fontName, DXFontWeight fileWeight, DXFontStyleSlant fileStyle, DXFontStretch fileStretch)
		{
			DXFontDescriptorBuilder dXFontDescriptorBuilder = new DXFontDescriptorBuilder();
			regex.Match(fontName, dXFontDescriptorBuilder);
			return new DXFontDescriptor(weight: (dXFontDescriptorBuilder.WeightDefined && (dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight >= DXFontWeight.Normal || fileWeight >= DXFontWeight.Normal) && (dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight <= DXFontWeight.Medium || fileWeight <= DXFontWeight.Medium || fileWeight == DXFontWeight.Bold) && ((dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight != DXFontWeight.Normal && dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight != DXFontWeight.Medium) || (fileWeight != DXFontWeight.Normal && fileWeight != DXFontWeight.Medium)) && (fileWeight == DXFontWeight.Normal || fileWeight == DXFontWeight.Medium || fileWeight == DXFontWeight.Bold || Math.Abs(dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight - fileWeight) > 150)) ? dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight : fileWeight, stretch: (dXFontDescriptorBuilder.StretchDefined && (dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Stretch >= DXFontStretch.Normal || fileStretch >= DXFontStretch.Normal) && (dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Stretch <= DXFontStretch.Normal || fileStretch <= DXFontStretch.Normal)) ? dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Stretch : fileStretch, slant: (!dXFontDescriptorBuilder.StyleDefined) ? fileStyle : dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Style, familyName: dXFontDescriptorBuilder.FamilyName);
		}

		internal static DXFontDescriptor GetGDICompatibleDescriptor(string fontName, FontStyle style)
		{
			DXFontDescriptorBuilder dXFontDescriptorBuilder = new DXFontDescriptorBuilder();
			regex.Match(fontName, dXFontDescriptorBuilder);
			DXFontWeight weight = ((dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Weight < DXFontWeight.Bold && style.HasFlag(FontStyle.Bold)) ? DXFontWeight.Bold : DXFontWeight.Normal);
			DXFontStyleSlant slant = ((dXFontDescriptorBuilder.Style == DXFontStyleSlant.Regular && style.HasFlag(FontStyle.Italic)) ? DXFontStyleSlant.Italic : DXFontStyleSlant.Regular);
			return new DXFontDescriptor(fontName, weight, slant, DXFontStretch.Normal);
		}

		public static bool ContainsItalicStyle(string fontStyle)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontStyle))
			{
				return italicPattern.IsMatch(fontStyle);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool ContainsBoldStyle(string fontStyle)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontStyle))
			{
				return boldPattern.IsMatch(fontStyle);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static string GetNormalizedFontStyle(string fontName)
		{
			return Normalize(stylePattern.Match(fontName).Value);
		}

		public static string GetNormalizedFontFamily(string fontName)
		{
			return Normalize(GetFontFamily(fontName));
		}

		public static string GetFontFamily(string fontName)
		{
			return stylePattern.Replace(fontName, string.Empty);
		}

		public static string Normalize(string value)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(value);
			stringBuilder.Replace(" ", string.Empty);
			stringBuilder.Replace("-", string.Empty);
			stringBuilder.Replace(",", string.Empty);
			return stringBuilder.ToString().ToLowerInvariant();
		}

		public static IEnumerable<string> ExtractAdditionalStyles(string actualStyle)
		{
			return advancedStylePattern.Split(actualStyle);
		}
	}

	internal static class DXWin32FontSearchHelper
	{
		public static DXFontFace MatchFaceByWin32Name<TWin32FontFace>(IDXWin32FontCollection<TWin32FontFace> collection, string win32Name, DXFontStyle style) where TWin32FontFace : IFontFace
		{
			DXWin32Family<TWin32FontFace> dXWin32Family = collection.FindWin32Family(win32Name);
			if (dXWin32Family == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DXFontDescriptor descriptor = DXFontNamesHelper.GetDescriptor(win32Name, style);
			DXFontSearchResult<TWin32FontFace> firstMatchingFont = DXFontSearchHelper<TWin32FontFace>.GetFirstMatchingFont(dXWin32Family.Faces, descriptor.Weight, descriptor.Stretch, descriptor.Slant);
			IDXFontFamily iDXFontFamily = collection.FindFamily(firstMatchingFont.FontFace.FamilyName);
			if (iDXFontFamily != null)
			{
				DXFontWeight weight = (((firstMatchingFont.FontSimulations & DXFontSimulations.Bold) != DXFontSimulations.None) ? DXFontWeight.Bold : firstMatchingFont.FontFace.Weight);
				DXFontStyleSlant style2 = (((firstMatchingFont.FontSimulations & DXFontSimulations.Italic) != DXFontSimulations.None) ? DXFontStyleSlant.Oblique : firstMatchingFont.FontFace.Slant);
				return iDXFontFamily.GetFirstMatchingFontFace(weight, firstMatchingFont.FontFace.Stretch, style2);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class DXFontSearchHelper<T> where T : IFontFace
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable<T> fontPatterns;

		public static DXFontSearchResult<T> GetFirstMatchingFont(IEnumerable<T> fontPatterns, DXFontWeight weight, DXFontStretch fontStretch, DXFontStyleSlant style)
		{
			return new DXFontSearchHelper<T>(fontPatterns).GetFirstMatchingFont(weight, fontStretch, style);
		}

		private DXFontSearchHelper(IEnumerable<T> fontPatterns)
		{
			this.fontPatterns = fontPatterns;
		}

		private DXFontSearchResult<T> GetFirstMatchingFont(DXFontWeight weight, DXFontStretch fontStretch, DXFontStyleSlant style)
		{
			T val = fontPatterns.FirstOrDefault((T f) => f.Weight == weight && f.Stretch == fontStretch && f.Slant == style);
			bool emulateItalic = false;
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = fontPatterns.First();
				IEnumerable<T> source = FilterByStretch(fontPatterns, fontStretch);
				if (source.Any())
				{
					source = FilterByWeight(source, weight);
					if (source.Any())
					{
						val = FilterByStyle(source, style, out emulateItalic).FirstOrDefault();
					}
				}
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = fontPatterns.First();
				}
			}
			DXFontSimulations dXFontSimulations = DXFontSimulations.None;
			if (val.Weight <= DXFontWeight.Normal && weight > DXFontWeight.Normal)
			{
				dXFontSimulations |= DXFontSimulations.Bold;
			}
			if (emulateItalic)
			{
				dXFontSimulations |= DXFontSimulations.Italic;
			}
			return new DXFontSearchResult<T>(val, dXFontSimulations);
		}

		private IEnumerable<T> FilterByWeight(IEnumerable<T> fontPatterns, DXFontWeight requestedWeight)
		{
			IEnumerable<T> enumerable = fontPatterns.Where((T f) => f.Weight == requestedWeight);
			if (enumerable.Any())
			{
				return enumerable;
			}
			IOrderedEnumerable<T> orderedEnumerable = fontPatterns.OrderBy((T f) => Math.Abs(f.Weight - requestedWeight));
			if (Math.Abs((int)(700 - requestedWeight)) < Math.Abs(orderedEnumerable.First().Weight - requestedWeight))
			{
				return FindNormalWeightedFonts(fontPatterns);
			}
			return orderedEnumerable;
		}

		private IEnumerable<T> FindNormalWeightedFonts(IEnumerable<T> fontPatterns)
		{
			IEnumerable<T> enumerable = fontPatterns.Where((T f) => f.Weight == DXFontWeight.Normal);
			if (enumerable.Any())
			{
				return enumerable;
			}
			return fontPatterns;
		}

		private IEnumerable<T> FilterByStretch(IEnumerable<T> fontPatterns, DXFontStretch requestedStretch)
		{
			IEnumerable<T> enumerable = fontPatterns.Where((T f) => f.Stretch == requestedStretch);
			if (enumerable.Any())
			{
				return enumerable;
			}
			return fontPatterns.OrderBy((T f) => Math.Abs(f.Stretch - requestedStretch));
		}

		private IEnumerable<T> FilterByStyle(IEnumerable<T> fontPatterns, DXFontStyleSlant requestedStyle, out bool emulateItalic)
		{
			emulateItalic = false;
			IEnumerable<T> enumerable = fontPatterns.Where((T f) => f.Slant == requestedStyle);
			if (enumerable.Any())
			{
				return enumerable;
			}
			if (requestedStyle == DXFontStyleSlant.Italic)
			{
				return FilterByStyle(fontPatterns, DXFontStyleSlant.Oblique, out emulateItalic);
			}
			if (requestedStyle == DXFontStyleSlant.Oblique)
			{
				emulateItalic = true;
				return fontPatterns.Where((T f) => f.Slant == DXFontStyleSlant.Regular);
			}
			return fontPatterns;
		}
	}

			num = num * -1521134295 + EndIndex.GetHashCode();
			return num * -1521134295 + BidiLevel.GetHashCode();
		}

		}

	public static class DXBidiHelper
	{
		public static void Reorder(IList<DXCluster> clusters)
		{
			int count = clusters.Count;
			if (count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				num = Math.Max(clusters[i].BidiLevel, num);
			}
			for (int num2 = num; num2 > 0; num2--)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					if (clusters[j].BidiLevel >= num2)
					{
						int num3 = j;
						for (; j < count && clusters[j].BidiLevel >= num2; j++)
						{
						}
						int num4 = j - 1;
						while (num3 <= num4)
						{
							DXCluster value = clusters[num3];
							clusters[num3] = clusters[num4];
							clusters[num4] = value;
							num3++;
							num4--;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public struct DXCluster
	{
		private class OneElementList<T> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
		{
			private readonly T value;

			public int Count => 1;

			public bool IsReadOnly => true;

			public T this[int index]

					return value;
				}
				set

					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
			}

			public OneElementList(T value)
			{
				this.value = value;
			}

			public void Add(T item)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public bool Contains(T item)
			{
				return value.Equals(item);
			}

			public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
			{
				yield return value;
			}

			public int IndexOf(T item)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public void Insert(int index, T item)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public bool Remove(T item)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public void RemoveAt(int index)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		public IList<DXGlyph> Glyphs { get; }

		public StringView Text { get; }

		public float Width { get; }

		public DXLineBreakpoint Breakpoint { get; }

		public byte BidiLevel { get; }

		public bool IsTabCluster { get; }

		public bool IsNotDefGlyph
		{
			get
			{
				if (Glyphs.Count != 0)
				{
					return Glyphs.Any((DXGlyph g) => g.Index == 0);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public string FallbackFontFamily { get; set; }

		public DXFontStyle FallbackFontStyle { get; set; }

		public DXCluster(DXGlyph glyph, StringView text, DXLineBreakpoint breakpoint, byte bidiLevel, bool isTabCluster)
			: this(new OneElementList<DXGlyph>(glyph), text, breakpoint, bidiLevel, isTabCluster)
		{
		}

		public DXCluster(IList<DXGlyph> glyphs, StringView text, DXLineBreakpoint breakpoint, byte bidiLevel, bool isTabCluster = false)
		{
			if (glyphs.Count > 1 && bidiLevel % 2 != 0)
			{
				glyphs = glyphs.Reverse().ToList();
			}
			Glyphs = glyphs;
			Text = text;
			Breakpoint = breakpoint;
			BidiLevel = bidiLevel;
			int count = glyphs.Count;
			Width = 0f;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				Width += glyphs[i].Advance;
			}
			IsTabCluster = isTabCluster;
			FallbackFontFamily = null;
			FallbackFontStyle = DXFontStyle.Regular;
		}
	}

	public class DXLineFormatter
	{
		private interface IResultBuilder
		{
			int Count { get; }

			void Add(Line line);

			void BeginParagraph(ParagraphInfo paragraph);

			void EndParagraph();

			void Clear();
		}

		private class FormatResultBuilder : IResultBuilder
		{
			private List<Line> paragraphLines = new List<Line>();

			private bool justifyText;

			public List<DXTextLine> Lines { get; } = new List<DXTextLine>();

			public int Count => Lines.Count + paragraphLines.Count;

			public FormatResultBuilder(bool justifyText)
			{
				this.justifyText = justifyText;
			}

			public void Add(Line line)
			{
				paragraphLines.Add(line);
			}

			public void BeginParagraph(ParagraphInfo paragraph)
			{
			}

			public void EndParagraph()
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < paragraphLines.Count; i++)
				{
					Line line = paragraphLines[i];
					IList<DXCluster> clusters = line.GetClusters();
					DXBidiHelper.Reorder(clusters);
					bool flag = i == paragraphLines.Count - 1;
					if (justifyText && !flag)
					{
						DXJustifyHelper.Justify(clusters, line.MaxWidth);
					}
					Lines.Add(DXTextLine.Create(clusters));
				}
				paragraphLines.Clear();
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				Lines.Clear();
				paragraphLines.Clear();
			}
		}

		private class MeasureResultBuilder : IResultBuilder
		{
			private readonly float maxWidth;

			private ParagraphInfo paragraph;

			public float MaxLineWidth { get; private set; }

			public int Count { get; private set; }

			public int CharactersCount { get; private set; }

			public MeasureResultBuilder(float maxWidth)
			{
				this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
			}

			public void Add(Line line)
			{
				Count++;
				MaxLineWidth = Math.Max(MaxLineWidth, Math.Min(line.GetClusters().Sum((DXCluster c) => c.Width), maxWidth));
				StringView stringView = line.GetLineEndCluster()?.Text;
				int num = ((stringView != null) ? (stringView.Length + stringView.Offset) : 0);
				if (line.EndWithSoftHyphen)
				{
					num++;
				}
				CharactersCount = paragraph.GetActualCharactersCount(num);
			}

			public void BeginParagraph(ParagraphInfo paragraph)
			{
				this.paragraph = paragraph;
			}

			public void EndParagraph()
			{
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				MaxLineWidth = 0f;
				Count = 0;
				CharactersCount = 0;
				paragraph = null;
			}
		}

		private readonly SizeF layoutSize;

		private readonly float tabStopSize;

		private readonly uint maxLineCount;

		private readonly LineTrimmingInfo trimmingInfo;

		private readonly Lazy<ClusterListSegment> hyphenRun;

		private readonly IResultBuilder lineBuilder;

		private readonly bool noWrap;

		private readonly bool measureTrailingSpaces;

		private ClusterListSegment HyphenRun => hyphenRun.Value;

		private bool IsLastLine
		{
			get
			{
				if (lineBuilder.Count != maxLineCount - 1)
				{
					return noWrap;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private Line CurrentLine { get; set; }

		public static IReadOnlyList<DXTextLine> FormatLines(string text, SizeF? layoutSize, IDXLineFormatterFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat, DXLineFormatterOptions options)
		{
			FormatResultBuilder formatResultBuilder = new FormatResultBuilder(layoutSize.HasValue && options.JustifyText);
			FormatText(text, layoutSize, font, stringFormat, options.KerningMode, formatResultBuilder);
			return formatResultBuilder.Lines;
		}

		public static DXTextMeasurementResult MeasureText(string text, SizeF? layoutSize, IDXLineFormatterFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat, DXKerningMode kerningMode)
		{
			float maxWidth = (layoutSize.HasValue ? layoutSize.Value.Width : float.MaxValue);
			MeasureResultBuilder measureResultBuilder = new MeasureResultBuilder(maxWidth);
			FormatText(text, layoutSize, font, stringFormat, kerningMode, measureResultBuilder);
			double num = font.Ascent + font.Descent;
			return new DXTextMeasurementResult(new SizeF(measureResultBuilder.MaxLineWidth, (float)(num + font.LineSpacing * (double)Math.Max(0, measureResultBuilder.Count - 1))), measureResultBuilder.Count, measureResultBuilder.CharactersCount);
		}

		private static void FormatText(string text, SizeF? layoutSize, IDXLineFormatterFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat, DXKerningMode kerningMode, IResultBuilder resultBuilder)
		{
			SizeF sizeF = ((!layoutSize.HasValue || !(layoutSize.Value.Width > 0f)) ? new SizeF(float.MaxValue, float.MaxValue) : new SizeF(layoutSize.Value.Width - (stringFormat.TrailingMarginFactor + stringFormat.LeadingMarginFactor) * font.Size, layoutSize.Value.Height));
			IList<ParagraphInfo> list = ParagraphInfo.SplitByParagraphs(text);
			if (list.Count == 1)
			{
				if (layoutSize.HasValue && kerningMode == DXKerningMode.MultilineOnly)
				{
					if (!FormatSingleParagraph(list[0], sizeF, font, stringFormat, resultBuilder, useKerning: false, shouldFitIntoSingleLine: true))
					{
						resultBuilder.Clear();
						FormatSingleParagraph(list[0], sizeF, font, stringFormat, resultBuilder, useKerning: true, shouldFitIntoSingleLine: false);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					FormatSingleParagraph(list[0], sizeF, font, stringFormat, resultBuilder, kerningMode == DXKerningMode.Always, shouldFitIntoSingleLine: false);
				}
				return;
			}
			DXLineFormatter dXLineFormatter = new DXLineFormatter(sizeF, font, stringFormat, resultBuilder);
			foreach (ParagraphInfo item in list)
			{
				resultBuilder.BeginParagraph(item);
				string text2 = item.GetText(stringFormat.HotkeyPrefix == DXHotkeyPrefix.Hide);
				dXLineFormatter.Format(font.ShapeText(text2, stringFormat.FormatFlags.HasFlag(DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft), kerningMode != DXKerningMode.None), shouldFitIntoSingleLine: false);
				resultBuilder.EndParagraph();
				if (dXLineFormatter.IsLayoutOverflowed())
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool FormatSingleParagraph(ParagraphInfo paragraph, SizeF layoutSize, IDXLineFormatterFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat, IResultBuilder builder, bool useKerning, bool shouldFitIntoSingleLine)
		{
			string text = paragraph.GetText(stringFormat.HotkeyPrefix == DXHotkeyPrefix.Hide);
			builder.BeginParagraph(paragraph);
			bool flag = new DXLineFormatter(layoutSize, font, stringFormat, builder).Format(font.ShapeText(text, stringFormat.FormatFlags.HasFlag(DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft), useKerning), shouldFitIntoSingleLine);
			builder.EndParagraph();
			if (!flag || (shouldFitIntoSingleLine && builder.Count > 1))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static uint GetLineCount(bool limitLines, IDXLineFormatterFont font, float layoutHeight)
		{
			double lineSpacing = font.LineSpacing;
			double num = font.Ascent + font.Descent;
			if ((double)layoutHeight < num)
			{
				return (!limitLines && (double)layoutHeight >= lineSpacing * 0.25) ? 1u : 0u;
			}
			double num2 = ((double)layoutHeight - num) / lineSpacing;
			uint num3 = (uint)Math.Min(4294967293.0, Math.Floor(num2 + 0.01));
			if (!limitLines && num2 - (double)num3 >= 0.25)
			{
				num3++;
			}
			return num3 + 1;
		}

		private DXLineFormatter(SizeF layoutSize, IDXLineFormatterFont font, DXStringFormat stringFormat, IResultBuilder lineBuilder)
		{
			this.layoutSize = layoutSize;
			tabStopSize = ((stringFormat.TabStops != null && stringFormat.TabStops.Length != 0) ? stringFormat.TabStops[0] : 0f);
			DXStringFormatFlags formatFlags = stringFormat.FormatFlags;
			noWrap = formatFlags.HasFlag(DXStringFormatFlags.NoWrap);
			measureTrailingSpaces = formatFlags.HasFlag(DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces);
			bool flag = formatFlags.HasFlag(DXStringFormatFlags.LineLimit);
			switch (stringFormat.Trimming)
			{
			case DXStringTrimming.Character:
				trimmingInfo = new LineTrimmingInfo(DXStringTrimming.Character);
				break;
			case DXStringTrimming.Word:
				trimmingInfo = new LineTrimmingInfo(DXStringTrimming.Word);
				break;
			case DXStringTrimming.EllipsisWord:
				trimmingInfo = new LineTrimmingInfo(font, DXStringTrimming.Word);
				break;
			case DXStringTrimming.EllipsisCharacter:
			case DXStringTrimming.EllipsisPath:
				trimmingInfo = new LineTrimmingInfo(font, DXStringTrimming.Character);
				break;
			default:
				trimmingInfo = new LineTrimmingInfo((flag && !noWrap) ? DXStringTrimming.Word : DXStringTrimming.None);
				break;
			}
			hyphenRun = new Lazy<ClusterListSegment>(() => new ClusterListSegment(font.ShapeText("-", directionRightToLeft: false, useKerning: false)));
			maxLineCount = GetLineCount(flag, font, layoutSize.Height);
			this.lineBuilder = lineBuilder;
			StartNewLine();
		}

		private bool IsLayoutOverflowed()
		{
			if (trimmingInfo.Trimming != DXStringTrimming.None)
			{
				return lineBuilder.Count >= maxLineCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool Format(IList<DXCluster> clusters, bool shouldFitIntoSingleLine)
		{
			if (IsLayoutOverflowed())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (clusters.Count == 0)
			{
				EndLine(appendEmptyLine: true);
				return true;
			}
			RangeBuilder rangeBuilder = new RangeBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < clusters.Count; i++)
			{
				DXCluster tabCluster = clusters[i];
				bool isLastWord = i == clusters.Count - 1;
				if (shouldFitIntoSingleLine && lineBuilder.Count > 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (tabCluster.IsTabCluster)
				{
					if (!rangeBuilder.Empty)
					{
						if (AppendRange(rangeBuilder.GetRange(clusters), isLastWord))
						{
							return true;
						}
						rangeBuilder = new RangeBuilder();
					}
					GoToNextTabStop(tabCluster);
					continue;
				}
				if (tabCluster.Breakpoint.IsWhitespace && !tabCluster.IsTabCluster)
				{
					rangeBuilder.AppendSpace(i);
				}
				else if (!tabCluster.Breakpoint.IsSoftHyphen)
				{
					rangeBuilder.AppendGlyph(i);
				}
				if (tabCluster.Breakpoint.BreakConditionAfter != DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak && !NeedExtendRangeForPrediction(rangeBuilder.GetRange(clusters, tabCluster.Breakpoint.IsSoftHyphen)))
				{
					if (AppendRange(rangeBuilder.GetRange(clusters, tabCluster.Breakpoint.IsSoftHyphen), isLastWord))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (tabCluster.Breakpoint.BreakConditionAfter == DXBreakCondition.MustBreak)
					{
						EndLine(appendEmptyLine: true);
					}
					rangeBuilder = new RangeBuilder();
				}
			}
			if (!rangeBuilder.Empty && AppendRange(rangeBuilder.GetRange(clusters), isLastWord: true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			EndLine(appendEmptyLine: false);
			return true;
		}

		private bool NeedExtendRangeForPrediction(Range range)
		{
			if (IsLastLine && trimmingInfo.Trimming != DXStringTrimming.None)
			{
				float num = range.WidthWithoutTrailingSpaces + (range.EndsWithSoftHyphen ? HyphenRun.Width : 0f);
				float num2 = (IsLastLine ? trimmingInfo.EllipsisWidth : 0f);
				float width = num + num2;
				if (CurrentLine.MaxWidth > num2 && CurrentLine.IsFit(num))
				{
					return !CurrentLine.IsFit(width);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void GoToNextTabStop(DXCluster tabCluster)
		{
			if (!CurrentLine.TryAppendTabStop(tabCluster, tabStopSize))
			{
				EndLine(appendEmptyLine: true);
				CurrentLine.TryAppendTabStop(tabCluster, tabStopSize);
			}
		}

		private bool AppendRange(Range range, bool isLastWord)
		{
			do
			{
				float width = range.WidthWithoutTrailingSpaces + (IsLastLine ? trimmingInfo.EllipsisWidth : 0f) + (range.EndsWithSoftHyphen ? HyphenRun.Width : 0f);
				if (CurrentLine.IsFit(width) || (trimmingInfo.Trimming == DXStringTrimming.None && noWrap))
				{
					CurrentLine.AddRange(range);
					return false;
				}
				if (IsLastLine && trimmingInfo.Trimming != DXStringTrimming.None)
				{
					Trim(range, isLastWord);
					EndLine(appendEmptyLine: true);
					return true;
				}
				if (CurrentLine.EmptyAndNoTrailingSpaces)
				{
					range = CurrentLine.AddRangePart(range);
					if (range != null)
					{
						EndLine(appendEmptyLine: true);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					EndLine(appendEmptyLine: true);
				}
			}
			while (range != null);
			return false;
		}

		private void Trim(Range range, bool isLastWord)
		{
			if (isLastWord && CurrentLine.IsFit(range.WidthWithoutTrailingSpaces))
			{
				CurrentLine.AddRange(range);
			}
			else if (trimmingInfo.Trimming == DXStringTrimming.Word)
			{
				if (CurrentLine.EmptyAndNoTrailingSpaces)
				{
					TrimByClusters(range);
				}
				else
				{
					CurrentLine.TryEndLineWithEllipsis(trimmingInfo.EllipsisCollection, ignoreHyphen: false);
				}
			}
			else if (trimmingInfo.Trimming == DXStringTrimming.Character)
			{
				TrimByClusters(range);
			}
		}

		private void TrimByClusters(Range range)
		{
			int i = 0;
			IReadOnlyList<DXCluster> clusters = range.Clusters;
			i = AppendByClusters(clusters, i, trimmingInfo.EllipsisWidth);
			if (!CurrentLine.TryEndLineWithEllipsis(trimmingInfo.EllipsisCollection, trimmingInfo.Trimming == DXStringTrimming.Character))
			{
				i = AppendByClusters(clusters, i, 0f);
				if (i == clusters.Count && range.EndsWithSoftHyphen && CurrentLine.IsFit(HyphenRun.Width))
				{
					CurrentLine.AppendHyphen();
				}
			}
		}

		private int AppendByClusters(IReadOnlyList<DXCluster> clusters, int i, float ellipsisWidth)
		{
			while (i < clusters.Count)
			{
				DXCluster cluster = clusters[i];
				if (!CurrentLine.EmptyAndNoTrailingSpaces && !CurrentLine.IsFit(cluster.Width + ellipsisWidth))
				{
					break;
				}
				CurrentLine.AddCluster(cluster);
				i++;
			}
			return i;
		}

		private void EndLine(bool appendEmptyLine)
		{
			if (!CurrentLine.Empty)
			{
				if (CurrentLine.ShouldAppendSoftHyphen)
				{
					CurrentLine.AppendHyphen();
				}
				lineBuilder.Add(CurrentLine);
			}
			else if (appendEmptyLine)
			{
				lineBuilder.Add(new Line(layoutSize.Width, hyphenRun, measureTrailingSpaces));
			}
			StartNewLine();
		}

		private void StartNewLine()
		{
			CurrentLine = new Line(layoutSize.Width, hyphenRun, measureTrailingSpaces);
		}
	}

	public class DXTextBuffer<T> where T : IDXTextBufferRun<T>
	{
		private readonly LinkedList<T> runs = new LinkedList<T>();

		public LinkedList<T> Runs => runs;

		public DXTextBuffer(T sourceRun)
		{
			runs.AddFirst(sourceRun);
		}

		public void SetProperties(int offset, int length, Action<T> setRunProperties)
		{
			int num = offset + length - 1;
			for (LinkedListNode<T> linkedListNode = runs.First; linkedListNode != null; linkedListNode = linkedListNode.Next)
			{
				T val = linkedListNode.Value;
				int offset2 = val.Offset;
				int num2 = val.Offset + val.Length - 1;
				if (offset2 == offset && num2 == num)
				{
					setRunProperties(val);
					break;
				}
				if (offset2 <= offset && num2 >= num)
				{
					if (offset2 < offset)
					{
						val = val.Split(offset);
						LinkedListNode<T> linkedListNode2 = new LinkedListNode<T>(val);
						runs.AddAfter(linkedListNode, linkedListNode2);
						linkedListNode = linkedListNode2;
					}
					if (num2 != num)
					{
						runs.AddAfter(linkedListNode, new LinkedListNode<T>(val.Split(num + 1)));
					}
					setRunProperties(val);
					break;
				}
				if (offset <= offset2 && num >= num2)
				{
					setRunProperties(val);
				}
				else if (offset >= offset2 && offset <= num2 && num > num2)
				{
					LinkedListNode<T> linkedListNode3 = new LinkedListNode<T>(val.Split(offset));
					setRunProperties(linkedListNode3.Value);
					runs.AddAfter(linkedListNode, linkedListNode3);
					linkedListNode = linkedListNode3;
				}
				else if (num >= offset2 && num <= num2 && offset < offset2)
				{
					LinkedListNode<T> linkedListNode4 = new LinkedListNode<T>(val.Split(num + 1));
					setRunProperties(val);
					runs.AddAfter(linkedListNode, linkedListNode4);
					linkedListNode = linkedListNode4;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public interface IDXTextBufferRun<T> where T : IDXTextBufferRun<T>
	{
		int Offset { get; }

		int Length { get; }

		T Split(int splitOffset);
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("{GetText()}")]
	public class StringView
	{
		public static readonly StringView Empty = new StringView("", 0, 0);

		private readonly string source;

		public string Source => source;

		public int Offset { get; }

		public int Length { get; }

		public char this[int index] => source[Offset + index];

		public StringView(string source)
			: this(source, 0, source.Length)
		{
			this.source = source;
		}

		public StringView(string source, int offset, int length)
		{
			this.source = source;
			Offset = offset;
			Length = length;
		}

		public string GetText()
		{
			return source.Substring(Offset, Length);
		}

		public int GetUtf32Char(int index)
		{
			return char.ConvertToUtf32(source, Offset + index);
		}

		public StringView CreateSegment(int splitOffset)
		{
			return CreateSegment(splitOffset, Length - splitOffset);
		}

		public StringView CreateSegment(int splitOffset, int length)
		{
			return new StringView(source, Offset + splitOffset, length);
		}

		public StringMarshaler Marshal()
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new StringMarshaler(source, Offset);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.Fonts.Interop

	public class FontFileData : IFontFileData, IDisposable
	{
		private class FontFileDataContainerOwner
		{
			private int referenceCount;

			public IFontFileDataContainer Source { get; }

			public FontFileDataContainerOwner(IFontFileDataContainer source)
			{
				Source = source;
				referenceCount = 1;
			}

			public void AddRef()
			{
				Interlocked.Increment(ref referenceCount);
			}

			public void Release()
			{
				if (Interlocked.Decrement(ref referenceCount) == 0)
				{
					Source.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly FontFileDataContainerOwner data;

		private bool isDisposed;

		public int Length => data.Source.Length;

		public IntPtr NativeObject => data.Source.Data;

		public FontFileData(IFontFileDataContainer data)
		{
			this.data = new FontFileDataContainerOwner(data);
		}

		private FontFileData(FontFileDataContainerOwner data)
		{
			this.data = data;
			data.AddRef();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!isDisposed)
			{
				data.Release();
			}
			isDisposed = true;
		}

		public IFontFileData Clone()
		{
			return new FontFileData(data);
		}
	}
	public interface IFontFileData : IDisposable
	{
		int Length { get; }

		IntPtr NativeObject { get; }

		IFontFileData Clone();
	}
	public interface IFontFileDataContainer : IDisposable
	{
		int Length { get; }

		IntPtr Data { get; }
	}
	public class SharedFontFileData : IFontFileData, IDisposable
	{
		private static readonly IDictionary<string, IFontFileDataContainer> fontFilaData = new Dictionary<string, IFontFileDataContainer>();

		private readonly IFontFileDataContainer data;

		public int Length => data.Length;

		public IntPtr NativeObject => data.Data;

		public static SharedFontFileData Create(string fontFilePath)
		{
			IFontFileDataContainer value;
			lock (fontFilaData)
			{
				if (!fontFilaData.TryGetValue(fontFilePath, out value))
				{
					value = new MemoryMappedFileWrapper(fontFilePath);
					fontFilaData.Add(fontFilePath, value);
				}
			}
			return new SharedFontFileData(value);
		}

		private SharedFontFileData(IFontFileDataContainer data)
		{
			this.data = data;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}

		public IFontFileData Clone()
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	public class MemoryMappedFileWrapper : IFontFileDataContainer, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly MemoryMappedFile memoryMappedFile;

		private readonly MemoryMappedViewAccessor accessor;

		public int Length { get; }

		public IntPtr Data { get; }

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public MemoryMappedFileWrapper(string filePath)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read);
			memoryMappedFile = MemoryMappedFile.CreateFromFile(fileStream, null, 0L, MemoryMappedFileAccess.Read, null, HandleInheritability.None, leaveOpen: false);
			accessor = memoryMappedFile.CreateViewAccessor(0L, 0L, MemoryMappedFileAccess.Read);
			Length = (int)accessor.Capacity;
			Data = InteropHelperBuilder.AcquirePointer(accessor.SafeMemoryMappedViewHandle);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void Dispose()
		{
			accessor.SafeMemoryMappedViewHandle.ReleasePointer();
			accessor.Dispose();
			memoryMappedFile.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public class MemoryWrapper : ExternalObject, IFontFileDataContainer, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly int length;

		int IFontFileDataContainer.Length => length;

		IntPtr IFontFileDataContainer.Data => base.NativeObject;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public MemoryWrapper(byte[] data)
			: base(Marshal.AllocHGlobal(data.Length))
		{
			Marshal.Copy(data, 0, base.NativeObject, data.Length);
			length = data.Length;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DisposeCore(bool disposing)
		{
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(base.NativeObject);
		}
	}
	public class FcFontSet : ExternalObject
	{
		private struct _FcFontSet
		{
			public int nfont;

			public int sfont;

			public IntPtr fonts;
		}

		public FcFontSet(FcPattern pattern, FcObjectSet objectSet)
			: base(FontConfigInterop.FcFontList(IntPtr.Zero, pattern.NativeObject, objectSet.NativeObject))
		{
		}

		public IList<FontConfigFont> GetFonts()
		{
			_FcFontSet fcFontSet = Marshal.PtrToStructure<_FcFontSet>(base.NativeObject);
			List<FontConfigFont> list = new List<FontConfigFont>(fcFontSet.nfont);
			for (int i = 0; i < fcFontSet.nfont; i++)
			{
				FcPattern fcPattern = new FcPattern(Marshal.ReadIntPtr(fcFontSet.fonts, IntPtr.Size * i));
				string fontFormat = fcPattern.FontFormat;
				if (((fontFormat == "TrueType" && string.Compare(Path.GetExtension(fcPattern.FontFilePath), ".woff", ignoreCase: true) != 0) || fontFormat == "CFF") && fcPattern.Outline)
				{
					list.Add(new FontConfigFont(fcPattern));
				}
				else
				{
					fcPattern.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void DisposeCore(bool disposing)
		{
			FontConfigInterop.FcFontSetDestroy(base.NativeObject);
		}
	}

	public static class FontConfigInterop
	{
		private const int FcFalse = 0;

		private const int FcTrue = 1;

		private static Lazy<IFontConfigInterop> interop;

		private static IFontConfigInterop Interop => interop.Value;

		static FontConfigInterop()
		{
			interop = new Lazy<IFontConfigInterop>(delegate
			{
				string fontConfigPath = NativeDependenciesLocations.FontConfigPath;
				UnmanagedLibrary loader = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fontConfigPath) ? NativeLibraryLoader.Loader.Load("fontconfig", "1") : NativeLibraryLoader.Loader.Load(fontConfigPath));
				IFontConfigInterop fontConfigInterop = InteropHelperBuilder.CreateInteropHelper<IFontConfigInterop>(loader);
				fontConfigInterop.FcInit();
				return fontConfigInterop;
			});
		}

		private static void CheckFcResult(int value)
		{
			if (value < 0 || value > 1)
			{
				throw new ExternalException($"FontConfig call failed. FcResult: {value}");
			}
		}

		public static void EnsureLoaded()
		{
			IFontConfigInterop value = interop.Value;
		}

		public static void FcInit()
		{
			if (Interop.FcInit() == 0)
			{
				throw new ExternalException("FontConfig initialization failed.");
			}
		}

		public static IntPtr FcPatternCreate()
		{
			return Interop.FcPatternCreate();
		}

		public static IntPtr FcObjectSetCreate()
		{
			return Interop.FcObjectSetCreate();
		}

		public static IntPtr FcFontList(IntPtr zero, IntPtr pat, IntPtr os)
		{
			return Interop.FcFontList(zero, pat, os);
		}

		public static void FcObjectSetAdd(IntPtr os, string value)
		{
			Utf8StringMarshaler utf8StringMarshaler = new Utf8StringMarshaler(value);
			try
			{
				Interop.FcObjectSetAdd(os, ((Marshaler)utf8StringMarshaler).Pointer);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)utf8StringMarshaler)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public static void FcPatternAddBool(IntPtr pattern, string propertyName, bool value)
		{
			Utf8StringMarshaler utf8StringMarshaler = new Utf8StringMarshaler(propertyName);
			try
			{
				CheckFcResult(Interop.FcPatternAddBool(pattern, ((Marshaler)utf8StringMarshaler).Pointer, value ? 1 : 0));
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)utf8StringMarshaler)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public static int? FcPatternGetInteger(IntPtr pattern, string propertyName, bool throwIfFailed)
		{
			Utf8StringMarshaler utf8StringMarshaler = new Utf8StringMarshaler(propertyName);
			int result;
			try
			{
				int num = Interop.FcPatternGetInteger(pattern, ((Marshaler)utf8StringMarshaler).Pointer, 0, out result);
				if (throwIfFailed)
				{
					CheckFcResult(num);
				}
				else if (num != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)utf8StringMarshaler)?.Dispose();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool FcPatternGetBool(IntPtr pattern, string propertyName)
		{
			Utf8StringMarshaler utf8StringMarshaler = new Utf8StringMarshaler(propertyName);
			int result;
			try
			{
				CheckFcResult(Interop.FcPatternGetBool(pattern, ((Marshaler)utf8StringMarshaler).Pointer, 0, out result));
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)utf8StringMarshaler)?.Dispose();
			}
			return result != 0;
		}

		public static string FcPatternGetString(IntPtr pattern, string propertyName)
		{
			Utf8StringMarshaler utf8StringMarshaler = new Utf8StringMarshaler(propertyName);
			IntPtr result;
			try
			{
				CheckFcResult(Interop.FcPatternGetString(pattern, ((Marshaler)utf8StringMarshaler).Pointer, 0, out result));
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)utf8StringMarshaler)?.Dispose();
			}
			if (result == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<byte> list = new List<byte>(4);
			int num = 0;
			while (true)
			{
				byte b = Marshal.ReadByte(result, num);
				if (b == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(b);
				num++;
			}
			return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(list.ToArray());
		}

		public static void FcObjectSetDestroy(IntPtr set)
		{
			Interop.FcObjectSetDestroy(set);
		}

		public static void FcFontSetDestroy(IntPtr set)
		{
			Interop.FcFontSetDestroy(set);
		}

		public static void FcPatternDestroy(IntPtr pattern)
		{
			Interop.FcPatternDestroy(pattern);
		}

		public static void FcFini()
		{
			Interop.FcFini();
		}
	}

	public class Utf8StringMarshaler : Marshaler
	{
		private readonly GCHandle handle;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public Utf8StringMarshaler(string value)
		{
			int byteCount = Encoding.UTF8.GetByteCount(value);
			byte[] array = new byte[byteCount + 1];
			Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(value, 0, value.Length, array, 0);
			handle = GCHandle.Alloc(array, GCHandleType.Pinned);
			((Marshaler)this).Pointer = handle.AddrOfPinnedObject();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void FreePointer()
		{
			handle.Free();
		}
	}

		public void AddUTF16(string text)
		{
			HarfBuzzInterop.hb_buffer_add_utf16(base.NativeObject, text, text.Length, 0, -1);
		}

		public void AddUTF16(StringView text)
		{
			StringMarshaler val = text.Marshal();
			try
			{
				HarfBuzzInterop.hb_buffer_add_utf16(base.NativeObject, ((Marshaler)val).Pointer, text.Length, 0, -1);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

			IntPtr intPtr = HarfBuzzInterop.hb_buffer_get_glyph_infos(base.NativeObject, out length);
			hb_glyph_info_t[] array = new hb_glyph_info_t[length];
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = Marshal.PtrToStructure<hb_glyph_info_t>(intPtr + i * Marshal.SizeOf<hb_glyph_info_t>());
			}
			return array;

	public struct hb_feature_t
	{
		private static int KernTag = CreateTag("kern");

		public static hb_feature_t KerningOff = new hb_feature_t(KernTag, 0, 0u, uint.MaxValue);

		public static hb_feature_t KerningOn = new hb_feature_t(KernTag, 1, 0u, uint.MaxValue);

		private int tag;

		private int value;

		private uint start;

		private uint end;

		private static int CreateTag(string tag)
		{
			return ((tag[0] & 0xFF) << 24) | ((tag[1] & 0xFF) << 16) | ((tag[2] & 0xFF) << 8) | (tag[3] & 0xFF);
		}

		private hb_feature_t(int tag, int value, uint start, uint end)
		{
			this.tag = tag;
			this.value = value;
			this.start = start;
			this.end = end;
		}
	}

	public static class ICUInterop
	{
		private const string versionEnvironmentVariableName = "DXEXPORT_ICU_VERSION_OVERRIDE";

		private const int minMajorVersion = 50;

		private const int maxMajorVersion = 99;

		private const int minMinorICUVersion = 1;

		private const int maxMinorICUVersion = 5;

		private const string libraryName = "icuuc";

		private static Lazy<IICUInterop> interop;

		private static IICUInterop Interop => interop.Value;

		static ICUInterop()
		{
			interop = new Lazy<IICUInterop>(delegate
			{
				string iCUPath = NativeDependenciesLocations.ICUPath;
				UnmanagedLibrary loader;
				string nameSuffix;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(iCUPath))
				{
					loader = NativeLibraryLoader.Loader.Load(iCUPath);
					nameSuffix = NativeDependenciesLocations.ICUVersionSuffix ?? "";
				}
				else
				{
					Tuple<UnmanagedLibrary, string> tuple = LoadSharedLibrary(NativeLibraryLoader.Loader);
					loader = tuple.Item1;
					nameSuffix = tuple.Item2;
				}
				return InteropHelperBuilder.CreateInteropHelper<IICUInterop>(loader, nameSuffix);
			});
		}

		private static bool CheckAllMethods(UnmanagedLibrary library, string suffix)
		{
			return (from m in typeof(IICUInterop).GetMethods()
				select m.Name).All((string name) => library.TryGetFunctionPointer(name + suffix) != IntPtr.Zero);
		}

		private static string FindSuffix(UnmanagedLibrary library, int majorVersion, int? minorVersion)
		{
			if (library.TryGetFunctionPointer("ubidi_setPara") != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				if (!CheckAllMethods(library, ""))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return "";
			}
			string text = "_" + majorVersion;
			if (library.TryGetFunctionPointer("ubidi_setPara" + text) != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				if (!CheckAllMethods(library, text))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return text;
			}
			if (minorVersion.HasValue)
			{
				text = text + "_" + minorVersion.Value;
				if (library.TryGetFunctionPointer("ubidi_setPara" + text) != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					if (!CheckAllMethods(library, text))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return text;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static Tuple<UnmanagedLibrary, string> LoadSharedLibrary(NativeLibraryLoader libraryLoader)
		{
			string environmentVariable = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DXEXPORT_ICU_VERSION_OVERRIDE");
			UnmanagedLibrary unmanagedLibrary;
			if (environmentVariable != null)
			{
				unmanagedLibrary = libraryLoader.TryLoad("icuuc", environmentVariable);
				if (unmanagedLibrary != null)
				{
					string[] array = environmentVariable.Split('.');
					if (int.TryParse(array[0], out var result))
					{
						int? minorVersion = null;
						if (array.Length > 1 && int.TryParse(array[1], out var result2))
						{
							minorVersion = result2;
						}
						string text = FindSuffix(unmanagedLibrary, result, minorVersion);
						if (text != null)
						{
							return new Tuple<UnmanagedLibrary, string>(unmanagedLibrary, text);
						}
						unmanagedLibrary.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			unmanagedLibrary = libraryLoader.TryLoad("icuuc", string.Empty);
			if (unmanagedLibrary != null)
			{
				for (int i = 50; i <= 99; i++)
				{
					for (int num = 5; num >= 1; num--)
					{
						string text2 = FindSuffix(unmanagedLibrary, i, num);
						if (text2 != null)
						{
							return new Tuple<UnmanagedLibrary, string>(unmanagedLibrary, text2);
						}
					}
				}
				unmanagedLibrary.Dispose();
			}
			for (int j = 50; j <= 99; j++)
			{
				unmanagedLibrary = libraryLoader.TryLoad("icuuc", j.ToString());
				int? minorVersion2 = null;
				if (unmanagedLibrary == null)
				{
					for (int num2 = 5; num2 >= 1; num2--)
					{
						minorVersion2 = num2;
						unmanagedLibrary = libraryLoader.TryLoad("icuuc", string.Format($"{j}.{num2}"));
						if (unmanagedLibrary != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (unmanagedLibrary != null)
				{
					string text3 = FindSuffix(unmanagedLibrary, j, minorVersion2);
					if (text3 != null)
					{
						return new Tuple<UnmanagedLibrary, string>(unmanagedLibrary, text3);
					}
					unmanagedLibrary.Dispose();
				}
			}
			throw new DllNotFoundException("Unable to load ICU library.");
		}

		private static void HandleError(UErrorCode code)
		{
			if (code > UErrorCode.U_ZERO_ERROR)
			{
				throw new ExternalException($"ICU Error: {code}");
			}
		}

		public static void EnsureLoaded()
		{
			IICUInterop iICUInterop = Interop;
		}

		public static bool IsAvaliable()
		{
			try
			{
				EnsureLoaded();
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			IntPtr intPtr = Interop.uscript_getShortName(script);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Marshal.PtrToStringAnsi(intPtr, 4);
		}

		public static IntPtr? uscript_getShortNamePointer(UScriptCode script)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = Interop.uscript_getShortName(script);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return intPtr;
		}

	public class UScriptRun : ExternalObject
	{
		public UScriptRun(string text)
			: base(ICUInterop.uscript_openRun(text))
		{
		}

		public bool NextRun(out int pRunStart, out int pRunLimit, out UScriptCode pRunScript)
		{
			return ICUInterop.uscript_nextRun(base.NativeObject, out pRunStart, out pRunLimit, out pRunScript);
		}

		protected override void DisposeCore(bool disposing)
		{
			ICUInterop.uscript_closeRun(base.NativeObject);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.Fonts.Sfnt
{
	internal static class SfntFontHelpers
	{
		public static string[] GetFontNames(byte[] fontFile)
		{
			try
			{
				return SfntFont.ParseAll(fontFile)?.Select((SfntFont f) => GetName(f, SfntNameID.FontFamily) ?? GetName(f, SfntNameID.TypographicFamily)).ToArray() ?? new string[0];
			}
			catch
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
		}

		public static string GetName(SfntFont font, SfntNameID id)
		{
			return GetName(font.Name, id);
		}

		public static string GetName(SfntNameTable nameTable, SfntNameID id)
		{
			if (nameTable == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (SfntName name in nameTable.Names)
			{
				if (name.NameID == id && name.PlatformID == SfntPlatformID.Microsoft && (name.EncodingID == 1 || name.EncodingID == 0) && name.LanguageID == 1033)
				{
					return name.DecodedName;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTableEntryDescriptor
	{
		public SfntPlatformID PlatformID { get; }

		public ushort EncodingID { get; }

		public uint Offset { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableEntryDescriptor(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, uint offset)
		{
			PlatformID = platformID;
			EncodingID = encodingID;
			Offset = offset;
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTable : SfntTable
	{
		private readonly List<SfntCmapTableEntryDescriptor> entries = new List<SfntCmapTableEntryDescriptor>();

		public short Version { get; }

		public IReadOnlyList<SfntCmapTableEntryDescriptor> Entries => entries;

		public SfntCmapTable(byte[] tableData)
			: base(SfntTags.Cmap)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(tableData);
			Version = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			short num = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			entries = new List<SfntCmapTableEntryDescriptor>(num);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				SfntPlatformID platformID = (SfntPlatformID)sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				ushort encodingID = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				uint offset = sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
				entries.Add(new SfntCmapTableEntryDescriptor(platformID, encodingID, offset));
			}
		}

		public SfntCmapTableEntry GetEntry(byte[] tableData, SfntCmapTableEntryDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(tableData);
			try
			{
				sfntStreamReader.Position = descriptor.Offset;
				return SfntCmapTableEntry.Parse(sfntStreamReader, descriptor.PlatformID, descriptor.EncodingID);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SfntCmapTableEntry
	{
		public SfntPlatformID PlatformID { get; }

		public ushort EncodingID { get; }

		public ushort Format { get; }

		public static SfntCmapTableEntry Parse(SfntStreamReader reader, SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID)
		{
			return reader.ReadUShort() switch
			{
				0 => new SfntCmapTableFormat0Entry(platformID, encodingID, reader), 
				2 => new SfntCmapTableFormat2Entry(platformID, encodingID, reader), 
				4 => new SfntCmapTableFormat4Entry(platformID, encodingID, reader), 
				6 => new SfntCmapTableFormat6Entry(platformID, encodingID, reader), 
				8 => new SfntCmapTableFormat8Entry(platformID, encodingID, reader), 
				10 => new SfntCmapTableFormat10Entry(platformID, encodingID, reader), 
				12 => new SfntCmapTableFormat12Entry(platformID, encodingID, reader), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		protected SfntCmapTableEntry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, ushort format)
		{
			PlatformID = platformID;
			EncodingID = encodingID;
			Format = format;
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTableFormat0Entry : SfntCmapTableShortHeaderEntry
	{
		public byte[] GlyphIdArray { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat0Entry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, 0, reader)
		{
			GlyphIdArray = reader.ReadArray(256);
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTableFormat10Entry : SfntCmapTableLongHeaderEntry
	{
		public uint StartCharCode { get; }

		public uint NumChars { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat10Entry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, 10, reader)
		{
			StartCharCode = reader.ReadUInt();
			NumChars = reader.ReadUInt();
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTableFormat12Entry : SfntCmapTableLongHeaderEntry
	{
		public SfntCMapSequentialGroup[] Groups { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat12Entry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, 12, reader)
		{
			uint num = reader.ReadUInt();
			Groups = new SfntCMapSequentialGroup[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				uint startCharCode = reader.ReadUInt();
				uint endCharCode = reader.ReadUInt();
				uint startGlyphID = reader.ReadUInt();
				Groups[i] = new SfntCMapSequentialGroup(startCharCode, endCharCode, startGlyphID);
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct SfntCmapTableFormat2Subheader
	{
		public ushort FirstCode { get; }

		public ushort EntryCount { get; }

		public short IdDelta { get; }

		public ushort IdRangeOffset { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat2Subheader(ushort firstCode, ushort entryCount, short idDelta, ushort idRangeOffset)
		{
			FirstCode = firstCode;
			EntryCount = entryCount;
			IdDelta = idDelta;
			IdRangeOffset = idRangeOffset;
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTableFormat2Entry : SfntCmapTableShortHeaderEntry
	{
		public ushort[] SubHeaderKeys { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat2Subheader[] SubHeaders { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat2Entry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, 2, reader)
		{
			SubHeaderKeys = new ushort[256];
			for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
			{
				SubHeaderKeys[i] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
			int num = SubHeaderKeys.Distinct().Count();
			SubHeaders = new SfntCmapTableFormat2Subheader[num];
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				SubHeaders[j] = ReadSubHeader(reader);
			}
		}

		private SfntCmapTableFormat2Subheader ReadSubHeader(SfntStreamReader reader)
		{
			ushort firstCode = reader.ReadUShort();
			ushort entryCount = reader.ReadUShort();
			short idDelta = reader.ReadShort();
			ushort idRangeOffset = reader.ReadUShort();
			return new SfntCmapTableFormat2Subheader(firstCode, entryCount, idDelta, idRangeOffset);
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTableFormat4Entry : SfntCmapTableShortHeaderEntry
	{
		public ushort SegCountX2 { get; }

		public ushort SearchRange { get; }

		public ushort EntrySelector { get; }

		public ushort RangeShift { get; }

		public ushort[] EndCode { get; }

		public ushort[] StartCode { get; }

		public short[] IdDelta { get; }

		public ushort[] IdRangeOffsets { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat4Entry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, 4, reader)
		{
			SegCountX2 = reader.ReadUShort();
			SearchRange = reader.ReadUShort();
			EntrySelector = reader.ReadUShort();
			RangeShift = reader.ReadUShort();
			int num = SegCountX2 / 2;
			EndCode = new ushort[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				EndCode[i] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
			reader.ReadUShort();
			StartCode = new ushort[num];
			for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
			{
				StartCode[j] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
			IdDelta = new short[num];
			for (int k = 0; k < num; k++)
			{
				IdDelta[k] = reader.ReadShort();
			}
			IdRangeOffsets = new ushort[num];
			for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
			{
				IdRangeOffsets[l] = reader.ReadUShort();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTableFormat6Entry : SfntCmapTableShortHeaderEntry
	{
		public ushort FirstCode { get; }

		public ushort EntryCount { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat6Entry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, 6, reader)
		{
			FirstCode = reader.ReadUShort();
			EntryCount = reader.ReadUShort();
		}
	}
	internal struct SfntCMapSequentialGroup
	{
		public uint StartCharCode { get; }

		public uint EndCharCode { get; }

		public uint StartGlyphID { get; }

		public SfntCMapSequentialGroup(uint startCharCode, uint endCharCode, uint startGlyphID)
		{
			StartCharCode = startCharCode;
			EndCharCode = endCharCode;
			StartGlyphID = startGlyphID;
		}
	}
	internal class SfntCmapTableFormat8Entry : SfntCmapTableLongHeaderEntry
	{
		public byte[] Is32 { get; }

		public uint NumGroups { get; }

		public SfntCMapSequentialGroup[] Groups { get; }

		public SfntCmapTableFormat8Entry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, 8, reader)
		{
			Is32 = reader.ReadArray(8192);
			ushort num = reader.ReadUShort();
			Groups = new SfntCMapSequentialGroup[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				uint startCharCode = reader.ReadUInt();
				uint endCharCode = reader.ReadUInt();
				uint startGlyphID = reader.ReadUInt();
				Groups[i] = new SfntCMapSequentialGroup(startCharCode, endCharCode, startGlyphID);
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SfntCmapTableShortHeaderEntry : SfntCmapTableEntry
	{
		public ushort Length { get; set; }

		public ushort Language { get; set; }

		protected SfntCmapTableShortHeaderEntry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, ushort format, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, format)
		{
			Length = reader.ReadUShort();
			Language = reader.ReadUShort();
		}
	}
	internal abstract class SfntCmapTableLongHeaderEntry : SfntCmapTableEntry
	{
		public uint Length { get; set; }

		public uint Language { get; set; }

		protected SfntCmapTableLongHeaderEntry(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, ushort format, SfntStreamReader reader)
			: base(platformID, encodingID, format)
		{
			reader.ReadUShort();
			Length = reader.ReadUInt();
			Language = reader.ReadUInt();
		}
	}

	[DebuggerDisplay("Platform: {PlatformID}; Encoding: {EncodingID}; Lang {LanguageID}; Name={DecodedName}")]
	internal class SfntName
	{
		private readonly SfntPlatformID platformID;

		private readonly ushort encodingID;

		private readonly ushort languageID;

		private readonly SfntNameID nameID;

		private readonly byte[] data;

		public SfntPlatformID PlatformID => platformID;

		public ushort EncodingID => encodingID;

		public ushort LanguageID => languageID;

		public SfntNameID NameID => nameID;

		public byte[] Data => data;

		public string DecodedName { get; }

		public SfntName(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, ushort languageID, SfntNameID nameID, string name)
			: this(platformID, encodingID, languageID, nameID, (platformID == SfntPlatformID.Macintosh) ? Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(name) : Encoding.BigEndianUnicode.GetBytes(name))
		{
		}

		public SfntName(SfntPlatformID platformID, ushort encodingID, ushort languageID, SfntNameID nameID, byte[] nameData)
		{
			this.platformID = platformID;
			this.languageID = languageID;
			this.nameID = nameID;
			this.encodingID = encodingID;
			data = nameData;
			DecodedName = ((platformID == SfntPlatformID.Macintosh) ? Encoding.UTF8.GetString(data) : Encoding.BigEndianUnicode.GetString(data));
		}

		public SfntName(SfntStreamReader stream, int dataOffset)
		{
			platformID = (SfntPlatformID)stream.ReadUShort();
			encodingID = stream.ReadUShort();
			languageID = stream.ReadUShort();
			nameID = (SfntNameID)stream.ReadUShort();
			int num = stream.ReadUShort();
			int num2 = stream.ReadUShort();
			long num3 = dataOffset + num2;
			if (num3 + num <= stream.Length)
			{
				long position = stream.Position;
				stream.Position = num3;
				data = stream.ReadArray(num);
				DecodedName = ((platformID == SfntPlatformID.Macintosh) ? Encoding.UTF8.GetString(data) : Encoding.BigEndianUnicode.GetString(data));
				stream.Position = position;
			}
		}
	}

	internal class SfntMaxpTable : SfntTable
	{
		public const uint Version1 = 65536u;

		public const uint Version05 = 20480u;

		public uint Version { get; set; }

		public ushort NumGlyphs { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxPoints { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxContours { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxCompositePoints { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxCompositeContours { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxZones { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxTwilightPoints { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxStorage { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxFunctionDefs { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxInstructionDefs { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxStackElements { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxSizeOfInstructions { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxComponentElements { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxComponentDepth { get; set; }

		public SfntMaxpTable(byte[] tableData)
			: base(SfntTags.Maxp)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(tableData);
			Version = sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
			NumGlyphs = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			if (Version >= 65536)
			{
				MaxPoints = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxContours = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxCompositePoints = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxCompositeContours = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxZones = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxTwilightPoints = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxStorage = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxFunctionDefs = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxInstructionDefs = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxStackElements = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxSizeOfInstructions = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxComponentElements = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxComponentDepth = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SfntNameTable : SfntTable
	{
		public IList<SfntName> Names { get; set; }

		public IList<byte[]> LangTags { get; set; }

		public SfntNameTable(byte[] tableData)
			: base(SfntTags.Name)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(tableData);
			Names = new List<SfntName>();
			if (sfntStreamReader.Length <= 6)
			{
				return;
			}
			ushort num = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			ushort num2 = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			ushort dataOffset = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			if (num >= 1)
			{
				ushort num3 = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				LangTags = new List<byte[]>(num3);
				for (int i = 0; i < num3; i++)
				{
					ushort num4 = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
					ushort num5 = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
					if (num5 + num4 < sfntStreamReader.Length)
					{
						sfntStreamReader.Position = num5;
						LangTags.Add(sfntStreamReader.ReadArray(num4));
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
			{
				Names.Add(new SfntName(sfntStreamReader, dataOffset));
			}
		}
	}
