		public SfntCodePageRange2 CodePageRange2 { get; set; }

		public short XHeight { get; set; }

		public short CapHeight { get; set; }

		public ushort DefaultChar { get; set; }

		public ushort BreakChar { get; set; }

		public ushort MaxContext { get; set; }

		public ushort LowerOpticalPointSize { get; set; }

		public ushort UpperOpticalPointSize { get; set; }

		public SfntOS2Table(byte[] tableData)
			: base(SfntTags.OS2)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(tableData);
			Version = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			AvgCharWidth = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			WeightClass = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			WidthClass = (SfntWidthClass)sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			EmbeddingType = (SfntEmbeddingType)sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			SubscriptXSize = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			SubscriptYSize = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			SubscriptXOffset = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			SubscriptYOffset = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			SuperscriptXSize = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			SuperscriptYSize = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			SuperscriptXOffset = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			SuperscriptYOffset = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			StrikeoutSize = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			StrikeoutPosition = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			FamilyClass = (SfntFamilyClass)sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			Panose = sfntStreamReader.ReadArray(10);
			UnicodeRange1 = (SfntUnicodeRange1)sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
			UnicodeRange2 = (SfntUnicodeRange2)sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
			UnicodeRange3 = (SfntUnicodeRange3)sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
			UnicodeRange4 = (SfntUnicodeRange4)sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
			Vendor = sfntStreamReader.ReadTag();
			Selection = (SfntSelection)sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			FirstCharIndex = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			LastCharIndex = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			TypoAscender = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			TypoDescender = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			TypoLineGap = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			WinAscent = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			WinDescent = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			if (Version >= 1)
			{
				CodePageRange1 = (SfntCodePageRange1)sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
				CodePageRange2 = (SfntCodePageRange2)sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
			}
			if (Version >= 2)
			{
				XHeight = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
				CapHeight = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
				DefaultChar = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				BreakChar = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				MaxContext = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			}
			if (Version >= 5)
			{
				LowerOpticalPointSize = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
				UpperOpticalPointSize = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			}
		}
	}

	internal class SfntHeadTable : SfntTable
	{

		public uint MagicNumber { get; set; } = 1594834165u;

		public SfntHeadFlags Flags { get; set; }

		public ushort UnitsPerEm { get; set; }

		public long Created { get; set; }

		public long Modified { get; set; }

		public short XMin { get; set; }

		public short YMin { get; set; }

		public short XMax { get; set; }

		public short YMax { get; set; }

		public SfntHeadMacStyle MacStyle { get; set; }

		public SfntIndexToLocFormat IndexToLocFormat { get; set; }

		public short GlyphDataFormat { get; set; }

		public SfntHeadTable(byte[] tableData)
			: base(SfntTags.Head)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(tableData);
			MajorVersion = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			MinorVersion = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			FontRevision = sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
			CheckSumAdjustment = sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
			MagicNumber = sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
			Flags = (SfntHeadFlags)sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			UnitsPerEm = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			Created = sfntStreamReader.ReadLong();
			Modified = sfntStreamReader.ReadLong();
			XMin = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			YMin = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			XMax = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			YMax = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			MacStyle = (SfntHeadMacStyle)sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			LowestRecPPEM = sfntStreamReader.ReadUShort();
			FontDirectionHint = (SfntDirectionHint)sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			IndexToLocFormat = (SfntIndexToLocFormat)sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			GlyphDataFormat = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
		}

		public SfntHeadTable()
			: base(SfntTags.Head)
		{
			MajorVersion = 1;
			MinorVersion = 0;
			FontRevision = 0;
			CheckSumAdjustment = 0u;
			MagicNumber = 1594834165u;
			Flags = SfntHeadFlags.Empty;
			UnitsPerEm = 1000;
			Created = (DateTime.Now - minDateTime).Seconds;
			Modified = Created;
			LowestRecPPEM = 6;
		}
	}

	internal class SfntTable
	{
		public SfntTag Tag { get; }

		public static SfntTable Create(SfntTag tag, byte[] data)
		{
			if (tag == SfntTags.Head)
			{
				return new SfntHeadTable(data);
			}
			if (tag == SfntTags.OS2)
			{
				return new SfntOS2Table(data);
			}
			if (tag == SfntTags.Name)
			{
				return new SfntNameTable(data);
			}
			if (tag == SfntTags.Cmap)
			{
				return new SfntCmapTable(data);
			}
			return new SfntTable(tag);
		}

		protected SfntTable(SfntTag tag)
		{
			Tag = tag;
		}
	}
	internal class SfntFont
	{
		private class TableContainer
		{
			private readonly SfntTag tag;

			private SfntTable table;

			private byte[] data;

			public TableContainer(SfntTag tag, byte[] tableData)
			{
				this.tag = tag;
				data = tableData;
			}

			public TableContainer(SfntTable table)
			{
				this.table = table;
			}

			public SfntTable GetTable(SfntFont font)
			{
				if (table == null && data != null)
				{
					table = SfntTable.Create(tag, data);
					data = null;
				}
				return table;
			}
		}

		private struct TableRecord
		{
			public SfntTag Tag { get; }

			public int Offset { get; }

			public byte[] TableData { get; }

			public uint Checksum { get; }

			public TableRecord(int offset, byte[] tableData, SfntTag tag, uint checksum)
			{
				Offset = offset;
				TableData = tableData;
				Tag = tag;
				Checksum = checksum;
			}
		}

		private const int tableDirectoryOffset = 12;

		private const long ttcHeaderLength = 12L;

		private readonly IDictionary<SfntTag, TableContainer> tableDirectory = new Dictionary<SfntTag, TableContainer>();

		public SfntTag Version { get; set; }

		public SfntHeadTable Head => GetTable<SfntHeadTable>(SfntTags.Head);

		public SfntNameTable Name => GetTable<SfntNameTable>(SfntTags.Name);

		public SfntOS2Table OS2 => GetTable<SfntOS2Table>(SfntTags.OS2);

		private static bool CheckVersion(byte[] fontFileData, SfntTag versionTag)
		{
			if (fontFileData.Length >= 4 && fontFileData[0] == versionTag.A && fontFileData[1] == versionTag.B && fontFileData[2] == versionTag.C)
			{
				return fontFileData[3] == versionTag.D;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsOpenType(byte[] fontFileData)
		{
			return CheckVersion(fontFileData, SfntTags.OpenTypeVersion);
		}

		public static bool IsTrueType(byte[] fontFileData)
		{
			return CheckVersion(fontFileData, SfntTags.TrueTypeVersion);
		}

		public static bool IsTrueTypeCollection(byte[] fontFileData)
		{
			return CheckVersion(fontFileData, SfntTags.TrueTypeCollectionVersion);
		}

		public static SfntFont Parse(byte[] fontFileData, int index = 0)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(fontFileData);
			long fontFileOffset = 0L;
			if (SfntTags.TrueTypeCollectionVersion == sfntStreamReader.ReadTag())
			{
				sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
				long num = (uint)sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
				if (index >= num)
				{
					throw new SfntParseException(SfntParsingErrorType.TTCIndexIsGreaterThanFontCount, SfntTags.TrueTypeCollectionVersion);
				}
				sfntStreamReader.Position = 12L + (long)(index * 4);
				fontFileOffset = (uint)sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
			}
			return ParseFontFile(fontFileData, fontFileOffset);
		}

		public static int GetFontFileCount(Stream fontFileStream)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(fontFileStream);
			if (SfntTags.TrueTypeCollectionVersion == sfntStreamReader.ReadTag())
			{
				sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
				return sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
			}
			return 1;
		}

		public static SfntFont[] ParseAll(byte[] fontFileData)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(fontFileData);
			if (SfntTags.TrueTypeCollectionVersion == sfntStreamReader.ReadTag())
			{
				sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
				long num = sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
				SfntFont[] array = new SfntFont[num];
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					sfntStreamReader.Position = 12L + (long)(i * 4);
					long fontFileOffset = sfntStreamReader.ReadUInt();
					array[i] = ParseFontFile(fontFileData, fontFileOffset);
				}
				return array;
			}
			return new SfntFont[1] { ParseFontFile(fontFileData, 0L) };
		}

		private static SfntFont ParseFontFile(byte[] fontFileData, long fontFileOffset)
		{
			SfntStreamReader sfntStreamReader = new SfntStreamReader(fontFileData);
			sfntStreamReader.Position = fontFileOffset;
			SfntTag version = sfntStreamReader.ReadTag();
			short num = sfntStreamReader.ReadShort();
			sfntStreamReader.Position = fontFileOffset + 12;
			Dictionary<SfntTag, TableContainer> dictionary = new Dictionary<SfntTag, TableContainer>();
			for (short num2 = 0; num2 < num; num2++)
			{
				SfntTag sfntTag = sfntStreamReader.ReadTag();
				sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
				int num3 = sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
				int num4 = sfntStreamReader.ReadInt();
				if (sfntTag == SfntTags.Glyf && num4 == 0)
				{
					num4 = (int)(sfntStreamReader.Length - num3);
				}
				if (sfntTag != SfntTags.EBLC && num3 > 0 && num3 < sfntStreamReader.Length && num4 > 0)
				{
					long position = sfntStreamReader.Position;
					sfntStreamReader.Position = num3;
					try
					{
						num4 = Math.Min(num4, (int)(sfntStreamReader.Length - num3));
						if (num4 > 0)
						{
							dictionary[sfntTag] = new TableContainer(sfntTag, sfntStreamReader.ReadArray(num4));
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						sfntStreamReader.Position = position;
					}
				}
			}
			return new SfntFont(version, dictionary);
		}

		public SfntFont()
		{
		}

		private SfntFont(SfntTag version, IDictionary<SfntTag, TableContainer> tableDirectory)
		{
			Version = version;
			this.tableDirectory = tableDirectory;
		}

		public bool HasTable(SfntTag tag)
		{
			return tableDirectory.ContainsKey(tag);
		}

		private T GetTable<T>(SfntTag tag) where T : SfntTable
		{
			return GetTable(tag) as T;
		}

		public SfntTable GetTable(SfntTag tag)
		{
			if (tableDirectory.TryGetValue(tag, out var value))
			{
				return value.GetTable(this);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class SfntStreamReader
	{
		private readonly Stream stream;

		public long Length => stream.Length;

		public long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return stream.Position;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value > Length)
				{
					throw new SfntParseException(SfntParsingErrorType.UnexpectedEndOfStream);
				}
				stream.Position = Math.Max(0L, value);
			}
		}

		public SfntStreamReader(Stream stream)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
		}

		public SfntStreamReader(byte[] data)
		{
			stream = new MemoryStream(data);
		}

		public SfntTag ReadTag()
		{
			return new SfntTag(ReadByte(), ReadByte(), ReadByte(), ReadByte());
		}

		public byte ReadByte()
		{
			if (Position >= Length)
			{
				throw new SfntParseException(SfntParsingErrorType.UnexpectedEndOfStream);
			}
			return (byte)stream.ReadByte();
		}

		public short ReadShort()
		{
			return (short)((ReadByte() << 8) + ReadByte());
		}

		public ushort ReadUShort()
		{
			return (ushort)((ReadByte() << 8) + ReadByte());
		}

		public uint ReadUInt()
		{
			return (uint)ReadInt();
		}

		public int ReadInt()
		{
			return (ReadByte() << 24) | (ReadByte() << 16) | (ReadByte() << 8) | ReadByte();
		}

		public long ReadLong()
		{
			long num = 0L;
			for (int num2 = 7; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				num |= (long)((ulong)ReadByte() << num2 * 8);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public byte[] ReadArray(int length)
		{
			if (Position + length > Length)
			{
				throw new SfntParseException(SfntParsingErrorType.UnexpectedEndOfStream);
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[length];
			StreamHelper.FillBuffer(stream, array, 0, length);
			return array;
		}

		public int Read24BitInt()
		{
			return (ReadByte() << 16) + (ReadByte() << 8) + ReadByte();
		}
	}
	internal enum SfntParsingErrorType
	{
		UnknownVersion,
		UnexpectedEndOfStream,
		TTCIndexIsGreaterThanFontCount
	}
	internal class SfntParseException : Exception
	{
		public SfntTag? ErrorTag { get; }

		public SfntParsingErrorType ErrorType { get; }

		public SfntParseException(SfntParsingErrorType errorType)
		{
			ErrorType = errorType;
		}

		public SfntParseException(SfntParsingErrorType errorType, SfntTag errorTag)
		{
			ErrorType = errorType;
			ErrorTag = errorTag;
		}
	}
	internal class SfntStreamWriter
	{
		private readonly Stream stream;

		public long Position
		{
			get
			{
				return stream.Position;
			}
			set
			{
				stream.Position = value;
			}
		}

		public SfntStreamWriter(Stream stream)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
		}

		public void WriteByte(byte value)
		{
			stream.WriteByte(value);
		}

		public void WriteTag(SfntTag tag)
		{
			stream.WriteByte(tag.A);
			stream.WriteByte(tag.B);
			stream.WriteByte(tag.C);
			stream.WriteByte(tag.D);
		}

		public void WriteShort(short value)
		{
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF00) >> 8));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)(value & 0xFF));
		}

		public void WriteUShort(ushort value)
		{
			WriteShort((short)value);
		}

		public void WriteUInt(uint value)
		{
			WriteInt((int)value);
		}

		public void WriteInt(int value)
		{
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF000000u) >> 24));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF0000) >> 16));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF00) >> 8));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)(value & 0xFF));
		}

		public void Write24BitInt(int value)
		{
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF0000) >> 16));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF00) >> 8));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)(value & 0xFF));
		}

		public void WriteLong(long value)
		{
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((ulong)(value & -72057594037927936L) >> 56));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF000000000000L) >> 48));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF0000000000L) >> 40));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF00000000L) >> 32));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF000000u) >> 24));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF0000) >> 16));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)((value & 0xFF00) >> 8));
			stream.WriteByte((byte)(value & 0xFF));
		}

		public void WriteArray(byte[] array)
		{
			stream.Write(array, 0, array.Length);
		}

		public void WriteShortArray(short[] array)
		{
			foreach (short value in array)
			{
				WriteShort(value);
			}
		}

		public void WriteString(string str)
		{
			foreach (char c in str)
			{
				stream.WriteByte((byte)c);
			}
		}

		public void Align()
		{
			long num = stream.Length % 4;
			num = ((num > 0) ? (4 - num) : 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				stream.WriteByte(0);
			}
		}

		public byte[] GetData()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[stream.Length];
			long position = Position;
			Position = 0L;
			stream.Read(array, 0, array.Length);
			Position = position;
			return array;
		}
	}

	internal struct SfntTag : IEquatable<SfntTag>, IComparable<SfntTag>
	{
		public byte A { get; }

		public byte B { get; }

		public byte C { get; }

		public byte D { get; }

		public static bool operator ==(SfntTag tag1, SfntTag tag2)
		{
			if (tag1.A == tag2.A && tag1.B == tag2.B && tag1.C == tag2.C)
			{
				return tag1.D == tag2.D;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(SfntTag tag1, SfntTag tag2)
		{
			if (tag1.A == tag2.A && tag1.B == tag2.B && tag1.C == tag2.C)
			{
				return tag1.D != tag2.D;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static SfntTag Create(string tag)
		{
			if (tag.Length < 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return new SfntTag((byte)tag[0], (byte)tag[1], (byte)tag[2], (byte)tag[3]);
		}

		public static SfntTag Create(byte[] tag)
		{
			if (tag.Length < 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			return new SfntTag(tag[0], tag[1], tag[2], tag[3]);
		}

		public SfntTag(byte a, byte b, byte c, byte d)
		{
			A = a;
			B = b;
			C = c;
			D = d;
		}

		public uint ToUIntInverted()
		{
			return (uint)((D << 24) | (C << 16) | (B << 8) | A);
		}

		public uint ToUInt()
		{
			return (uint)((A << 24) | (B << 16) | (C << 8) | D);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return new string(new char[4]
			{
				(char)A,
				(char)B,
				(char)C,
				(char)D
			});
		}

		public bool Equals(SfntTag other)
		{
			if (A == other.A && B == other.B && C == other.C)
			{
				return D == other.D;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is SfntTag)
			{
				return Equals((SfntTag)obj);
			}
			return base.Equals(obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<byte, byte, byte, byte>(A, B, C, D);
		}

		public int CompareTo(SfntTag other)
		{
			int num = A.CompareTo(other.A);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = B.CompareTo(other.B);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = C.CompareTo(other.C);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			num = D.CompareTo(other.D);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	internal static class SfntUtils
	{
		public static uint CalcChecksum(byte[] data)
		{
			uint num = 0u;
			int num2 = data.Length / 4;
			int i = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			for (; i < num2; i++)
			{
				int num4 = data[num3++] << 24;
				num4 += data[num3++] << 16;
				num4 += data[num3++] << 8;
				num4 += data[num3++];
				num += (uint)num4;
			}
			int num5 = data.Length % 4;
			if (num5 != 0)
			{
				int num6 = 0;
				int num7 = 24;
				for (int num8 = num5; num8 > 0; num8--)
				{
					num6 += data[data.Length - num8] << num7;
					num7 -= 8;
				}
				num += (uint)num6;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_003d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		}

	public class DirectWriteFont : DXFontFace
	{
		private static readonly DXCharRange complexScripRrange = new DXCharRange(1424, 1791);

		private static readonly List<DXCharRange> cjkRanges = new List<DXCharRange>
		{
			new DXCharRange(11904, 12287),
			new DXCharRange(12688, 12703),
			new DXCharRange(12736, 12783),
			new DXCharRange(12800, 19903),
			new DXCharRange(19968, 40959),
			new DXCharRange(63744, 64255),
			new DXCharRange(65040, 65055),
			new DXCharRange(65072, 65103),
			new DXCharRange(131072, 173791),
			new DXCharRange(194560, 195103)
		};

		private readonly DirectWriteFontFamily fontFamily;

		private readonly DWriteFont1 font;

		private readonly Lazy<DWriteFontFace> fontFace;

		private readonly Lazy<DXFontMetrics> metrics;

		private readonly Lazy<bool> hasKernTable;

		public override string FamilyName => fontFamily.Name;

		public override DXFontMetrics Metrics => metrics.Value;

		public override byte[] Panose => font.GetPanose();

		public override DXFontSimulations Simulations => (DXFontSimulations)((DWriteFont)font).GetSimulations();

		public override DXFontStretch Stretch => (DXFontStretch)((DWriteFont)font).GetStretch();

		public override DXFontStyleSlant Slant => (DXFontStyleSlant)((DWriteFont)font).GetStyle();

		public override DXFontWeight Weight => (DXFontWeight)((DWriteFont)font).GetWeight();

		public DWriteFontFace FontFace => fontFace.Value;

		public override bool IsComplexScript
		{
			get
			{
				IList<DXCharRange> fontCharacterRanges = GetFontCharacterRanges();
				foreach (DXCharRange item in fontCharacterRanges)
				{
					if (IsRangesIntersect(item, complexScripRrange))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsCjk
		{
			get
			{
				IList<DXCharRange> fontCharacterRanges = GetFontCharacterRanges();
				foreach (DXCharRange item in fontCharacterRanges)
				{
					foreach (DXCharRange cjkRange in cjkRanges)
					{
						if (IsRangesIntersect(item, cjkRange))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static DXFontMetrics CreateMetrics(DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1 metrics)
		{
			return new DXFontMetrics(new DXFontMetrics.Builder
			{
				UnitsPerEm = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).DesignUnitsPerEm,
				EmAscent = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).Ascent,
				EmDescent = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).Descent,
				EmLineSpacing = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).Ascent + ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).Descent + ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).LineGap,
				UnderlinePosition = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).UnderlinePosition,
				UnderlineSize = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).UnderlineThickness,
				StrikeoutPosition = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).StrikethroughPosition,
				StrikeoutSize = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).StrikethroughThickness,
				SubscriptSize = new Size(((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).SubscriptSizeX, ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).SubscriptSizeY),
				SuperscriptOffset = new Point(((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).SuperscriptPositionX, ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).SuperscriptPositionY),
				SubscriptOffset = new Point(((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).SubscriptPositionX, ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).SubscriptPositionY),
				SuperscriptSize = new Size(((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).SuperscriptSizeX, ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).SuperscriptSizeY),
				HasTypoMetrics = ((DWRITE_FONT_METRICS1)(ref metrics)).HasTypographicMetrics
			});
		}

		private static bool IsRangesIntersect(DXCharRange first, DXCharRange second)
		{
			if (first.Start <= second.End)
			{
				return second.Start <= first.End;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DirectWriteFont(DirectWriteFontFamily fontFamily, DWriteFont1 font)
		{
			this.fontFamily = fontFamily;
			this.font = font;
			fontFace = new Lazy<DWriteFontFace>(() => ((DWriteFont)font).CreateFontFace(), isThreadSafe: false);
			metrics = new Lazy<DXFontMetrics>(() => CreateMetrics(font.GetMetrics1()));
			hasKernTable = new Lazy<bool>(HasKernTable);
		}

		public override DXFontFileInfo GetFontFile()
		{
			DWriteFontFace val = ((DWriteFont)font).CreateFontFace();
			try
			{
				DWriteFontFile[] files = val.GetFiles();
				return new DXFontFileInfo(val.GetIndex(), files[0].GetData());
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override string GetWin32FamilyName()
		{

		}

		public override IDXShaper CreateShaper(IDXFontFallback fontFallback = null)
		{

		}

		public override bool HasCharacters(StringView str)
		{

				}
			}

			}

	public class DirectWritePrivateFontCollection : DirectWriteFontCollection, IDirectWriteFontProviderListener, IDXPrivateFontCollection, IDXFontCollection, IDisposable
	{
		private class PrivateFontCollection : IDisposable
		{
			private readonly DWriteFactory factory;

			private readonly IList<DWriteFontFile> files = new List<DWriteFontFile>();

			private readonly CCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontCollectionLoader> collectionLoader;

			public DWriteFontCollection Collection { get; private set; }

			public PrivateFontCollection(DWriteFactory factory, DirectWriteFontProvider provider)
			{
				PrivateFontCollection privateFontCollection = this;
				this.factory = factory;
				DirectWriteFontFileLoader fileLoader = provider.FontFileLoader;
				foreach (int fontFileKey in fileLoader.FontFileKeys)
				{
					InteropHelpers.DoActionWithPinnedObject((object)fontFileKey, (Action<IntPtr>)delegate(IntPtr ptr)
					{
						privateFontCollection.files.Add(factory.CreateCustomFontFileReference(ptr, 4, (IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteFontFileLoaderCCW>)fileLoader));
					});
				}
				collectionLoader = DirectWriteFontCollectionLoader.Create(files);
				factory.RegisterFontCollectionLoader((IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteFontCollectionLoaderCCW>)collectionLoader.Value);
				InteropHelpers.DoActionWithPinnedObject((object)0, (Action<IntPtr>)delegate(IntPtr ptr)
				{
					privateFontCollection.Collection = factory.CreateCustomFontCollection((IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteFontCollectionLoaderCCW>)privateFontCollection.collectionLoader.Value, ptr);
				});
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				factory.UnregisterFontCollectionLoader((IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteFontCollectionLoaderCCW>)collectionLoader.Value);
				collectionLoader.Dispose();
				foreach (DWriteFontFile file in files)
				{
					((ComObject)file).Dispose();
				}
				((ComObject)Collection).Dispose();
			}
		}

		private readonly DirectWriteFontProvider fontProvider;

		private PrivateFontCollection privateCollection;

		private bool disposed;

		public override DWriteFontCollection Collection
		{
			get
			{
				lock (base.ThisLock)
				{
					if (privateCollection == null && !disposed)
					{
						privateCollection = new PrivateFontCollection(base.Context.Factory, fontProvider);
					}
					return privateCollection.Collection;
				}
			}
		}

		DWriteFactory IDirectWriteFontProviderListener.Factory => base.Context.Factory;

		public DirectWritePrivateFontCollection(DirectWriteContext context, DirectWriteFontProvider fontProvider)
			: base(context)
		{
			this.fontProvider = fontProvider;
			fontProvider.RegisterListener(this);
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			base.Dispose();
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				DisposeAndClearCollection();
				fontProvider.RemoveListener(this);
				disposed = true;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeAndClearCollection()
		{
			ClearFamilies();
			if (privateCollection != null)
			{
				privateCollection.Dispose();
				privateCollection = null;
			}
		}

		void IDirectWriteFontProviderListener.OnFontsChanged()
		{
			lock (base.ThisLock)
			{
				if (!disposed)
				{
					DisposeAndClearCollection();
				}
			}
		}

		}

	public class DirectWriteTextAnalysis : ComCallableWrapperBase, IDWriteTextAnalysisSinkCCW, IUnknownCCW, IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteTextAnalysisSinkCCW>
	{
		private readonly DWriteTextAnalyzer textAnalyzer;

		private DXTextBuffer<DirectWriteTextRun> runs;

		private DWRITE_LINE_BREAKPOINT[] breakpoints;

		public LinkedList<DirectWriteTextRun> Runs => runs.Runs;

		internal DWRITE_LINE_BREAKPOINT[] Breakpoints => breakpoints;

		IntPtr IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteTextAnalysisSinkCCW>.NativeObject => ((ComCallableWrapperBase)this).QueryInterface<IDWriteTextAnalysisSinkCCW>();

		public static LinkedList<DirectWriteTextRun> GetRuns(DWriteTextAnalyzer textAnalyzer, string text, bool rtlParagraph)
		{
			CCWWrapper<DirectWriteAnalysisSource> val = DirectWriteAnalysisSource.Create(text, 0, text.Length, rtlParagraph);
			try
			{
				CCWWrapper<DirectWriteTextAnalysis> val2 = Create(textAnalyzer, text);
				try
				{
					DirectWriteTextAnalysis value = val2.Value;
					DirectWriteAnalysisSource value2 = val.Value;
					value.AnalyzeLineBreakpoints(value2);
					foreach (DirectWriteTextRun run in value.Runs)
					{
						run.Breakpoints = value.Breakpoints;
					}
					value.AnalyzeBidi(value2);
					value.AnalyzeScript(value2);
					return value.Runs;
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val2)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private static CCWWrapper<DirectWriteTextAnalysis> Create(DWriteTextAnalyzer textAnalyzer, string text)
		{
			return new CCWWrapper<DirectWriteTextAnalysis>(new DirectWriteTextAnalysis(textAnalyzer, text));
		}

		{
			this.textAnalyzer = textAnalyzer;
			int length = text.Length;
			runs = new DXTextBuffer<DirectWriteTextRun>(new DirectWriteTextRun(text, 0, length));
			breakpoints = (DWRITE_LINE_BREAKPOINT[])(object)new DWRITE_LINE_BREAKPOINT[length];
		}

		{
			textAnalyzer.AnalyzeLineBreakpoints((IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteTextAnalysisSourceCCW>)source, 0, source.Length, (IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteTextAnalysisSinkCCW>)this);

		{
			textAnalyzer.AnalyzeBidi((IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteTextAnalysisSourceCCW>)source, 0, source.Length, (IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteTextAnalysisSinkCCW>)this);
		}

		private void AnalyzeScript(DirectWriteAnalysisSource source)
		{
			textAnalyzer.AnalyzeScript((IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteTextAnalysisSourceCCW>)source, 0, source.Length, (IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteTextAnalysisSinkCCW>)this);
		}

	public class DirectWriteFontFileLoader : ComCallableWrapperBase, IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteFontFileLoaderCCW>, IDWriteFontFileLoaderCCW, IUnknownCCW
	{
		private readonly object syncObject = new object();

		private readonly IDictionary<int, ICCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontFileStream>> storage = new Dictionary<int, ICCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontFileStream>>();

		public IEnumerable<int> FontFileKeys => storage.Keys;

		public int Count { get; private set; }

		public IntPtr NativeObject => ((ComCallableWrapperBase)this).QueryInterface<IDWriteFontFileLoaderCCW>();

		public static CCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontFileLoader> Create()
		{
			return new CCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontFileLoader>(new DirectWriteFontFileLoader());
		}

		private DirectWriteFontFileLoader()
		{
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public int CreateStreamFromKey(IntPtr fontFileReferenceKey, int fontFileReferenceKeySize, out IntPtr fontFileStream)
		{
			int key = Marshal.ReadInt32(fontFileReferenceKey);
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				if (storage.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					((ComCallableWrapperBase)value.Value).AddRef();
					fontFileStream = value.Value.NativeObject;
					return 0;
				}
			}
			fontFileStream = IntPtr.Zero;
			return -1;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				ClearCore();
			}
		}

		public int Add(ICCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontFileStream> stream)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				storage.Add(Count, stream);
				return Count++;
			}
		}

		protected override void FreeResources()
		{
			((ComCallableWrapperBase)this).FreeResources();
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				ClearCore();
			}
		}

		private void ClearCore()
		{
			foreach (ICCWWrapper<DirectWriteFontFileStream> value in storage.Values)
			{
				((IDisposable)value).Dispose();
			}
			storage.Clear();
			Count = 0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DirectWriteFontFileStream : ComCallableWrapperBase, IComCallableWrapper<IDWriteFontFileStreamCCW>, IDWriteFontFileStreamCCW, IUnknownCCW

		}

		public int ReleaseFileFragment(IntPtr fragmentContext)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public int GetFileSize(out long fileSize)
		{
			fileSize = Length;
			return 0;
		}

		public int GetLastWriteTime(out long lastWriteTime)
		{
			lastWriteTime = 0L;
			return 0;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Drawing.Internal.Fonts.CrossPlatform

	internal interface IDXTextAnalyzer<TRun> where TRun : IDXTextBufferRun<TRun>
	{
		DXTextBuffer<TRun> Analyze(string text, bool directionRightToLeft);
	}
	internal class CrossPlatformTextAnalyzer : IDXTextAnalyzer<CrossPlatformTextRun>
	{
		private class SimpleTextAnalyzer : IDXTextAnalyzer<CrossPlatformTextRun>
		{
			public DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> Analyze(string text, bool directionRightToLeft)
			{
				IList<DXBreakCondition> breakPoints = DXLineBreakAnalyzer.Instance.GetBreakPoints(text);
				DXLineBreakpoint[] array = new DXLineBreakpoint[text.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = new DXLineBreakpoint(breakPoints[i], text[i]);
				}
				CrossPlatformTextRun sourceRun = new CrossPlatformTextRun(text, 0, text.Length)
				{
					Breakpoints = array,
					Script = "Zyyy"
				};
				return new DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun>(sourceRun);
			}
		}

		private class ScriptIterator
		{
			private readonly DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> runs;

			private UScriptCode runScript;

			private int runStartIndex;

			public static void ScriptBreak(string text, DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> runs)
			{
				new ScriptIterator(runs).ScriptBreak(text);
			}

			private ScriptIterator(DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> runs)
			{
				this.runs = runs;
			}

			private void ScriptBreak(string text)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
				{
					char c = text[i];
					int ch = c;
					if (char.IsHighSurrogate(c) && i < text.Length - 1)
					{
						char c2 = text[i + 1];
						if (char.IsLowSurrogate(c2))
						{
							ch = (c - 55296) * 1024 + c2 - 56320 + 65536;
							i++;
						}
					}
					UScriptCode uScriptCode = ICUInterop.uscript_getScript(ch);
					if (uScriptCode == UScriptCode.USCRIPT_COMMON)
					{
						UnicodeCategory unicodeCategory = char.GetUnicodeCategory(c);
						if (unicodeCategory == UnicodeCategory.Control || unicodeCategory == UnicodeCategory.Format)
						{
							EndRun(i, runScript);
							EndRun(i + 1, uScriptCode, isNonVisual: true);
							continue;
						}
					}
					if (uScriptCode <= UScriptCode.USCRIPT_INHERITED)
					{
						uScriptCode = runScript;
					}
					if (runScript <= UScriptCode.USCRIPT_INHERITED)
					{
						runScript = uScriptCode;
					}
					if (runScript != uScriptCode)
					{
						EndRun(i, runScript);
						runScript = uScriptCode;
					}
				}
				EndRun(text.Length, runScript);
			}

			private void EndRun(int endIndex, UScriptCode currentScript, bool isNonVisual = false)
			{
				int num = endIndex - runStartIndex;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					runs.SetProperties(runStartIndex, num, delegate(CrossPlatformTextRun run)
					{
						run.Script = ICUInterop.uscript_getShortName(runScript);
						run.IsNonVisual = isNonVisual;
					});
				}
				runScript = currentScript;
				runStartIndex = endIndex;
			}
		}

		private const string commonScriptCode = "Zyyy";

		private static bool IsMauiSpecificPlatformWithIcuBug => false;

		public static IDXTextAnalyzer<CrossPlatformTextRun> Instance { get; }

		static CrossPlatformTextAnalyzer()
		{
			if (ICUInterop.IsAvaliable())
			{
				Instance = new CrossPlatformTextAnalyzer();
			}
			else
			{
				Instance = new SimpleTextAnalyzer();
			}
		}

		private static void SetLineBreak(string text, DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> runs)
		{
			DXLineBreakpoint[] array = new DXLineBreakpoint[text.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				array[i] = new DXLineBreakpoint(DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak, char.IsWhiteSpace(c), c == '\u00ad');
			}
			using (UBrk uBrk = new UBrk(text))
			{
				int num;
				while ((num = uBrk.Next()) != -1)
				{
					ULineBreakTag ruleStatus = uBrk.GetRuleStatus();
					DXBreakCondition breakConditionAfter = ((ruleStatus >= ULineBreakTag.UBRK_LINE_SOFT && ruleStatus < ULineBreakTag.UBRK_LINE_SOFT_LIMIT) ? DXBreakCondition.CanBreak : ((ruleStatus < ULineBreakTag.UBRK_LINE_SOFT_LIMIT || ruleStatus >= ULineBreakTag.UBRK_LINE_HARD_LIMIT) ? DXBreakCondition.MayNotBreak : ((IsMauiSpecificPlatformWithIcuBug && text[num - 1] == ' ') ? DXBreakCondition.CanBreak : DXBreakCondition.MustBreak)));
					DXLineBreakpoint dXLineBreakpoint = array[num - 1];
					array[num - 1] = new DXLineBreakpoint(breakConditionAfter, dXLineBreakpoint.IsWhitespace, dXLineBreakpoint.IsSoftHyphen);
				}
			}
			foreach (CrossPlatformTextRun run in runs.Runs)
			{
				run.Breakpoints = array;
			}
		}

		private static DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> GetBidiRuns(string text, bool directionRightToLeft)
		{
			int length = text.Length;
			DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> dXTextBuffer = new DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun>(new CrossPlatformTextRun(text, 0, length));
			using UBiDi uBiDi = new UBiDi(length, 0);
			uBiDi.SetPara(text, directionRightToLeft ? UBiDiLevel.RTL : UBiDiLevel.LTR);
			int num = 0;
			int endPosition;
			UBiDiLevel level;
			do
			{
				uBiDi.GetLogicalRun(num, out endPosition, out level);
				dXTextBuffer.SetProperties(num, endPosition - num, delegate(CrossPlatformTextRun run)
				{
					run.BidiLevel = level.BidiLevel;
				});
				num = endPosition;
			}
			while (endPosition < length);
			return dXTextBuffer;
		}

		public DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> Analyze(string text, bool directionRightToLeft)
		{
			DXTextBuffer<CrossPlatformTextRun> bidiRuns = GetBidiRuns(text, directionRightToLeft);
			ScriptIterator.ScriptBreak(text, bidiRuns);
			SetLineBreak(text, bidiRuns);
			return bidiRuns;
		}
	}

			Breakpoints = breakpoints;
		}

		}
	}
	public class HarfBuzzNativeShaper : ICrossPlatformShaper, IDisposable
	{
		private class ShaperClusterBuilder
		{
			private readonly CrossPlatformTextRun run;

			private readonly hb_glyph_info_t[] infos;

			private readonly hb_glyph_position_t[] positions;

			private readonly int unitsPerEm;

			private readonly float fontSize;

			private List<DXCluster> clusters = new List<DXCluster>();

			public static IList<DXCluster> BuildClusters(CrossPlatformTextRun run, hb_buffer buffer, int unitsPerEm, float fontSize)
			{
				ShaperClusterBuilder shaperClusterBuilder = new ShaperClusterBuilder(run, buffer, unitsPerEm, fontSize);
				shaperClusterBuilder.BuildClusters();
				return shaperClusterBuilder.clusters;
			}

			private ShaperClusterBuilder(CrossPlatformTextRun run, hb_buffer buffer, int unitsPerEm, float fontSize)
			{
				this.run = run;
				infos = buffer.GetGlyphInfos();
				positions = buffer.GetGlyphPositions();
				this.unitsPerEm = unitsPerEm;
				this.fontSize = fontSize;
			}

			private void BuildClusters()
			{
				int num = 0;
				int firsGlyphIndex = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < infos.Length; i++)
				{
					int cluster = infos[i].Cluster;
					if (cluster != num)
					{
						AppendCluster(firsGlyphIndex, i, num, cluster);
						num = cluster;
						firsGlyphIndex = i;
					}
				}
				AppendCluster(firsGlyphIndex, infos.Length, num, run.Length);
			}

			private void AppendCluster(int firsGlyphIndex, int lastGlyphIndex, int firstCharacterIndex, int lastCharacterIndex)
			{
				List<DXGlyph> list = new List<DXGlyph>();
				for (int i = firsGlyphIndex; i < lastGlyphIndex; i++)
				{
					hb_glyph_position_t hb_glyph_position_t = positions[i];
					list.Add(new DXGlyph((ushort)infos[i].Codepoint, ConvertPosition(hb_glyph_position_t.X_advance), new DXGlyphOffset(ConvertPosition(hb_glyph_position_t.X_offset), ConvertPosition(hb_glyph_position_t.Y_offset))));
				}
				int num = lastCharacterIndex - firstCharacterIndex;
				clusters.Add(new DXCluster(list, run.Text.CreateSegment(firstCharacterIndex, num), run.GetBreakpoint(firstCharacterIndex + num - 1), run.BidiLevel));
			}

			private float ConvertPosition(int position)
			{
				return (float)position / 64f / (float)unitsPerEm * fontSize;
			}
		}

		private readonly hb_font_t font;

		private readonly int unitsPerEm;

		private readonly FreeTypeFontFace parentFace;

		public HarfBuzzNativeShaper(FreeTypeFontFace parentFace, hb_font_t font, int unitsPerEm)
		{
			this.parentFace = parentFace;
			this.font = font;
			this.unitsPerEm = unitsPerEm;
		}

		public IList<DXCluster> ShapeRun(CrossPlatformTextRun run, float fontSize, bool useKerning)
		{
			using hb_buffer hb_buffer = new hb_buffer();
			hb_buffer.AddUTF16(run.Text);
			bool flag = run.BidiLevel % 2 != 0;
			hb_buffer.SetDirection(flag ? hb_direction_t.HB_DIRECTION_RTL : hb_direction_t.HB_DIRECTION_LTR);
			hb_buffer.SetScript(HarfBuzzInterop.hb_script_from_string(run.Script));
			HarfBuzzInterop.hb_shape(font, hb_buffer, new hb_feature_t[1] { useKerning ? hb_feature_t.KerningOn : hb_feature_t.KerningOff });
			if (flag)
			{
				hb_buffer.Reverse();
			}
			return ShaperClusterBuilder.BuildClusters(run, hb_buffer, unitsPerEm, fontSize);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			font.Dispose();
		}
	}
	internal interface ICrossPlatformShaper : IDisposable
	{
		IList<DXCluster> ShapeRun(CrossPlatformTextRun textRun, float fontSize, bool useKerning);
	}
	public static class CrossPlatformBidiAnalyzer
	{
		public static IList<DXTextRun> GetBidiRuns(string text, bool isRTLParagraph)
		{
			int length = text.Length;
			using UBiDi uBiDi = new UBiDi(length, 0);
			uBiDi.SetPara(text, isRTLParagraph ? UBiDiLevel.RTL : UBiDiLevel.LTR);
			UBiDiDirection direction = uBiDi.Direction;
			if (direction != UBiDiDirection.UBIDI_MIXED)
			{
				return new DXTextRun[1]
				{
					new DXTextRun(0, length - 1, (direction == UBiDiDirection.UBIDI_RTL) ? ((byte)1) : ((byte)0))
				};
			}
			int num = 0;
			List<DXTextRun> list = new List<DXTextRun>();
			int endPosition;
			do
			{
				uBiDi.GetLogicalRun(num, out endPosition, out var runLevel);
				list.Add(new DXTextRun(num, endPosition - 1, runLevel.BidiLevel));
				num = endPosition;
			}
			while (endPosition < length);
			return list;
		}
	}

	public class CrossPlatformMeasurer : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly hb_font_t font;

		private readonly int unitsPerEm;

		private Action<hb_buffer> action;

		public CrossPlatformMeasurer(hb_font_t font, int unitsPerEm)
		{
			this.font = font;
			this.unitsPerEm = unitsPerEm;
		}

		public float MeasureSingleLineString(string text)
		{
			float width = 0f;
			action = delegate(hb_buffer buffer)
			{
				width += (float)((IEnumerable<hb_glyph_position_t>)buffer.GetGlyphPositions()).Sum((Func<hb_glyph_position_t, long>)((hb_glyph_position_t p) => p.X_advance)) / 64f;
			};
			ProcessLine(text);
			return width;
		}

		public DXShapedGlyphInfo GetShapedGlyphsInfo(string text, float fontSizeInPoints)
		{
			List<short> clusters = new List<short>();
			List<float> widths = new List<float>();
			action = delegate(hb_buffer buffer)
			{
				clusters.AddRange(from i in buffer.GetGlyphInfos()
					select (short)i.Cluster);
				hb_glyph_position_t[] glyphPositions = buffer.GetGlyphPositions();
				widths.AddRange(glyphPositions.Select((hb_glyph_position_t p) => (float)p.X_advance / 64f * fontSizeInPoints / (float)unitsPerEm));
			};
			ProcessLine(text);
			return new DXShapedGlyphInfo(clusters.ToArray(), widths.ToArray());
		}

		private void ProcessLine(string text)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int length = text.Length;
			if (length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			using UBiDi uBiDi = new UBiDi(length, 0);
			uBiDi.SetPara(text, flag ? UBiDiLevel.RTL : UBiDiLevel.LTR);
			RenderLine(uBiDi, text, 0, length);
		}

		private void RenderLine(UBiDi line, string text, int start, int limit)
		{
			UBiDiDirection direction = line.Direction;
			if (direction != UBiDiDirection.UBIDI_MIXED)
			{
				RenderRun(text, start, limit, direction);
				return;
			}
			int num = line.CountRuns();
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				direction = line.GetVisualRun(i, out start, out var pLength);
				RenderRun(text, start, start + pLength, direction);
			}
		}

		private void RenderRun(string text, int start, int limit, UBiDiDirection textDirection)
		{
			using UScriptRun uScriptRun = new UScriptRun(text.Substring(start, limit - start));
			int pRunStart;
			int pRunLimit;
			UScriptCode pRunScript;
			while (uScriptRun.NextRun(out pRunStart, out pRunLimit, out pRunScript))
			{
				RenderRun(text, start + pRunStart, start + pRunLimit, textDirection, pRunScript);
			}
		}

		private void RenderRun(string text, int start, int limit, UBiDiDirection textDirection, UScriptCode script)
		{
			using hb_buffer hb_buffer = new hb_buffer();
			hb_buffer.AddUTF16(text.Substring(start, limit - start));
			hb_buffer.SetDirection((textDirection == UBiDiDirection.UBIDI_LTR) ? hb_direction_t.HB_DIRECTION_LTR : hb_direction_t.HB_DIRECTION_RTL);
			hb_buffer.SetScript(HarfBuzzInterop.hb_script_from_string(ICUInterop.uscript_getShortName(script)));
			HarfBuzzInterop.hb_shape(font, hb_buffer, null);
			action(hb_buffer);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			font.Dispose();
		}
	}

	public class FontConfigFontCollection : IDXFontCollection, IDisposable, IDXWin32FontCollection<FontConfigFont>
	{
		private readonly FcFontSet nativeCollection;

		private readonly Lazy<IDictionary<string, FontConfigFontFamily>> families;

		private readonly Lazy<IDictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FontConfigFont>>> win32Families;

		public IEnumerable<IDXFontFamily> Families => families.Value.Values;

		public static FontConfigFontCollection CreateSystemFontCollection()
		{
			using FcObjectSet fcObjectSet = new FcObjectSet();
			using FcPattern fcPattern = new FcPattern();
			fcPattern.AddBool("scalable", value: true);
			fcObjectSet.Add("family");
			fcObjectSet.Add("index");
			fcObjectSet.Add("slant");
			fcObjectSet.Add("weight");
			fcObjectSet.Add("width");
			fcObjectSet.Add("file");
			fcObjectSet.Add("fontformat");
			fcObjectSet.Add("outline");
			fcObjectSet.Add("scalable");
			return new FontConfigFontCollection(new FcFontSet(fcPattern, fcObjectSet));
		}

		private FontConfigFontCollection(FcFontSet nativeCollection)
		{
			this.nativeCollection = nativeCollection;
			families = new Lazy<IDictionary<string, FontConfigFontFamily>>(CreateFontFamilies);
			win32Families = new Lazy<IDictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FontConfigFont>>>(CreateWin32FontFamilies);
		}

		public IDXFontFamily FindFamily(string familyName)
		{
			families.Value.TryGetValue(familyName, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			nativeCollection.Dispose();
			if (!families.IsValueCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, FontConfigFontFamily> item in families.Value)
			{
				item.Value.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private IDictionary<string, FontConfigFontFamily> CreateFontFamilies()
		{
			IList<FontConfigFont> fonts = nativeCollection.GetFonts();
			return (from f in fonts
				group f by f.FamilyName).ToDictionary((IGrouping<string, FontConfigFont> g) => g.Key, (IGrouping<string, FontConfigFont> g) => new FontConfigFontFamily(g.Key, g.ToArray()), StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
		}

		private IDictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FontConfigFont>> CreateWin32FontFamilies()
		{
			Dictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FontConfigFont>> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, DXWin32Family<FontConfigFont>>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
			foreach (FontConfigFontFamily value2 in families.Value.Values)
			{
				foreach (FontConfigFont font in value2.Fonts)
				{
					using FreeTypeFontFace freeTypeFontFace = new FreeTypeFontFace(font, DXFontSimulations.None);
					string win32FamilyName = freeTypeFontFace.GetWin32FamilyName();
					if (win32FamilyName != null)
					{
						if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(win32FamilyName, out var value))
						{
							value = new DXWin32Family<FontConfigFont>();
							dictionary.Add(win32FamilyName, value);
						}
						value.AddFont(font);
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		public DXFontFace MatchFaceByWin32Name(string win32Name, DXFontStyle style)
		{
			return DXWin32FontSearchHelper.MatchFaceByWin32Name(this, win32Name, style);
		}

		public IEnumerable<DXFontInfo> GetFontsInfo()
		{
			foreach (FontConfigFontFamily value in families.Value.Values)
			{
				foreach (FontConfigFont font in value.Fonts)
				{
					using FreeTypeFontFace face = new FreeTypeFontFace(font, DXFontSimulations.None);
					yield return new DXFontInfo(face.GetWin32FamilyName(), face.Weight == DXFontWeight.Bold, face.Slant == DXFontStyleSlant.Italic, face.TtcIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		DXWin32Family<FontConfigFont> IDXWin32FontCollection<FontConfigFont>.FindWin32Family(string win32FamilyName)
		{
			if (win32Families.Value.TryGetValue(win32FamilyName, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class FreeTypeFontFace : DXFontFace, IFontFace
	{
		private const ushort italicMask = 1;

		private const ushort boldMask = 16;

		private const ushort obliqueMask = 256;

		private readonly Lazy<DXFontMetrics> metrics;

		private readonly Lazy<bool> supportsKerning;

		private readonly IFontFileData fontFileData;

		private readonly int index;

		private readonly DXFontDescriptor descriptor;

		private IntPtr nativeFace;

		public override string FamilyName => descriptor.FamilyName;

		public override DXFontWeight Weight => descriptor.Weight;

		public override DXFontStretch Stretch => descriptor.Stretch;

		public override DXFontStyleSlant Slant => descriptor.Slant;

		public override DXFontSimulations Simulations { get; }

		public override byte[] Panose
		{
			get
			{
				TT_OS2? os = GetOs2();
				if (os.HasValue)
				{
					return os.Value.panose;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override DXFontMetrics Metrics => metrics.Value;

		public int NumFaces => FaceData.num_faces.ToInt32();

		public int TtcIndex => index;

		private FT_FaceRec FaceData => Marshal.PtrToStructure<FT_FaceRec>(nativeFace);

		public override bool IsComplexScript
		{
			get
			{
				TT_OS2? os = GetOs2();
				if (os.HasValue)
				{
					uint value = os.Value.ulUnicodeRange1.GetValue();
					return (value & 0x1400) != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsCjk
		{
			get
			{
				TT_OS2? os = GetOs2();
				if (os.HasValue)
				{
					uint value = os.Value.ulUnicodeRange2.GetValue();
					if ((value & 0x28C00000) != 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					uint value2 = os.Value.ulUnicodeRange3.GetValue();
					if ((value2 & 2) != 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static int GetHheaLineSpacing(TT_HoriHeader? hhea)
		{
			if (hhea.HasValue)
			{
				return hhea.Value.Ascender + Math.Abs(hhea.Value.Descender) + hhea.Value.Line_Gap;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private bool SupportsKerning()
		{
			uint length = 0u;
			IntPtr zero = IntPtr.Zero;
			return FreeTypeInterop.FT_Load_Sfnt_Table(nativeFace, SfntTags.Kern.ToUInt(), 0, zero, ref length) == 0;
		}

		public FreeTypeFontFace(FontConfigFont font, DXFontSimulations simulations)
		{
			DXFontWeight weight = (simulations.HasFlag(DXFontSimulations.Bold) ? DXFontWeight.Bold : font.Weight);
			DXFontStyleSlant slant = (simulations.HasFlag(DXFontSimulations.Italic) ? DXFontStyleSlant.Oblique : font.Slant);
			descriptor = new DXFontDescriptor(font.FamilyName, weight, slant, font.Stretch);
			Simulations = simulations;
			fontFileData = SharedFontFileData.Create(font.FontFilePath);
			index = font.Index;
			nativeFace = FreeTypeInterop.FT_New_Memory_Face(FreeTypeLibrary.Library, fontFileData.NativeObject, fontFileData.Length, index);
			metrics = new Lazy<DXFontMetrics>(CreateFontMetrics);
			DXFontMetrics dXFontMetrics = Metrics;
			FreeTypeInterop.FT_Set_Char_Size(nativeFace, dXFontMetrics.UnitsPerEm, dXFontMetrics.UnitsPerEm, 0, 0);
			supportsKerning = new Lazy<bool>(SupportsKerning);
		}

		public FreeTypeFontFace(FreeTypeFontFace fontFace, DXFontSimulations simulations)
		{
			descriptor = fontFace.descriptor;
			Simulations = simulations;
			index = fontFace.index;
			fontFileData = fontFace.fontFileData.Clone();
			FreeTypeInterop.FT_Reference_Face(fontFace.nativeFace);
			nativeFace = fontFace.nativeFace;
			metrics = new Lazy<DXFontMetrics>(CreateFontMetrics);
			supportsKerning = new Lazy<bool>(SupportsKerning);
		}

		public FreeTypeFontFace(IFontFileData data, int index = 0)
		{
			fontFileData = data;
			nativeFace = FreeTypeInterop.FT_New_Memory_Face(FreeTypeLibrary.Library, fontFileData.NativeObject, fontFileData.Length, index);
			this.index = index;
			TT_OS2? os = GetOs2();
			DXFontWeight dXFontWeight;
			DXFontStretch fileStretch;
			DXFontStyleSlant dXFontStyleSlant;
			if (os.HasValue)
			{
				dXFontWeight = (DXFontWeight)os.Value.usWeightClass;
				fileStretch = (DXFontStretch)os.Value.usWidthClass;
				ushort fsSelection = os.Value.fsSelection;
				dXFontStyleSlant = (((fsSelection & 1) != 0) ? DXFontStyleSlant.Italic : (((fsSelection & 0x100) != 0) ? DXFontStyleSlant.Oblique : DXFontStyleSlant.Regular));
				if ((fsSelection & 0x10) != 0 && dXFontWeight == DXFontWeight.Normal)
				{
					dXFontWeight = DXFontWeight.Bold;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dXFontWeight = DXFontWeight.Normal;
				fileStretch = DXFontStretch.Normal;
				dXFontStyleSlant = DXFontStyleSlant.Regular;
			}
			if (dXFontStyleSlant == DXFontStyleSlant.Regular)
			{
				TT_Postscript? table = GetTable<TT_Postscript>(FT_Sfnt_Tag.POST);
				if ((table.HasValue && Math.Abs(table.Value.ItalicAngle) > 0f) || DXFontNamesHelper.ContainsItalicStyle(GetName(DXFontNameID.FontSubfamily)))
				{
					dXFontStyleSlant = DXFontStyleSlant.Italic;
				}
			}
			descriptor = DXFontNamesHelper.GetDescriptor(GetFamilyName(), dXFontWeight, dXFontStyleSlant, fileStretch);
			metrics = new Lazy<DXFontMetrics>(CreateFontMetrics);
			DXFontMetrics dXFontMetrics = Metrics;
			FreeTypeInterop.FT_Set_Char_Size(nativeFace, dXFontMetrics.UnitsPerEm, dXFontMetrics.UnitsPerEm, 0, 0);
			supportsKerning = new Lazy<bool>(SupportsKerning);
		}

		public override IList<DXCharRange> GetFontCharacterRanges()
		{
			if (FaceData.charmap == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (Marshal.PtrToStructure<FT_CharMapRec>(FaceData.charmap).encoding == FT_Encoding.UNICODE)
			{
				int agindex;
				uint num = FreeTypeInterop.FT_Get_First_Char(nativeFace, out agindex);
				uint num2 = 0u;
				List<DXCharRange> list = new List<DXCharRange>();
				uint start = num;
				while (agindex != 0)
				{
					num2 = num;
					num = FreeTypeInterop.FT_Get_Next_Char(nativeFace, num, out agindex);
					if (num - num2 > 1)
					{
						list.Add(new DXCharRange((int)start, (int)num2));
						start = num;
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override DXFontFileInfo GetFontFile()
		{
			byte[] array = new byte[fontFileData.Length];
			Marshal.Copy(fontFileData.NativeObject, array, 0, array.Length);
			return new DXFontFileInfo(index, array);
		}

		public override float MeasureCharacterWidth(char character, float fontSize)
		{
			uint num = FreeTypeInterop.FT_Get_Char_Index(nativeFace, character);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return 0f;
			}
			FreeTypeInterop.FT_Load_Glyph(nativeFace, num, FT_LoadFlags.NO_SCALE);
			long num2 = Marshal.PtrToStructure<FT_GlyphSlotRec>(FaceData.glyph).metrics.horiAdvance.AsInt();
			return (float)num2 / (float)(int)FaceData.units_per_EM * fontSize;
		}

		public override SizeF MeasureString(string text, float fontSizeInPoints)
		{
			DXFontMetrics dXFontMetrics = Metrics;
			using CrossPlatformMeasurer crossPlatformMeasurer = new CrossPlatformMeasurer(new hb_font_t(nativeFace), dXFontMetrics.UnitsPerEm);
			return new SizeF(crossPlatformMeasurer.MeasureSingleLineString(text) * fontSizeInPoints / (float)Metrics.UnitsPerEm, (float)dXFontMetrics.EmLineSpacing / (float)dXFontMetrics.UnitsPerEm * fontSizeInPoints);
		}

		public override IDXShaper CreateShaper(IDXFontFallback fontFallback = null)
		{
			return new CrossPlatformShaper(this, CrossPlatformTextAnalyzer.Instance, new HarfBuzzNativeShaper(this, new hb_font_t(nativeFace), FaceData.units_per_EM), fontFallback, supportsKerning.Value);
		}

		public override bool HasCharacters(StringView str)
		{
			foreach (int item in new Utf32Enumerator(str))
			{
				if (FreeTypeInterop.FT_Get_Char_Index(nativeFace, (uint)item) == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (nativeFace != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				FreeTypeInterop.FT_Done_Face(nativeFace);
			}
			nativeFace = IntPtr.Zero;
			if (disposing)
			{
				fontFileData.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: true);
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		~FreeTypeFontFace()
		{
			Dispose(disposing: false);
		}

		private DXFontMetrics CreateFontMetrics()
		{
			DXFontMetrics.Builder builder = default(DXFontMetrics.Builder);
			TT_OS2? os = GetOs2();
			TT_Postscript? table = GetTable<TT_Postscript>(FT_Sfnt_Tag.POST);
			TT_HoriHeader? table2 = GetTable<TT_HoriHeader>(FT_Sfnt_Tag.HHEA);
			FT_FaceRec faceData = FaceData;
			builder.UnitsPerEm = faceData.units_per_EM;
			if (os.HasValue)
			{
				TT_OS2 value = os.Value;
				if ((value.fsSelection & 0x80) != 0)
				{
					builder.EmAscent = value.sTypoAscender;
					builder.EmDescent = -value.sTypoDescender;
					builder.EmLineSpacing = builder.EmAscent + builder.EmDescent + value.sTypoLineGap;
					builder.HasTypoMetrics = true;
				}
				else
				{
					builder.EmAscent = value.usWinAscent;
					builder.EmDescent = value.usWinDescent;
					builder.EmLineSpacing = Math.Max(GetHheaLineSpacing(table2), value.usWinAscent + value.usWinDescent);
				}
				builder.StrikeoutPosition = value.yStrikeoutPosition;
				builder.StrikeoutSize = value.yStrikeoutSize;
				builder.SubscriptSize = new Size(value.ySubscriptXSize, value.ySubscriptYSize);
				builder.SubscriptOffset = new Point(value.ySubscriptXOffset, -value.ySubscriptYOffset);
				builder.SuperscriptOffset = new Point(value.ySuperscriptXOffset, value.ySuperscriptYOffset);
				builder.SuperscriptSize = new Size(value.ySuperscriptXSize, value.ySuperscriptYSize);
			}
			else if (table2.HasValue)
			{
				TT_HoriHeader value2 = table2.Value;
				builder.EmAscent = value2.Ascender;
				builder.EmDescent = -value2.Descender;
				builder.EmLineSpacing = GetHheaLineSpacing(table2);
			}
			else
			{
				builder.EmAscent = faceData.ascender;
				builder.EmDescent = -faceData.descender;
				builder.EmLineSpacing = faceData.height;
			}
			if (table.HasValue)
			{
				TT_Postscript value3 = table.Value;
				builder.UnderlinePosition = value3.underlinePosition;
				builder.UnderlineSize = value3.underlineThickness;
			}
			return new DXFontMetrics(builder);
		}

		private TT_OS2? GetOs2()
		{
			return GetTable<TT_OS2>(FT_Sfnt_Tag.OS2);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private T? GetTable<T>(FT_Sfnt_Tag tag) where T : struct
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = FreeTypeInterop.FT_Get_Sfnt_Table(nativeFace, tag);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Marshal.PtrToStructure<T>(intPtr);
		}

		public override string GetWin32FamilyName()
		{
			return GetName(DXFontNameID.FontFamily) ?? FamilyName;
		}

		private string GetName(DXFontNameID nameID)
		{
			int num = FreeTypeInterop.FT_Get_Sfnt_Name_Count(nativeFace);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				FT_SfntName fT_SfntName = FreeTypeInterop.FT_Get_Sfnt_Name(nativeFace, i);
				if ((DXFontNameID)fT_SfntName.name_id == nameID && fT_SfntName.platform_id == Platform.MICROSOFT && (fT_SfntName.encoding_id == 1 || fT_SfntName.encoding_id == 0) && fT_SfntName.language_id == 1033 && fT_SfntName.name != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[fT_SfntName.nameLength];
					Marshal.Copy(fT_SfntName.name, array, 0, fT_SfntName.nameLength);
					return Encoding.BigEndianUnicode.GetString(array);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string GetFamilyName()
		{
			FT_FaceRec faceData = FaceData;
			if (faceData.family_name != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return Marshal.PtrToStringAnsi(faceData.family_name);
			}
			string win32FamilyName = GetWin32FamilyName();
			if (win32FamilyName != null)
			{
				return win32FamilyName;
			}
			return "";
		}
	}
	public class FreeTypeFontFamily : IDXFontFamily, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly object syncObject = new object();

		private readonly string familyName;

		private readonly IList<FreeTypeFontFace> faces;

		public string Name => familyName;

		public IEnumerable<FreeTypeFontFace> Faces => faces;

		public FreeTypeFontFamily(string familyName, FreeTypeFontFace face)
		{
			this.familyName = familyName;
			faces = new List<FreeTypeFontFace>(1) { face };
		}

		public DXFontFace GetFirstMatchingFontFace(DXFontWeight weight, DXFontStretch fontStretch, DXFontStyleSlant style)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				DXFontSearchResult<FreeTypeFontFace> firstMatchingFont = DXFontSearchHelper<FreeTypeFontFace>.GetFirstMatchingFont(faces, weight, fontStretch, style);
				return new FreeTypeFontFace(firstMatchingFont.FontFace, firstMatchingFont.FontSimulations);
			}
		}

		public bool AddFontFace(FreeTypeFontFace fontFace)
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				if (!faces.Any((FreeTypeFontFace f) => f.Weight == fontFace.Weight && f.Stretch == fontFace.Stretch && f.Slant == fontFace.Slant))
				{
					faces.Add(fontFace);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<DXFontInfo> GetFontsInfo()
		{
			List<DXFontInfo> list = new List<DXFontInfo>();
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				foreach (FreeTypeFontFace face in faces)
				{
					if (face.Simulations == DXFontSimulations.None)
					{
						list.Add(new DXFontInfo(face.GetWin32FamilyName(), face.Weight == DXFontWeight.Bold, face.Slant == DXFontStyleSlant.Italic, face.TtcIndex));
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			lock (syncObject)
			{
				foreach (FreeTypeFontFace face in faces)
				{
					face.Dispose();
				}
				faces.Clear();
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Drawing.GdiPlus.Internal
{
	internal class GdiPlusJustifiedStringPainter : GdiPlusJustifiedStringPainterBase
	{
		private readonly GdiPlusGraphics graphics;

		private GdiPlusMeasurer measurer;

		protected override RectangleF ClipBounds
		{
			get
			{
				return graphics.ClipBounds;
			}
			set
			{
				graphics.SetClip(value);
			}
		}

		public static void DrawString(GdiPlusGraphics gr, string text, DXFont font, DXBrush br, RectangleF rect, DXStringFormat sf, bool doClip = true)
		{
			using GdiPlusJustifiedStringPainter gdiPlusJustifiedStringPainter = new GdiPlusJustifiedStringPainter(gr, text, rect, font, br, sf, doClip);
			gdiPlusJustifiedStringPainter.DrawJustifiedString();
		}

		public GdiPlusJustifiedStringPainter(GdiPlusGraphics graphics, string text, RectangleF rect, DXFont font, DXBrush br, DXStringFormat sf, bool doClip)
			: base(text, rect, font, br, sf, graphics.PageUnit, doClip)
		{
			this.graphics = graphics;
			measurer = new GdiPlusMeasurer();
		}

		protected override void DrawString(string s, DXFont font, DXBrush brush, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat format)
		{
			graphics.DrawString(s, font, brush, bounds, format);
		}

		{
			return measurer.MeasureString(text, font, size, stringFormat, unit);

			measurer = null;
			base.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public abstract class GdiPlusJustifiedStringPainterBase : IDisposable
	{
		private class WordInfo : IComparable<WordInfo>
		{
			public string text;

			public RectangleF rect;

			public bool lastInLine;

			public CharacterRange range;

			public int CompareTo(WordInfo obj)
			{
				if (rect.Y != obj.rect.Y)
				{
					return Convert.ToInt32(rect.Y - obj.rect.Y);
				}
				return Convert.ToInt32(rect.X - obj.rect.X);
			}
		}

		private readonly DXFont font;

		private readonly DXBrush brush;

		private readonly RectangleF fitRect;

		private readonly RectangleF clipRect;

		private readonly DXStringAlignment lineAlignment;

		private readonly DXGraphicsUnit unit;

		private readonly string text;

		private readonly bool doClip;

		private DXStringFormat stringFormat;

		private Matrix identityMatrix = new Matrix();

		protected abstract RectangleF ClipBounds { get; set; }

		protected abstract SizeF MeasureString(string text, DXFont font, SizeF size, DXStringFormat stringFormat, DXGraphicsUnit unit);

		protected abstract void DrawString(string s, DXFont font, DXBrush brush, RectangleF bounds, DXStringFormat format);

		protected GdiPlusJustifiedStringPainterBase(string text, RectangleF rect, DXFont font, DXBrush br, DXStringFormat sf, DXGraphicsUnit unit, bool doClip)
		{
			clipRect = rect;
			this.font = font;
			stringFormat = sf.Clone();
			this.text = text;
			brush = br;
			lineAlignment = sf.LineAlignment;
			this.unit = unit;
			stringFormat.Alignment = DXStringAlignment.Near;
			stringFormat.LineAlignment = DXStringAlignment.Near;
			this.doClip = doClip;
			fitRect = clipRect;
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			if (stringFormat != null)
			{
				stringFormat = null;
			}
			if (identityMatrix != null)
			{
				identityMatrix.Dispose();
				identityMatrix = null;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsCR(char ch)
		{
			if (ch != '\n')
			{
				return ch == '\r';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsWhiteSpace(char ch)
		{
			if (ch != ' ' && ch != '\t')
			{
				return IsCR(ch);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsLongHyphen(char ch)
		{
			return ch == '–';
		}

		private static CharacterRange[] GetCharacterRanges(string text)
		{
			List<CharacterRange> list = new List<CharacterRange>();
			int length = text.Length;
			int i = 0;
			bool flag = true;
			do
			{
				int num = i;
				for (; i < length && IsWhiteSpace(text[i]); i++)
				{
					if (IsCR(text[i]))
					{
						flag = true;
						num = i + 1;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					num = i;
				}
				if (i >= length)
				{
					break;
				}
				while (i < length && !IsWhiteSpace(text[i]) && !IsLongHyphen(text[i++]))
				{
				}
				list.Add(new CharacterRange(num, i - num));
			}
			while (i < length);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static float CalcTotalWordsWidth(List<WordInfo> infos)
		{
			float num = 0f;
			foreach (WordInfo info in infos)
			{
				num += info.rect.Width;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void RemeasureWords(List<WordInfo> infos)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < infos.Count; i++)
			{
				SizeF sizeF = MeasureString(infos[i].text, font, SizeF.Empty, stringFormat, unit);
				infos[i].rect.Width = sizeF.Width;
			}
		}

		private void JustifyLine(List<WordInfo> infos)
		{
			bool flag = (stringFormat.FormatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.DirectionRightToLeft) != 0;
			if (infos.Count == 1)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					infos[0].rect.X = fitRect.X;
				}
				infos[0].rect.Width = fitRect.Width;
				return;
			}
			RemeasureWords(infos);
			float wordGap = GetWordGap(infos);
			if (flag)
			{
				infos[infos.Count - 1].rect.X = fitRect.Right - infos[infos.Count - 1].rect.Width;
				for (int num = infos.Count - 2; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					infos[num].rect.X = infos[num + 1].rect.Left - infos[num].rect.Width - wordGap;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < infos.Count; i++)
				{
					infos[i].rect.X = infos[i - 1].rect.Right + wordGap;
				}
			}
		}

		private float GetWordGap(List<WordInfo> infos)
		{
			WordInfo wordInfo = infos[infos.Count - 1];
			if (wordInfo.lastInLine && (stringFormat.FormatFlags & DXStringFormatFlags.DisplayFormatControl) == 0)
			{
				DXStringFormatFlags formatFlags = stringFormat.FormatFlags;
				try
				{
					stringFormat.FormatFlags |= DXStringFormatFlags.MeasureTrailingSpaces;
					return MeasureString(" ", font, SizeF.Empty, stringFormat, unit).Width;
				}
				finally
				{
					stringFormat.FormatFlags = formatFlags;
				}
			}
			return Math.Max(0f, fitRect.Width - CalcTotalWordsWidth(infos)) / (float)(infos.Count - 1);
		}

		private static void AddWordInfoToLines(WordInfo info, Dictionary<float, List<WordInfo>> ht)
		{
			float top = info.rect.Top;
			if (!ht.ContainsKey(top))
			{
				List<WordInfo> list = new List<WordInfo>();
				list.Add(info);
				ht[top] = list;
			}
			else
			{
				ht[top].Add(info);
			}
		}

		private void PerformJustification(WordInfo[] infos)
		{
			if (infos.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<float, List<WordInfo>> dictionary = new Dictionary<float, List<WordInfo>>();
			for (int i = 0; i < infos.Length; i++)
			{
				AddWordInfoToLines(infos[i], dictionary);
			}
			foreach (float key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				JustifyLine(dictionary[key]);
			}
		}

		private bool IsLastWord(CharacterRange range)
		{
			if (range.First + range.Length >= text.Length)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = range.First + range.Length;
			char ch;
			do
			{
				ch = text[num];
				num++;
			}
			while (IsWhiteSpace(ch) && !IsCR(ch) && num < text.Length);
			if (!IsCR(ch))
			{
				return num >= text.Length;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SplitWord(CharacterRange range, Dictionary<float, WordInfo> lines)
		{
			int length = range.Length;
			CharacterRange[] array = new CharacterRange[length];
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new CharacterRange(range.First + i, 1);
			}
			Region[] array2 = CalcRegions(array);
			for (int j = 0; j < length; j++)
			{
				RectangleF[] regionScans = array2[j].GetRegionScans(identityMatrix);
				if (regionScans != null && regionScans.Length != 0)
				{
					RectangleF rectangleF = regionScans[0];
					float top = rectangleF.Top;
					if (!lines.ContainsKey(top))
					{
						WordInfo wordInfo = new WordInfo();
						wordInfo.rect = rectangleF;
						wordInfo.range = new CharacterRange(array[j].First, array[j].Length);
						lines[top] = wordInfo;
					}
					else
					{
						WordInfo wordInfo2 = lines[top];
						wordInfo2.rect = RectangleF.Union(wordInfo2.rect, rectangleF);
						wordInfo2.range.Length++;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (float key in lines.Keys)
			{
				WordInfo wordInfo3 = lines[key];
				wordInfo3.text = text.Substring(wordInfo3.range.First, wordInfo3.range.Length);
				wordInfo3.lastInLine = IsLastWord(wordInfo3.range);
			}
		}

		private WordInfo[] CreateWordInfo(Region region, CharacterRange range)
		{
			RectangleF[] regionScans = region.GetRegionScans(identityMatrix);
			if (regionScans.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (regionScans.Length == 1)
			{
				WordInfo[] array = new WordInfo[1]
				{
					new WordInfo()
				};
				array[0].rect = regionScans[0];
				array[0].text = text.Substring(range.First, range.Length);
				array[0].lastInLine = IsLastWord(range);
				return array;
			}
			Dictionary<float, WordInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<float, WordInfo>();
			SplitWord(range, dictionary);
			WordInfo[] array2 = new WordInfo[dictionary.Count];
			int num = 0;
			foreach (float key in dictionary.Keys)
			{
				array2[num] = dictionary[key];
				num++;
			}
			return array2;
		}

		private WordInfo[] CreateWordInfo(Region[] regions, CharacterRange[] ranges)
		{
			List<WordInfo> list = new List<WordInfo>();
			for (int i = 0; i < regions.Length; i++)
			{
				WordInfo[] array = CreateWordInfo(regions[i], ranges[i]);
				if (array != null && array.Length != 0)
				{
					list.AddRange(array);
				}
			}
			return list.OrderBy((WordInfo info) => info).ToArray();
		}

		private static void CopyRanges(CharacterRange[] from, CharacterRange[] to, int startIndexFrom, int count)
		{
			int num = startIndexFrom;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < count)
			{
				to[num2] = from[num];
				num2++;
				num++;
			}
		}

		private Region[] MeasureCharacterRangesImpl(Font font, StringFormat sf)
		{
			RectangleF layoutRect = fitRect;
			layoutRect.Height = 2.1474836E+09f;
			using Graphics graphics = GraphicsHelper.CreateGraphicsFromHiResImage();
			graphics.PageUnit = (GraphicsUnit)unit;
			return graphics.MeasureCharacterRanges(text, font, layoutRect, sf);
		}

		private Region[] CalcRegions(CharacterRange[] ranges)
		{
			using StringFormat sf = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateStringFormat(stringFormat);
			using Font font = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(this.font);
			return CalcRegions(ranges, font, sf);
		}

		private Region[] CalcRegions(CharacterRange[] ranges, Font font, StringFormat sf)
		{
			if (ranges.Length <= 32)
			{
				sf.SetMeasurableCharacterRanges(ranges);
				return MeasureCharacterRangesImpl(font, sf);
			}
			List<Region> list = new List<Region>();
			CharacterRange[] array = new CharacterRange[32];
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < ranges.Length; i += 32)
			{
				if (i + 32 <= ranges.Length)
				{
					CopyRanges(ranges, array, i, 32);
					sf.SetMeasurableCharacterRanges(array);
					list.AddRange(MeasureCharacterRangesImpl(font, sf));
				}
			}
			int num = ranges.Length % 32;
			if (num != 0)
			{
				CharacterRange[] array2 = new CharacterRange[num];
				CopyRanges(ranges, array2, i - 32, num);
				sf.SetMeasurableCharacterRanges(array2);
				list.AddRange(MeasureCharacterRangesImpl(font, sf));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private float MeasureTextHeight()
		{
			return MeasureString(text, font, new SizeF(fitRect.Width, 999999f), stringFormat, unit).Height;
		}

		private void AdjustWordsYPosition(WordInfo[] infos, float dy)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < infos.Length; i++)
			{
				infos[i].rect.Offset(0f, dy);
			}
		}

		private void CenterWordsVertically(WordInfo[] infos, RectangleF rect)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = rect;
			rectangleF.Height = MeasureTextHeight();
			float dy = (rect.Height - rectangleF.Height) / 2f;
			AdjustWordsYPosition(infos, dy);
		}

		private void AlignWordsToBottom(WordInfo[] infos, RectangleF rect)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = rect;
			rectangleF.Height = MeasureTextHeight();
			float dy = rect.Height - rectangleF.Height;
			AdjustWordsYPosition(infos, dy);
		}

		private void DoClip()
		{
			if (doClip)
			{
				RectangleF rectangleF = clipRect;
				rectangleF.Intersect(ClipBounds);
				ClipBounds = new RectangleF(ClipBounds.X, rectangleF.Y, ClipBounds.Width, rectangleF.Height);
			}
		}

		protected void DrawJustifiedString()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return;
			}
			CharacterRange[] characterRanges = GetCharacterRanges(text);
			if (characterRanges.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Region[] regions = CalcRegions(characterRanges);
			WordInfo[] array = CreateWordInfo(regions, characterRanges);
			PerformJustification(array);
			if (lineAlignment == DXStringAlignment.Center)
			{
				CenterWordsVertically(array, fitRect);
			}
			else if (lineAlignment == DXStringAlignment.Far)
			{
				AlignWordsToBottom(array, fitRect);
			}
			RectangleF clipBounds = ClipBounds;
			try
			{
				DoClip();
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					DrawString(array[i].text, font, brush, array[i].rect, stringFormat);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ClipBounds = clipBounds;
			}
		}
	}

		}
	}
	internal static class GdiPlusDriverStringPainter
	{
		private static readonly PropertyInfo graphicsAccessor = GetProperty<Graphics>("NativeGraphics");

		private static readonly PropertyInfo fontAccessor = GetProperty<Font>("NativeFont");

		private static readonly PropertyInfo brushAccessor = GetProperty<Brush>("NativeBrush");

		private static PropertyInfo GetProperty<T>(string name)
		{
			return typeof(T).GetProperty(name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void DrawDriverString(this Graphics graphics, ushort[] text, Font font, Brush brush, PointF[] positions)
		{
			if (graphics == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("graphics");
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("text");
			}
			if (font == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("font");
			}
			if (brush == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("brush");
			}
			if (positions == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("positions");
			}
			IntPtr graphics2 = (IntPtr)graphicsAccessor.GetValue(graphics);
			IntPtr font2 = (IntPtr)fontAccessor.GetValue(font);
			IntPtr brush2 = (IntPtr)brushAccessor.GetValue(brush);
			int num = Gdi32Interop.GdipDrawDriverString(graphics2, text, text.Length, font2, brush2, positions, 0, IntPtr.Zero);
		}
	}
	public class GdiPlusGraphicsPath : IDXGraphicsPath, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly GraphicsPath gdiPath;

		public int PointCount => gdiPath.PointCount;

		public IReadOnlyList<PointF> PathPoints => gdiPath.PathPoints;

		public IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> PathTypes => SystemDrawingConverter.ConvertPathPointTypes(gdiPath.PathTypes);

		public DXFillMode FillMode
		{
			get
			{
				return (DXFillMode)gdiPath.FillMode;
			}
			set
			{
				gdiPath.FillMode = (FillMode)value;
			}
		}

		public static GraphicsPath Unwrap(IDXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			return ((GdiPlusGraphicsPath)path).gdiPath;
		}

		public static DXGraphicsPath Wrap(GraphicsPath path)
		{
			return new DXGraphicsPath(new GdiPlusGraphicsPath(path));
		}

		public GdiPlusGraphicsPath(DXFillMode fillMode)
		{
			gdiPath = new GraphicsPath((FillMode)fillMode);
		}

		public GdiPlusGraphicsPath(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types, DXFillMode fillMode)
		{
			gdiPath = new GraphicsPath(points.ToArray(), types.Select((DXPathPointType x) => (byte)x).ToArray(), (FillMode)fillMode);
		}

		public GdiPlusGraphicsPath(GraphicsPath path)

			gdiPath = path;
		}

			if (PointCount == 0 || matrix.IsIdentity)
