	public abstract class GdiPlusImage
	{
		internal static Lazy<ImageCodecInfo> TiffCodec = new Lazy<ImageCodecInfo>(() => FindCodec(ImageFormat.Tiff));

		internal static Lazy<ImageCodecInfo> JpegCodec = new Lazy<ImageCodecInfo>(() => FindCodec(ImageFormat.Jpeg));

		private static ImageCodecInfo FindCodec(ImageFormat format)
		{
			ImageCodecInfo[] imageDecoders = ImageCodecInfo.GetImageDecoders();
			foreach (ImageCodecInfo imageCodecInfo in imageDecoders)
			{
				if (imageCodecInfo.FormatID == format.Guid)
				{
					return imageCodecInfo;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static EncoderValue GetTiffCompressionEncoder(DXTiffImageFormatOptions tiffImageFormatOptions)
		{
			if (tiffImageFormatOptions == null)
			{
				return EncoderValue.CompressionLZW;
			}
			return tiffImageFormatOptions.TiffCompression switch
			{
				DXTiffCompression.CCITT3 => EncoderValue.CompressionCCITT3, 
				DXTiffCompression.CCITT4 => EncoderValue.CompressionCCITT4, 
				DXTiffCompression.LZW => EncoderValue.CompressionLZW, 
				DXTiffCompression.Unknown => EncoderValue.CompressionLZW, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException("TiffCompression is not valid"), 
			};
		}

		private static void SaveToTiff(Image bitmap, Stream stream, DXTiffImageFormatOptions tiffImageFormatOptions)
		{
			EncoderValue tiffCompressionEncoder = GetTiffCompressionEncoder(tiffImageFormatOptions);
			using EncoderParameters encoderParameters = new EncoderParameters(1);
			encoderParameters.Param[0] = new EncoderParameter(System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.Compression, (long)tiffCompressionEncoder);
			bitmap.Save(stream, TiffCodec.Value, encoderParameters);
		}

		internal static void SaveToJpeg(Image image, Stream stream, DXJpegImageFormatOptions formatOptions)
		{
			if (formatOptions == null || JpegCodec.Value == null)
			{
				SaveImageResilent(image, stream, delegate(Image i, Stream s)
				{
					i.Save(s, ImageFormat.Jpeg);
				});
				return;
			}
			EncoderParameters encoderParameters = new EncoderParameters(1);
			try
			{
				encoderParameters.Param[0] = new EncoderParameter(System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.Quality, formatOptions.Quality);
				ImageCodecInfo codec = JpegCodec.Value;
				SaveImageResilent(image, stream, delegate(Image i, Stream s)
				{
					i.Save(s, codec, encoderParameters);
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				if (encoderParameters != null)
				{
					((IDisposable)encoderParameters).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void SaveToIco(Image bitmap, Stream stream)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			bitmap.Save(memoryStream, ImageFormat.Png);
			IcoHelper.WriteSingleImageIcoHeader(stream, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height, Image.GetPixelFormatSize(bitmap.PixelFormat) * 4, (uint)memoryStream.Length);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			memoryStream.CopyTo(stream);
		}

		protected static void Save(Image bitmap, Stream stream, DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions)
		{
			if (imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Tiff)
			{
				SaveToTiff(bitmap, stream, imageFormatOptions as DXTiffImageFormatOptions);
			}
			else if (imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Jpeg)
			{
				SaveToJpeg(bitmap, stream, imageFormatOptions as DXJpegImageFormatOptions);
			}
			else
			{
				Save(bitmap, stream, imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat);
			}
		}

		protected static void Save(Image bitmap, Stream stream, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Png)
			{
				bitmap.Save(stream, ImageFormat.Png);
				return;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Jpeg)
			{
				SaveToJpeg(bitmap, stream, null);
				return;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Tiff)
			{
				SaveToTiff(bitmap, stream, null);
				return;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Bmp)
			{
				bitmap.Save(stream, ImageFormat.Bmp);
				return;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Gif)
			{
				bitmap.Save(stream, ImageFormat.Gif);
				return;
			}
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Icon)
			{
				SaveToIco(bitmap, stream);
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException("Specific image format is not supported");
		}

		protected static void SaveImageResilent(Image image, Stream stream, Action<Image, Stream> action)
		{
			try
			{
				action(image, stream);
			}
			catch (ExternalException)
			{
				if (!(image is Bitmap original))
				{
					throw;
				}
				using Bitmap arg = new Bitmap(original);
				action(arg, stream);
			}
		}

		public static DXImage Wrap(Image image)
		{
			if (image == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (image is Bitmap bitmap)
			{
				return new DXBitmap(new GdiPlusBitmap(bitmap));
			}
			return new DXMetafile(new GdiPlusMetafile((Metafile)image));
		}

		internal abstract Image Unwrap(bool cloneImage);

		public bool Equals(IDXImage other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}
	}
	public class GdiPlusMetafile : GdiPlusImage, IDXMetafile, IDXImage, IDisposable, IEquatable<IDXImage>, IEquatable<IDXMetafile>
	{
		private readonly Metafile metafile;

		private readonly Lazy<DXMetafileHeader> header;

		private readonly DXImageProperties imageProperties = new DXImageProperties();

		public SizeF PhysicalDimension => metafile.PhysicalDimension;

		public int Width => metafile.Width;

		public int Height => metafile.Height;

		public DXImageFormatOptions ImageFormatOptions => DXImageFormatOptions.WindowsMetafile;

		public DXMetafileHeader Header => header.Value;

		public float HorizontalResolution => metafile.HorizontalResolution;

		public float VerticalResolution => metafile.VerticalResolution;

		public int NumberOfFrames => 1;

		public object NativeImage => metafile;

		public DXImageProperties ImageProperties => imageProperties;

		public static DXMetafile Wrap(Metafile metafile)
		{
			return new DXMetafile(new GdiPlusMetafile(metafile));
		}

		public GdiPlusMetafile(Metafile metafile)
		{
			this.metafile = metafile;
			header = new Lazy<DXMetafileHeader>(CreateHeader);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			metafile.Dispose();
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions)
		{
			if (imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Emf || imageFormatOptions.ImageFormat == DXImageFormat.Wmf)
			{
				byte[] metafileArray = ImageTool.GetMetafileArray(metafile);
				stream.Write(metafileArray, 0, metafileArray.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				GdiPlusImage.Save(metafile, stream, imageFormatOptions);
			}
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			if (imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Emf || imageFormat == DXImageFormat.Wmf)
			{
				byte[] metafileArray = ImageTool.GetMetafileArray(metafile);
				stream.Write(metafileArray, 0, metafileArray.Length);
			}
			else
			{
				GdiPlusImage.Save(metafile, stream, imageFormat);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public EmfMetafileModel ToEmfMetafileModel()
		{
			using Metafile metafile = (Metafile)this.metafile.Clone();
			IntPtr henhmetafile = metafile.GetHenhmetafile();
			uint enhMetaFileBits = Gdi32Interop.GetEnhMetaFileBits(henhmetafile, 0u, null);
			if (enhMetaFileBits == 0 && Marshal.GetLastWin32Error() != 0)
			{
				Gdi32Interop.DeleteMetaFile(henhmetafile);
				return null;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[enhMetaFileBits];
			Gdi32Interop.GetEnhMetaFileBits(henhmetafile, enhMetaFileBits, array);
			Gdi32Interop.DeleteEnhMetaFile(henhmetafile);
			return EmfMetafileModel.Create(array);
		}

		private DXMetafileHeader CreateHeader()
		{
			MetafileHeader metafileHeader = metafile.GetMetafileHeader();
			return new DXMetafileHeader(metafileHeader.Bounds, metafile.PhysicalDimension, metafileHeader.DpiX, metafileHeader.DpiY);
		}

		public IDXMetafile Clone()
		{
			return new GdiPlusMetafile((Metafile)metafile.Clone());
		}

		internal override Image Unwrap(bool cloneImage)
		{
			if (cloneImage)
			{
				return (Image)metafile.Clone();
			}
			return metafile;
		}

		public bool Equals(IDXMetafile other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return metafile.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is GdiPlusMetafile gdiPlusMetafile)
			{
				return metafile == gdiPlusMetafile.metafile;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void RotateFlip(DXRotateFlipType rotateFlipType)
		{
			metafile.RotateFlip((RotateFlipType)rotateFlipType);
		}

		public IDXGraphics CreateGraphics()
		{
			return new GdiPlusGraphics(metafile);
		}

		public bool IsDisposedOrInvalid()
		{
			return ImageGuard.IsDisposedOrInvalid((Image)metafile);
		}
	}
	public class GdiMultiPageTiffBuilder : IMultiPageTiffBuilder, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly bool disposeImages;

		private readonly Stream stream;

		private DXBitmap multiPageImage;

		private EncoderParameters parameters = new EncoderParameters(2);

		private readonly DXTiffImageFormatOptions imageOptions;

		public GdiMultiPageTiffBuilder(Stream stream, DXTiffImageFormatOptions imageOptions = null, bool disposeImages = true)
		{
			this.stream = stream;
			this.imageOptions = imageOptions;
			this.disposeImages = disposeImages;
			multiPageImage = null;
		}

		public void AppendPage(DXBitmap image)
		{
			EncoderValue tiffCompressionEncoder = GdiPlusImage.GetTiffCompressionEncoder(imageOptions);
			Image image2 = SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(image);
			if (multiPageImage == null)
			{
				using (EncoderParameter encoderParameter = new EncoderParameter(System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.Compression, (long)tiffCompressionEncoder))
				{
					using EncoderParameter encoderParameter2 = new EncoderParameter(System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.SaveFlag, 18L);
					parameters.Param[0] = encoderParameter;
					parameters.Param[1] = encoderParameter2;
					image2.Save(stream, GdiPlusImage.TiffCodec.Value, parameters);
				}
				multiPageImage = image;
				return;
			}
			using (EncoderParameter encoderParameter3 = new EncoderParameter(System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.Compression, (long)tiffCompressionEncoder))
			{
				using EncoderParameter encoderParameter4 = new EncoderParameter(System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.SaveFlag, 23L);
				parameters.Param[0] = encoderParameter3;
				parameters.Param[1] = encoderParameter4;
				SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(multiPageImage).SaveAdd(image2, parameters);
			}
			if (disposeImages)
			{
				image.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (multiPageImage != null)
			{
				using (EncoderParameters encoderParameters = new EncoderParameters(1))
				{
					EncoderParameter encoderParameter = new EncoderParameter(System.Drawing.Imaging.Encoder.SaveFlag, 20L);
					encoderParameters.Param[0] = encoderParameter;
					SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapImage(multiPageImage).SaveAdd(encoderParameters);
				}
				if (parameters != null)
				{
					parameters = null;
				}
				if (disposeImages)
				{
					multiPageImage.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class GdiPlusBitmap : GdiPlusImage, IDXBitmap, IDXImage, IDisposable, IEquatable<IDXImage>, IEquatable<IDXBitmap>
	{
		private const PixelFormat CMYK32bppPixelFormat = (PixelFormat)8207;

		private const int ExifOrientation = 274;

		private Lazy<DXImageProperties> imageProperties;

		private Bitmap bitmap;

		public SizeF PhysicalDimension => bitmap.PhysicalDimension;

		public int Width => bitmap.Width;

		public int Height => bitmap.Height;

		public object NativeImage => bitmap;

		public DXImageFormatOptions ImageFormatOptions { get; }

		public DXPixelFormat PixelFormat { get; }

		public DXPalette Palette { get; }

		public bool CanGetPixels
		{
			get
			{
				if (SecurityHelper.IsUnmanagedCodeGrantedAndHasZeroHwnd)
				{
					return !AzureCompatibility.Enable;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int NumberOfFrames
		{
			get
			{
				if (((ICollection<Guid>)bitmap.FrameDimensionsList).Contains(FrameDimension.Page.Guid))
				{
					return bitmap.GetFrameCount(FrameDimension.Page);
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		public float HorizontalResolution => DXGraphicsDpi.GetSafeResolution(bitmap.HorizontalResolution);

		public float VerticalResolution => DXGraphicsDpi.GetSafeResolution(bitmap.VerticalResolution);

		public DXImageProperties ImageProperties => imageProperties.Value;

		private static DXImageFormatOptions GetTiffImageFormatOptions(Bitmap bitmap)
		{
			int num = Array.IndexOf(bitmap.PropertyIdList, 259);
			if (num != -1)
			{
				PropertyItem propertyItem = bitmap.PropertyItems[num];
				switch (BitConverter.ToInt16(propertyItem.Value, 0))
				{
				case 3:
					return DXImageFormatOptions.TiffCCITT3;
				case 4:
					return DXImageFormatOptions.TiffCCITT4;
				case 5:
					return DXImageFormatOptions.TiffLZW;
				}
			}
			return DXImageFormatOptions.Tiff;
		}

		public static DXBitmap Wrap(Bitmap bitmap)
		{
			return new DXBitmap(new GdiPlusBitmap(bitmap));
		}

		internal GdiPlusBitmap(Bitmap bitmap, DXPixelFormat pixelFormat, DXPalette palette)
		{
			this.bitmap = bitmap;
			PixelFormat = pixelFormat;
			Palette = palette;
			ImageFormatOptions = DXImageFormatOptions.Bmp;
			imageProperties = new Lazy<DXImageProperties>(() => FillImageProperties());
		}

		public GdiPlusBitmap(Bitmap bitmap)
		{
			this.bitmap = bitmap;
			PixelFormat pixelFormat = bitmap.PixelFormat;
			bool indexed = (pixelFormat & System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Indexed) != 0;
			DXAlpha alpha = DXAlpha.No;
			if ((pixelFormat & System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.PAlpha) != System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Undefined)
			{
				alpha = DXAlpha.Premul;
			}
			else if ((pixelFormat & System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Alpha) != System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Undefined)
			{
				alpha = DXAlpha.Unpremul;
			}
			switch (pixelFormat)
			{
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb:
				PixelFormat = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format24Bpp, DXColorSpace.RGB, alpha, indexed);
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppPArgb:
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppArgb:
				PixelFormat = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format32Bpp, DXColorSpace.RGB, alpha, indexed);
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format1bppIndexed:
				PixelFormat = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format1Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, alpha, indexed);
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format4bppIndexed:
				PixelFormat = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format4Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, alpha, indexed);
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format8bppIndexed:
				PixelFormat = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format8Bpp, DXColorSpace.Gray, alpha, indexed);
				break;
			case (PixelFormat)8207:
				PixelFormat = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Format32Bpp, DXColorSpace.CMYK, alpha, indexed);
				break;
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format16bppRgb555:
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format16bppRgb565:
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format32bppRgb:
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format16bppArgb1555:
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format48bppRgb:
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format64bppPArgb:
			case System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format64bppArgb:
				PixelFormat = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Undefined, DXColorSpace.RGB, alpha, indexed);
				break;
			default:
				PixelFormat = new DXPixelFormat(DXBitsPerPixel.Undefined, DXColorSpace.Undefined, alpha, indexed);
				break;
			}
			if (bitmap.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Jpeg))
			{
				ImageFormatOptions = DXImageFormatOptions.Jpeg;
			}
			else if (bitmap.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Tiff))
			{
				ImageFormatOptions = GetTiffImageFormatOptions(bitmap);
			}
			else if (bitmap.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Bmp))
			{
				ImageFormatOptions = DXImageFormatOptions.Bmp;
			}
			else if (bitmap.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Png))
			{
				ImageFormatOptions = DXImageFormatOptions.Png;
			}
			else if (bitmap.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Gif))
			{
				ImageFormatOptions = DXImageFormatOptions.Gif;
			}
			else if (bitmap.RawFormat.Equals(ImageFormat.Icon))
			{
				ImageFormatOptions = DXImageFormatOptions.Icon;
			}
			else
			{
				ImageFormatOptions = DXImageFormatOptions.Unknown;
			}
			if (PixelFormat.Indexed)
			{
				ColorPalette palette = bitmap.Palette;
				Color[] entries = palette.Entries;
				Palette = new DXPalette(entries.Any((Color c) => c.B != c.G || c.G != c.R) ? DXColorSpace.RGB : DXColorSpace.Gray, entries);
			}
			imageProperties = new Lazy<DXImageProperties>(() => FillImageProperties());
		}

		public IDXBitmap Clone()
		{
			return new GdiPlusBitmap((Bitmap)bitmap.Clone());
		}

		public IDXBitmap Convert(DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			return new GdiPlusBitmap(bitmap.Clone(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, bitmap.Size), SystemDrawingConverter.ConvertPixelFormat(pixelFormat)));
		}

		public void ConvertToJpeg(Stream stream, long jpegQuality)
		{
			GdiPlusImage.Save(bitmap, stream, new DXJpegImageFormatOptions((int)jpegQuality));
		}

		public IDXBitmapData GetBitmapData(Rectangle rect, DXImageLockMode lockMode, DXPixelFormat format)
		{
			return new GdiPlusBitmapData(bitmap, rect, lockMode, format);
		}

		public void SetResolution(float horizontalResolution, float verticalResolution)
		{
			bitmap.SetResolution(horizontalResolution, verticalResolution);
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormatOptions imageFormatOptions)
		{
			GdiPlusImage.SaveImageResilent(bitmap, stream, delegate(Image image, Stream s)
			{
				GdiPlusImage.Save(image, s, imageFormatOptions);
			});
		}

		public void Save(Stream stream, DXImageFormat imageFormat)
		{
			GdiPlusImage.SaveImageResilent(bitmap, stream, delegate(Image image, Stream s)
			{
				GdiPlusImage.Save(image, s, imageFormat);
			});
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			bitmap.Dispose();
		}

		public IDXBitmap Crop(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			return new GdiPlusBitmap(bitmap.Clone(rectangle, bitmap.PixelFormat));
		}

		internal override Image Unwrap(bool cloneImage)
		{
			if (cloneImage)
			{
				return (Image)bitmap.Clone();
			}
			return bitmap;
		}

		public Color GetPixel(int x, int y)
		{
			return bitmap.GetPixel(x, y);
		}

		public bool Equals(IDXBitmap other)
		{
			return Equals((object)other);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return bitmap.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is GdiPlusBitmap gdiPlusBitmap)
			{
				return bitmap == gdiPlusBitmap.bitmap;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void RotateFlip(DXRotateFlipType rotateFlipType)
		{
			DXMatrix dXMatrix = DXMatrix.CreateRotateFlipMatrix(rotateFlipType, Width, Height);
			if (dXMatrix.IsIdentity)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
			{
				bool flag = DXMathUtils.NearlyZero(dXMatrix.A);
				Bitmap image = new Bitmap(flag ? bitmap.Height : bitmap.Width, flag ? bitmap.Width : bitmap.Height, bitmap.PixelFormat);
				using (bitmap)
				{
					using Matrix transform = SystemDrawingConverter.CreateMatrix(dXMatrix);
					using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image);
					graphics.InterpolationMode = InterpolationMode.NearestNeighbor;
					graphics.Transform = transform;
					graphics.DrawImage(bitmap, Point.Empty);
				}
				bitmap = image;
			}
			else
			{
				bitmap.RotateFlip((RotateFlipType)rotateFlipType);
			}
		}

		public IDXGraphics CreateGraphics()
		{
			return new GdiPlusGraphics(bitmap);
		}

		public bool IsDisposedOrInvalid()
		{
			return ImageGuard.IsDisposedOrInvalid((Image)bitmap);
		}

		private DXImageProperties FillImageProperties()
		{
			DXImageProperties result = new DXImageProperties();
			FillOrientation(result);
			return result;
		}

		private void FillOrientation(DXImageProperties imageProperties)
		{
			PropertyItem[] propertyItems = bitmap.PropertyItems;
			foreach (PropertyItem propertyItem in propertyItems)
			{
				if (propertyItem.Id == 274)
				{
					PropertyItem propertyItem2 = bitmap.GetPropertyItem(propertyItem.Id);
					short num = BitConverter.ToInt16(propertyItem2.Value, 0);
					DXRotateFlipType dXRotateFlipType = DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipXY;
					if (num == 2)
					{
						dXRotateFlipType = DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipY;
					}
					if (num == 3)
					{
						dXRotateFlipType = DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipNone;
					}
					if (num == 4)
					{
						dXRotateFlipType = DXRotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipX;
					}
					if (num == 5)
					{
						dXRotateFlipType = DXRotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipY;
					}
					if (num == 6)
					{
						dXRotateFlipType = DXRotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipXY;
					}
					if (num == 7)
					{
						dXRotateFlipType = DXRotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipX;
					}
					if (num == 8)
					{
						dXRotateFlipType = DXRotateFlipType.Rotate270FlipNone;
					}
					imageProperties.Add(new DXImageProperty(DXImageExifProperty.Orientation, dXRotateFlipType));
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class GdiPlusBitmapData : IDXBitmapData, IDisposable
	{
		private readonly Bitmap bitmap;

		private readonly BitmapData bitmapData;

		public int RowBytes => bitmapData.Stride;

		public IntPtr DataPointer => bitmapData.Scan0;

		public int Height => bitmapData.Height;

		public GdiPlusBitmapData(Bitmap bitmap, Rectangle rect, DXImageLockMode lockMode, DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			this.bitmap = bitmap;
			bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(rect, (ImageLockMode)lockMode, SystemDrawingConverter.ConvertPixelFormat(pixelFormat));
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
		}
	}

		{

		}

	public class GdiPlusGraphicsObjectsFactory : IDXGraphicsObjectsFactory
	{
		private const int pixelFormatBppMask = 65280;

		private static bool UseEmfMetafile
		{
			get
			{
				if (PlatformHelpers.IsWindows)
				{
					return AzureCompatibility.Enable;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public DXDrawingBackend Backend => DXDrawingBackend.GdiPlus;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void CopyBitmapData(Bitmap bitmap, int stride, PixelFormat gdiPlusPixelFormat, byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			BitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(new Rectangle(Point.Empty, bitmap.Size), ImageLockMode.WriteOnly, gdiPlusPixelFormat);
			try
			{
				if (stride == bitmapData.Stride)
				{
					Marshal.Copy(data, offset, bitmapData.Scan0, stride * bitmap.Height);
					return;
				}
				int num = bitmap.Width * ((int)(gdiPlusPixelFormat & (PixelFormat)65280) >> 8);
				int num2 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)num / 8.0);
				if (num2 > stride)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Source data stride is less than byte-aligned row size");
				}
				IntPtr scan = bitmapData.Scan0;
				for (int i = 0; i < bitmap.Height; i++)
				{
					Marshal.Copy(data, offset, scan, num2);
					scan += bitmapData.Stride;
					offset += stride;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
			}
		}

		private static void CopyPalette(Bitmap bitmap, Color[] palette)
		{
			ColorPalette palette2 = bitmap.Palette;
			Color[] entries = palette2.Entries;
			for (int i = 0; i < palette.Length; i++)
			{
				entries[i] = palette[i];
			}
			bitmap.Palette = palette2;
		}

		public IDXRegion CreateRegion()
		{
			return new GdiPlusRegion(new Region());
		}

		public IDXRegion CreateRegion(RectangleF rectangle)
		{
			return new GdiPlusRegion(new Region(rectangle));
		}

		public IDXRegion CreateRegion(DXGraphicsPath path)
		{
			return new GdiPlusRegion(new Region(SystemDrawingConverter.UnwrapGraphicsPath(path)));
		}

		public IDXRegion CreateRegion(DXRegionDataNode data)
		{
			return DXRegionImplementationBuilder.Build(data, this);
		}

		public IDXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath(DXFillMode fillMode)
		{
			return new GdiPlusGraphicsPath(fillMode);
		}

		public IDXGraphicsPath CreateGraphicsPath(IReadOnlyList<PointF> points, IReadOnlyList<DXPathPointType> types, DXFillMode fillMode)
		{
			return new GdiPlusGraphicsPath(points, types, fillMode);
		}

		public IDXImage CreateImage(Stream stream)
		{
			if (UseEmfMetafile && EmfMetafile.TryCreateEmfMetafile(stream, out var emfMetafile))
			{
				return emfMetafile;
			}
			if (DXSvgImageHelper.IsSvgImage(stream))
			{
				return new SvgImageWrapper(SvgImage.FromStream(stream));
			}
			Image image = Image.FromStream(stream, useEmbeddedColorManagement: true, validateImageData: false);
			if (image is Bitmap bitmap)
			{
				return new GdiPlusBitmap(bitmap);
			}
			return new GdiPlusMetafile((Metafile)image);
		}

		public IDXBitmap CreateBitmap(int width, int height, int stride, PixelFormat gdiPlusPixelFormat, Color[] palette, byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height, gdiPlusPixelFormat);
			try
			{
				if ((gdiPlusPixelFormat & PixelFormat.Indexed) != PixelFormat.Undefined)
				{
					CopyPalette(bitmap, palette);
				}
				CopyBitmapData(bitmap, stride, gdiPlusPixelFormat, data, offset);
				return new GdiPlusBitmap(bitmap);
			}
			catch
			{
				bitmap.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
		}

		public IDXBitmap CreateBitmap(int width, int height, int stride, DXPixelFormat pixelFormat, DXPalette palette, byte[] data, int offset)
		{
			PixelFormat pixelFormat2 = SystemDrawingConverter.ConvertPixelFormat(pixelFormat);
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width, height, pixelFormat2);
			try
			{
				if (pixelFormat.Indexed)
				{
					CopyPalette(bitmap, palette.Colors);
				}
				else if (pixelFormat.ColorSpace == DXColorSpace.Gray)
				{
					ColorPalette palette2 = bitmap.Palette;
					Color[] entries = palette2.Entries;
					int num = 8 - (int)Math.Log(entries.Length, 2.0);
					for (int i = 0; i < entries.Length; i++)
					{
						int num2 = i << num;
						entries[i] = Color.FromArgb(num2, num2, num2);
					}
					bitmap.Palette = palette2;
				}
				CopyBitmapData(bitmap, stride, pixelFormat2, data, offset);
				return new GdiPlusBitmap(bitmap, pixelFormat, palette);
			}
			catch
			{
				bitmap.Dispose();
				throw;
			}
		}

		public IDXBitmap CreateBitmap(int width, int height)
		{
			return new GdiPlusBitmap(new Bitmap(width, height));
		}

		public IDXBitmap CreateBitmap(int width, int height, DXPixelFormat pixelFormat)
		{
			return new GdiPlusBitmap(new Bitmap(width, height, SystemDrawingConverter.ConvertPixelFormat(pixelFormat)));
		}

		public IDXMetafile CreateMetafile(Size size, DXMetafileFrameUnit frameUnit, DXEmfType emfType)
		{
			if (UseEmfMetafile)
			{
				return new EmfMetafile(new EmfMetafileModel(size, frameUnit));
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, size);
			return new GdiPlusMetafile(MetafileCreator.CreateInstance((RectangleF)rectangle, (MetafileFrameUnit)frameUnit, (EmfType)emfType));
		}

		public IDXMetafile CreateMetafile(Stream stream, Size size, DXMetafileFrameUnit frameUnit, DXEmfType emfType)
		{
			if (UseEmfMetafile)
			{
				return new EmfMetafile(new EmfMetafileModel(size, frameUnit));
			}
			return new GdiPlusMetafile(MetafileCreator.CreateInstance(stream, size.Width, size.Height, (MetafileFrameUnit)frameUnit, (EmfType)emfType));
		}

		public IDXMeasurer CreateMeasurer()
		{
			return new GdiPlusMeasurer();
		}

		public IDXPlatformFont CreatePlatformFont(DXFont font)
		{
			return new GdiPlusPlatformFont(SystemDrawingConverter.CreateFont(font));
		}

		public IMultiPageTiffBuilder CreateMultiPageTiffBuilder(Stream ouputStream, DXTiffImageFormatOptions imageOptions, bool disposeImages)
		{
			return new GdiMultiPageTiffBuilder(ouputStream, imageOptions, disposeImages);
		}

		public DXFontEngine CreateFontEngine()
		{
			return CreatePlatformEngine();
		}

		private static DXFontEngine CreatePlatformEngine()
		{
			return Environment.OSVersion.Platform switch
			{
				PlatformID.Win32NT => CreateEngine(DXEngineType.DirectWrite), 
				PlatformID.Unix => CreateEngine(DXEngineType.CrossPlatform), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static DXFontEngine CreateEngine(DXEngineType type)
		{
			return type switch
			{
				DXEngineType.DirectWrite => new DirectWriteFontEngine(), 
				DXEngineType.CrossPlatform => new CrossPlatformFontEngine(), 
				_ => throw new Exception("todo"), 
			};
		}

		public void ApplyWorkarounds()
		{
		}
	}
